units.italian: Consegna di beneficenza

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|description|26|0
units.english: Deliver a care package of <cargo> to <destination>, as part of a charity initiative.
units.italian: Consegna un pacco di aiuti di <cargo> a <destination>, nell'ambito di un'iniziativa di beneficenza.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|A Kimek in a blue uniform approaches you. "Good day, Captain. Interested in helping with some charity work, would you be?" she asks.|45|0
units.english: A Kimek in a blue uniform approaches you. "Good day, Captain. Interested in helping with some charity work, would you be?" she asks.
units.italian: Un Kimek in uniforme blu ti si avvicina. "Buongiorno, Capitano. A dare una mano con un po' di beneficenza, tu interessato saresti?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"What sort of charity work?"|47|0
units.english: "What sort of charity work?"
units.italian: "Di che tipo di beneficenza si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"Sorry, I'm busy right now."|48|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, sono occupato in questo momento."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"Very prosperous, many Kimek worlds have become, but still lagging behind, a few of our planets are," she explains. "Very poor, the people of <planet> are, and many amenities such as computers and communicators, they lack. To help them, our more fortunate want, and offered up many supplies, they have. In need of captains to transport them to <planet>, we are. Offer <payment> for your assistance, we can," she finishes, looking at your ship.|50|0
units.english: "Very prosperous, many Kimek worlds have become, but still lagging behind, a few of our planets are," she explains. "Very poor, the people of <planet> are, and many amenities such as computers and communicators, they lack. To help them, our more fortunate want, and offered up many supplies, they have. In need of captains to transport them to <planet>, we are. Offer <payment> for your assistance, we can," she finishes, looking at your ship.
units.italian: "Molto prosperi, molti mondi Kimek sono diventati, ma ancora indietro, alcuni dei nostri pianeti restano," spiega. "Molto povera, la gente di <planet> è, e molte comodità come computer e comunicatori, gli mancano. Aiutarli, i nostri più fortunate vogliono, e molte provviste hanno offerto. Di capitani che le trasportino su <planet>, noi abbiamo bisogno. Offrire <payment> per il tuo aiuto, noi possiamo," conclude, guardando la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"I'd be glad to help you. Have the supplies loaded into my ship."|52|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help you. Have the supplies loaded into my ship."
units.italian: "Sarò lieto di aiutarti. Fai caricare le provviste sulla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"That's a noble cause, but I don't work as a cargo hauler, sorry."|53|0
units.english: "That's a noble cause, but I don't work as a cargo hauler, sorry."
units.italian: "È una causa nobile, ma non faccio il trasportatore di merci, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	Her mouth produces something of a chirping, clicking sound. "Grateful I am, Captain. Be able to pay you as well as some other jobs, we may not, but know that helping many, you will be. Of that, assure you I do."|55|0
units.english: Her mouth produces something of a chirping, clicking sound. "Grateful I am, Captain. Be able to pay you as well as some other jobs, we may not, but know that helping many, you will be. Of that, assure you I do."
units.italian: La sua bocca produce una specie di suono cinguettante e schioccante. "Riconoscente, io sono, Capitano. Pagarti come farebbero altri lavori, noi forse non potremo, ma sappi che aiuterai molti. Di questo, ti assicuro io."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	She signals to some workers with similar uniforms, and in a few minutes they bring the cargo crates to your ship. She explains that more of her colleagues are already on <planet> working with more captains and suggests you look for them when you arrive. She thanks you again, and wishes you a good trip to <planet>.|56|0
units.english: She signals to some workers with similar uniforms, and in a few minutes they bring the cargo crates to your ship. She explains that more of her colleagues are already on <planet> working with more captains and suggests you look for them when you arrive. She thanks you again, and wishes you a good trip to <planet>.
units.italian: Fa cenno ad alcuni operai con uniformi simili, e in pochi minuti portano le casse di carico alla tua nave. Spiega che altri suoi colleghi sono già su <planet> a lavorare con altri capitani e ti suggerisce di cercarli quando arrivi. Ti ringrazia di nuovo e ti augura un buon viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|log|60|0
units.english: One of the things Chiree does for the Lunarium is to maintain and operate a "charity" in Kimek space, both to help the less fortunate of the Coalition and also obfuscate the Lunarium's activities from the Heliarchs and their agents.
units.italian: Una delle cose che Chiree fa per il Lunarium è mantenere e gestire una "beneficenza" nello spazio Kimek, sia per aiutare i meno fortunati della Coalizione sia per mascherare le attività del Lunarium agli occhi degli Heliarchs e dei loro agenti.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|A Kimek in a blue uniform approaches you, and you recognize her as Chiree, the Lunarium leader you met when joining them. She asks to speak in private, and you two go inside your ship. "Much better," she says once the hatch is closed. "Easier to explain to you the job, it will be, if speak freely and truly of it, I can.|61|0
units.english: A Kimek in a blue uniform approaches you, and you recognize her as Chiree, the Lunarium leader you met when joining them. She asks to speak in private, and you two go inside your ship. "Much better," she says once the hatch is closed. "Easier to explain to you the job, it will be, if speak freely and truly of it, I can.
units.italian: Un Kimek in uniforme blu ti si avvicina, e riconosci in lei Chiree, la leader del Lunarium che hai conosciuto quando ti sei unito a loro. Chiede di parlare in privato, e voi due entrate nella tua nave. "Molto meglio," dice quando il portello è chiuso. "Più facile spiegarti il lavoro sarà, se parlarne liberamente e sinceramente io potrò.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"A 'charity' of sorts in Kimek space, me and other members maintain. True and honest, the donations we receive are, and glad to help those in need within our region, we are. But, also a great cover for certain Lunarium cargo transfers, it is. Wish to enlist your help in that, we do."|62|0
units.english: "A 'charity' of sorts in Kimek space, me and other members maintain. True and honest, the donations we receive are, and glad to help those in need within our region, we are. But, also a great cover for certain Lunarium cargo transfers, it is. Wish to enlist your help in that, we do."
units.italian: "Una 'beneficenza' di sorta nello spazio Kimek, io e altri membri gestiamo. Vere e oneste, le donazioni che riceviamo sono, e felici di aiutare chi è nel bisogno nella nostra regione, noi siamo. Ma anche un'ottima copertura per certi trasferimenti di carico del Lunarium, essa è. Arruolare il tuo aiuto in questo, noi vogliamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"What will I be transporting?"|64|0
units.english: "What will I be transporting?"
units.italian: "Che cosa trasporterò?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"Sorry, I'm not available for that now."|65|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not available for that now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ora non sono disponibile per questo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"A regular delivery, this one is. Some tech and amenity goods, to <planet>, a poorer world, you would transport. Wish to risk your valuable aid with a dangerous smuggling task right away, we do not, so help you build a background with the charity, we will. Paid only <payment> for this, you would be, but promise you much greater bounties further down the line, I do."|67|0
units.english: "A regular delivery, this one is. Some tech and amenity goods, to <planet>, a poorer world, you would transport. Wish to risk your valuable aid with a dangerous smuggling task right away, we do not, so help you build a background with the charity, we will. Paid only <payment> for this, you would be, but promise you much greater bounties further down the line, I do."
units.italian: "Una consegna normale, questa è. Alcune merci tecnologiche e di comfort, a <planet>, un mondo più povero, tu trasporteresti. Mettere a rischio il tuo prezioso aiuto con un pericoloso lavoro di contrabbando subito, noi non vogliamo, quindi aiutarti a costruire una copertura con la beneficenza, noi faremo. Pagato solo <payment> per questo, tu saresti, ma prometterti ricompense molto maggiori più avanti, io posso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"Alright, I'll do what I can."|69|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll do what I can."
units.italian: "Va bene, farò quello che posso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"I actually have some more pressing missions I need to get to, sorry."|70|0
units.english: "I actually have some more pressing missions I need to get to, sorry."
units.italian: "Ho in realtà missioni più urgenti a cui dedicarmi, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	Her mouth produces something of a chirping, clicking sound. "Good. Very good. Have the goods brought in shortly, I will." She leaves your ship, signals to some workers with similar uniforms, and in a few minutes they bring the cargo crates to your ship. She explains that more of her colleagues are already on <planet> working with more captains and suggests you look for them when you arrive. She thanks you again, and wishes you a good trip to <planet>.|72|0
units.english: Her mouth produces something of a chirping, clicking sound. "Good. Very good. Have the goods brought in shortly, I will." She leaves your ship, signals to some workers with similar uniforms, and in a few minutes they bring the cargo crates to your ship. She explains that more of her colleagues are already on <planet> working with more captains and suggests you look for them when you arrive. She thanks you again, and wishes you a good trip to <planet>.
units.italian: La sua bocca produce una specie di suono cinguettante e schioccante. "Bene. Molto bene. Far portare subito la merce, io farò." Lascia la tua nave, fa cenno ad alcuni operai con uniformi simili, e in pochi minuti portano le casse di carico alla tua nave. Spiega che altri suoi colleghi sono già su <planet> a lavorare con altri capitani e ti suggerisce di cercarli quando arrivi. Ti ringrazia di nuovo e ti augura un buon viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|log|76|0
units.english: Agreed to help a Kimek charity by transporting some supplies to one of their poorer worlds.
units.italian: Hai accettato di aiutare una beneficenza Kimek trasportando alcune provviste verso uno dei loro mondi più poveri.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|dialog|78|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the charity supplies hasn't entered this system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con le provviste benefiche non è ancora entrata in questo sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|You find the local charity workers, and they begin unloading the supplies from your ship. When they're about done, you receive a transmission from the Kimek who gave you the job.|85|0
units.english: You find the local charity workers, and they begin unloading the supplies from your ship. When they're about done, you receive a transmission from the Kimek who gave you the job.
units.italian: Trovi gli operatori della beneficenza locale, e cominciano a scaricare le provviste dalla tua nave. Quando hanno quasi finito, ricevi una trasmissione dal Kimek che ti ha dato il lavoro.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"Grateful for your services I am, Captain. As simple to you as the job may seem, a great help for those in need, these deliveries are. Contact you again, we shall, if interested in helping more, you are," she says. Once the workers are done, they hand you <payment> and move the crates to a building where Kimek are lining up to receive the supplies. Other workers continue to unload more cargo from arriving ships.|86|0
units.english: "Grateful for your services I am, Captain. As simple to you as the job may seem, a great help for those in need, these deliveries are. Contact you again, we shall, if interested in helping more, you are," she says. Once the workers are done, they hand you <payment> and move the crates to a building where Kimek are lining up to receive the supplies. Other workers continue to unload more cargo from arriving ships.
units.italian: "Riconoscente per i tuoi servizi, io sono, Capitano. Per quanto semplice ti possa sembrare il lavoro, un grande aiuto per chi è nel bisogno, queste consegne sono. Contattarti di nuovo, noi dovremo, se interessato ad aiutare ancora, tu sarai," dice. Quando gli operai hanno finito, ti consegnano <payment> e portano le casse in un edificio dove i Kimek fanno la fila per ricevere le provviste. Altri operai continuano a scaricare altro carico dalle navi in arrivo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|You find the local charity workers, and they begin unloading the supplies from your ship. When they're about done, you receive a transmission from Chiree.|89|0
units.english: You find the local charity workers, and they begin unloading the supplies from your ship. When they're about done, you receive a transmission from Chiree.
units.italian: Trovi gli operatori della beneficenza locale, e cominciano a scaricare le provviste dalla tua nave. Quando hanno quasi finito, ricevi una trasmissione da Chiree.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1|	"A simple job it was, Captain, but important nonetheless. More work for you, we'll have, so ask that you keep watch for more members in Kimek space, I do." Once the workers are done, they hand you <payment>, and move the crates to a building where Kimek are lining up to receive the supplies. Other workers continue to unload more cargo from arriving ships.|90|0
units.english: "A simple job it was, Captain, but important nonetheless. More work for you, we'll have, so ask that you keep watch for more members in Kimek space, I do." Once the workers are done, they hand you <payment>, and move the crates to a building where Kimek are lining up to receive the supplies. Other workers continue to unload more cargo from arriving ships.
units.italian: "Un lavoro semplice è stato, Capitano, ma importante comunque. Altro lavoro per te, noi avremo, quindi chiedo che tu tenga d'occhio altri membri nello spazio Kimek, io faccio." Quando gli operai hanno finito, ti consegnano <payment> e portano le casse in un edificio dove i Kimek fanno la fila per ricevere le provviste. Altri operai continuano a scaricare altro carico dalle navi in arrivo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|name|95|0
units.english: Charity Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di beneficenza

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|description|96|0
units.english: Bring <cargo> and <bunks> doctors to <destination>, to aid the poor Kimek on the planet who are suffering through harsh winter conditions.
units.italian: Porta <cargo> e <bunks> medici a <destination>, per aiutare i poveri Kimek del pianeta che soffrono per le dure condizioni invernali.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|As you make your way through the spaceport on <origin>, a Kimek in a blue uniform sees you and approaches. You recognize her as the charity worker who had you deliver some supplies to the poor Kimek world of Fourth Shadow.|114|0
units.english: As you make your way through the spaceport on <origin>, a Kimek in a blue uniform sees you and approaches. You recognize her as the charity worker who had you deliver some supplies to the poor Kimek world of Fourth Shadow.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto su <origin>, un Kimek in uniforme blu ti vede e ti si avvicina. Riconosci in lei l'operatrice della beneficenza che ti aveva fatto consegnare delle provviste al povero mondo Kimek di Fourth Shadow.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"Again we meet, Captain <last>! In some more charity work, are you interested?"|115|0
units.english: "Again we meet, Captain <last>! In some more charity work, are you interested?"
units.italian: "Ci incontriamo di nuovo, Capitano <last>! In altro lavoro di beneficenza, tu interessato sei?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"I'd love to. What do you need me to do?"|117|0
units.english: "I'd love to. What do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Ne sarei felice. Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"Sorry, charity doesn't pay much and I'm kind of in need of cash."|118|0
units.english: "Sorry, charity doesn't pay much and I'm kind of in need of cash."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, la beneficenza non paga granché e ho un po' bisogno di soldi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"An ever-colder world, <planet> is. Left the planet, many have, but wish to abandon their homes, lots of Kimek there do not," she explains. "Lacking proper winter clothing for the harsher weather, many are, and led to many job losses, the snowfall has, so delivering various coats and warm clothing pieces, we are."|120|0
units.english: "An ever-colder world, <planet> is. Left the planet, many have, but wish to abandon their homes, lots of Kimek there do not," she explains. "Lacking proper winter clothing for the harsher weather, many are, and led to many job losses, the snowfall has, so delivering various coats and warm clothing pieces, we are."
units.italian: "Un mondo sempre più freddo, <planet> è. Lasciato il pianeta, molti hanno, ma abbandonare le loro case, molti Kimek laggiù non vogliono," spiega. "Privi di abiti invernali adatti al clima più rigido, molti sono, e causato molti licenziamenti, le nevicate hanno, quindi consegnare vari cappotti e capi caldi, noi stiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	She slowly raises up one leg, struggles for footing with her other five, and waves to a group of other Kimek with the same blue uniform. They come to you and she continues. "Unsuited for such cold climates, we Kimek are, so fall to illnesses, many on <planet> also do. Agreed to help them, these fine doctors have," she says, pointing to the <bunks> Kimek doctors, who all greet you briefly with nods and some leg movement. "Received more incentive funds, we have, so as thanks for your continued assistance, paid more than last time you will be. Help compensate you enough for how much this helps, <payment> hopefully will."|121|0
units.english: She slowly raises up one leg, struggles for footing with her other five, and waves to a group of other Kimek with the same blue uniform. They come to you and she continues. "Unsuited for such cold climates, we Kimek are, so fall to illnesses, many on <planet> also do. Agreed to help them, these fine doctors have," she says, pointing to the <bunks> Kimek doctors, who all greet you briefly with nods and some leg movement. "Received more incentive funds, we have, so as thanks for your continued assistance, paid more than last time you will be. Help compensate you enough for how much this helps, <payment> hopefully will."
units.italian: Solleva lentamente una zampa, cerca l'equilibrio con le altre cinque e fa cenno a un gruppo di altri Kimek con la stessa uniforme blu. Si avvicinano e lei continua. "Non adatti a climi così freddi, noi Kimek siamo, quindi si ammalano, molti su <planet> lo fanno. Accettato di aiutarli, questi bravi medici hanno," dice, indicando i <bunks> medici Kimek, che ti salutano brevemente con cenni del capo e un po' di movimento delle zampe. "Ricevuto altri fondi di incentivo, noi abbiamo, quindi come ringraziamento per il tuo continuo aiuto, pagato più dell'ultima volta tu sarai. Compensarti abbastanza per quanto questo aiuta, <payment> speriamo possa."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	Some workers bring <cargo> into your ship, while you show the <bunks> Kimek doctors their bunks. The Kimek who met you here wishes you all a safe trip to <planet>, and moves on to speak with some other captains.|122|0
units.english: Some workers bring <cargo> into your ship, while you show the <bunks> Kimek doctors their bunks. The Kimek who met you here wishes you all a safe trip to <planet>, and moves on to speak with some other captains.
units.italian: Alcuni operai portano <cargo> sulla tua nave, mentre tu mostri ai <bunks> medici Kimek le loro cuccette. Il Kimek che ti ha accolto qui ti augura un buon viaggio verso <planet> e si allontana per parlare con altri capitani.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|As you make your way through the spaceport on <origin>, a Kimek in a blue uniform sees you and approaches. You quickly recognize Chiree, and gesture for her to follow you into your ship. "Thank you, Captain," she says once you're both inside. "Another 'charity' job for you, I have. With some passengers, this time."|125|0
units.english: As you make your way through the spaceport on <origin>, a Kimek in a blue uniform sees you and approaches. You quickly recognize Chiree, and gesture for her to follow you into your ship. "Thank you, Captain," she says once you're both inside. "Another 'charity' job for you, I have. With some passengers, this time."
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto su <origin>, un Kimek in uniforme blu ti vede e ti si avvicina. Riconosci subito Chiree e le fai cenno di seguirti nella tua nave. "Grazie, Capitano," dice quando siete entrambi dentro. "Un altro lavoro di 'beneficenza' per te, io ho. Con dei passeggeri, questa volta."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"Just a normal delivery again?"|127|0
units.english: "Just a normal delivery again?"
units.italian: "Di nuovo una consegna normale?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in helping with this kind of work anymore."|128|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in helping with this kind of work anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono più interessato ad aiutare con questo genere di lavoro."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"No," she is quick to respond. "Well, not entirely. In need of more winter clothing, citizens on <planet> are. Also in need of doctors to combat many illnesses the cold there brings, they are. Transport <bunks> passengers there, you also would. Doctors, two of them are. Headed there to help treat the sick in a hospital. As for the other three... 'researchers' of ours, the best way to describe them is. Of course, if questioned, say that all <bunks> of them are doctors, you must."|130|0
units.english: "No," she is quick to respond. "Well, not entirely. In need of more winter clothing, citizens on <planet> are. Also in need of doctors to combat many illnesses the cold there brings, they are. Transport <bunks> passengers there, you also would. Doctors, two of them are. Headed there to help treat the sick in a hospital. As for the other three... 'researchers' of ours, the best way to describe them is. Of course, if questioned, say that all <bunks> of them are doctors, you must."
units.italian: "No," risponde pronta. "Beh, non del tutto. Di più abiti invernali, i cittadini su <planet> hanno bisogno. Anche di medici per combattere le molte malattie che il freddo porta laggiù, hanno bisogno. Trasportare <bunks> passeggeri laggiù, tu anche dovresti. Medici, due di loro sono. Diretti là per curare i malati in un ospedale. Quanto agli altri tre... 'ricercatori' nostri, il modo migliore per descriverli è. Naturalmente, se ti fanno domande, dire che tutti e <bunks> sono medici, tu devi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"Alright, I'll take them there."|132|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll take them there."
units.italian: "Va bene, li porto io."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in helping with this kind of work anymore."|133|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in helping with this kind of work anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono più interessato ad aiutare con questo genere di lavoro."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	She leaves your ship, and meets with a nearby group of <bunks> other Kimek - your passengers, you imagine - before having some workers load up the cargo into your ship. The Kimek greet you briefly with nods and some leg movement as you meet them, and after the cargo is ready, you show them to their bunks.|135|0
units.english: She leaves your ship, and meets with a nearby group of <bunks> other Kimek - your passengers, you imagine - before having some workers load up the cargo into your ship. The Kimek greet you briefly with nods and some leg movement as you meet them, and after the cargo is ready, you show them to their bunks.
units.italian: Lascia la tua nave e incontra un gruppo vicino di <bunks> altri Kimek - i tuoi passeggeri, immagini - prima di far caricare il carico sulla tua nave da alcuni operai. I Kimek ti salutano brevemente con cenni del capo e un po' di movimento delle zampe mentre li incontri, e quando il carico è pronto li accompagni alle loro cuccette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|	"Paid <payment> for this job, you will be. Have a safe trip, Captain," Chiree says before leaving.|136|0
units.english: "Paid <payment> for this job, you will be. Have a safe trip, Captain," Chiree says before leaving.
units.italian: "Pagato <payment> per questo lavoro, tu sarai. Fai buon viaggio, Capitano," dice Chiree prima di uscire.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|dialog|141|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the charity supplies and Kimek doctors hasn't entered this system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con le provviste benefiche e i medici Kimek non è ancora entrata in questo sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|More blue-uniformed workers are waiting when you land, though these uniforms consist of incredibly thick, bulky coats. They take the crates out of your ship while the doctors are directed to a hospital building, and <payment> are transferred to you when the workers are done. They thank you for your help and ask that you look for them in Kimek worlds if you wish to continue helping.|148|0
units.english: More blue-uniformed workers are waiting when you land, though these uniforms consist of incredibly thick, bulky coats. They take the crates out of your ship while the doctors are directed to a hospital building, and <payment> are transferred to you when the workers are done. They thank you for your help and ask that you look for them in Kimek worlds if you wish to continue helping.
units.italian: Altri operai in uniforme blu ti aspettano quando atterri, anche se queste uniformi sono cappotti incredibilmente spessi e ingombranti. Prendono le casse dalla tua nave mentre i medici vengono indirizzati a un edificio ospedaliero, e <payment> ti vengono trasferiti quando gli operai hanno finito. Ti ringraziano per l'aiuto e ti chiedono di cercarli sui mondi Kimek se vuoi continuare ad aiutare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2|More blue-uniformed workers are waiting when you land, though these uniforms consist of incredibly thick, bulky coats. They take the crates out of your ship while the "doctors" are directed to a hospital building, and <payment> are transferred to you when the workers are done. They thank you for your help, and come in close as they're about to leave, quietly asking that you look for more members on worlds in northern Kimek space.|151|0
units.english: More blue-uniformed workers are waiting when you land, though these uniforms consist of incredibly thick, bulky coats. They take the crates out of your ship while the "doctors" are directed to a hospital building, and <payment> are transferred to you when the workers are done. They thank you for your help, and come in close as they're about to leave, quietly asking that you look for more members on worlds in northern Kimek space.
units.italian: Altri operai in uniforme blu ti aspettano quando atterri, anche se queste uniformi sono cappotti incredibilmente spessi e ingombranti. Prendono le casse dalla tua nave mentre i "medici" vengono indirizzati a un edificio ospedaliero, e <payment> ti vengono trasferiti quando gli operai hanno finito. Ti ringraziano per l'aiuto, e si avvicinano quando stanno per andarsene, chiedendoti sottovoce di cercare altri membri sui mondi nello spazio Kimek settentrionale.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|name|156|0
units.english: Charity Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di beneficenza

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|description|157|0
units.english: Bring <cargo> to <destination>
units.italian: Porta <cargo> a <destination>

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|A group of Kimek approach you in the spaceport. They are all in the blue uniforms of the charity you have been helping by transporting supplies and people. "Greetings, Captain <last>," one of them says. "Helped our charity before, you have. Interested in more work, are you?"|174|0
units.english: A group of Kimek approach you in the spaceport. They are all in the blue uniforms of the charity you have been helping by transporting supplies and people. "Greetings, Captain <last>," one of them says. "Helped our charity before, you have. Interested in more work, are you?"
units.italian: Un gruppo di Kimek ti si avvicina nello spazioporto. Indossano tutti le uniformi blu della beneficenza che hai aiutato trasportando provviste e persone. "Salve, Capitano <last>," dice uno di loro. "Aiutato la nostra beneficenza prima, tu hai. Interessato a più lavoro, tu sei?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	"What do you need me to do?"|176|0
units.english: "What do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in helping anymore."|177|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in helping anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono più interessato ad aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	"Lack many of their preferred diet options, the Arachi and Saryds on <planet> do," they explain. "Enough to order it from off-world, the poorer of them do not have, so sending them a care package, our group is."|179|0
units.english: "Lack many of their preferred diet options, the Arachi and Saryds on <planet> do," they explain. "Enough to order it from off-world, the poorer of them do not have, so sending them a care package, our group is."
units.italian: "Mancano di molte delle opzioni della loro dieta preferita, gli Arachi e i Saryd su <planet>," spiegano. "Abbastanza da ordinarla da fuori mondo, i più poveri tra loro non hanno, quindi inviare loro un pacco di aiuti, il nostro gruppo sta."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	They show you to a pile of containers and crates near the hangars, and you have them loaded into your ship. "Once on <planet>, you are, pay you <payment>, we will. Thankful of your help, we are, Captain." They wish you a safe trip, and vanish into the spaceport halls.|180|0
units.english: They show you to a pile of containers and crates near the hangars, and you have them loaded into your ship. "Once on <planet>, you are, pay you <payment>, we will. Thankful of your help, we are, Captain." They wish you a safe trip, and vanish into the spaceport halls.
units.italian: Ti mostrano un mucchio di container e casse vicino agli hangar, e li fai caricare sulla tua nave. "Quando su <planet> sarai, pagarti <payment>, noi faremo. Grato del tuo aiuto, io sono, Capitano." Ti augurano un buon viaggio e svaniscono nei corridoi dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|A group of Kimek approach you in the spaceport. They are all in the blue uniforms of Chiree's "charity" group, and one of them signals to your ship once they're close. You get the hint, and bring them aboard. "More work for you, Chiree has. To <planet>," one of them begins the moment you close the hatch. "Prepared an important job, she has. One only you can do. Paid <payment> to deliver <cargo> to <planet>, you will be, and once there, tell you the details about the main mission, she can."|183|0
units.english: A group of Kimek approach you in the spaceport. They are all in the blue uniforms of Chiree's "charity" group, and one of them signals to your ship once they're close. You get the hint, and bring them aboard. "More work for you, Chiree has. To <planet>," one of them begins the moment you close the hatch. "Prepared an important job, she has. One only you can do. Paid <payment> to deliver <cargo> to <planet>, you will be, and once there, tell you the details about the main mission, she can."
units.italian: Un gruppo di Kimek ti si avvicina nello spazioporto. Indossano tutti le uniformi blu del gruppo "beneficenza" di Chiree, e uno di loro fa cenno verso la tua nave quando si avvicinano. Capisci l'accenno e li fai salire a bordo. "Altro lavoro per te, Chiree ha. A <planet>," comincia uno di loro appena chiudi il portello. "Preparato un lavoro importante, lei ha. Uno che solo tu puoi fare. Pagato <payment> per consegnare <cargo> a <planet>, tu sarai, e una volta là, spiegarti i dettagli della missione principale, lei potrà."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	"Understood. I'll go there right away."|185|0
units.english: "Understood. I'll go there right away."
units.italian: "Ho capito. Ci andrò subito."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	"I'm sorry, but I don't think this line of work is for me."|186|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't think this line of work is for me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo che questo genere di lavoro faccia per me."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 3|	They nod, and you all leave your ship. They show you a pile of containers and crates near the hangars, and load them in your cargo hold.|188|0
units.english: They nod, and you all leave your ship. They show you a pile of containers and crates near the hangars, and load them in your cargo hold.
units.italian: Annuiscono, e uscite tutti dalla tua nave. Ti mostrano un mucchio di container e casse vicino agli hangar e li fanno caricare nella tua stiva.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|name|199|0
units.english: Grenade Smuggling
units.italian: Contrabbando di granate

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|description|200|0
units.english: Bring 100 Fragmentation Grenades from human space to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta 100 granate a frammentazione dallo spazio umano a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|log|209|0
units.english: Been providing transport services for a charity that is actually the Lunarium, a resistance group within the Coalition aiming to free it from the Heliarchs' rule. Some of the work was genuinely charity, apparently, but some was to support the resistance.
units.italian: Hai fornito servizi di trasporto a una beneficenza che in realtà è il Lunarium, un gruppo di resistenza dentro la Coalizione che mira a liberarla dal dominio degli Heliarchs. Parte del lavoro era davvero beneficenza, a quanto pare, ma parte serviva a sostenere la resistenza.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|You drop off the crates full of charity goods, and the spaceport workers start getting them up on vehicles to transport them to the poor. One of the workers transfers 261,000 credits to your account, thanking you for the help.|212|0
units.english: You drop off the crates full of charity goods, and the spaceport workers start getting them up on vehicles to transport them to the poor. One of the workers transfers 261,000 credits to your account, thanking you for the help.
units.italian: Scarichi le casse piene di beni di beneficenza, e gli operai dello spazioporto cominciano a caricarli su veicoli per portarli ai poveri. Uno degli operai trasferisce 261.000 crediti sul tuo conto, ringraziandoti per l'aiuto.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	As they move the last few crates, you hear a rapid tapping approaching from behind, and as you turn to investigate a Kimek tackles you. Some more join in, covering your head with some dark sack, and start shoving you around once they restrain you. You call out for help, but nobody comes. The Kimek keep pushing and tugging at you as they bring you around the city. After many minutes, you hear some doors close behind you, and your captors force you into some cramped room or compartment. You try to stand up straight, but hit your head against the ceiling. It soon becomes clear you're in a descending elevator, and when it stops, you're walked around for a while longer. Finally, the Kimek seat you and remove the sack from your head.|215|0
units.english: As they move the last few crates, you hear a rapid tapping approaching from behind, and as you turn to investigate a Kimek tackles you. Some more join in, covering your head with some dark sack, and start shoving you around once they restrain you. You call out for help, but nobody comes. The Kimek keep pushing and tugging at you as they bring you around the city. After many minutes, you hear some doors close behind you, and your captors force you into some cramped room or compartment. You try to stand up straight, but hit your head against the ceiling. It soon becomes clear you're in a descending elevator, and when it stops, you're walked around for a while longer. Finally, the Kimek seat you and remove the sack from your head.
units.italian: Mentre spostano le ultime casse, senti un rapido tamburellare avvicinarsi da dietro, e quando ti volti per controllare un Kimek ti salta addosso. Altri si uniscono, ti coprono la testa con un sacco scuro e cominciano a spingerti qua e là dopo averti bloccato. Chiami aiuto, ma non arriva nessuno. I Kimek continuano a spingerti e tirarti mentre ti portano in giro per la città. Dopo molti minuti, senti delle porte chiudersi dietro di te, e i tuoi carcerieri ti spingono in una stanza o in un vano angusto. Cerchi di raddrizzarti, ma batti la testa contro il soffitto. Presto diventa chiaro che sei in un ascensore in discesa, e quando si ferma ti fanno camminare ancora un po'. Alla fine i Kimek ti fanno sedere e ti tolgono il sacco dalla testa.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	The insides remind you of an office building or call center; several Kimek are working in cubicles, most examining computer screens while others speak into communicators. You look back to where you reckon you came from, seeing the entrance to a short elevator by the end of a hallway. Coming around the corner, a Kimek you recognize approaches to sit opposite to you - the Kimek who first contacted you about the charity missions. A group of the blue uniformed Kimek follow after her as they bring a crate: one of the crates you transported here. "Forgive us for the discomfort you must, Captain," she says, as the workers open up the crate, revealing several Heliarch guns stuffed inside. "Wished to speak away from prying eyes, I did. Rest easy, you may, harm you, we will not."|216|0
units.english: The insides remind you of an office building or call center; several Kimek are working in cubicles, most examining computer screens while others speak into communicators. You look back to where you reckon you came from, seeing the entrance to a short elevator by the end of a hallway. Coming around the corner, a Kimek you recognize approaches to sit opposite to you - the Kimek who first contacted you about the charity missions. A group of the blue uniformed Kimek follow after her as they bring a crate: one of the crates you transported here. "Forgive us for the discomfort you must, Captain," she says, as the workers open up the crate, revealing several Heliarch guns stuffed inside. "Wished to speak away from prying eyes, I did. Rest easy, you may, harm you, we will not."
units.italian: L'interno ti ricorda un palazzo di uffici o un call center; diversi Kimek lavorano in cubicoli, la maggior parte davanti a schermi di computer mentre altri parlano in comunicatori. Ti volti verso il punto da cui pensi di essere arrivato, e vedi l'ingresso di un breve ascensore in fondo a un corridoio. Girato l'angolo, un Kimek che riconosci si avvicina per sedersi di fronte a te: il Kimek che ti aveva contattato per la prima volta per le missioni della beneficenza. Un gruppo di Kimek in uniforme blu la segue portando una cassa: una di quelle che hai trasportato fin qui. "Perdonarci il disagio, tu devi, Capitano," dice, mentre gli operai aprono la cassa, rivelando diverse armi degli Heliarchs stipate dentro. "Parlare lontano da occhi indiscreti, io volevo. Stare tranquillo, tu puoi: farti del male, noi non lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"What do you want from me?"|218|0
units.english: "What do you want from me?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi da me?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"So that's the 'charity work' I've been doing? Smuggling weapons?"|220|0
units.english: "So that's the 'charity work' I've been doing? Smuggling weapons?"
units.italian: "Quindi è questo il 'lavoro di beneficenza' che ho fatto? Contrabbando di armi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"The first time? No, in need of help, Fourth Shadow really is, and do proper charity work, we must, if to keep that disguise, we wish," she explains. "The second time, truly carrying winter clothing, you were, only... doctors, three of the Kimek you transported were not. This time, helped supply our cause, you have."|221|0
units.english: "The first time? No, in need of help, Fourth Shadow really is, and do proper charity work, we must, if to keep that disguise, we wish," she explains. "The second time, truly carrying winter clothing, you were, only... doctors, three of the Kimek you transported were not. This time, helped supply our cause, you have."
units.italian: "La prima volta? No: bisogno di aiuto, Fourth Shadow ne ha davvero, e fare vera beneficenza, noi dobbiamo, se mantenere quel travestimento, noi vogliamo," spiega. "La seconda volta, davvero abiti invernali trasportavi, solo... medici, tre dei Kimek che hai trasportato non lo erano. Questa volta, rifornito la nostra causa, tu hai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	She signals for the Kimek in blue uniforms, and they come to her sides, carefully managing the base of some of her legs. You hear a click, followed by a snap. They pull the prosthetics away from her body, removing the "leg" closest to her head on her left side, and the one furthest from her head on her right side. The Kimek on her left side works on her middle leg, revealing that as a prosthetic as well. "Factory accident," she says, gesturing her head to her right side. "Heroic Heliarch patrols, blasting at the teen Kimek," she gestures to her left side. "Guns of my own, I wanted, to ensure no more legs to them, I lost. Some... rarer equipment, my group needs, though. Help us get that equipment, only you can."|223|0
units.english: She signals for the Kimek in blue uniforms, and they come to her sides, carefully managing the base of some of her legs. You hear a click, followed by a snap. They pull the prosthetics away from her body, removing the "leg" closest to her head on her left side, and the one furthest from her head on her right side. The Kimek on her left side works on her middle leg, revealing that as a prosthetic as well. "Factory accident," she says, gesturing her head to her right side. "Heroic Heliarch patrols, blasting at the teen Kimek," she gestures to her left side. "Guns of my own, I wanted, to ensure no more legs to them, I lost. Some... rarer equipment, my group needs, though. Help us get that equipment, only you can."
units.italian: Fa cenno ai Kimek in uniforme blu, che le si affiancano e le sostengono con cura la base di alcune zampe. Senti un clic, seguito da uno scatto. Le allontanano le protesi dal corpo, togliendo la "zampa" più vicina alla testa sul lato sinistro e quella più lontana dalla testa sul lato destro. Il Kimek alla sua sinistra lavora sulla zampa centrale, rivelando che anche quella è una protesi. "Incidente in fabbrica," dice, indicando con la testa il lato destro. "Pattuglie degli Heliarchs, eroiche, che sparano ai giovani Kimek," indica il lato sinistro. "Armi mie, io volevo, per assicurarmi che non perdessero altre zampe. Un'attrezzatura... più rara, il mio gruppo ha bisogno, però. Aiutarci a procurarla, solo tu puoi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"Your group?"|225|0
units.english: "Your group?"
units.italian: "Il tuo gruppo?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"What sort of equipment?"|227|0
units.english: "What sort of equipment?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di attrezzatura?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"And if I refuse?"|229|0
units.english: "And if I refuse?"
units.italian: "E se rifiuto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"Then put that sack on your head again, we will, and brought back to your ship, you will be," she says. "Harming you, we are not. Tell on us, you could, but not very... willing to investigate here, most Heliarchs are."|230|0
units.english: "Then put that sack on your head again, we will, and brought back to your ship, you will be," she says. "Harming you, we are not. Tell on us, you could, but not very... willing to investigate here, most Heliarchs are."
units.italian: "Allora rimetterti quel sacco in testa, noi faremo, e riportarti alla tua nave, tu sarai," dice. "Farti del male, noi non lo facciamo. Denunciarci, tu potresti, ma non molto... disposti a indagare qui, la maggior parte degli Heliarchs è."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"Heard of us in the news, you must have? Terrorists, bandits, outlaws, criminals... many nicknames, the Heliarchs give us." She looks at the weapons inside the crate. "The Lunarium Redoubt, this is. A group of thugs, or whatever they call us, we are not. Trying to rescue our Coalition from the Heliarchs, we are."|233|0
units.english: "Heard of us in the news, you must have? Terrorists, bandits, outlaws, criminals... many nicknames, the Heliarchs give us." She looks at the weapons inside the crate. "The Lunarium Redoubt, this is. A group of thugs, or whatever they call us, we are not. Trying to rescue our Coalition from the Heliarchs, we are."
units.italian: "Sentito parlare di noi nelle notizie, tu devi avere. Terroristi, banditi, fuorilegge, criminali... molti soprannomi, gli Heliarchs ci danno." Guarda le armi dentro la cassa. "Il Lunarium Redoubt, questo è. Un gruppo di teppisti, o qualunque cosa ci chiamino, noi non siamo. Cercare di salvare la nostra Coalizione dagli Heliarchs, noi stiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	A pair of Kimek walk past the table where you're seated, headed for the elevator. The Kimek seated in front of you stays silent as she watches them leave. "No criminal, I was, when these two, I lost," she gestures to the stubs on her left side. "Make sure the Heliarchs can never do that again, we will. Greatly appreciated, your help would be." She asks that one of the weapons from the crate be put on the table, and taps it with her leg. "Powerful, the blasts from these are, but in need of some more broad, wider-impacting equipment, we are. Explosives. Fetch for us some grenades from human space, you could."|235|0
units.english: A pair of Kimek walk past the table where you're seated, headed for the elevator. The Kimek seated in front of you stays silent as she watches them leave. "No criminal, I was, when these two, I lost," she gestures to the stubs on her left side. "Make sure the Heliarchs can never do that again, we will. Greatly appreciated, your help would be." She asks that one of the weapons from the crate be put on the table, and taps it with her leg. "Powerful, the blasts from these are, but in need of some more broad, wider-impacting equipment, we are. Explosives. Fetch for us some grenades from human space, you could."
units.italian: Una coppia di Kimek passa accanto al tavolo dove sei seduto, diretta all'ascensore. Il Kimek seduto di fronte a te resta in silenzio mentre li guarda uscire. "Nessun criminale, io ero, quando queste due, io le ho perse," dice, indicando i monconi sul suo lato sinistro. "Assicurarci che gli Heliarchs non possano mai più farlo, noi lo faremo. Molto apprezzato, il tuo aiuto sarebbe." Chiede che una delle armi della cassa venga messa sul tavolo, e la tocca con la zampa. "Potenti, le esplosioni che ne vengono sono, ma di un'attrezzatura più ampia, di più vasto impatto, noi abbiamo bisogno. Esplosivi. Procurarci delle granate dallo spazio umano, tu potresti."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"Alright, I'll help you. How many grenades do you need?"|237|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll help you. How many grenades do you need?"
units.italian: "Va bene, ti aiuterò. Quante granate ti servono?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"No, I want no part in this. Bring me back to my ship."|239|0
units.english: "No, I want no part in this. Bring me back to my ship."
units.italian: "No, non voglio farne parte. Riportami alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"<payment>. Pay you twice their cost, we would," she says as you're getting up. "A lot of money, you could make, if help us, you do."|240|0
units.english: "<payment>. Pay you twice their cost, we would," she says as you're getting up. "A lot of money, you could make, if help us, you do."
units.italian: "<payment>. Pagarti il doppio del loro costo, noi lo faremmo," dice mentre ti alzi. "Un sacco di soldi, potresti guadagnare, se ci aiuti, tu lo fai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"Fine. How many grenades?"|242|0
units.english: "Fine. How many grenades?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Quante granate?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"No. Get me back to my ship."|243|0
units.english: "No. Get me back to my ship."
units.italian: "No. Riportami alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	Her mandibles click together for a few seconds. "100 boxes. Brought to <planet>, they must be. The exact coordinates, upon arrival, you will receive." She pauses as the other Kimek put her prosthetics back on. "Chiree, my name is. Hoping, I am, that help us a great deal you will, Captain <last>."|246|0
units.english: Her mandibles click together for a few seconds. "100 boxes. Brought to <planet>, they must be. The exact coordinates, upon arrival, you will receive." She pauses as the other Kimek put her prosthetics back on. "Chiree, my name is. Hoping, I am, that help us a great deal you will, Captain <last>."
units.italian: Le sue mandibole si chiudono a scatto per qualche secondo. "100 casse. Portate su <planet>, devono essere. Le coordinate esatte, all'arrivo, tu le riceverai." Fa una pausa mentre gli altri Kimek le rimettono le protesi. "Chiree, il mio nome è. Sperare, io spero, che aiutarci molto tu vorrai, Capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	She heads back into the strange grouping of cubicles, and the Kimek behind you have you get up, putting the sack back on your head. After another ride in the unpleasantly tight elevator, and some more pushing and tugging at your body, they have you back at your ship. The sack is removed from your head and the Kimek walk off as if nothing happened. Nobody around the hangar seems to have noticed anything unusual.|247|0
units.english: She heads back into the strange grouping of cubicles, and the Kimek behind you have you get up, putting the sack back on your head. After another ride in the unpleasantly tight elevator, and some more pushing and tugging at your body, they have you back at your ship. The sack is removed from your head and the Kimek walk off as if nothing happened. Nobody around the hangar seems to have noticed anything unusual.
units.italian: Torna dentro lo strano insieme di cubicoli, e i Kimek dietro di te ti fanno alzare, rimettendoti il sacco in testa. Dopo un altro viaggio nell'ascensore scomodamente stretto, e altre spinte e strattoni al tuo corpo, ti riportano alla tua nave. Il sacco ti viene tolto dalla testa e i Kimek se ne vanno come se nulla fosse. Nessuno intorno all'hangar sembra aver notato niente di strano.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	She breathes deeply for a moment, then asks the other Kimek to put her prosthetics back on. "Very well," she says, before walking back into the strange grouping of cubicles. The Kimek behind you have you get up, putting the sack back on your head. After another ride in the unpleasantly tight elevator, and some more pushing and tugging at your body, they have you back at your ship. The sack is removed from your head and the Kimek walk off as if nothing happened. Nobody around the hangar seems to have noticed anything unusual.|250|0
units.english: She breathes deeply for a moment, then asks the other Kimek to put her prosthetics back on. "Very well," she says, before walking back into the strange grouping of cubicles. The Kimek behind you have you get up, putting the sack back on your head. After another ride in the unpleasantly tight elevator, and some more pushing and tugging at your body, they have you back at your ship. The sack is removed from your head and the Kimek walk off as if nothing happened. Nobody around the hangar seems to have noticed anything unusual.
units.italian: Respira a fondo per un momento, poi chiede agli altri Kimek di rimetterle le protesi. "Molto bene," dice, prima di tornare dentro lo strano insieme di cubicoli. I Kimek dietro di te ti fanno alzare, rimettendoti il sacco in testa. Dopo un altro viaggio nell'ascensore scomodamente stretto, e altre spinte e strattoni al tuo corpo, ti riportano alla tua nave. Il sacco ti viene tolto dalla testa e i Kimek se ne vanno come se nulla fosse. Nessuno intorno all'hangar sembra aver notato niente di strano.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	While they're removing the crates from your hold, a familiar Kimek approaches you: it's Chiree, the local Lunarium leader. "Speak in your ship, may we, Captain?" You bring her inside <ship>, and she continues. "Since one of us, you now are, to help with acquiring some equipment, you I'd like to ask."|253|0
units.english: While they're removing the crates from your hold, a familiar Kimek approaches you: it's Chiree, the local Lunarium leader. "Speak in your ship, may we, Captain?" You bring her inside <ship>, and she continues. "Since one of us, you now are, to help with acquiring some equipment, you I'd like to ask."
units.italian: Mentre tolgono le casse dalla tua stiva, un Kimek familiare ti si avvicina: è Chiree, la leader locale del Lunarium. "Parlare nella tua nave, possiamo, Capitano?" La fai entrare nella <ship>, e lei continua. "Dato che uno di noi, ora tu sei, per aiutarci a procurarci un'attrezzatura, a te vorrei chiedere."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"What sort of equipment?"|255|0
units.english: "What sort of equipment?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di attrezzatura?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"Was this 'charity' job just to get me here for this?"|257|0
units.english: "Was this 'charity' job just to get me here for this?"
units.italian: "Questo lavoro di 'beneficenza' serviva solo a portarmi qui per questo?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	"This last one? Yes, wished to speak about this away from prying eyes, I did," she says. "Really in need of help, the people of Fourth Shadow were. Actual charity work, we still need to perform, if to keep up the disguise, we want. The second one... well, as you know, doctors, three of the Kimek were not."|258|0
units.english: "This last one? Yes, wished to speak about this away from prying eyes, I did," she says. "Really in need of help, the people of Fourth Shadow were. Actual charity work, we still need to perform, if to keep up the disguise, we want. The second one... well, as you know, doctors, three of the Kimek were not."
units.italian: "Quest'ultimo? Sì: parlare di questo lontano da occhi indiscreti, io volevo," dice. "Davvero bisogno di aiuto, la gente di Fourth Shadow ne aveva. Vera beneficenza, noi dobbiamo ancora farla, se mantenere il travestimento, noi vogliamo. Il secondo... beh, come sai, medici, tre dei Kimek non lo erano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	She explains that the crates you brought in were filled with Heliarch assault guns, meant to supply the members here with better weaponry. "Used the charity as a means of smuggling, for decades we have," she explains. "But difficult to acquire, larger Heliarch outfits are. Difficult to transport in secret. Capable of leaving, you are, so bring in outfits from the outside, you could." She tells you the Lunarium needs some explosives they could reproduce with relative ease, and use against the Heliarchs in boarding operations. They've been informed that not far from the Coalition, there are human worlds selling Fragmentation Grenades, which would do the job. "100 boxes of them, to <planet>, you must bring," she says. "Paid twice their value, you will be, <payment>."|260|0
units.english: She explains that the crates you brought in were filled with Heliarch assault guns, meant to supply the members here with better weaponry. "Used the charity as a means of smuggling, for decades we have," she explains. "But difficult to acquire, larger Heliarch outfits are. Difficult to transport in secret. Capable of leaving, you are, so bring in outfits from the outside, you could." She tells you the Lunarium needs some explosives they could reproduce with relative ease, and use against the Heliarchs in boarding operations. They've been informed that not far from the Coalition, there are human worlds selling Fragmentation Grenades, which would do the job. "100 boxes of them, to <planet>, you must bring," she says. "Paid twice their value, you will be, <payment>."
units.italian: Spiega che le casse che hai portato erano piene di fucili d'assalto degli Heliarchs, destinati a rifornire i membri qui di armi migliori. "Usato la beneficenza come mezzo di contrabbando, per decenni noi abbiamo," spiega. "Ma difficili da procurarsi, le attrezzature più grandi degli Heliarchs sono. Difficili da trasportare in segreto. Capace di uscire, tu sei, quindi portare attrezzature dall'esterno, tu potresti." Ti dice che il Lunarium ha bisogno di esplosivi che possa riprodurre con relativa facilità e usare contro gli Heliarchs nelle operazioni di abbordaggio. Sono stati informati che non lontano dalla Coalizione ci sono mondi umani che vendono granate a frammentazione, che farebbero al caso. "100 casse di quelle, a <planet>, tu devi portare," dice. "Pagato il doppio del loro valore, tu sarai, <payment>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	A communicator on her beeps, and she gets word that the workers have finished unloading the smuggled guns. She tells you you'll receive coordinates for delivering the grenades once you arrive at <planet>, and wishes you good luck.|261|0
units.english: A communicator on her beeps, and she gets word that the workers have finished unloading the smuggled guns. She tells you you'll receive coordinates for delivering the grenades once you arrive at <planet>, and wishes you good luck.
units.italian: Un comunicatore alla sua cintura emette un segnale, e le arriva la notizia che gli operai hanno finito di scaricare le armi di contrabbando. Ti dice che riceverai le coordinate per consegnare le granate una volta arrivato su <planet>, e ti augura buona fortuna.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|log|265|0
units.english: Agreed to acquire some grenades for the Lunarium from human space. They've offered to pay quite well.
units.italian: Hai accettato di procurarti delle granate per il Lunarium dallo spazio umano. Hanno offerto di pagare piuttosto bene.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|dialog|267|0
units.english: You've arrived on <planet>, but you haven't brought all the grenades you needed to yet. Make sure you have them all in your cargo before you land.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora portato tutte le granate che ti servivano. Assicurati di averle tutte nel carico prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|As you approach the standard docking bay, a message pops up on your monitor telling you to go to the edge of the city. You follow the instructions and find yourself in the middle of several dozen warehouses. Another message arrives and asks that you unload the grenades and bring them to a specific warehouse. As this information comes in, you notice that a few Arachi have arrived just outside your ship with some cargo loaders, seemingly waiting for you to begin moving the smuggled weapons. You open up your hatch, and help them get the grenade crates out of your ship and into the designated warehouse as fast as you can, worried that someone might see you. The door is open, with a few more Arachi waiting inside by a staircase. They say nothing to you and simply take the grenade crates, lifting them off of the cargo loader and bringing them down the stairs, crate by crate.|273|0
units.english: As you approach the standard docking bay, a message pops up on your monitor telling you to go to the edge of the city. You follow the instructions and find yourself in the middle of several dozen warehouses. Another message arrives and asks that you unload the grenades and bring them to a specific warehouse. As this information comes in, you notice that a few Arachi have arrived just outside your ship with some cargo loaders, seemingly waiting for you to begin moving the smuggled weapons. You open up your hatch, and help them get the grenade crates out of your ship and into the designated warehouse as fast as you can, worried that someone might see you. The door is open, with a few more Arachi waiting inside by a staircase. They say nothing to you and simply take the grenade crates, lifting them off of the cargo loader and bringing them down the stairs, crate by crate.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al normale bacino di attracco, sul monitor compare un messaggio che ti dice di andare ai margini della città. Segui le istruzioni e ti ritrovi in mezzo a diverse decine di magazzini. Arriva un altro messaggio che ti chiede di scaricare le granate e portarle a un magazzino specifico. Mentre arrivano queste informazioni, noti che alcuni Arachi sono arrivati appena fuori dalla tua nave con dei caricatori, e sembrano aspettare che tu cominci a spostare le armi di contrabbando. Apri il portello e li aiuti a tirare fuori le casse di granate dalla nave e a portarle nel magazzino indicato il più in fretta possibile, preoccupato che qualcuno possa vederti. La porta è aperta, con altri Arachi che aspettano dentro vicino a una scala. Non ti dicono nulla e prendono semplicemente le casse di granate, sollevandole dal caricatore e portandole giù per le scale, cassa per cassa.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades|	When you're done with the last one, one of the Arachi hands you several credit chips, worth <payment> in total. "Contact you for more deliveries of this kind, we will," they say as they head down with the final grenade box. You head back to your ship, and leave for the usual hangars.|274|0
units.english: When you're done with the last one, one of the Arachi hands you several credit chips, worth <payment> in total. "Contact you for more deliveries of this kind, we will," they say as they head down with the final grenade box. You head back to your ship, and leave for the usual hangars.
units.italian: Quando hai finito con l'ultima, uno degli Arachi ti consegna diversi gettoni di credito, per un totale di <payment>. "Contattarti per altre consegne di questo tipo, noi lo faremo," dicono mentre scendono con l'ultima cassa di granate. Torni alla tua nave e riparti verso gli hangar abituali.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|name|279|0
units.english: Anti-Missile Smuggling
units.italian: Contrabbando di antimissili

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|description|280|0
units.english: Bring three Heavy Anti-Missile Turrets to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta tre torrette antimissile pesanti a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|Shortly after you land, an Arach approaches your ship, waiting for you to come out. When you do, she pulls out a Heliarch badge. "Forgive me for this intrusion, you must, Captain <last>, but orders to inspect your ship, I have." She heads inside your ship and rushes to the cockpit before you can say anything, and asks you to close the door once you get there too. Her eyes trail the interior for a while, then she approaches you. "Helped the Lunarium with supplies before, you have," she whispers. "In need of more such services, we are. Means to defend ourselves against the Heliarch missiles, we require, so sent to ask you for three of the largest human anti-missile turrets, I was."|293|0
units.english: Shortly after you land, an Arach approaches your ship, waiting for you to come out. When you do, she pulls out a Heliarch badge. "Forgive me for this intrusion, you must, Captain <last>, but orders to inspect your ship, I have." She heads inside your ship and rushes to the cockpit before you can say anything, and asks you to close the door once you get there too. Her eyes trail the interior for a while, then she approaches you. "Helped the Lunarium with supplies before, you have," she whispers. "In need of more such services, we are. Means to defend ourselves against the Heliarch missiles, we require, so sent to ask you for three of the largest human anti-missile turrets, I was."
units.italian: Poco dopo che sei atterrato, un Arach si avvicina alla tua nave, aspettando che tu esca. Quando lo fai, tira fuori un distintivo degli Heliarchs. "Perdonarmi questa intrusione, tu devi, Capitano <last>, ma ordini di ispezionare la tua nave, io ho." Entra nella tua nave e si precipita in cabina di pilotaggio prima che tu possa dire qualcosa, e ti chiede di chiudere la porta quando arrivi anche tu. I suoi occhi scorrono l'interno per un po', poi si avvicina a te. "Aiutato il Lunarium con delle provviste prima, tu hai," sussurra. "Bisogno di altri servizi simili, noi abbiamo. Mezzi per difenderci dai missili degli Heliarchs, ci servono, quindi mandata a chiederti tre delle più grandi torrette antimissile umane, io sono stata."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|	"Where should I take them to?"|295|0
units.english: "Where should I take them to?"
units.italian: "Dove devo portarle?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|	"I'm not sure human anti-missiles will be very effective against your missiles."|296|0
units.english: "I'm not sure human anti-missiles will be very effective against your missiles."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro che gli antimissili umani saranno molto efficaci contro i vostri missili."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|	"Brought to <destination>, they must be. The factories there, numerous and alike, they are. Hopes to produce our own, in secret, we have."|298|0
units.english: "Brought to <destination>, they must be. The factories there, numerous and alike, they are. Hopes to produce our own, in secret, we have."
units.italian: "Portate a <destination>, devono essere. Le fabbriche laggiù, numerose e simili tra loro, sono. Speriamo di produrne di nostri, in segreto, noi abbiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|	"The simpler their mechanisms, the faster that replicate them, we can," she says. "Strong enough to stop the Finishers, I hope they are... Bring the turrets to <destination>, you must."|301|0
units.english: "The simpler their mechanisms, the faster that replicate them, we can," she says. "Strong enough to stop the Finishers, I hope they are... Bring the turrets to <destination>, you must."
units.italian: "Più semplici sono i loro meccanismi, più in fretta replicarli, noi possiamo," dice. "Abbastanza forti da fermare i Finishers, spero che siano... Portare le torrette a <destination>, tu devi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|	She asks for your monitor, and, after tinkering with the controls for a minute, plugs a small, round device into it. "Allow us to more easily contact you, this will. Accessed by a separate network entirely, the device is. Simply a means to receive our messages, it is. Leave traces on its hardware, communications will not, and gain access to the network on its own, it cannot. Traced back to us, you won't be, unless caught by the Heliarchs during our communications, you are," she explains. "After delivered the goods to <planet>, you have, message you for more missions, we shall. Good luck I wish you, and my thanks you have, Captain." Once the "inspection" is done, she leaves your ship and scurries off.|303|0
units.english: She asks for your monitor, and, after tinkering with the controls for a minute, plugs a small, round device into it. "Allow us to more easily contact you, this will. Accessed by a separate network entirely, the device is. Simply a means to receive our messages, it is. Leave traces on its hardware, communications will not, and gain access to the network on its own, it cannot. Traced back to us, you won't be, unless caught by the Heliarchs during our communications, you are," she explains. "After delivered the goods to <planet>, you have, message you for more missions, we shall. Good luck I wish you, and my thanks you have, Captain." Once the "inspection" is done, she leaves your ship and scurries off.
units.italian: Chiede il tuo monitor e, dopo aver armeggiato con i comandi per un minuto, vi collega un piccolo dispositivo rotondo. "Permetterci di contattarti più facilmente, questo farà. Accessibile tramite una rete completamente separata, il dispositivo è. Solo un mezzo per ricevere i nostri messaggi, è. Lasciare tracce sul suo hardware, le comunicazioni non lo faranno, e accedere alla rete da solo, non può. Risalire a noi, tu non verrai, a meno che catturato dagli Heliarchs durante le nostre comunicazioni, tu non sia," spiega. "Dopo che consegnato la merce a <planet>, tu avrai, mandarti messaggi per altre missioni, noi lo faremo. Buona fortuna ti auguro, e la mia gratitudine tu hai, Capitano." Quando l'"ispezione" è finita, lascia la tua nave e si allontana in fretta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|log|307|0
units.english: Agreed to smuggle three of the largest human anti-missile turrets to the Lunarium. They hope to reverse-engineer them to defend against Heliarch weaponry, though the effectiveness of human designs here is dubious.
units.italian: Hai accettato di contrabbandare tre delle più grandi torrette antimissile umane per il Lunarium. Sperano di studiarle a rovescio per difendersi dalle armi degli Heliarchs, anche se l'efficacia dei progetti umani in questo campo è dubbia.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|log|308|0
units.english: Given what appears to be some sort of communication device by a Lunarium representative to facilitate easier contact.
units.italian: Ti è stato dato quello che sembra un qualche tipo di dispositivo di comunicazione da un rappresentante del Lunarium, per facilitare i contatti.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|dialog|310|0
units.english: You've arrived on <planet>, but you haven't brought all the anti-missile turrets you needed to yet. Make sure you have them all in cargo before you land.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora portato tutte le torrette antimissile che ti servivano. Assicurati di averle tutte nel carico prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|Your monitor beeps loudly as you prepare for your descent onto <planet>, indicating that you have a message. The message details instructions on how to complete your delivery. Under the guise that you're transporting heavy factory equipment, you stop on a landing pad adjacent to a massive automated compound. A gantry crane moves the turrets down to ground levels, setting them on cargo platforms, which are then pulled into a large warehouse. Once all is done, you see that <payment> have been added to your account.|316|0
units.english: Your monitor beeps loudly as you prepare for your descent onto <planet>, indicating that you have a message. The message details instructions on how to complete your delivery. Under the guise that you're transporting heavy factory equipment, you stop on a landing pad adjacent to a massive automated compound. A gantry crane moves the turrets down to ground levels, setting them on cargo platforms, which are then pulled into a large warehouse. Once all is done, you see that <payment> have been added to your account.
units.italian: Il tuo monitor emette un segnale sonoro mentre ti prepari a scendere su <planet>, indicando che hai un messaggio. Il messaggio spiega come completare la consegna. Con la scusa di trasportare pesanti attrezzature da fabbrica, ti fermi su una piazzola adiacente a un enorme complesso automatizzato. Una gru a portale porta le torrette a livello del suolo, le appoggia su piattaforme da carico, che vengono poi tirate dentro un grande magazzino. Quando tutto è finito, vedi che <payment> sono stati aggiunti al tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: AM|	You look to your monitor again, and see a message explaining the Lunarium would happily take more copies of smuggled equipment, if you wish to help further. The message details that they've prepared a method of integrating their missions into your job board. The device installed in your ship will include them in your list of regular jobs whenever they're available.|317|0
units.english: You look to your monitor again, and see a message explaining the Lunarium would happily take more copies of smuggled equipment, if you wish to help further. The message details that they've prepared a method of integrating their missions into your job board. The device installed in your ship will include them in your list of regular jobs whenever they're available.
units.italian: Guardi di nuovo il monitor e vedi un messaggio che spiega che il Lunarium accetterebbe volentieri altre copie di attrezzature di contrabbando, se desideri aiutare ancora. Il messaggio spiega che hanno preparato un metodo per integrare le loro missioni nella tua bacheca degli incarichi. Il dispositivo installato nella tua nave le includerà nell'elenco dei lavori ordinari ogni volta che saranno disponibili.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|name|323|0
units.english: Torpedo Smuggling
units.italian: Contrabbando di siluri

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|description|324|0
units.english: Bring two Torpedo and two Typhoon Launchers to <destination>, along with the maximum ammunition each can carry.
units.italian: Porta due lanciatori Torpedo e due Typhoon a <destination>, insieme al massimo delle munizioni che ciascuno può trasportare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|Once you land on <origin>, the little round drive the Lunarium member plugged into your ship beeps quietly. Your monitor begins to flicker, eventually changing to some sort of messaging interface. A few seconds pass, and some text pops up. "Greetings Captain! Chiree, it is. In need of your 'delivery services' again, we are. Told, we have been, that developed some torpedoes of their own, humans have, and while not as dangerous as Finishers, still provide us much needed offensive power against Heliarch ships, they would. Issued anti-missile defenses, they are not, so a great boon to us, these weapons would be."|338|0
units.english: Once you land on <origin>, the little round drive the Lunarium member plugged into your ship beeps quietly. Your monitor begins to flicker, eventually changing to some sort of messaging interface. A few seconds pass, and some text pops up. "Greetings Captain! Chiree, it is. In need of your 'delivery services' again, we are. Told, we have been, that developed some torpedoes of their own, humans have, and while not as dangerous as Finishers, still provide us much needed offensive power against Heliarch ships, they would. Issued anti-missile defenses, they are not, so a great boon to us, these weapons would be."
units.italian: Una volta atterrato su <origin>, il piccolo disco rotondo che il membro del Lunarium ha collegato alla tua nave emette un segnale sommesso. Il monitor comincia a tremolare e alla fine si trasforma in una specie di interfaccia di messaggistica. Passano alcuni secondi e compare del testo. "Salve Capitano! Chiree, sono io. Di nuovo bisogno dei tuoi 'servizi di consegna', noi abbiamo. Detto ci è stato che sviluppato dei siluri propri, gli umani hanno, e anche se non pericolosi come i Finishers, fornirci una potenza offensiva molto necessaria contro le navi degli Heliarchs, essi potrebbero. Dotate di difese antimissile, non sono, quindi un grande vantaggio per noi, queste armi sarebbero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	After you've read the message, you see a blinking circle at the bottom of your monitor, prompting you for some sort of response.|339|0
units.english: After you've read the message, you see a blinking circle at the bottom of your monitor, prompting you for some sort of response.
units.italian: Dopo aver letto il messaggio, vedi un cerchio lampeggiante in fondo al monitor, che ti invita a dare una qualche risposta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	"What weapons do you need?"|341|0
units.english: "What weapons do you need?"
units.italian: "Di quali armi hai bisogno?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	"Where am I delivering the weapons?"|342|0
units.english: "Where am I delivering the weapons?"
units.italian: "Dove devo consegnare le armi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	You input the message, and get a response almost immediately; it seems Chiree's prosthetics don't negate the advantage of having so many legs typing in unison. "Two 'Torpedo Launchers' and two 'Typhoon Launchers' are what we need, along with the ammo to fill all of them. Brought to <planet>, they must be. There, our most adequate facilities for torpedoes are. Receive <payment> once you've delivered them there, you will."|343|0
units.english: You input the message, and get a response almost immediately; it seems Chiree's prosthetics don't negate the advantage of having so many legs typing in unison.
