"Two 'Torpedo Launchers' and two 'Typhoon Launchers' are what we need, along with the ammo to fill all of them. Brought to <planet>, they must be. There, our most adequate facilities for torpedoes are. Receive <payment> once you've delivered them there, you will."
units.italian: Scrivi il messaggio e ricevi una risposta quasi immediata; sembra che le protesi di Chiree non annullino il vantaggio di avere così tante zampe che scrivono all'unisono. "Due 'lanciatori Torpedo' e due 'lanciatori Typhoon' sono ciò che ci serve, insieme alle munizioni per riempirli tutti. Portati su <planet>, devono essere. Là, le nostre strutture più adatte per i siluri sono. Ricevere <payment> una volta che li avrai consegnati, tu dovrai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	The interface blinks off, and the round drive stops beeping as your monitor returns to normal.|344|0
units.english: The interface blinks off, and the round drive stops beeping as your monitor returns to normal.
units.italian: L'interfaccia si spegne e il disco smette di segnalare mentre il monitor torna alla normalità.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|log|348|0
units.english: Agreed to provide the Lunarium with some Torpedo and Typhoon Launchers. The lack of anti-missile systems on Heliarch ships means missile technology will be highly beneficial for the Lunarium.
units.italian: Hai accettato di fornire al Lunarium alcuni lanciatori Torpedo e Typhoon. L'assenza di sistemi antimissile sulle navi degli Heliarchs significa che la tecnologia missilistica sarà molto utile al Lunarium.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|dialog|350|0
units.english: You've arrived on <planet>, but you haven't brought all the launchers and ammo you needed to yet. Make sure you have them all in your cargo before you land.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora portato tutti i lanciatori e le munizioni che ti servivano. Assicurati di averli tutti nel carico prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|Once again, your monitor beeps, and some coordinates appear on the screen. You follow them, arriving to a snowfield close to the base of a mountain. Donning your heavy winter clothing, you open the hatch to find several Saryds waiting for you, ready to take the launchers and the ammunition out of your ship. "A better fighting chance, these should give us," one of them tells you as she hands you <payment>, and others work on getting the launchers and their ammunition out of your ship. "Not as mighty as their own Finishers, these are, but still hurt their hulls good, they should."|359|0
units.english: Once again, your monitor beeps, and some coordinates appear on the screen. You follow them, arriving to a snowfield close to the base of a mountain. Donning your heavy winter clothing, you open the hatch to find several Saryds waiting for you, ready to take the launchers and the ammunition out of your ship. "A better fighting chance, these should give us," one of them tells you as she hands you <payment>, and others work on getting the launchers and their ammunition out of your ship. "Not as mighty as their own Finishers, these are, but still hurt their hulls good, they should."
units.italian: Ancora una volta il monitor emette un segnale, e sullo schermo compaiono delle coordinate. Le segui e arrivi a un campo innevato vicino alla base di una montagna. Indossati i tuoi pesanti abiti invernali, apri il portello e trovi diversi Saryd che ti aspettano, pronti a tirare fuori dalla nave i lanciatori e le munizioni. "Una possibilità di combattere migliore, questa dovrebbe darci," ti dice uno di loro mentre ti consegna <payment>, e altri lavorano per tirare fuori dalla nave i lanciatori e le loro munizioni. "Non potenti come i loro Finishers, queste sono, ma fare ancora molto male ai loro scafi, dovrebbero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	"Are you sure they won't find you here?"|361|0
units.english: "Are you sure they won't find you here?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che non vi troveranno qui?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	"Why is it that their ships don't have anti-missiles?"|363|0
units.english: "Why is it that their ships don't have anti-missiles?"
units.italian: "Come mai le loro navi non hanno antimissili?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	She seems puzzled by the question, then her face sparks up as if remembering something. "Right, well-versed in our history, you are not," she begins. "Developed their arsenal to fight the Quarg, the Heliarchs have, and while possible, it was, to shoot down their projectiles, far too difficult a task, it proved. Favored more offensive turrets due to that, they historically have."|364|0
units.english: She seems puzzled by the question, then her face sparks up as if remembering something. "Right, well-versed in our history, you are not," she begins. "Developed their arsenal to fight the Quarg, the Heliarchs have, and while possible, it was, to shoot down their projectiles, far too difficult a task, it proved. Favored more offensive turrets due to that, they historically have."
units.italian: Sembra confuso dalla domanda, poi il suo viso si illumina come se ricordasse qualcosa. "Giusto: ben versato nella nostra storia, tu non sei," comincia. "Sviluppato il loro arsenale per combattere i Quarg, gli Heliarchs l'hanno, e anche se possibile era abbattere i loro proiettili, un compito fin troppo difficile si è rivelato. Preferito torrette più offensive per questo motivo, storicamente essi hanno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	"A calm world, this is, and many Heliarch patrols, it does not get," she explains. "Hidden many things here for long, we have. Continue to remain hidden, I hope we can."|367|0
units.english: "A calm world, this is, and many Heliarch patrols, it does not get," she explains. "Hidden many things here for long, we have. Continue to remain hidden, I hope we can."
units.italian: "Un mondo tranquillo, questo è, e molte pattuglie degli Heliarchs, non riceve," spiega. "Nascosto molte cose qui a lungo, noi abbiamo. Continuare a restare nascosti, spero che potremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes|	The final torpedo is brought out of your ship, and the Saryds start bringing them inside a cave leading into the mountain. The Saryd who paid you thanks you again, and follows after the others. You head back to your ship and fly it to the hangars, hoping to find something warm to drink.|369|0
units.english: The final torpedo is brought out of your ship, and the Saryds start bringing them inside a cave leading into the mountain. The Saryd who paid you thanks you again, and follows after the others. You head back to your ship and fly it to the hangars, hoping to find something warm to drink.
units.italian: L'ultimo siluro viene portato fuori dalla tua nave, e i Saryd cominciano a portarli dentro una caverna che conduce nella montagna. Il Saryd che ti ha pagato ti ringrazia di nuovo e segue gli altri. Torni alla tua nave e la porti agli hangar, sperando di trovare qualcosa di caldo da bere.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|name|375|0
units.english: Heated Smuggling
units.italian: Contrabbando incandescente

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|description|376|0
units.english: Deliver two Plasma Turrets and ten Flamethrowers to <destination>.
units.italian: Consegna due torrette al plasma e dieci lanciafiamme a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|Once again, the Lunarium's device starts beeping as you land, and your monitor flickers to the same messaging screen as last time. "Hello again Captain. Chiree, it is. Thank you for the torpedoes, I must, already at work on producing more like them, we are. Win us battles, however, they alone will not, so asking you to help us once again, I am. Received word, we have, of some more weapons developed by humans. Quickly heat up ships, they can, and so a great help against Heliarch attacks, they would be."|389|0
units.english: Once again, the Lunarium's device starts beeping as you land, and your monitor flickers to the same messaging screen as last time. "Hello again Captain. Chiree, it is. Thank you for the torpedoes, I must, already at work on producing more like them, we are. Win us battles, however, they alone will not, so asking you to help us once again, I am. Received word, we have, of some more weapons developed by humans. Quickly heat up ships, they can, and so a great help against Heliarch attacks, they would be."
units.italian: Ancora una volta, atterrando, il dispositivo del Lunarium comincia a segnalare, e il monitor passa tremolando alla stessa schermata di messaggi dell'ultima volta. "Di nuovo salve, Capitano. Chiree, sono io. Ringraziarti per i siluri, io devo: già al lavoro per produrne altri simili, noi siamo. Vincere le battaglie, però, da soli non potranno, quindi chiederti di aiutarci ancora, io sto. Ricevuto parola, noi abbiamo, di altre armi sviluppate dagli umani. Riscaldare rapidamente le navi, possono, e quindi un grande aiuto contro gli attacchi degli Heliarchs, sarebbero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"What do you need me to do?"|391|0
units.english: "What do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"You have 'received word' of that? From whom? Who's telling you of these weapons?"|393|0
units.english: "You have 'received word' of that? From whom? Who's telling you of these weapons?"
units.italian: "Hai 'ricevuto parola' di questo? Da chi? Chi ti informa di queste armi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	For how fast she typed before, Chiree takes a long time to answer. "Know that, we do not," is what first appears on the screen. "First contacted centuries ago, we were. Unsure, we still are, if trustworthy, whoever is sending the messages is, but always right they are on their information. The first to bring us human outfits, you are not; whoever they are, brought us caches of some human platings and guns, decades ago, they did. Seen, their ships never were, only the crates and containers, we found."|394|0
units.english: For how fast she typed before, Chiree takes a long time to answer. "Know that, we do not," is what first appears on the screen. "First contacted centuries ago, we were. Unsure, we still are, if trustworthy, whoever is sending the messages is, but always right they are on their information. The first to bring us human outfits, you are not; whoever they are, brought us caches of some human platings and guns, decades ago, they did. Seen, their ships never were, only the crates and containers, we found."
units.italian: Per quanto fosse veloce a scrivere prima, Chiree impiega molto tempo a rispondere. "Saperlo, noi non lo sappiamo," è ciò che compare per primo sullo schermo. "Contattati secoli fa, noi fummo. Insicuri, noi siamo ancora, se affidabile sia chiunque stia mandando i messaggi, ma sempre esatti sono nelle loro informazioni. Il primo a portarci attrezzature umane, tu non sei; chiunque essi siano, portato casse di corazze e armi umane, decenni fa, essi lo hanno. Viste, le loro navi non sono mai state: solo le casse e i container, noi abbiamo trovato."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"So why do you trust these mystery informants so much?"|396|0
units.english: "So why do you trust these mystery informants so much?"
units.italian: "E allora perché ti fidi così tanto di questi informatori misteriosi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"Whatever the case, just tell me what you need me to do."|397|0
units.english: "Whatever the case, just tell me what you need me to do."
units.italian: "Comunque sia, dimmi solo che cosa devo fare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"Because helped us, they always have, and in dire need of help, we are," she shoots back in an instant. "Given us a fighting chance, they have," she adds.|399|0
units.english: "Because helped us, they always have, and in dire need of help, we are," she shoots back in an instant. "Given us a fighting chance, they have," she adds.
units.italian: "Perché aiutati, ci hanno sempre, e in disperato bisogno di aiuto, noi siamo," ribatte in un istante. "Data una possibilità di combattere, ci hanno," aggiunge.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	She quickly types out another message. "A larger delivery, this will be, so a good hiding spot, we'll need. To <destination>, bring two 'Plasma Turrets' and ten 'Flamethrowers' you must. Paid <payment>, you will be."|401|0
units.english: She quickly types out another message. "A larger delivery, this will be, so a good hiding spot, we'll need. To <destination>, bring two 'Plasma Turrets' and ten 'Flamethrowers' you must. Paid <payment>, you will be."
units.italian: Scrive rapidamente un altro messaggio. "Una consegna più grande, questa sarà, quindi un buon nascondiglio, ci servirà. A <destination>, portare due 'torrette al plasma' e dieci 'lanciafiamme' tu devi. Pagato <payment>, tu sarai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	The beeping stops and your monitor screen goes back to normal.|402|0
units.english: The beeping stops and your monitor screen goes back to normal.
units.italian: Il segnale cessa e lo schermo del monitor torna alla normalità.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|log|406|0
units.english: Agreed to bring the Lunarium some Plasma Turrets and Flamethrowers. They seem to believe heat damage will be effective against Heliarch ships.
units.italian: Hai accettato di portare al Lunarium alcune torrette al plasma e dei lanciafiamme. Sembrano convinti che i danni da calore saranno efficaci contro le navi degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|dialog|408|0
units.english: You've arrived on <planet>, but you haven't brought all the Plasma Turrets and Flamethrowers you needed to yet. Make sure to have them all in your cargo before you land.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora portato tutte le torrette al plasma e i lanciafiamme che ti servivano. Assicurati di averli tutti nel carico prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|As you enter the planet's atmosphere you can't help but notice that much of the planet is covered in a dense, heavy fog. As you contemplate such an oddity, you get a message that guides you to land on a rocky beach, where a large cargo barge is waiting. Stepping off your ship, you're met by a few Saryds with the right equipment to get the Plasma Turrets and Flamethrowers out of your cargo hold. They do so with haste, handing you <payment> as they carry the turrets, and then Flamethrower after Flamethrower, off of your ship.|415|0
units.english: As you enter the planet's atmosphere you can't help but notice that much of the planet is covered in a dense, heavy fog. As you contemplate such an oddity, you get a message that guides you to land on a rocky beach, where a large cargo barge is waiting. Stepping off your ship, you're met by a few Saryds with the right equipment to get the Plasma Turrets and Flamethrowers out of your cargo hold. They do so with haste, handing you <payment> as they carry the turrets, and then Flamethrower after Flamethrower, off of your ship.
units.italian: Entrando nell'atmosfera del pianeta non puoi fare a meno di notare che gran parte è coperta da una nebbia densa e pesante. Mentre ti interroghi su una tale stranezza, ricevi un messaggio che ti guida ad atterrare su una spiaggia rocciosa, dove ti aspetta una grande chiatta da carico. Scendendo dalla nave, ti accolgono alcuni Saryd con l'attrezzatura giusta per tirare fuori le torrette al plasma e i lanciafiamme dalla stiva. Lo fanno in fretta, consegnandoti <payment> mentre portano via le torrette e poi lanciafiamme su lanciafiamme dalla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"For your participation in our conjoined efforts, we thank you, <last>," one of them says when they are almost done. "If right, the information is, a tremendous boon to us, these weapons will be."|416|0
units.english: "For your participation in our conjoined efforts, we thank you, <last>," one of them says when they are almost done. "If right, the information is, a tremendous boon to us, these weapons will be."
units.italian: "Per la tua partecipazione ai nostri sforzi congiunti, ti ringraziamo, <last>," dice uno di loro quando hanno quasi finito. "Se giusta, l'informazione è, un vantaggio enorme per noi, queste armi saranno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"Are you sure this planet is an appropriate hiding spot? It doesn't seem to be exactly isolated."|418|0
units.english: "Are you sure this planet is an appropriate hiding spot? It doesn't seem to be exactly isolated."
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che questo pianeta sia un nascondiglio adatto? Non sembra esattamente isolato."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"How are the turrets and flamethrowers going to help, exactly?"|419|0
units.english: "How are the turrets and flamethrowers going to help, exactly?"
units.italian: "In che modo esattamente aiuteranno le torrette e i lanciafiamme?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	He smiles at your question. "Lie hidden in the fog, many secrets do," he says, as if it were some adage. "Unknown even to most Saryds, parts of this planet are. Well hidden, the weapons will be. Worry about them, you need not."|421|0
units.english: He smiles at your question. "Lie hidden in the fog, many secrets do," he says, as if it were some adage. "Unknown even to most Saryds, parts of this planet are. Well hidden, the weapons will be. Worry about them, you need not."
units.italian: Sorride alla tua domanda. "Nascosti nella nebbia, molti segreti stanno," dice, come se fosse un proverbio. "Sconosciute anche alla maggior parte dei Saryd, alcune parti di questo pianeta sono. Ben nascoste, le armi saranno. Preoccupartene, tu non devi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	"If to fight the Heliarchs, we are, an advantage against their mighty vessels, we need," he explains. "When long in combat, close to their heat limit, their ships are. Greatly cripple them, we hope that these weapons will."|424|0
units.english: "If to fight the Heliarchs, we are, an advantage against their mighty vessels, we need," he explains. "When long in combat, close to their heat limit, their ships are. Greatly cripple them, we hope that these weapons will."
units.italian: "Se combattere gli Heliarchs dobbiamo, un vantaggio contro le loro potenti navi, noi abbiamo bisogno," spiega. "Quando a lungo in combattimento, vicino al loro limite di calore, le loro navi sono. Danneggiarle gravemente, speriamo che queste armi possano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat|	He bids you farewell once the last Flamethrower is loaded onto the barge, and gets on it with the others to sail away. The barge is fully encompassed by the planet's ever-present fog within minutes of raising the anchor. You get inside your ship, and head to the usual hangars.|426|0
units.english: He bids you farewell once the last Flamethrower is loaded onto the barge, and gets on it with the others to sail away. The barge is fully encompassed by the planet's ever-present fog within minutes of raising the anchor. You get inside your ship, and head to the usual hangars.
units.italian: Ti saluta quando l'ultimo lanciafiamme è caricato sulla chiatta, e sale a bordo con gli altri per allontanarsi. La chiatta è completamente avvolta dalla nebbia sempre presente del pianeta entro pochi minuti dall'issare l'ancora. Entri nella tua nave e ti dirigi verso gli hangar abituali.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|name|432|0
units.english: Reactor Smuggling
units.italian: Contrabbando di reattori

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|description|433|0
units.english: Bring an Armageddon Core, a Fusion Reactor, and a Breeder Reactor to <destination>. To avoid the risk of larger Heliarch patrols you must deliver them before the fifth day of any month.
units.italian: Porta un nucleo Armageddon, un reattore a fusione e un reattore autofertilizzante a <destination>. Per evitare il rischio di pattuglie più numerose degli Heliarchs devi consegnarli prima del quinto giorno di qualsiasi mese.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|Landing on <origin>, the Lunarium's device starts beeping once again. Your monitor's screen shifts as you receive Chiree's message. "Captain <last>, a more complicated task for you, I have. Some better power generation, our ships will need, if to fight Heliarch warships, we are. Simpler to mass-produce, human ones should be, but only on <planet>, large enough facilities exist."|445|0
units.english: Landing on <origin>, the Lunarium's device starts beeping once again. Your monitor's screen shifts as you receive Chiree's message. "Captain <last>, a more complicated task for you, I have. Some better power generation, our ships will need, if to fight Heliarch warships, we are. Simpler to mass-produce, human ones should be, but only on <planet>, large enough facilities exist."
units.italian: Atterrando su <origin>, il dispositivo del Lunarium ricomincia a segnalare. Lo schermo del monitor cambia mentre ricevi il messaggio di Chiree. "Capitano <last>, un compito più complicato per te, io ho. Di una generazione di energia migliore, le nostre navi avranno bisogno, se combattere le navi da guerra degli Heliarchs dobbiamo. Più semplici da produrre in serie, quelli umani dovrebbero essere, ma solo su <planet>, strutture abbastanza grandi esistono."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"Why is that a problem? I already delivered the grenades to that planet."|447|0
units.english: "Why is that a problem? I already delivered the grenades to that planet."
units.italian: "Perché è un problema? Ho già consegnato le granate su quel pianeta."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"Did something change about <planet>?"|448|0
units.english: "Did something change about <planet>?"
units.italian: "È cambiato qualcosa su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"Larger than other equipment you've brought us, these generators are," the next message says. "The 'Armageddon Core,' 'Fusion Reactor' and 'Breeder Reactor,' what we need are, but take a long time to move such large pieces, it will. Risk being seen, we cannot, so only in some days, delivered they may be. Switch every month, the rotating patrols do. Arrive on the fifth, new patrols usually do, so delivered during that window before the fifth, the reactors must be. Pay you well for this, we will, <payment>."|449|0
units.english: "Larger than other equipment you've brought us, these generators are," the next message says. "The 'Armageddon Core,' 'Fusion Reactor' and 'Breeder Reactor,' what we need are, but take a long time to move such large pieces, it will. Risk being seen, we cannot, so only in some days, delivered they may be. Switch every month, the rotating patrols do. Arrive on the fifth, new patrols usually do, so delivered during that window before the fifth, the reactors must be. Pay you well for this, we will, <payment>."
units.italian: "Più grandi delle altre attrezzature che ci hai portato, questi generatori sono," dice il messaggio successivo. "Il 'nucleo Armageddon', il 'reattore a fusione' e il 'reattore autofertilizzante', ciò di cui abbiamo bisogno sono, ma molto tempo per spostare pezzi così grandi, ci vorrà. Rischio di essere visti, noi non possiamo correre, quindi solo in certi giorni, consegnati potranno essere. Cambiare ogni mese, le pattuglie a rotazione lo fanno. Arrivare il quinto giorno, di solito le nuove pattuglie lo fanno, quindi consegnati in quella finestra prima del quinto, i reattori devono essere. Pagarti bene per questo, noi lo faremo, <payment>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	She signs off, the beeping stops, and your monitor screen returns to normal.|450|0
units.english: She signs off, the beeping stops, and your monitor screen returns to normal.
units.italian: Chiude la comunicazione, il segnale cessa e lo schermo del monitor torna alla normalità.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|log|454|0
units.english: The Lunarium will need more power than the Coalition solar panels and fuel cells can provide to take on the Heliarchs. Agreed to provide them samples of human shipboard nuclear reactors to reproduce to this end.
units.italian: Il Lunarium avrà bisogno di più energia di quanta ne possano fornire i pannelli solari e le celle a combustibile della Coalizione per affrontare gli Heliarchs. Hai accettato di fornire loro campioni di reattori nucleari umani da riprodurre a questo scopo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|dialog|456|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but don't receive any instructions from the local Lunarium members. Either one or more of the reactors aren't with you in the system, or you're past the delivery window. You should prepare to bring in the three reactors before the fifth day of the month, and try again.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non ricevi istruzioni dai membri locali del Lunarium. O uno o più dei reattori non sono con te nel sistema, oppure sei fuori dalla finestra di consegna. Dovresti prepararti a portare i tre reattori prima del quinto giorno del mese e riprovare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|log|466|0
units.english: After delivering some nuclear reactors, Chiree says she won't make further contact via the usual communicator, but others of the Lunarium on Coalition worlds may offer similar work.
units.italian: Dopo aver consegnato alcuni reattori nucleari, Chiree dice che non ti contatterà più tramite il comunicatore abituale, ma altri del Lunarium sui mondi della Coalizione potrebbero offrirti un lavoro simile.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|log|467|0
units.english: Factions
units.italian: Factions

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|When you come in to land, the local Lunarium contacts direct you to a site far away from any of the cities. You are led close to a gigantic cave entrance, on a valley already blanketed by the planet's typical heavy downpours. Dozens of Arachi and Kimek are waiting for you, and once you land they use hulking cargo loaders to carefully take each reactor from your ship, slowly bringing them inside the cave. They repeat this slow, arduous process with each reactor that you were tasked to bring to them.|469|0
units.english: When you come in to land, the local Lunarium contacts direct you to a site far away from any of the cities. You are led close to a gigantic cave entrance, on a valley already blanketed by the planet's typical heavy downpours. Dozens of Arachi and Kimek are waiting for you, and once you land they use hulking cargo loaders to carefully take each reactor from your ship, slowly bringing them inside the cave. They repeat this slow, arduous process with each reactor that you were tasked to bring to them.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, i contatti locali del Lunarium ti indicano un sito lontano da qualsiasi città. Ti guidano vicino all'ingresso gigantesco di una caverna, in una valle già inzuppata dai forti rovesci tipici del pianeta. Decine di Arachi e Kimek ti aspettano, e una volta atterrato usano enormi caricatori per prendere con cura ogni reattore dalla tua nave e portarli lentamente dentro la caverna. Ripetono questo processo lento e faticoso con ogni reattore che ti era stato chiesto di portare.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	Most of those not working on moving the reactors are heavily armed, keeping careful watch of the skies and occasionally tuning into a communicator for any signs of Heliarch ships that may be approaching. After over an hour, once the last reactor is finally taken out of your cargo hold, one of the Arachi comes up to you and hands you <payment>, thanking you for your service to their cause. "A lot of money, this is, but worth it, the reactors should be."|470|0
units.english: Most of those not working on moving the reactors are heavily armed, keeping careful watch of the skies and occasionally tuning into a communicator for any signs of Heliarch ships that may be approaching. After over an hour, once the last reactor is finally taken out of your cargo hold, one of the Arachi comes up to you and hands you <payment>, thanking you for your service to their cause. "A lot of money, this is, but worth it, the reactors should be."
units.italian: La maggior parte di quelli che non lavorano allo spostamento dei reattori è pesantemente armata e tiene un'attenta sorveglianza del cielo, sintonizzandosi ogni tanto su un comunicatore per qualsiasi segno di navi degli Heliarchs in avvicinamento. Dopo più di un'ora, quando l'ultimo reattore è finalmente fuori dalla stiva, uno degli Arachi ti si avvicina e ti consegna <payment>, ringraziandoti per il tuo servizio alla loro causa. "Un sacco di soldi, questi sono, ma valerne la pena, i reattori dovrebbero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"Where do you even get all this money from?"|472|0
units.english: "Where do you even get all this money from?"
units.italian: "Dove prendete tutti questi soldi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"What are you even going to do with those reactors? It would be really hard to install them in a ship out here."|473|0
units.english: "What are you even going to do with those reactors? It would be really hard to install them in a ship out here."
units.italian: "Che cosa farete con quei reattori? Sarebbe davvero difficile installarli su una nave quaggiù."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"Word of our existence, the Heliarchs muffle, and distorted and twisted, their versions of our actions are, but enough to drive away our supporters, that is not," he says. "Not entirely... happy, some Arach Houses are, with the direction of things. Help fund us, they do."|475|0
units.english: "Word of our existence, the Heliarchs muffle, and distorted and twisted, their versions of our actions are, but enough to drive away our supporters, that is not," he says. "Not entirely... happy, some Arach Houses are, with the direction of things. Help fund us, they do."
units.italian: "La notizia della nostra esistenza, gli Heliarchs la soffocano, e distorte e stravolte, le loro versioni delle nostre azioni sono, ma abbastanza per allontanare i nostri sostenitori, non lo è," dice. "Non del tutto... contente, alcune Case Arach sono, della direzione che hanno preso le cose. Finanziarci, esse lo fanno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	"Fit for battle, solar panels and fuel cells are not. Come to fight the Heliarchs, we eventually will, so better power generation for our weapons, we'll need," he says, and then points in the direction of the spaceport. "More efficient, Heliarch reactors are, but too difficult to steal them, it is. Too risky. Only provide energy for our facilities, they do. Studied and reproduced for use in our ships, the reactors you brought us will be."|478|0
units.english: "Fit for battle, solar panels and fuel cells are not. Come to fight the Heliarchs, we eventually will, so better power generation for our weapons, we'll need," he says, and then points in the direction of the spaceport. "More efficient, Heliarch reactors are, but too difficult to steal them, it is. Too risky. Only provide energy for our facilities, they do. Studied and reproduced for use in our ships, the reactors you brought us will be."
units.italian: "Adatte alla battaglia, le celle solari e le celle a combustibile non sono. Arrivare a combattere gli Heliarchs, noi prima o poi lo faremo, quindi una generazione di energia migliore per le nostre armi, ci servirà," dice, e poi indica la direzione dello spazioporto. "Più efficienti, i reattori degli Heliarchs sono, ma troppo difficile rubarli, è. Troppo rischioso. Fornire energia solo alle nostre strutture, essi lo fanno. Studiati e riprodotti per l'uso sulle nostre navi, i reattori che ci hai portato saranno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors|	They bid you farewell and head into the cave, and you get back inside your ship. Once you land back at the city hangars, the device installed in your monitor beeps again with a message from Chiree. "Helped us a great deal you have, Captain <last>. Contact you like this again, I may not, but find more offers for smuggling jobs, you will. Appreciated, any more equipment you bring us will be, and of course, pay well we would." She signs off, and the beeps stop.|480|0
units.english: They bid you farewell and head into the cave, and you get back inside your ship. Once you land back at the city hangars, the device installed in your monitor beeps again with a message from Chiree. "Helped us a great deal you have, Captain <last>. Contact you like this again, I may not, but find more offers for smuggling jobs, you will. Appreciated, any more equipment you bring us will be, and of course, pay well we would." She signs off, and the beeps stop.
units.italian: Ti salutano e si addentrano nella caverna, e tu torni dentro la tua nave. Quando atterri di nuovo agli hangar della città, il dispositivo installato nel monitor segnala di nuovo con un messaggio di Chiree. "Aiutati moltissimo, tu ci hai, Capitano <last>. Contattarti di nuovo così, io forse non potrò, ma trovare altre offerte di lavori di contrabbando, tu potrai. Apprezzata, qualsiasi altra attrezzatura che ci porterai sarà, e naturalmente, pagare bene noi vorremmo." Il segnale cessa.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|name|487|0
units.english: Meet with House Bebliss
units.italian: Incontro con Casa Bebliss

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|description|488|0
units.english: Head to <destination>, where members of House Bebliss wish to discuss a job offer.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove i membri di Casa Bebliss vogliono discutere una proposta di lavoro.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|An Arach stops you by the spaceport and invites you to a free meal at a local bar. "A business proposal for you, my employers have."|505|0
units.english: An Arach stops you by the spaceport and invites you to a free meal at a local bar. "A business proposal for you, my employers have."
units.italian: Un Arach ti ferma allo spazioporto e ti invita a un pasto offerto in un bar locale. "Una proposta d'affari per te, i miei datori di lavoro hanno."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Very well, lead the way."|507|0
units.english: "Very well, lead the way."
units.italian: "Molto bene, fai strada."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Can't you just give me the details here? I'm not hungry."|509|0
units.english: "Can't you just give me the details here? I'm not hungry."
units.italian: "Non puoi semplicemente darmi i dettagli qui? Non ho fame."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	He seems somewhat disappointed, but agrees nonetheless. "A messenger from the great House Bebliss, I am. Expressed a wish to see you, my employers have, for a great aid to one of their projects, you would be."|510|0
units.english: He seems somewhat disappointed, but agrees nonetheless. "A messenger from the great House Bebliss, I am. Expressed a wish to see you, my employers have, for a great aid to one of their projects, you would be."
units.italian: Sembra un po' deluso, ma acconsente comunque. "Un messaggero della grande Casa Bebliss, io sono. Manifestato il desiderio di vederti, i miei datori di lavoro hanno, perché un grande aiuto a uno dei loro progetti, tu saresti."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"What do they want?"|512|0
units.english: "What do they want?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vogliono?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Did they mention how much I would get paid?"|513|0
units.english: "Did they mention how much I would get paid?"
units.italian: "Hanno detto quanto verrei pagato?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Know such exact details, I do not, but certain, I am, that answer any of your questions, they will. Much interest in your resourcefulness, my superiors have," he says. "On <destination>, they wait. Now, told to tell you, I was, that only to speak with you, they want. To make an offer. If uninterested, you are, pressure you any further, they will not."|514|0
units.english: "Know such exact details, I do not, but certain, I am, that answer any of your questions, they will. Much interest in your resourcefulness, my superiors have," he says. "On <destination>, they wait. Now, told to tell you, I was, that only to speak with you, they want. To make an offer. If uninterested, you are, pressure you any further, they will not."
units.italian: "Conoscere dettagli così precisi, io non li conosco, ma certo, io sono, che risponderanno a tutte le tue domande, essi lo faranno. Molto interesse nella tua intraprendenza, i miei superiori hanno," dice. "Su <destination>, essi aspettano. Ora, incaricato di dirti, io sono stato, che solo parlare con te, essi vogliono. Fare un'offerta. Se disinteressato, tu sei, farti pressioni ulteriori, essi non lo faranno."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Fair enough. Tell them I'll be heading there to hear them out."|516|0
units.english: "Fair enough. Tell them I'll be heading there to hear them out."
units.italian: "Mi sta bene. Di' loro che passerò a sentirli."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"I won't go out of my way just to hear about a job offer. Tell them to come in person next time."|517|0
units.english: "I won't go out of my way just to hear about a job offer. Tell them to come in person next time."
units.italian: "Non mi metterò in viaggio solo per sentire di un'offerta di lavoro. Di' loro di venire di persona la prossima volta."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	He nods in some quick gesture, and gives you some coordinates. "To an estate, these will bring you. Thankful for your understanding, House Bebliss is." He runs off, and heads into an office building to inform his superiors that you'll be on your way to <planet>.|519|0
units.english: He nods in some quick gesture, and gives you some coordinates. "To an estate, these will bring you. Thankful for your understanding, House Bebliss is." He runs off, and heads into an office building to inform his superiors that you'll be on your way to <planet>.
units.italian: Annuisce in un rapido gesto e ti dà delle coordinate. "A una tenuta, queste ti porteranno. Riconoscente della tua comprensione, Casa Bebliss è." Corre via e si infila in un palazzo di uffici per informare i suoi superiori che sarai in viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	You follow him into the establishment and order something. "To business, then," he says. "A messenger from the great House Bebliss, I am. Expressed a wish to see you, my employers have, for a great aid to one of their projects, you would be."|521|0
units.english: You follow him into the establishment and order something. "To business, then," he says. "A messenger from the great House Bebliss, I am. Expressed a wish to see you, my employers have, for a great aid to one of their projects, you would be."
units.italian: Lo segui nel locale e ordini qualcosa. "Al dunque, allora," dice. "Un messaggero della grande Casa Bebliss, io sono. Manifestato il desiderio di vederti, i miei datori di lavoro hanno, perché un grande aiuto a uno dei loro progetti, tu saresti."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"What do they want?"|523|0
units.english: "What do they want?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vogliono?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Did they mention how much I would get paid?"|524|0
units.english: "Did they mention how much I would get paid?"
units.italian: "Hanno detto quanto verrei pagato?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Know such exact details, I do not, but certain, I am, that answer any of your questions, they will. Much interest in your resourcefulness, my superiors have," he says. "On <destination>, they wait. Now, told to tell you, I was, that only to speak with you, they want. To make an offer. If uninterested, you are, pressure you any further, they will not."|525|0
units.english: "Know such exact details, I do not, but certain, I am, that answer any of your questions, they will. Much interest in your resourcefulness, my superiors have," he says. "On <destination>, they wait. Now, told to tell you, I was, that only to speak with you, they want. To make an offer. If uninterested, you are, pressure you any further, they will not."
units.italian: "Conoscere dettagli così precisi, io non li conosco, ma certo, io sono, che risponderanno a tutte le tue domande, essi lo faranno. Molto interesse nella tua intraprendenza, i miei superiori hanno," dice. "Su <destination>, essi aspettano. Ora, incaricato di dirti, io sono stato, che solo parlare con te, essi vogliono. Fare un'offerta. Se disinteressato, tu sei, farti pressioni ulteriori, essi non lo faranno."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"Fair enough. Tell them I'll be heading there to hear them out."|527|0
units.english: "Fair enough. Tell them I'll be heading there to hear them out."
units.italian: "Mi sta bene. Di' loro che passerò a sentirli."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	"I won't go out of my way just to hear about a job offer. Tell them to come in person next time."|528|0
units.english: "I won't go out of my way just to hear about a job offer. Tell them to come in person next time."
units.italian: "Non mi metterò in viaggio solo per sentire di un'offerta di lavoro. Di' loro di venire di persona la prossima volta."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-A|	He nods in some quick gesture, and gives you some coordinates. "To an estate, these will bring you. Thankful for your understanding, House Bebliss is." He finishes up his drink quickly, and leaves the bar to inform his superiors that you'll be on your way to <planet>.|530|0
units.english: He nods in some quick gesture, and gives you some coordinates. "To an estate, these will bring you. Thankful for your understanding, House Bebliss is." He finishes up his drink quickly, and leaves the bar to inform his superiors that you'll be on your way to <planet>.
units.italian: Annuisce in un rapido gesto e ti dà delle coordinate. "A una tenuta, queste ti porteranno. Riconoscente della tua comprensione, Casa Bebliss è." Finisce in fretta il suo drink e lascia il bar per informare i suoi superiori che sarai in viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|name|540|0
units.english: Meet with House Bebliss
units.italian: Incontro con Casa Bebliss

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|description|541|0
units.english: Head to <destination>, where representatives from an Arach House that supports the Lunarium wish to discuss a job offer.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove i rappresentanti di una Casa Arach che sostiene il Lunarium vogliono discutere una proposta di lavoro.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|On your way to the spaceport, you're stopped by a duo who seem to be Arachi businessmen, surrounded by half a dozen bulky, taller Arachi. "In person, as per your request, we have come, Captain," one of the two in fancy suits says.|553|0
units.english: On your way to the spaceport, you're stopped by a duo who seem to be Arachi businessmen, surrounded by half a dozen bulky, taller Arachi. "In person, as per your request, we have come, Captain," one of the two in fancy suits says.
units.italian: Mentre vai verso lo spazioporto, ti ferma una coppia che sembra fatta di uomini d'affari Arachi, circondata da una mezza dozzina di Arachi più massicci e alti. "Di persona, come da tua richiesta, noi siamo venuti, Capitano," dice uno dei due in abiti eleganti.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"My request? What are you talking about?"|555|0
units.english: "My request? What are you talking about?"
units.italian: "Mia richiesta? Di che cosa parli?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"You've got the wrong person. I don't know either of you."|556|0
units.english: "You've got the wrong person. I don't know either of you."
units.italian: "Avete sbagliato persona. Non conosco nessuno dei due."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"House Bebliss, right? Thank you for finally finding the time."|557|0
units.english: "House Bebliss, right? Thank you for finally finding the time."
units.italian: "Casa Bebliss, giusto? Grazie per aver finalmente trovato il tempo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"To our employee, what you said, it is," they answer. "To 'come in person next time,' you requested."|559|0
units.english: "To our employee, what you said, it is," they answer. "To 'come in person next time,' you requested."
units.italian: "Al nostro impiegato, ciò che tu hai detto, è questo," rispondono. "Di 'venire di persona la prossima volta', tu hai chiesto."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	They "invite" you to follow you into what looks like an expensive restaurant, serving typical Arach cuisine. The bulky Arachi don't give you much of a choice, barring you from going elsewhere and only letting up when you are seated. The two Arachi businessmen say they will pay for your meal, though you can't quite find much in the menu appealing to the human palate.|561|0
units.english: They "invite" you to follow you into what looks like an expensive restaurant, serving typical Arach cuisine. The bulky Arachi don't give you much of a choice, barring you from going elsewhere and only letting up when you are seated. The two Arachi businessmen say they will pay for your meal, though you can't quite find much in the menu appealing to the human palate.
units.italian: Ti "invitano" a seguirli in quello che sembra un ristorante costoso, che serve cucina tipica Arach. Gli Arachi massicci non ti lasciano molta scelta, ti sbarrano la strada e si rilassano solo quando sei seduto. I due uomini d'affari Arachi dicono che pagheranno il tuo pasto, anche se nel menu non trovi granché di appetitoso per un palato umano.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"Usually more... respectful about such requests from our House, people are, but hasty of us to approach a human Captain like we would an Arach one, it may have been," one of them says, going through the menu. "Still interested, the House is, so to entertain your request, we came."|562|0
units.english: "Usually more... respectful about such requests from our House, people are, but hasty of us to approach a human Captain like we would an Arach one, it may have been," one of them says, going through the menu. "Still interested, the House is, so to entertain your request, we came."
units.italian: "Di solito più... rispettose, di tali richieste dalla nostra Casa, le persone sono, ma affrettato da parte nostra avvicinare un capitano umano come faremmo con uno Arach, forse è stato," dice uno di loro, scorrendo il menu. "Comunque interessata, la Casa è, quindi per assecondare la tua richiesta, noi siamo venuti."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"Interested in your assistance, that is," the other continues, as he signals for one of the bodyguards to get a waiter. "An important job for you, we have."|563|0
units.english: "Interested in your assistance, that is," the other continues, as he signals for one of the bodyguards to get a waiter. "An important job for you, we have."
units.italian: "Interessata al tuo aiuto, cioè," continua l'altro, facendo cenno a una delle guardie del corpo di chiamare un cameriere. "Un lavoro importante per te, noi abbiamo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"Alright, you have my interest. What's this job about?"|565|0
units.english: "Alright, you have my interest. What's this job about?"
units.italian: "Va bene, avete la mia attenzione. Di che lavoro si tratta?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"Well, if you want me to work with you so much, why don't you just tell me what the job is?"|566|0
units.english: "Well, if you want me to work with you so much, why don't you just tell me what the job is?"
units.italian: "Beh, se ci tenete tanto a lavorare con me, perché non mi dite semplicemente di che lavoro si tratta?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"I'm sorry, I understand you've taken the effort to come meet me in person, but I've got pressing business outside of Coalition space."|567|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I understand you've taken the effort to come meet me in person, but I've got pressing business outside of Coalition space."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, capisco che vi siate presi la briga di venire a incontrarmi di persona, ma ho affari urgenti fuori dallo spazio della Coalizione."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"Second chance, tenth chance, I really don't care how many you give me. I'm not interested."|569|0
units.english: "Second chance, tenth chance, I really don't care how many you give me. I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Seconda occasione, decima occasione, non mi interessa quante me ne date. Non sono interessato."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"Say much, here we cannot," he answers. "If interested, you are, to <destination>, you must go. There, our House's private estate is."|571|0
units.english: "Say much, here we cannot," he answers. "If interested, you are, to <destination>, you must go. There, our House's private estate is."
units.italian: "Dire molto, qui noi non possiamo," risponde. "Se interessato, tu sei, a <destination>, tu devi andare. Là, la tenuta privata della nostra Casa è."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	"That it concerns recent human events, we can say. Events that involved in, you were," the other says, handing you some coordinates to their estate on <planet>.|572|0
units.english: "That it concerns recent human events, we can say. Events that involved in, you were," the other says, handing you some coordinates to their estate on <planet>.
units.italian: "Che riguarda eventi umani recenti, noi possiamo dire. Eventi in cui coinvolto, tu eri," dice l'altro, consegnandoti delle coordinate per la loro tenuta su <planet>.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	The waiter arrives, and they suggest some dishes, seeing as you didn't pick anything from the menu. The smell coming from the other tables, however, tells you to decline, so you politely leave the establishment. It seems the only way to find out what these Arachi want is to head to <destination>.|573|0
units.english: The waiter arrives, and they suggest some dishes, seeing as you didn't pick anything from the menu. The smell coming from the other tables, however, tells you to decline, so you politely leave the establishment. It seems the only way to find out what these Arachi want is to head to <destination>.
units.italian: Arriva il cameriere, e ti suggeriscono alcuni piatti, visto che non hai scelto nulla dal menu. L'odore che arriva dagli altri tavoli, però, ti dice di rifiutare, così lasci il locale con cortesia. Sembra che l'unico modo per scoprire che cosa vogliono questi Arachi sia andare a <destination>.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 1-B|	The two of them eye you up for a very uncomfortable minute, but never provide some response or acknowledgment. You try and move away and leave the restaurant, but their bodyguards block you. One of the two Arachi from the table appears to grunt, then signals for the guards to let you pass through. You leave the restaurant, and return to your ship.|576|0
units.english: The two of them eye you up for a very uncomfortable minute, but never provide some response or acknowledgment. You try and move away and leave the restaurant, but their bodyguards block you. One of the two Arachi from the table appears to grunt, then signals for the guards to let you pass through. You leave the restaurant, and return to your ship.
units.italian: I due ti fissano per un minuto molto scomodo, ma non danno alcuna risposta né cenno di assenso. Provi ad allontanarti e a lasciare il ristorante, ma le loro guardie del corpo ti bloccano. Uno dei due Arachi al tavolo emette qualcosa come un grugnito, poi fa cenno alle guardie di lasciarti passare. Lasci il ristorante e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|name|586|0
units.english: Find Freya
units.italian: Trovare Freya

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|description|587|0
units.english: Go to <destination> and look for Freya to see if she is willing to let the members of House Bebliss study the Pug artifacts with her.
units.italian: Vai a <destination> e cerca Freya per vedere se è disposta a lasciare che i membri di Casa Bebliss studino con lei i manufatti dei Pug.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|You follow the coordinates given to you and land on top of a mountain at a set of private hangars. Nearby is an estate, covered by a dome similar to the one over the spaceport city. You are received by who you assume are Arachi butlers and maids, given their tidy, well-kept uniforms, and follow one of them into the mansion.|599|0
units.english: You follow the coordinates given to you and land on top of a mountain at a set of private hangars. Nearby is an estate, covered by a dome similar to the one over the spaceport city. You are received by who you assume are Arachi butlers and maids, given their tidy, well-kept uniforms, and follow one of them into the mansion.
units.italian: Segui le coordinate che ti sono state date e atterri in cima a una montagna, presso una serie di hangar privati. Lì vicino c'è una tenuta, coperta da una cupola simile a quella sopra la città dello spazioporto. Ti accolgono quelli che supponi siano maggiordomi e cameriere Arachi, a giudicare dalle uniformi ordinate e ben tenute, e segui uno di loro dentro la villa.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	They bring you to a large, wide room where three preoccupied Arachi are pouring over schematics and blueprints scattered across a table.|600|0
units.english: They bring you to a large, wide room where three preoccupied Arachi are pouring over schematics and blueprints scattered across a table.
units.italian: Ti portano in una stanza ampia e larga, dove tre Arachi assorti stanno esaminando schemi e progetti sparsi su un tavolo.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Captain <first> <last>!" One of them comes to greet you after the servant announces your arrival. "A rare opportunity, it is, such an exquisite guest, to entertain. Care for a drink, would you?" Without waiting for a response, one of the maids brings over a platter with several cups, and you're pleasantly surprised to discover familiar smells like coffee and tea coming from the silver dish. You notice that there are also some alcoholic beverages as well as just plain water in the middle of the platter.|601|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last>!" One of them comes to greet you after the servant announces your arrival. "A rare opportunity, it is, such an exquisite guest, to entertain. Care for a drink, would you?" Without waiting for a response, one of the maids brings over a platter with several cups, and you're pleasantly surprised to discover familiar smells like coffee and tea coming from the silver dish. You notice that there are also some alcoholic beverages as well as just plain water in the middle of the platter.
units.italian: "Capitano <first> <last>!" Uno di loro viene a salutarti dopo che il servitore ha annunciato il tuo arrivo. "Un'occasione rara, è, un ospite così squisito, da intrattenere. Gradisci qualcosa da bere, tu?" Senza aspettare risposta, una delle cameriere porta un vassoio con diverse tazze, e scopri con piacevole sorpresa che dal piatto d'argento arrivano odori familiari come caffè e tè. Noti che al centro del vassoio ci sono anche alcune bevande alcoliche oltre alla semplice acqua.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Difficult to replicate, some of these human drinks were, but for a special guest, the least we could do, it is," another one approaches, gesturing for you to pick one of the drinks, while signaling for another maid to bring him and the other two some drinks of their own.|602|0
units.english: "Difficult to replicate, some of these human drinks were, but for a special guest, the least we could do, it is," another one approaches, gesturing for you to pick one of the drinks, while signaling for another maid to bring him and the other two some drinks of their own.
units.italian: "Difficili da replicare, alcune di queste bevande umane sono state, ma per un ospite speciale, il minimo che potevamo fare, è," si avvicina un altro, facendoti cenno di scegliere una delle bevande, mentre segnala a un'altra cameriera di portare da bere a lui e agli altri due.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Thank you, but why exactly did you want to talk to me so badly?"|604|0
units.english: "Thank you, but why exactly did you want to talk to me so badly?"
units.italian: "Grazie, ma perché ci tenevate tanto a parlarmi?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"You asked me to come here for a job. What is the job?"|605|0
units.english: "You asked me to come here for a job. What is the job?"
units.italian: "Mi avete chiesto di venire qui per un lavoro. Qual è il lavoro?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"The great House Bebliss, we represent. Maintain the local hyperspace communication network, our House does," he says as he swirls the drink in his cup before taking a sip.|608|0
units.english: "The great House Bebliss, we represent. Maintain the local hyperspace communication network, our House does," he says as he swirls the drink in his cup before taking a sip.
units.italian: "La grande Casa Bebliss, noi rappresentiamo. Mantenere la rete locale di comunicazioni iperspaziali, la nostra Casa lo fa," dice, facendo ruotare la bevanda nella tazza prima di sorseggiarne un po'.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	The other one jumps in. "Studied hyperspace links, for millennia we have. More recently, an application of such phenomena that would help the Coalition, we have searched for."|609|0
units.english: The other one jumps in. "Studied hyperspace links, for millennia we have. More recently, an application of such phenomena that would help the Coalition, we have searched for."
units.italian: L'altro interviene. "Studiato i collegamenti iperspaziali, per millenni noi abbiamo. Più di recente, un'applicazione di tali fenomeni che aiuterebbe la Coalizione, noi abbiamo cercato."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"To be trusted, you are. Assured us of that, Chiree has," the one Arach still by the blueprints chimes in. "The Lunarium's guardian angels, we are," she boasts. "Safeguard them against the Heliarchs, our meddling in the communication network does. To better serve that purpose, look further into this field, we must."|612|0
units.english: "To be trusted, you are. Assured us of that, Chiree has," the one Arach still by the blueprints chimes in. "The Lunarium's guardian angels, we are," she boasts. "Safeguard them against the Heliarchs, our meddling in the communication network does. To better serve that purpose, look further into this field, we must."
units.italian: "Degno di fiducia, tu sei. Ce ne ha assicurato, Chiree lo ha," interviene l'Arach ancora vicino ai progetti. "Gli angeli custodi del Lunarium, noi siamo," si vanta. "Proteggerli dagli Heliarchs, la nostra intromissione nella rete di comunicazioni lo fa. Per servire meglio quello scopo, guardare più a fondo in questo campo, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	Still gently swirling his drink in between periodic sips, the other Arach beside you asks, "Knowledge, we have acquired, of a certain conflict in human space. Invaded by aliens, were you? Aliens with such technology?"|614|0
units.english: Still gently swirling his drink in between periodic sips, the other Arach beside you asks, "Knowledge, we have acquired, of a certain conflict in human space. Invaded by aliens, were you? Aliens with such technology?"
units.italian: Sempre facendo ruotare piano la bevanda tra un sorso e l'altro, l'altro Arach accanto a te chiede: "Conoscenza, noi abbiamo acquisito, di un certo conflitto nello spazio umano. Invasi da alieni, voi siete stati? Alieni con una tale tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Yes, they're called Pug."|616|0
units.english: "Yes, they're called Pug."
units.italian: "Sì, si chiamano Pug."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Wait, how do you know of this?"|618|0
units.english: "Wait, how do you know of this?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, come fate a saperlo?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Know it, the Heliarchs do, so learned about it, we have."|619|0
units.english: "Know it, the Heliarchs do, so learned about it, we have."
units.italian: "Saperlo, gli Heliarchs lo sanno, quindi appreso, noi abbiamo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Many resources, our great House possesses," the Arach still by the table adds. "Trivial to acquire such information, for us it is."|620|0
units.english: "Many resources, our great House possesses," the Arach still by the table adds. "Trivial to acquire such information, for us it is."
units.italian: "Molte risorse, la nostra grande Casa possiede," aggiunge l'Arach ancora al tavolo. "Banale procurarsi tali informazioni, per noi è."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"I see. Well, yes, we were invaded by aliens known as the Pug."|622|0
units.english: "I see. Well, yes, we were invaded by aliens known as the Pug."
units.italian: "Capisco. Beh, sì, siamo stati invasi da alieni noti come Pug."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"And how did the Heliarchy know?"|624|0
units.english: "And how did the Heliarchy know?"
units.italian: "E come faceva a saperlo l'Eliarchia?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"In 'their' space, are you not? Scanned by their ships, you were. Subtly amassed, your flight records, your charted map of the galaxy, were," she finishes, and looks to you along with the other two, waiting for your answer.|627|0
units.english: "In 'their' space, are you not? Scanned by their ships, you were. Subtly amassed, your flight records, your charted map of the galaxy, were," she finishes, and looks to you along with the other two, waiting for your answer.
units.italian: "Nel 'loro' spazio, non sei tu? Scansionato dalle loro navi, tu sei stato. Accumulati in modo discreto, i tuoi registri di volo, la tua mappa della galassia, lo sono stati," conclude, e guarda te insieme agli altri due, aspettando la tua risposta.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|label|629|0
units.english: lunarium 2
units.italian: lunarium 2

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"In 'their' space, are you not? Scanned by their ships, you were. Subtly amassed, your flight records, your charted map of the galaxy, were," she finishes. "Of course, register any such logs, your ship does not, when running tasks or simply coming to meet us like this, you are. Permit them find our bases that easily, we must not. But, digress I do. Please Captain, intrigued about these aliens, we very much are." She gestures toward you with one leg, as the other Bebliss members eye you eagerly.|630|0
units.english: "In 'their' space, are you not? Scanned by their ships, you were. Subtly amassed, your flight records, your charted map of the galaxy, were," she finishes. "Of course, register any such logs, your ship does not, when running tasks or simply coming to meet us like this, you are. Permit them find our bases that easily, we must not. But, digress I do. Please Captain, intrigued about these aliens, we very much are." She gestures toward you with one leg, as the other Bebliss members eye you eagerly.
units.italian: "Nel 'loro' spazio, non sei tu? Scansionato dalle loro navi, tu sei stato. Accumulati in modo discreto, i tuoi registri di volo, la tua mappa della galassia, lo sono stati," conclude. "Naturalmente, registrare tali dati, la tua nave non lo fa, quando svolgi incarichi o vieni semplicemente a trovarci così, tu. Permettere loro di trovare le nostre basi così facilmente, noi non dobbiamo. Ma divago. Per favore, Capitano: incuriositi da questi alieni, noi lo siamo moltissimo." Ti fa cenno con una zampa, mentre gli altri membri Bebliss ti guardano con impazienza.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|label|631|0
units.english: pug reveal
units.italian: pug reveal

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Human space was invaded by a species known as the Pug."|633|0
units.english: "Human space was invaded by a species known as the Pug."
units.italian: "Lo spazio umano è stato invaso da una specie nota come Pug."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	Thankfully, the ones that were downing drinks weren't that close when you said the word "Pug," or else you'd need a new set of clothes. One of them signals for a maid to clean up their simultaneous spit takes, and the Arach by the blueprints finally comes closer.|635|0
units.english: Thankfully, the ones that were downing drinks weren't that close when you said the word "Pug," or else you'd need a new set of clothes. One of them signals for a maid to clean up their simultaneous spit takes, and the Arach by the blueprints finally comes closer.
units.italian: Per fortuna, quelli che stavano tracannando non erano così vicini quando hai detto la parola "Pug", altrimenti ti servirebbe un altro vestito. Uno di loro fa cenno a una cameriera di ripulire gli spruzzi che hanno sputato all'unisono, e l'Arach vicino ai progetti si avvicina finalmente.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"'Pug,' were they called?" she asks as the maid behind her quickly scrubs the floor. You confirm it, and she calls for a servant, asking them to ready a ship. She whispers something to the other two members of House Bebliss, which the translation devices don't pick up, and starts gathering her belongings. "To forgive me, I ask you, Captain, but leave at once, I must."|636|0
units.english: "'Pug,' were they called?" she asks as the maid behind her quickly scrubs the floor. You confirm it, and she calls for a servant, asking them to ready a ship. She whispers something to the other two members of House Bebliss, which the translation devices don't pick up, and starts gathering her belongings. "To forgive me, I ask you, Captain, but leave at once, I must."
units.italian: "'Pug', si chiamavano?" chiede mentre la cameriera dietro di lei strofina in fretta il pavimento. Lo confermi, e lei chiama un servitore, chiedendogli di preparare una nave. Sussurra qualcosa agli altri due membri di Casa Bebliss, che i dispositivi di traduzione non captano, e comincia a raccogliere le sue cose. "Perdonarmi, ti chiedo, Capitano, ma partire subito, io devo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	Once she's left, one of the other two asks for more details, so you give them a brief rundown of the Pug invasion and how humanity managed to fight them off. They ask you to further detail the moments where you had to fight off waves of Pug as Freya worked the graviton transmitters and reflectors to link back to other human systems.|637|0
units.english: Once she's left, one of the other two asks for more details, so you give them a brief rundown of the Pug invasion and how humanity managed to fight them off. They ask you to further detail the moments where you had to fight off waves of Pug as Freya worked the graviton transmitters and reflectors to link back to other human systems.
units.italian: Una volta che se n'è andata, uno degli altri due chiede più dettagli, così fai loro un breve riassunto dell'invasione dei Pug e di come l'umanità sia riuscita a respingerli. Ti chiedono di raccontare più in dettaglio i momenti in cui hai dovuto respingere ondate di Pug mentre Freya azionava i trasmettitori e i riflettori gravitonici per ricollegarsi agli altri sistemi umani.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Promising, this Freya woman sounds. Know her location, do you, Captain?"|638|0
units.english: "Promising, this Freya woman sounds. Know her location, do you, Captain?"
units.italian: "Promettente, questa donna Freya sembra. Conoscere la sua posizione, tu la conosci, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	You say that she is probably still on <destination>, and that when you saw her last, she was studying what artifacts the Pug left on the planet.|639|0
units.english: You say that she is probably still on <destination>, and that when you saw her last, she was studying what artifacts the Pug left on the planet.
units.italian: Dici che probabilmente è ancora su <destination>, e che l'ultima volta che l'hai vista stava studiando i manufatti che i Pug avevano lasciato sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Speak with this woman, would you, Captain? If willing to work with us, she is, greatly rewarded, you would be."|640|0
units.english: "Speak with this woman, would you, Captain? If willing to work with us, she is, greatly rewarded, you would be."
units.italian: "Parlare con questa donna, tu lo faresti, Capitano? Se disposta a lavorare con noi, lei è, molto ricompensato, tu saresti."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"I'll go talk with her and see what I can do."|642|0
units.english: "I'll go talk with her and see what I can do."
units.italian: "Andrò a parlarle e vedrò che cosa posso fare."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Sorry, but I don't want to bother her by pulling her into the Coalition's business."|643|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't want to bother her by pulling her into the Coalition's business."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non voglio coinvolgerla negli affari della Coalizione."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	They thank you, and head to another room asking you to wait. One of the maids offers you a choice of another one of the human drinks, while the one holding the platter with drinks that the House Bebliss members were savoring stands like a statue near a corner.|645|0
units.english: They thank you, and head to another room asking you to wait. One of the maids offers you a choice of another one of the human drinks, while the one holding the platter with drinks that the House Bebliss members were savoring stands like a statue near a corner.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano e si dirigono in un'altra stanza chiedendoti di aspettare. Una delle cameriere ti offre un'altra delle bevande umane, mentre quella che regge il vassoio con le bevande che i membri di Casa Bebliss stavano assaporando se ne sta immobile come una statua vicino a un angolo.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	(Taste some of the human drinks.)|647|0
units.english: (Taste some of the human drinks.)
units.italian: (Assaggia qualcuno dei drink umani.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	(Ask for one of the Arach drinks.)|649|0
units.english: (Ask for one of the Arach drinks.)
units.italian: (Chiedi uno dei drink degli Arach.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	(Just wait for my hosts to come back.)|651|0
units.english: (Just wait for my hosts to come back.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e basta che i miei ospiti tornino.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	You politely decline the drinks, and the maid gives you a brief nod, silently going back to her post to stand still like the other. You go over to the table to look at the blueprints, seeing many charts drawn and symbols resembling calculations on one corner, but you can't understand what's written. You sit as best as you can on what you guess is an Arach equivalent to an armchair, looking around the room for a few minutes.|652|0
units.english: You politely decline the drinks, and the maid gives you a brief nod, silently going back to her post to stand still like the other. You go over to the table to look at the blueprints, seeing many charts drawn and symbols resembling calculations on one corner, but you can't understand what's written. You sit as best as you can on what you guess is an Arach equivalent to an armchair, looking around the room for a few minutes.
units.italian: Rifiuti con cortesia le bevande, e la cameriera fa un breve cenno, tornando in silenzio al suo posto per restare immobile come l'altra. Ti avvicini al tavolo per guardare i progetti: vedi molti grafici disegnati e simboli che sembrano calcoli in un angolo, ma non riesci a capire che cosa ci sia scritto. Ti siedi come meglio puoi su quello che supponi sia l'equivalente Arach di una poltrona, e ti guardi intorno per qualche minuto.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	Though House Bebliss seemed surprised with your talk about the Pug, they seem to know human drinks all too well. The coffee, while not too strong, still holds that distinct, slightly bitter taste. The tea, which appears to be chamomile, is as soothing as you remember it being the last time you had the drink. The variety of juices available all have a natural, sweet taste to them, save for the peach juice, which you avoided given that its consistency seemed to be closer to pudding than juice and oozed over the lip as you tilted the cup.|655|0
units.english: Though House Bebliss seemed surprised with your talk about the Pug, they seem to know human drinks all too well. The coffee, while not too strong, still holds that distinct, slightly bitter taste. The tea, which appears to be chamomile, is as soothing as you remember it being the last time you had the drink. The variety of juices available all have a natural, sweet taste to them, save for the peach juice, which you avoided given that its consistency seemed to be closer to pudding than juice and oozed over the lip as you tilted the cup.
units.italian: Anche se Casa Bebliss è sembrata sorpresa dal tuo discorso sui Pug, le bevande umane sembrano conoscerle fin troppo bene. Il caffè, per quanto non troppo forte, conserva quel gusto distinto e leggermente amaro. Il tè, che sembra camomilla, è rassicurante come lo ricordavi l'ultima volta che l'hai bevuto. Le varie bevande a base di frutta hanno tutte un sapore naturale e dolce, tranne il succo di pesca, che hai evitato perché la consistenza sembrava più vicina a un budino che a un succo, e colava oltre il bordo quando inclinavi la tazza.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	You wave for the maid with the Arach drinks, and she looks to the other maid in surprise. She tries explaining to you that she isn't sure if these drinks are meant for human consumption. Regardless, you insist, so she reluctantly walks over, handing you one of the cups. You bring it to your nose, and an overwhelming aroma hits your nostrils. The drink somehow smells oddly similar to the feeling you have in your mouth after waking up extremely parched after a long night of sleep. You carefully sip some of it, bringing the cup away from your mouth once the liquid hits your tongue. The sweetness has a sting to it, as if it's lightly biting your tongue as it travels through your mouth. Swallowing it, your throat feels a worrying numbing sensation for several seconds. You put the cup back on the platter, and the maids move away. After about a minute, you start struggling to keep your eyes open. Your surroundings suddenly appear much brighter than before, as if the lights in the ceiling have somehow intensified their output and the colors on everything around you have sharpened their image. You close your eyes for a few minutes to gain your bearings, and everything seems to go back to normal.|658|0
units.english: You wave for the maid with the Arach drinks, and she looks to the other maid in surprise. She tries explaining to you that she isn't sure if these drinks are meant for human consumption. Regardless, you insist, so she reluctantly walks over, handing you one of the cups. You bring it to your nose, and an overwhelming aroma hits your nostrils. The drink somehow smells oddly similar to the feeling you have in your mouth after waking up extremely parched after a long night of sleep. You carefully sip some of it, bringing the cup away from your mouth once the liquid hits your tongue. The sweetness has a sting to it, as if it's lightly biting your tongue as it travels through your mouth. Swallowing it, your throat feels a worrying numbing sensation for several seconds. You put the cup back on the platter, and the maids move away. After about a minute, you start struggling to keep your eyes open. Your surroundings suddenly appear much brighter than before, as if the lights in the ceiling have somehow intensified their output and the colors on everything around you have sharpened their image. You close your eyes for a few minutes to gain your bearings, and everything seems to go back to normal.
units.italian: Fai cenno alla cameriera con le bevande degli Arach, e lei guarda l'altra cameriera con sorpresa. Cerca di spiegarti che non è sicura che quelle bevande siano adatte al consumo umano. Insisti comunque, così lei si avvicina a malincuore e ti consegna una delle tazze. La porti al naso, e un aroma travolgente ti investe le narici. La bevanda ha uno strano odore simile alla sensazione che hai in bocca quando ti svegli con la gola secca dopo una lunga notte di sonno. Ne sorseggi con cautela, allontanando la tazza dalla bocca appena il liquido ti tocca la lingua. La dolcezza ha una puntura, come se ti mordesse leggermente la lingua mentre attraversa la bocca. Inghiottendola, la gola ti dà una sensazione di intorpidimento preoccupante per diversi secondi. Rimetti la tazza sul vassoio, e le cameriere si allontanano. Dopo circa un minuto, cominci a faticare a tenere gli occhi aperti. Quello che ti circonda appare improvvisamente molto più luminoso di prima, come se le luci del soffitto avessero in qualche modo aumentato la loro intensità e i colori di tutto intorno a te avessero affilato la loro immagine. Chiudi gli occhi per qualche minuto per riprenderti, e tutto sembra tornare alla normalità.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	When your hosts return, they hand you a small suitcase of sorts. "Translated our proposal into your language, we have," one of them says. "Bring that to Miss Freya, you must. Hopeful, we are, that willing to share the research material with us, she is."|660|0
units.english: When your hosts return, they hand you a small suitcase of sorts. "Translated our proposal into your language, we have," one of them says. "Bring that to Miss Freya, you must. Hopeful, we are, that willing to share the research material with us, she is."
units.italian: Quando i tuoi ospiti tornano, ti consegnano una specie di piccola valigetta. "Tradotto la nostra proposta nella tua lingua, noi abbiamo," dice uno di loro. "Portarla alla signorina Freya, tu devi. Fiduciosi, noi siamo, che disposta a condividere con noi il materiale di ricerca, lei sia."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Also inside, certain... research papers are. A gift, she may consider it," the other adds.|663|0
units.english: "Also inside, certain... research papers are. A gift, she may consider it," the other adds.
units.italian: "Anche dentro, certi... documenti di ricerca sono. Un regalo, lei potrebbe considerarlo," aggiunge l'altro.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|label|665|0
units.english: lunarium 3
units.italian: lunarium 3

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	"Also inside, certain... research papers are. A gift, she may consider it," the other adds. "And, Captain, one last thing. Realize we do that in order to explain it all to her, inevitably tell Miss Freya of the Coalition, you will. Only, ask of you, I must, that reveal anything about the Lunarium, you do not. A bordering human world the Heliarchs periodically visit, and no means of culling what information they there gain, we have. Safer, it will be, if keep the Redoubt a secret, you do."|666|0
units.english: "Also inside, certain... research papers are. A gift, she may consider it," the other adds. "And, Captain, one last thing.
