Realize we do that in order to explain it all to her, inevitably tell Miss Freya of the Coalition, you will. Only, ask of you, I must, that reveal anything about the Lunarium, you do not. A bordering human world the Heliarchs periodically visit, and no means of culling what information they there gain, we have. Safer, it will be, if keep the Redoubt a secret, you do."
units.italian: "Anche dentro, certi... documenti di ricerca ci sono. Un regalo, potrebbe considerarlo," aggiunge l'altro. "E, Capitano, un'ultima cosa. Rendermi conto che per spiegare tutto a lei, inevitabilmente raccontare alla signorina Freya della Coalizione, tu lo farai. Solo, chiederti io devo, che non rivelare nulla del Lunarium, tu non lo faccia. Un mondo umano di confine che gli Heliarchs visitano periodicamente, e nessun mezzo per scremare le informazioni che lì raccolgono, noi abbiamo. Più sicuro, sarà, se tenere segreto il Redoubt, tu lo farai."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	They say they will be waiting in the estate for her response, and have the servants escort you back to your ship.|668|0
units.english: They say they will be waiting in the estate for her response, and have the servants escort you back to your ship.
units.italian: Dicono che aspetteranno nella tenuta una sua risposta, e fanno accompagnare te e i servitori di nuovo alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 2-FW|	They stare at you in surprise for a bit, glancing at one another a few times. They sigh. "Very well, understandable, that is," one of them says. They ask for some more drinks, and have some servants escort you back to your ship.|671|0
units.english: They stare at you in surprise for a bit, glancing at one another a few times. They sigh. "Very well, understandable, that is," one of them says. They ask for some more drinks, and have some servants escort you back to your ship.
units.italian: Ti fissano sorpresi per un po', guardandosi l'un l'altro diverse volte. Sospirano. "Molto bene, comprensibile, questo è," dice uno di loro. Chiedono altre bevande e fanno accompagnare te e i servitori di nuovo alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|name|681|0
units.english: Tell the Free Worlds about the Coalition
units.italian: Parlare ai Mondi Liberi della Coalizione

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|description|682|0
units.english: Go to <destination> with Freya and tell JJ all you've learned about the Coalition.
units.italian: Vai a <destination> con Freya e racconta a JJ tutto ciò che hai imparato sulla Coalizione.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|blocked|690|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|You look around for Freya, asking the local dock workers to point you in the direction of the people researching the Pug tech. They direct you to a quieter, less crowded place, where some warehouse complexes have been set up. Some are painted in the usual Syndicate colors, some are guarded by a few Navy troops, and a Free Worlds flag flies by the entrance of the one you enter. Inside, you see groups of people surrounding the various artifacts that the Pug left behind. Some of them are running complicated-looking tests, but it seems that they are mostly discussing what to do with the artifacts next. One of the graviton transmitters sits opposite to the entrance, half intact, half dismantled, with an array of scientists poking and prodding the machinery inside.|693|0
units.english: You look around for Freya, asking the local dock workers to point you in the direction of the people researching the Pug tech. They direct you to a quieter, less crowded place, where some warehouse complexes have been set up. Some are painted in the usual Syndicate colors, some are guarded by a few Navy troops, and a Free Worlds flag flies by the entrance of the one you enter. Inside, you see groups of people surrounding the various artifacts that the Pug left behind. Some of them are running complicated-looking tests, but it seems that they are mostly discussing what to do with the artifacts next. One of the graviton transmitters sits opposite to the entrance, half intact, half dismantled, with an array of scientists poking and prodding the machinery inside.
units.italian: Ti guardi intorno in cerca di Freya, chiedendo agli operai del porto di indicarti la direzione delle persone che studiano la tecnologia dei Pug. Ti mandano in un luogo più tranquillo e meno affollato, dove sono stati allestiti alcuni complessi di magazzini. Alcuni sono dipinti con i soliti colori del Sindacato, altri sono sorvegliati da alcune truppe della Marina, e una bandiera dei Mondi Liberi sventola all'ingresso di quello in cui entri. Dentro vedi gruppi di persone intorno ai vari manufatti che i Pug hanno lasciato. Alcuni eseguono test dall'aria complicata, ma sembra che per lo più stiano discutendo di che cosa fare dei manufatti. Uno dei trasmettitori gravitonici è di fronte all'ingresso, mezzo intatto e mezzo smontato, con una serie di scienziati che armeggiano con i meccanismi all'interno.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	Freya is atop a ladder near the transmitter when she sees you. She quickly hops down from her perch and runs toward you. "<first>! It's nice to see you again. What brings you here?" You tell her you have some important matters to discuss, and she has you follow her to an office-like room packed with tools and components.|694|0
units.english: Freya is atop a ladder near the transmitter when she sees you. She quickly hops down from her perch and runs toward you. "<first>! It's nice to see you again. What brings you here?" You tell her you have some important matters to discuss, and she has you follow her to an office-like room packed with tools and components.
units.italian: Freya è su una scala vicino al trasmettitore quando ti vede. Scende in fretta dal suo posto e ti corre incontro. "<first>! Che bello rivederti. Che cosa ti porta qui?" Le dici che hai alcune questioni importanti di cui parlare, e lei ti fa seguire in una stanza simile a un ufficio, piena di attrezzi e componenti.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|label|697|0
units.english: don't tell
units.italian: don't tell

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	You give her a rundown of the Coalition, explaining about the three species, the Heliarchs and their fight against the Quarg, and about who House Bebliss is, handing her the suitcase when you're done.|698|0
units.english: You give her a rundown of the Coalition, explaining about the three species, the Heliarchs and their fight against the Quarg, and about who House Bebliss is, handing her the suitcase when you're done.
units.italian: Le fai un riassunto della Coalizione, spiegando delle tre specie, degli Heliarchs e della loro lotta contro i Quarg, e di chi sia Casa Bebliss, consegnandole la valigetta quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	(Tell her everything, including the Lunarium.)|702|0
units.english: (Tell her everything, including the Lunarium.)
units.italian: (Raccontale tutto, incluso il Lunarium.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	(Don't mention the Lunarium.)|703|0
units.english: (Don't mention the Lunarium.)
units.italian: (Non menzionare il Lunarium.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	You give her a quick rundown of the Coalition, explaining about the three species, the Heliarchs and their fight against the Quarg, the Lunarium Redoubt and their intentions to overthrow the Heliarchy, and the part House Bebliss plays in that, handing her the suitcase when you're done.|705|0
units.english: You give her a quick rundown of the Coalition, explaining about the three species, the Heliarchs and their fight against the Quarg, the Lunarium Redoubt and their intentions to overthrow the Heliarchy, and the part House Bebliss plays in that, handing her the suitcase when you're done.
units.italian: Le fai un rapido riassunto della Coalizione, spiegando delle tre specie, degli Heliarchs e della loro lotta contro i Quarg, del Lunarium Redoubt e delle sue intenzioni di rovesciare l'Eliarchia, e del ruolo che Casa Bebliss vi ha, consegnandole la valigetta quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	"Well, at least these ones are asking if they can come invade us," she jokes as she lays the suitcase on a table, opening it. "Three alien species, huh? We were picking up some degraded radio signals from these systems, before the war even, so I figured there was someone out there." She begins to read the message House Bebliss prepared for her, frowning right at the start. "You didn't write this, did you?" You shake your head. "Thought so. The words are... jumbled?"|707|0
units.english: "Well, at least these ones are asking if they can come invade us," she jokes as she lays the suitcase on a table, opening it. "Three alien species, huh? We were picking up some degraded radio signals from these systems, before the war even, so I figured there was someone out there." She begins to read the message House Bebliss prepared for her, frowning right at the start. "You didn't write this, did you?" You shake your head. "Thought so. The words are... jumbled?"
units.italian: "Beh, almeno questi qui chiedono se possono venire a invaderci," scherza mentre appoggia la valigetta su un tavolo e l'apre. "Tre specie aliene, eh? Captavamo già dei segnali radio degradati da questi sistemi, prima ancora della guerra, quindi immaginavo che ci fosse qualcuno là fuori." Comincia a leggere il messaggio che Casa Bebliss ha preparato per lei, aggrottando le sopracciglia fin dall'inizio. "Non l'hai scritto tu, vero?" Fai cenno di no. "Immaginavo. Le parole sono... mescolate?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	"Oh, that. You get used to it."|709|0
units.english: "Oh, that. You get used to it."
units.italian: "Ah, quello. Ci si fa l'abitudine."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	"It's not so bad when you're talking with them in person."|710|0
units.english: "It's not so bad when you're talking with them in person."
units.italian: "Non è così male quando parli con loro di persona."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	She gives the message an odd look, lets out an "if you say so," and continues to read it. "If this 'House Bebliss' is as advanced as they claim in this, I don't see how I could help them with anything, but they're offering to share their knowledge with me in return, so I won't complain. If nothing else it'll be an experience, working with giant spiders."|711|0
units.english: She gives the message an odd look, lets out an "if you say so," and continues to read it. "If this 'House Bebliss' is as advanced as they claim in this, I don't see how I could help them with anything, but they're offering to share their knowledge with me in return, so I won't complain. If nothing else it'll be an experience, working with giant spiders."
units.italian: Dà al messaggio uno sguardo strano, emette un "se lo dici tu" e continua a leggerlo. "Se questa 'Casa Bebliss' è avanzata come sostiene qui, non vedo come potrei aiutarli in qualcosa, ma in cambio offrono di condividere con me le loro conoscenze, quindi non mi lamenterò. Quantomeno sarà un'esperienza, lavorare con ragni giganti."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	"So you're fine with letting them study the Pug artifacts with you?"|713|0
units.english: "So you're fine with letting them study the Pug artifacts with you?"
units.italian: "Quindi ti va bene lasciare che studino con te i manufatti dei Pug?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	"I can go back and tell them you've agreed then?"|714|0
units.english: "I can go back and tell them you've agreed then?"
units.italian: "Posso tornare a dirgli che hai accettato, allora?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	"Have you told the others about this?" Freya asks, and you tell her you haven't. "Alondo, JJ... they need to know about this 'Coalition,'" continues Freya, "even if they've no intention of invading us. JJ is stationed on <planet> currently, so I'll send word to him that we'll be heading there to meet with him. You can give us the whole situation, all details you've found out, there."|715|0
units.english: "Have you told the others about this?" Freya asks, and you tell her you haven't. "Alondo, JJ... they need to know about this 'Coalition,'" continues Freya, "even if they've no intention of invading us. JJ is stationed on <planet> currently, so I'll send word to him that we'll be heading there to meet with him. You can give us the whole situation, all details you've found out, there."
units.italian: "Ne hai parlato agli altri?" chiede Freya, e tu le dici di no. "Alondo, JJ... devono sapere di questa 'Coalizione'," continua Freya, "anche se non hanno alcuna intenzione di invaderci. JJ è di stanza su <planet> in questo momento, quindi gli manderò parola che stiamo arrivando per incontrarlo. Là potrai spiegargli tutta la situazione, tutti i dettagli che hai scoperto."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	You follow her back out of the room, and she tells the workers there she'll be heading away with you to <planet> to discuss some matters with JJ. They wish you a good trip, and you head out of the building and into a small residential area near the warehouse, built for the workers during their stay here. You help Freya pack her things while she messages JJ, and you two head to your ship. "When you're done, you can go pick up these Arachi and bring them here. On our way to <planet>, and while you're away getting them, I'll have some time to look at what they've sent me."|716|0
units.english: You follow her back out of the room, and she tells the workers there she'll be heading away with you to <planet> to discuss some matters with JJ. They wish you a good trip, and you head out of the building and into a small residential area near the warehouse, built for the workers during their stay here. You help Freya pack her things while she messages JJ, and you two head to your ship. "When you're done, you can go pick up these Arachi and bring them here. On our way to <planet>, and while you're away getting them, I'll have some time to look at what they've sent me."
units.italian: La segui fuori dalla stanza, e lei dice ai lavoratori che se ne andrà con te verso <planet> per discutere alcune questioni con JJ. Ti augurano un buon viaggio, e tu esci dall'edificio e ti addentri in una piccola zona residenziale vicino al magazzino, costruita per i lavoratori durante la loro permanenza. Aiuti Freya a fare i bagagli mentre lei scrive a JJ, e voi due vi dirigete alla tua nave. "Quando avete finito, puoi andare a prendere questi Arachi e portarli qui. Mentre andiamo verso <planet> e mentre sei via a prenderli, avrò un po' di tempo per guardare quello che mi hanno mandato."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|	You show her to her bunk once you're inside your ship, and plot a course for <destination>.|717|0
units.english: You show her to her bunk once you're inside your ship, and plot a course for <destination>.
units.italian: Le mostri la sua cuccetta una volta dentro la nave e imposti una rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 3-FW|dialog|722|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|name|729|0
units.english: An Answer to House Bebliss
units.italian: Una risposta a Casa Bebliss

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|description|730|0
units.english: Head back to <destination> to tell House Bebliss that Freya has agreed with their proposal.
units.italian: Torna a <destination> per dire a Casa Bebliss che Freya ha accettato la loro proposta.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|JJ is waiting for you two when you land, wearing a uniform with various medals and honors on his chest. He greets Freya with a handshake, then turns to you. "It was nice to hear from Freya that you'd be stopping to pay us a visit. Well, until she started going on about how you had some 'critical' information, that is," he says as he shakes your hand, sighing gently. "So much for taking a break from managing fleets."|739|0
units.english: JJ is waiting for you two when you land, wearing a uniform with various medals and honors on his chest. He greets Freya with a handshake, then turns to you. "It was nice to hear from Freya that you'd be stopping to pay us a visit. Well, until she started going on about how you had some 'critical' information, that is," he says as he shakes your hand, sighing gently. "So much for taking a break from managing fleets."
units.italian: JJ vi aspetta quando atterrate, indossando un'uniforme con varie medaglie e onorificenze sul petto. Saluta Freya con una stretta di mano, poi si volta verso di te. "È stato bello sentire da Freya che saresti passato a farci visita. Beh, almeno finché non ha cominciato a dire che avevi informazioni 'critiche'," dice stringendoti la mano con un sospiro leggero. "Addio pausa dalla gestione delle flotte."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Sorry about that. It's nice to see you too, JJ."|741|0
units.english: "Sorry about that. It's nice to see you too, JJ."
units.italian: "Scusa per questo. È bello rivederti anche a me, JJ."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Well, you won't need to worry about anything being 'critical' too much when it comes to these aliens. Hopefully."|743|0
units.english: "Well, you won't need to worry about anything being 'critical' too much when it comes to these aliens. Hopefully."
units.italian: "Beh, non dovrai preoccuparti troppo che qualcosa sia 'critico' quando si tratta di questi alieni. Speriamo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Hopefully? Wait, aliens?!" He gives you a mix between a worried look and a stern face. "Let's just go talk in my office. I'm guessing this is going to be a long story."|744|0
units.english: "Hopefully? Wait, aliens?!" He gives you a mix between a worried look and a stern face. "Let's just go talk in my office. I'm guessing this is going to be a long story."
units.italian: "Speriamo? Aspetta, alieni?!" Ti lancia uno sguardo a metà tra il preoccupato e il severo. "Andiamo a parlarne nel mio ufficio. Immagino che sarà una storia lunga."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	He beckons you to follow him to a traffic shuttle, which eventually brings you to a towering government building. As you get closer, you notice the main courtyard is home to a multitude of different colored flags, all of them situated around the Free Worlds' own. "Planetary flags," JJ says as you both get out of the shuttle. "Some of our planets created their own recently, and some of the more diplomatic folks decided to set them up around the major government buildings." Leaving the flags waving in the breeze, the three of you head inside the building and go up an elevator, arriving on a floor with a couple rooms to the side and a larger one opposite the elevator. You enter the larger room and see a nice wooden desk, which JJ heads to, sitting behind it, as Freya takes a seat on the sofa.|746|0
units.english: He beckons you to follow him to a traffic shuttle, which eventually brings you to a towering government building. As you get closer, you notice the main courtyard is home to a multitude of different colored flags, all of them situated around the Free Worlds' own. "Planetary flags," JJ says as you both get out of the shuttle. "Some of our planets created their own recently, and some of the more diplomatic folks decided to set them up around the major government buildings." Leaving the flags waving in the breeze, the three of you head inside the building and go up an elevator, arriving on a floor with a couple rooms to the side and a larger one opposite the elevator. You enter the larger room and see a nice wooden desk, which JJ heads to, sitting behind it, as Freya takes a seat on the sofa.
units.italian: Ti fa cenno di seguirlo su una navetta di linea, che alla fine ti porta a un palazzo del governo torreggiante. Avvicinandoti, noti che il cortile principale ospita una moltitudine di bandiere di colori diversi, tutte disposte intorno a quella dei Mondi Liberi. "Bandiere planetarie," dice JJ mentre uscite entrambi dalla navetta. "Alcuni dei nostri pianeti se ne sono create di proprie di recente, e alcuni dei più diplomatici hanno deciso di collocarle intorno agli edifici principali del governo." Lasciando le bandiere a sventolare nella brezza, entrate tutti e tre nel palazzo e salite con un ascensore, arrivando a un piano con un paio di stanze laterali e una più grande di fronte all'ascensore. Entrate nella stanza più grande e vedete una bella scrivania di legno, verso cui JJ si dirige per sedersi dietro, mentre Freya prende posto sul divano.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Well, here we are. What is this 'critical information' you've found, Captain <last>?"|747|0
units.english: "Well, here we are. What is this 'critical information' you've found, Captain <last>?"
units.italian: "Bene, eccoci. Qual è questa 'informazione critica' che hai trovato, Capitano <last>?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Some more aliens."|751|0
units.english: "Some more aliens."
units.italian: "Altri alieni."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"I hope none of you are afraid of spiders."|753|0
units.english: "I hope none of you are afraid of spiders."
units.italian: "Spero che nessuno di voi abbia paura dei ragni."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	(Explain everything, including the Lunarium.)|757|0
units.english: (Explain everything, including the Lunarium.)
units.italian: (Spiega tutto, incluso il Lunarium.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	(Don't mention the Lunarium.)|759|0
units.english: (Don't mention the Lunarium.)
units.italian: (Non menzionare il Lunarium.)

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	JJ quietly listens as you explain to him all you've learned about the Coalition. You bring up a map of the Free Worlds and show him and Freya the rough area of Coalition space and where it borders Free Worlds territory. As you gesture toward the map, you tell them of the three species, about the Heliarchs and how they've taken the three Quarg rings. Eventually you get to the Arach Houses, explaining that House Bebliss are the ones who wish to go study the Pug artifacts with Freya.|761|0
units.english: JJ quietly listens as you explain to him all you've learned about the Coalition. You bring up a map of the Free Worlds and show him and Freya the rough area of Coalition space and where it borders Free Worlds territory. As you gesture toward the map, you tell them of the three species, about the Heliarchs and how they've taken the three Quarg rings. Eventually you get to the Arach Houses, explaining that House Bebliss are the ones who wish to go study the Pug artifacts with Freya.
units.italian: JJ ascolta in silenzio mentre gli spieghi tutto ciò che hai imparato sulla Coalizione. Fai comparire una mappa dei Mondi Liberi e mostri a lui e a Freya la zona approssimativa dello spazio della Coalizione e dove confina con il territorio dei Mondi Liberi. Indicando la mappa, racconti delle tre specie, degli Heliarchs e di come hanno preso i tre anelli dei Quarg. Alla fine arrivi alle Case Arach, spiegando che Casa Bebliss è quella che vuole andare a studiare i manufatti dei Pug con Freya.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	When you're done, JJ is the first to speak up. "So far, we seem to be getting along better with these aliens than we did with the Pug. It's good that they're trying to be diplomatic, though I'm not sure it'd be a good idea for the general public to know of them, given past experiences. At least for right now."|762|0
units.english: When you're done, JJ is the first to speak up. "So far, we seem to be getting along better with these aliens than we did with the Pug. It's good that they're trying to be diplomatic, though I'm not sure it'd be a good idea for the general public to know of them, given past experiences. At least for right now."
units.italian: Quando hai finito, JJ è il primo a parlare. "Finora sembra che andiamo d'accordo con questi alieni meglio di quanto sia andata con i Pug. È positivo che cerchino la via diplomatica, anche se non sono sicuro che sarebbe una buona idea farli conoscere al grande pubblico, viste le esperienze passate. Almeno per ora."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Do they have jump drives?" Freya asks. You nod, but say that they can't make their own. "Well, as long as what stockpile they have isn't too large, we shouldn't be in too much trouble."|763|0
units.english: "Do they have jump drives?" Freya asks. You nod, but say that they can't make their own. "Well, as long as what stockpile they have isn't too large, we shouldn't be in too much trouble."
units.italian: "Hanno i motori di salto?" chiede Freya. Fai cenno di sì, ma dici che non sanno fabbricarli. "Beh, finché la scorta che hanno non è troppo grande, non dovremmo avere troppi problemi."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Except they took three Quarg rings," JJ chimes in. "They've beaten the Quarg? So they're stronger than the Quarg? More advanced?" He asks.|764|0
units.english: "Except they took three Quarg rings," JJ chimes in. "They've beaten the Quarg? So they're stronger than the Quarg? More advanced?" He asks.
units.italian: "Solo che hanno preso tre anelli dei Quarg," interviene JJ. "Hanno battuto i Quarg? Quindi sono più forti dei Quarg? Più avanzati?" chiede.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"No, but their ships are still a lot tougher than human ones."|766|0
units.english: "No, but their ships are still a lot tougher than human ones."
units.italian: "No, ma le loro navi sono comunque molto più resistenti di quelle umane."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"No, but they do outnumber humans - all humans."|767|0
units.english: "No, but they do outnumber humans - all humans."
units.italian: "No, ma sono più numerosi degli umani, di tutti gli umani."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"The Quarg would never just abandon their rings, and do you know how many Quarg are in one ring alone? There's no way they would have lost three of them like that," Freya says. "They'll want those rings back, that's certain."|768|0
units.english: "The Quarg would never just abandon their rings, and do you know how many Quarg are in one ring alone? There's no way they would have lost three of them like that," Freya says. "They'll want those rings back, that's certain."
units.italian: "I Quarg non abbandonerebbero mai i loro anelli, e sai quanti Quarg ci sono in un solo anello? Non c'è modo che ne abbiano persi tre così," dice Freya. "Vorrano quei anelli indietro, questo è certo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"And we're right between this 'Coalition' and the Quarg near Tarazed." JJ points at the map. "If they decide to go get their rings back, and our neighbors decide to use their jump drives to create a buffer before the Quarg hit them on their home turf..."|769|0
units.english: "And we're right between this 'Coalition' and the Quarg near Tarazed." JJ points at the map. "If they decide to go get their rings back, and our neighbors decide to use their jump drives to create a buffer before the Quarg hit them on their home turf..."
units.italian: "E noi siamo proprio tra questa 'Coalizione' e i Quarg vicino a Tarazed." JJ indica la mappa. "Se decidono di andare a riprendersi i loro anelli, e i nostri vicini decidono di usare i loro motori di salto per creare un cuscinetto prima che i Quarg li colpiscano a casa loro..."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	They stay silent for a while, then JJ picks up the talk again. "If the Quarg have waited six thousand years, then they might wait a few thousand more. What matters now is that we know of these aliens, meaning we must start thinking about possible outcomes to all of this and what they mean for the Free Worlds. If we start preparations now, perhaps we'll get lucky and we won't get caught up in any other wars; especially wars involving the Quarg."|770|0
units.english: They stay silent for a while, then JJ picks up the talk again. "If the Quarg have waited six thousand years, then they might wait a few thousand more. What matters now is that we know of these aliens, meaning we must start thinking about possible outcomes to all of this and what they mean for the Free Worlds. If we start preparations now, perhaps we'll get lucky and we won't get caught up in any other wars; especially wars involving the Quarg."
units.italian: Restano in silenzio per un po', poi JJ riprende a parlare. "Se i Quarg hanno aspettato seimila anni, potrebbero aspettarne altri qualche migliaio. Quello che conta ora è che sappiamo di questi alieni, il che significa che dobbiamo cominciare a pensare ai possibili esiti di tutto questo e a cosa significano per i Mondi Liberi. Se cominciamo a prepararci adesso, forse saremo fortunati e non ci troveremo coinvolti in altre guerre; soprattutto in guerre che coinvolgono i Quarg."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	JJ quietly listens as you explain to him all you've learned about the Coalition. You bring up a map of the Free Worlds and show him and Freya the rough area of Coalition space and where it borders Free Worlds territory. As you gesture toward the map, you tell them of the three species, about the Heliarchs and how they've taken the three Quarg rings. Eventually you get to the Arach Houses, explaining that House Bebliss are the ones who wish to go study the Pug artifacts with Freya. You also tell them about the Lunarium, explaining the group's actions and their wish to take down the Heliarch government, and what role House Bebliss has in helping them.|773|0
units.english: JJ quietly listens as you explain to him all you've learned about the Coalition. You bring up a map of the Free Worlds and show him and Freya the rough area of Coalition space and where it borders Free Worlds territory. As you gesture toward the map, you tell them of the three species, about the Heliarchs and how they've taken the three Quarg rings. Eventually you get to the Arach Houses, explaining that House Bebliss are the ones who wish to go study the Pug artifacts with Freya. You also tell them about the Lunarium, explaining the group's actions and their wish to take down the Heliarch government, and what role House Bebliss has in helping them.
units.italian: JJ ascolta in silenzio mentre gli spieghi tutto ciò che hai imparato sulla Coalizione. Fai comparire una mappa dei Mondi Liberi e mostri a lui e a Freya la zona approssimativa dello spazio della Coalizione e dove confina con il territorio dei Mondi Liberi. Indicando la mappa, racconti delle tre specie, degli Heliarchs e di come hanno preso i tre anelli dei Quarg. Alla fine arrivi alle Case Arach, spiegando che Casa Bebliss è quella che vuole andare a studiare i manufatti dei Pug con Freya. Parli anche del Lunarium, spiegando le azioni del gruppo e il loro desiderio di abbattere il governo degli Heliarchs, e quale ruolo abbia Casa Bebliss nell'aiutarli.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	When you're done, JJ is the first to speak up. "So far, we seem to be getting along better with these aliens than we did with the Pug. It's good that they're trying to be diplomatic, though I'm not sure it'd be a good idea for the general public to know of them, given past experiences. At least for right now." He pauses, then addresses you directly. "It's... bold of you to want to help this resistance group of theirs. There's some sympathy given the Free Worlds' own history, but they sound like they have an even worse shot than what we had."|774|0
units.english: When you're done, JJ is the first to speak up. "So far, we seem to be getting along better with these aliens than we did with the Pug. It's good that they're trying to be diplomatic, though I'm not sure it'd be a good idea for the general public to know of them, given past experiences. At least for right now." He pauses, then addresses you directly. "It's... bold of you to want to help this resistance group of theirs. There's some sympathy given the Free Worlds' own history, but they sound like they have an even worse shot than what we had."
units.italian: Quando hai finito, JJ è il primo a parlare. "Finora sembra che andiamo d'accordo con questi alieni meglio di quanto sia andata con i Pug. È positivo che cerchino la via diplomatica, anche se non sono sicuro che sarebbe una buona idea farli conoscere al grande pubblico, viste le esperienze passate. Almeno per ora." Fa una pausa, poi si rivolge direttamente a te. "È... coraggioso da parte tua voler aiutare questo loro gruppo di resistenza. C'è una certa solidarietà, vista la storia dei Mondi Liberi, ma sembra che abbiano prospettive ancora peggiori delle nostre."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Whatever their government is, or whether it's overthrown or not, it doesn't change that they're right at our doorstep," Freya says. "Do they have jump drives?" she asks. You nod, but say that they can't make their own. "Well, as long as what stockpile they have isn't too large, we shouldn't be in too much trouble."|775|0
units.english: "Whatever their government is, or whether it's overthrown or not, it doesn't change that they're right at our doorstep," Freya says. "Do they have jump drives?" she asks. You nod, but say that they can't make their own. "Well, as long as what stockpile they have isn't too large, we shouldn't be in too much trouble."
units.italian: "Qualunque sia il loro governo, o che venga rovesciato o no, non cambia il fatto che sono proprio sulla nostra soglia," dice Freya. "Hanno i motori di salto?" chiede. Fai cenno di sì, ma dici che non sanno fabbricarli. "Beh, finché la scorta che hanno non è troppo grande, non dovremmo avere troppi problemi."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Except they took three Quarg rings," JJ chimes in. "They've beaten the Quarg? So they're stronger than the Quarg? More advanced?" He asks.|776|0
units.english: "Except they took three Quarg rings," JJ chimes in. "They've beaten the Quarg? So they're stronger than the Quarg? More advanced?" He asks.
units.italian: "Solo che hanno preso tre anelli dei Quarg," interviene JJ. "Hanno battuto i Quarg? Quindi sono più forti dei Quarg? Più avanzati?" chiede.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"No, but their ships are still a lot tougher than human ones."|778|0
units.english: "No, but their ships are still a lot tougher than human ones."
units.italian: "No, ma le loro navi sono comunque molto più resistenti di quelle umane."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"No, but they do outnumber humans - all humans."|779|0
units.english: "No, but they do outnumber humans - all humans."
units.italian: "No, ma sono più numerosi degli umani, di tutti gli umani."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"The Quarg would never just abandon their rings, and do you know how many Quarg are in one ring alone? There's no way they would have lost three of them like that," Freya says. "They'll want those rings back, no matter what faction is holding them."|780|0
units.english: "The Quarg would never just abandon their rings, and do you know how many Quarg are in one ring alone? There's no way they would have lost three of them like that," Freya says. "They'll want those rings back, no matter what faction is holding them."
units.italian: "I Quarg non abbandonerebbero mai i loro anelli, e sai quanti Quarg ci sono in un solo anello? Non c'è modo che ne abbiano persi tre così," dice Freya. "Vorrano quei anelli indietro, qualunque fazione li tenga."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"And we're right between this 'Coalition' and the Quarg near Tarazed." JJ points at the map. "If they decide to go get their rings back, and our neighbors decide to use their jump drives to create a buffer before the Quarg hit them on their home turf..."|781|0
units.english: "And we're right between this 'Coalition' and the Quarg near Tarazed." JJ points at the map. "If they decide to go get their rings back, and our neighbors decide to use their jump drives to create a buffer before the Quarg hit them on their home turf..."
units.italian: "E noi siamo proprio tra questa 'Coalizione' e i Quarg vicino a Tarazed." JJ indica la mappa. "Se decidono di andare a riprendersi i loro anelli, e i nostri vicini decidono di usare i loro motori di salto per creare un cuscinetto prima che i Quarg li colpiscano a casa loro..."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"Well, if <first> and this 'Lunarium Redoubt' succeed, it probably won't come to that, from what I've gathered," Freya says.|782|0
units.english: "Well, if <first> and this 'Lunarium Redoubt' succeed, it probably won't come to that, from what I've gathered," Freya says.
units.italian: "Beh, se <first> e questo 'Lunarium Redoubt' riescono nel loro intento, probabilmente non si arriverà a questo, da quanto ho capito," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	"And if they don't? Then a human tried to help the rebels in their space overthrow them. A human that worked for the Free Worlds," JJ responds. "I'm not blaming you, <first>, but we don't know what these 'Heliarchs' will do if you fail. If they figure out how to make their own jump drives, or worse, learn how to cut off our systems like the Pug did..."|783|0
units.english: "And if they don't? Then a human tried to help the rebels in their space overthrow them. A human that worked for the Free Worlds," JJ responds. "I'm not blaming you, <first>, but we don't know what these 'Heliarchs' will do if you fail. If they figure out how to make their own jump drives, or worse, learn how to cut off our systems like the Pug did..."
units.italian: "E se non ci riescono? Allora un umano ha cercato di aiutare i ribelli nel loro spazio a rovesciarli. Un umano che lavorava per i Mondi Liberi," risponde JJ. "Non ti sto incolpando, <first>, ma non sappiamo che cosa faranno questi 'Heliarchs' se fallirai. Se scoprono come fabbricare i propri motori di salto, o peggio, imparano a isolarci i sistemi come hanno fatto i Pug..."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	They stay silent for a while, then Freya picks up the talk again. "If this rebel group never came to be, we could eventually be caught up in a war between the Heliarchs and the Quarg. If they succeed, we won't need to worry about that, at least. If they fail, and the Heliarchs retaliate against humanity, we ask the Quarg for help. At least, with <first> helping these rebels, there's a chance we won't get caught up in a war between the Heliarchs and the Quarg."|784|0
units.english: They stay silent for a while, then Freya picks up the talk again. "If this rebel group never came to be, we could eventually be caught up in a war between the Heliarchs and the Quarg. If they succeed, we won't need to worry about that, at least. If they fail, and the Heliarchs retaliate against humanity, we ask the Quarg for help. At least, with <first> helping these rebels, there's a chance we won't get caught up in a war between the Heliarchs and the Quarg."
units.italian: Restano in silenzio per un po', poi Freya riprende a parlare. "Se questo gruppo di ribelli non fosse mai esistito, potremmo prima o poi trovarci in una guerra tra gli Heliarchs e i Quarg. Se riescono, almeno non dovremo preoccuparcene. Se falliscono, e gli Heliarchs si vendicano sull'umanità, chiediamo aiuto ai Quarg. Almeno, con <first> che aiuta questi ribelli, c'è la possibilità che non ci troveremo coinvolti in una guerra tra gli Heliarchs e i Quarg."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	JJ thinks for a bit. "Fair enough, but it's still worrying."|785|0
units.english: JJ thinks for a bit. "Fair enough, but it's still worrying."
units.italian: JJ riflette un momento. "Mi sta bene, ma resta comunque preoccupante."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 4-FW|	JJ makes a few calls, arranging some meetings to inform Free Worlds officials of what you've told him, then heads out with you and Freya. You go to a cozy restaurant near the center of town, where Freya tells you a bit more of her recent work in Deneb, and JJ laments about some trouble he's been having with handling patrol fleets. He also comments on having visited Katya and Ijs in the Conservatory somewhat recently. They both keep asking you to tell more of your travels with the jump drive, and what you've seen of the galaxy. You do your best to describe the stars you've seen and planets you've been to, as well as the alien wildlife you've encountered. You worry at first that the stories might draw some attention to your table, but the waiters and other customers don't seem to pay much mind; either they ignored you or simply brushed it off as you having had too many drinks. You leave at dusk, and Freya says she'll help JJ in some of the talks with the Free Worlds officials, and will later find her own way back to Deneb. You say your goodbyes to them, and head back to your ship. You should return to <planet> now and tell House Bebliss that Freya's agreed to their proposal.|787|0
units.english: JJ makes a few calls, arranging some meetings to inform Free Worlds officials of what you've told him, then heads out with you and Freya. You go to a cozy restaurant near the center of town, where Freya tells you a bit more of her recent work in Deneb, and JJ laments about some trouble he's been having with handling patrol fleets. He also comments on having visited Katya and Ijs in the Conservatory somewhat recently. They both keep asking you to tell more of your travels with the jump drive, and what you've seen of the galaxy. You do your best to describe the stars you've seen and planets you've been to, as well as the alien wildlife you've encountered. You worry at first that the stories might draw some attention to your table, but the waiters and other customers don't seem to pay much mind; either they ignored you or simply brushed it off as you having had too many drinks. You leave at dusk, and Freya says she'll help JJ in some of the talks with the Free Worlds officials, and will later find her own way back to Deneb. You say your goodbyes to them, and head back to your ship. You should return to <planet> now and tell House Bebliss that Freya's agreed to their proposal.
units.italian: JJ fa alcune telefonate, organizzando incontri per informare i funzionari dei Mondi Liberi di ciò che gli hai detto, poi esce con te e Freya. Andate in un ristorante accogliente vicino al centro della città, dove Freya ti racconta qualcosa in più del suo lavoro recente a Deneb, e JJ si lamenta di alcuni problemi che ha avuto con la gestione delle flotte di pattuglia. Commenta anche di aver fatto visita a Katya e Ijs nel Conservatorio di recente. Entrambi continuano a chiederti di raccontare dei tuoi viaggi con il motore di salto e di quello che hai visto della galassia. Fai del tuo meglio per descrivere le stelle che hai visto e i pianeti dove sei stato, così come la fauna aliena che hai incontrato. All'inizio temi che le storie possano attirare l'attenzione sul vostro tavolo, ma i camerieri e gli altri clienti non sembrano darci peso; o ti hanno ignorato o l'hanno messo sul conto dei troppi drink. Te ne vai al tramonto, e Freya dice che aiuterà JJ in alcuni dei colloqui con i funzionari dei Mondi Liberi, e che poi troverà da sola la strada per tornare a Deneb. Vi salutate e torni alla tua nave. Dovresti tornare su <planet> ora e dire a Casa Bebliss che Freya ha accettato la loro proposta.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|name|797|0
units.english: Jumping Spiders
units.italian: Ragni saltatori

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|description|798|0
units.english: Acquire a spare Jump Drive and bring it to <destination>, where the House Bebliss representatives will have it installed in one of their ships.
units.italian: Procurati un motore di salto di riserva e portalo a <destination>, dove i rappresentanti di Casa Bebliss lo faranno installare su una delle loro navi.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|Landing beside an Arach Spindle, you maneuver your ship to House Bebliss' estate, and are once again welcomed by maids and butlers. They show you to a room where the same three Arachi from last time are.|807|0
units.english: Landing beside an Arach Spindle, you maneuver your ship to House Bebliss' estate, and are once again welcomed by maids and butlers. They show you to a room where the same three Arachi from last time are.
units.italian: Atterrando accanto a un Fuso Arach, porti la nave alla tenuta di Casa Bebliss, e vieni di nuovo accolto da cameriere e maggiordomi. Ti conducono in una stanza dove ci sono gli stessi tre Arachi dell'ultima volta.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Agreed to work with us, has she, Captain?" they ask.|808|0
units.english: "Agreed to work with us, has she, Captain?" they ask.
units.italian: "Accettato di lavorare con noi, lei ha, Capitano?" chiedono.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	You tell them that Freya has agreed to work with them and let them study the Pug artifacts she has collected on Deneb. You also explain that she asked you to inform the Free Worlds about the Coalition first.|809|0
units.english: You tell them that Freya has agreed to work with them and let them study the Pug artifacts she has collected on Deneb. You also explain that she asked you to inform the Free Worlds about the Coalition first.
units.italian: Dici loro che Freya ha accettato di lavorare con loro e di lasciarli studiare i manufatti dei Pug che ha raccolto su Deneb. Spieghi anche che ti ha chiesto di informare prima i Mondi Liberi della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Understandable, that is. An unusual request, from an unknown group, it was." They have some of the servants start carrying dozens of luggage bags outside. "If in agreement, Miss Freya is, head to that planet, 'Deneb,' to meet her, we shall."|810|0
units.english: "Understandable, that is. An unusual request, from an unknown group, it was." They have some of the servants start carrying dozens of luggage bags outside. "If in agreement, Miss Freya is, head to that planet, 'Deneb,' to meet her, we shall."
units.italian: "Comprensibile, questo è. Una richiesta insolita, da un gruppo sconosciuto, era." Fanno cominciare ai servitori a portare fuori decine di bagagli. "Se d'accordo, la signorina Freya è, andare su quel pianeta, 'Deneb', per incontrarla, noi dovremo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"How do you plan to do that?"|812|0
units.english: "How do you plan to do that?"
units.italian: "Come pensate di farlo?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Do you have a jump drive?"|813|0
units.english: "Do you have a jump drive?"
units.italian: "Avete un motore di salto?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"From the Heliarchs, much information our House can gather. Much more difficult, however, acquiring a jump drive is. Risky to possess one, even," they explain. "Assist us on that front, you must, Captain. Bring a jump drive to <destination>, you must. Equip one of our ships with it, we will. Receive <payment>, you will."|814|0
units.english: "From the Heliarchs, much information our House can gather. Much more difficult, however, acquiring a jump drive is. Risky to possess one, even," they explain. "Assist us on that front, you must, Captain. Bring a jump drive to <destination>, you must. Equip one of our ships with it, we will. Receive <payment>, you will."
units.italian: "Dagli Heliarchs, molte informazioni la nostra Casa può raccogliere. Molto più difficile, però, procurarsi un motore di salto è. Rischioso possederne uno, persino," spiegano. "Aiutarci su quel fronte, tu devi, Capitano. Portare un motore di salto a <destination>, tu devi. Equipaggiare una delle nostre navi con esso, noi lo faremo. Ricevere <payment>, tu dovrai."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Why can't I just bring you to Deneb myself?"|816|0
units.english: "Why can't I just bring you to Deneb myself?"
units.italian: "Perché non posso semplicemente portarvi io a Deneb?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"But you just said it's risky to possess one."|818|0
units.english: "But you just said it's risky to possess one."
units.italian: "Ma avete appena detto che è rischioso possederne uno."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Indeed. Keep it, we would not," another one responds. "Once concluded, our business with your friend Freya is, and returned, we have, give you back the jump drive, we would."|819|0
units.english: "Indeed. Keep it, we would not," another one responds. "Once concluded, our business with your friend Freya is, and returned, we have, give you back the jump drive, we would."
units.italian: "Infatti. Tenerlo, noi non lo faremmo," risponde un altro. "Una volta conclusi, i nostri affari con la tua amica Freya saranno, e tornati, noi saremo: restituirti il motore di salto, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Stay there for some months, we will, and though agreed to help us, your friend Freya has, troubled by our presence, other humans may be," they respond. "So that issues with accommodating us, she does not have, use our ship as a base, we will."|822|0
units.english: "Stay there for some months, we will, and though agreed to help us, your friend Freya has, troubled by our presence, other humans may be," they respond. "So that issues with accommodating us, she does not have, use our ship as a base, we will."
units.italian: "Restare là per alcuni mesi, noi vorremmo, e anche se accettato di aiutarci, la tua amica Freya ha, disturbati dalla nostra presenza, altri umani potrebbero essere," rispondono. "Così che problemi ad ospitarci, lei non ne abbia, usare la nostra nave come base, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	You follow them outside, and see them board the Spindle, heading to <destination>. You board your own ship, and head back to the city docks, preparing to meet them on <planet> when you have a spare jump drive for their ship.|824|0
units.english: You follow them outside, and see them board the Spindle, heading to <destination>. You board your own ship, and head back to the city docks, preparing to meet them on <planet> when you have a spare jump drive for their ship.
units.italian: Li segui fuori e li vedi salire sul Fuso, in partenza per <destination>. Salutati tutti, torni sulla tua nave e riparti verso i moli della città, preparandoti a incontrarli su <planet> quando avrai un motore di salto di riserva per la loro nave.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|dialog|829|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you haven't brought the extra jump drive you needed to yet. Make sure to have it in your cargo before you land.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai ancora portato il motore di salto in più che ti serviva. Assicurati di averlo nel carico prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|Some coordinates are automatically selected when you approach the surface of <planet>. You follow them to reach another private area of sorts, though it looks much more like a factory or a warehouse than an estate. On the corners, several flags and banners of House Idriss are in full display. House Bebliss' Spindle is landed there, and the members who will be following you to Deneb come to your ship when you land beside it. Some workers remove the jump drive from your ship and begin installing it on the Spindle. The House Bebliss members crewing the ship hand you <payment> when the drive is ready.|837|0
units.english: Some coordinates are automatically selected when you approach the surface of <planet>. You follow them to reach another private area of sorts, though it looks much more like a factory or a warehouse than an estate. On the corners, several flags and banners of House Idriss are in full display. House Bebliss' Spindle is landed there, and the members who will be following you to Deneb come to your ship when you land beside it. Some workers remove the jump drive from your ship and begin installing it on the Spindle. The House Bebliss members crewing the ship hand you <payment> when the drive is ready.
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini alla superficie di <planet> vengono selezionate automaticamente alcune coordinate. Le segui per raggiungere un'altra specie di zona privata, anche se sembra molto più una fabbrica o un magazzino che una tenuta. Sugli angoli sono ben esposte diverse bandiere e stendardi di Casa Idriss. Il Fuso di Casa Bebliss è atterrato lì, e i membri che ti seguiranno a Deneb vengono alla tua nave quando atterri accanto. Alcuni operai tolgono il motore di salto dalla tua nave e cominciano a installarlo sul Fuso. I membri di Casa Bebliss che compongono l'equipaggio ti consegnano <payment> quando il motore è pronto.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 5-FW|	"Once ready to leave, you are, meet us in the main spaceport, you should," one of them says.|838|0
units.english: "Once ready to leave, you are, meet us in the main spaceport, you should," one of them says.
units.italian: "Quando pronto a partire, tu sarai, incontrarci allo spazioporto principale, tu dovresti," dice uno di loro.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|name|843|0
units.english: Escort House Bebliss
units.italian: Scortare Casa Bebliss

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|description|844|0
units.english: Escort the ship with House Bebliss' representatives to <destination>, where they intend to join Freya in her studies on hyperspace links.
units.italian: Scorta la nave con i rappresentanti di Casa Bebliss fino a <destination>, dove intendono unirsi a Freya nei suoi studi sui collegamenti iperspaziali.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|One of the employees of House Bebliss spots you immediately as you enter the spaceport and guides you to what they claim is one of the top restaurants here. The members of the House are waiting inside, the only patrons within the establishment. Having already ordered their meals when you arrive, they offer to buy you anything you want from the menu. Seeing the selection of "exotic dishes" on the other tables, though, you decide to decline their offer.|852|0
units.english: One of the employees of House Bebliss spots you immediately as you enter the spaceport and guides you to what they claim is one of the top restaurants here. The members of the House are waiting inside, the only patrons within the establishment. Having already ordered their meals when you arrive, they offer to buy you anything you want from the menu. Seeing the selection of "exotic dishes" on the other tables, though, you decide to decline their offer.
units.italian: Uno dei dipendenti di Casa Bebliss ti nota subito appena entri nello spazioporto e ti guida in quello che sostiene essere uno dei migliori ristoranti del posto. I membri della Casa aspettano dentro, gli unici clienti del locale. Avendo già ordinato quando arrivi, si offrono di comprarti qualsiasi cosa tu voglia dal menu. Vedendo però la selezione di "piatti esotici" sugli altri tavoli, decidi di rifiutare l'offerta.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"Ready for takeoff, our ship is," one of them says, preparing some napkins as the waiters bring their orders to the table. "To the world where your friend is, bring us, you must."|853|0
units.english: "Ready for takeoff, our ship is," one of them says, preparing some napkins as the waiters bring their orders to the table. "To the world where your friend is, bring us, you must."
units.italian: "Pronta al decollo, la nostra nave è," dice uno di loro, preparando dei tovaglioli mentre i camerieri portano le loro ordinazioni al tavolo. "Al mondo dove la tua amica si trova, portarci, tu devi."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	Another one bites into something that looks like a goat's leg, albeit much bonier, before saying, "Prepared for concealing our presence, we and the crew are. Worry about that, you need not."|854|0
units.english: Another one bites into something that looks like a goat's leg, albeit much bonier, before saying, "Prepared for concealing our presence, we and the crew are. Worry about that, you need not."
units.italian: Un altro dà un morso a qualcosa che sembra una zampa di capra, anche se molto più ossuta, prima di dire: "Preparati a nascondere la nostra presenza, noi e l'equipaggio siamo. Preoccupartene, tu non devi."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"Extra fuel, the ship has. Enough to reach the planet, it should be," the last of them tells you. You stay at the restaurant for a surprisingly short while, as the Arachi devour the full-course meals in only a few minutes. You leave together, accompanying them to the hangars, where you see their Spindle landing next to the <ship>. They board it, saying they will follow your ship once you depart, and that you may take off at your earliest convenience.|855|0
units.english: "Extra fuel, the ship has. Enough to reach the planet, it should be," the last of them tells you. You stay at the restaurant for a surprisingly short while, as the Arachi devour the full-course meals in only a few minutes. You leave together, accompanying them to the hangars, where you see their Spindle landing next to the <ship>. They board it, saying they will follow your ship once you depart, and that you may take off at your earliest convenience.
units.italian: "Carburante extra, la nave ha. Abbastanza per raggiungere il pianeta, dovrebbe essere," ti dice l'ultimo di loro. Resti al ristorante per un tempo sorprendentemente breve, dato che gli Arachi divorano i pasti completi in pochi minuti. Uscite insieme e li accompagni agli hangar, dove vedi il loro Fuso atterrare accanto alla <ship>. Salgono a bordo, dicendo che seguiranno la tua nave una volta partita, e che puoi decollare quando ti è più comodo.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|dialog|864|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but left House Bebliss' ship behind! Best depart and wait for them to get here.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Casa Bebliss! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|As both your ships come in for a landing, you contact Freya and tell her the Arachi are with you this time. She tells you to land near the Free Worlds' warehouses, where you last met her, saying she'll be waiting there to greet them.|870|0
units.english: As both your ships come in for a landing, you contact Freya and tell her the Arachi are with you this time. She tells you to land near the Free Worlds' warehouses, where you last met her, saying she'll be waiting there to greet them.
units.italian: Mentre entrambe le navi si avvicinano per atterrare, contatti Freya e le dici che questa volta gli Arachi sono con te. Ti dice di atterrare vicino ai magazzini dei Mondi Liberi, dove l'hai incontrata l'ultima volta, e che sarà lì ad aspettarli per salutarli.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	When you arrive, you wait outside your ship while House Bebliss' ship keeps its hatch closed. It seems they intend to remain in there for the duration of their stay, most likely in fear that their appearance would cause a stir amongst other humans.|871|0
units.english: When you arrive, you wait outside your ship while House Bebliss' ship keeps its hatch closed. It seems they intend to remain in there for the duration of their stay, most likely in fear that their appearance would cause a stir amongst other humans.
units.italian: Quando arrivi, aspetti fuori dalla tua nave mentre quella di Casa Bebliss tiene il portello chiuso. Sembra che intendano restare lì dentro per tutta la durata della loro permanenza, molto probabilmente per timore che la loro vista susciti scalpore tra gli altri umani.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	A few minutes later Freya arrives, and you two approach the Spindle's hatch. Once House Bebliss is satisfied with making sure no curious bystanders are nearby, the hatch opens, and you two go into the ship. Though you've grown used to Arach ships by now, Freya's eyes dart around the interiors as you move within the ship. You imagine she's holding in the desire to ask you some technical questions about the model. When you arrive at the cockpit, you're greeted by the members of House Bebliss. Despite you having told her about them previously, Freya is understandably taken aback for a second or two upon first seeing the Arachi, but soon shakes it off, confidently walking up to greet them. "Hello, my name is Freya Winters. I've heard you're interested in the Pug artifacts we found on this world." Despite the initial shock in meeting them, for someone speaking with giant spiders for the first time she handles it surprisingly well.|872|0
units.english: A few minutes later Freya arrives, and you two approach the Spindle's hatch. Once House Bebliss is satisfied with making sure no curious bystanders are nearby, the hatch opens, and you two go into the ship. Though you've grown used to Arach ships by now, Freya's eyes dart around the interiors as you move within the ship. You imagine she's holding in the desire to ask you some technical questions about the model. When you arrive at the cockpit, you're greeted by the members of House Bebliss. Despite you having told her about them previously, Freya is understandably taken aback for a second or two upon first seeing the Arachi, but soon shakes it off, confidently walking up to greet them. "Hello, my name is Freya Winters. I've heard you're interested in the Pug artifacts we found on this world." Despite the initial shock in meeting them, for someone speaking with giant spiders for the first time she handles it surprisingly well.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo arriva Freya, e voi due vi avvicinate al portello del Fuso. Una volta che Casa Bebliss si è assicurata che non ci siano curiosi nei paraggi, il portello si apre, e voi due entrate nella nave. Anche se ormai ti sei abituato alle navi Arach, gli occhi di Freya guizzano intorno agli interni mentre vi muovete dentro la nave. Immagini che stia trattenendo il desiderio di farti qualche domanda tecnica sul modello. Quando arrivate in cabina di pilotaggio, vi accolgono i membri di Casa Bebliss. Nonostante tu le abbia parlato di loro in precedenza, Freya resta comprensibilmente spiazzata per un secondo o due vedendo gli Arachi per la prima volta, ma si riprende presto e si avvicina con sicurezza a salutarli. "Salve, mi chiamo Freya Winters. Ho sentito che vi interessano i manufatti dei Pug che abbiamo trovato su questo mondo." Nonostante lo shock iniziale, per qualcuno che parla per la prima volta con ragni giganti se la cava sorprendentemente bene.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"Indeed. The trade of our great House Bebliss for thousands of years, the study of hyperlanes has been," one of the Arachi says. "When tell us of your achievements, Captain <last> did, know that we needed to come look into your work ourselves, we did."|873|0
units.english: "Indeed. The trade of our great House Bebliss for thousands of years, the study of hyperlanes has been," one of the Arachi says. "When tell us of your achievements, Captain <last> did, know that we needed to come look into your work ourselves, we did."
units.italian: "Infatti. Il commercio della nostra grande Casa Bebliss, per migliaia di anni, lo studio delle ipervie è stato," dice uno degli Arachi. "Quando raccontarci dei tuoi successi, il Capitano <last> ha fatto, rendermi conto che dovevamo venire a esaminare il tuo lavoro di persona, noi lo abbiamo fatto."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	She quickly gets used to the translation box's odd speech quirk, as she and the members of House Bebliss discuss how to go about helping each other in researching the artifacts here. One of the crew members approaches you as they talk and hands you <payment>. "Thanks for the safe escort here, this is," they whisper.|874|0
units.english: She quickly gets used to the translation box's odd speech quirk, as she and the members of House Bebliss discuss how to go about helping each other in researching the artifacts here. One of the crew members approaches you as they talk and hands you <payment>. "Thanks for the safe escort here, this is," they whisper.
units.italian: Si abitua in fretta allo strano modo di parlare della scatola di traduzione, mentre lei e i membri di Casa Bebliss discutono di come aiutarsi a vicenda nella ricerca sui manufatti. Uno dei membri dell'equipaggio ti si avvicina mentre parlano e ti consegna <payment>. "Grazie per la scorta sicura fin qui, questi sono," sussurra.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	Freya's talk with them goes on for almost an hour. They eventually settle on having some of the artifacts moved to their ship's cargo hold, so that some research can happen there without the risk of being seen. House Bebliss' representatives thank her for the reception, and you follow her back outside.|875|0
units.english: Freya's talk with them goes on for almost an hour. They eventually settle on having some of the artifacts moved to their ship's cargo hold, so that some research can happen there without the risk of being seen. House Bebliss' representatives thank her for the reception, and you follow her back outside.
units.italian: Il colloquio di Freya con loro va avanti per quasi un'ora. Alla fine concordano di spostare alcuni manufatti nella stiva della loro nave, così che una parte della ricerca possa avvenire lì senza il rischio di essere visti. I rappresentanti di Casa Bebliss la ringraziano per l'accoglienza, e tu la segui fuori.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	Once the hatch is closed, she asks, "This is one of their freighter ships?"|876|0
units.english: Once the hatch is closed, she asks, "This is one of their freighter ships?"
units.italian: Una volta chiuso il portello, chiede: "Questa è una delle loro navi da trasporto?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"Yeah, though it's not their largest one."|878|0
units.english: "Yeah, though it's not their largest one."
units.italian: "Sì, anche se non è la più grande che hanno."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"They're civilians, so they can't buy the warships in their space."|879|0
units.english: "They're civilians, so they can't buy the warships in their space."
units.italian: "Sono civili, quindi non possono comprare le navi da guerra nel loro spazio."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"It's definitely a lot leaner than most of our own freighters, for a ship of its size." She turns around, and approaches the ship, reaching her hands up to touch it. "Looks like it's got some very tough armor plating..."|880|0
units.english: "It's definitely a lot leaner than most of our own freighters, for a ship of its size." She turns around, and approaches the ship, reaching her hands up to touch it. "Looks like it's got some very tough armor plating..."
units.italian: "È decisamente molto più snella della maggior parte dei nostri trasporti, per una nave della sua dimensione." Si volta e si avvicina alla nave, alzando le mani per toccarla. "Sembra che abbia delle corazze molto resistenti..."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"You think they'll be well hidden here?"|882|0
units.english: "You think they'll be well hidden here?"
units.italian: "Pensi che saranno ben nascosti qui?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"You think they'll be safe here?"|883|0
units.english: "You think they'll be safe here?"
units.italian: "Pensi che saranno al sicuro qui?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"What about the Republic and the Syndicate? Will you tell the teams here about the Arachi?"|885|0
units.english: "What about the Republic and the Syndicate? Will you tell the teams here about the Arachi?"
units.italian: "E la Repubblica e il Sindacato? Dirai ai gruppi qui degli Arachi?"

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"Well, <planet> has surged in population, for sure, but it's far from a tourist hotspot for now," she answers. "As long as they stick to that ship, no one should know they're here."|887|0
units.english: "Well, <planet> has surged in population, for sure, but it's far from a tourist hotspot for now," she answers. "As long as they stick to that ship, no one should know they're here."
units.italian: "Beh, <planet> è cresciuta molto di popolazione, questo è certo, ma per ora è lontana dall'essere una meta turistica," risponde. "Finché restano su quella nave, nessuno dovrebbe sapere che sono qui."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"<planet> is close enough to Sol that we get Navy fleets flying by here pretty often, and it's far away enough from the pirate strongholds that we rarely get any of them raiding here. They'll be fine."|890|0
units.english: "<planet> is close enough to Sol that we get Navy fleets flying by here pretty often, and it's far away enough from the pirate strongholds that we rarely get any of them raiding here. They'll be fine."
units.italian: "<planet> è abbastanza vicina a Sol che le flotte della Marina passano di qui piuttosto spesso, ed è abbastanza lontana dalle roccaforti dei pirati che raramente ne abbiamo qualcuno a saccheggiare. Staranno bene."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	"That's up to JJ, Alondo, and others more involved with Bourne and the Senate to decide. I imagine once they've put together a report of all you've told us, we'll be sharing that with the Republic and Syndicate. Probably best to avoid letting it out to the public right away though; there's still a lot of tension about aliens due to the Pug invasion."|893|0
units.english: "That's up to JJ, Alondo, and others more involved with Bourne and the Senate to decide. I imagine once they've put together a report of all you've told us, we'll be sharing that with the Republic and Syndicate. Probably best to avoid letting it out to the public right away though; there's still a lot of tension about aliens due to the Pug invasion."
units.italian: "Questo spetta a JJ, ad Alondo e ad altri più coinvolti con Bourne e il Senato. Immagino che una volta messo insieme un rapporto su tutto quello che ci hai detto, lo condivideremo con la Repubblica e il Sindacato. Probabilmente è meglio evitare di renderlo pubblico subito, però: c'è ancora molta tensione sugli alieni per via dell'invasione dei Pug."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	She moves away from the ship, and you both leisurely walk back to the Free Worlds' warehouse, chatting as you go. "I need to go tell my team that we're moving some of the load to Southbound's new experimental freighter. I'd prefer to tell them what's going on myself - it makes things so much easier - but I think I'll wait a little longer before doing that. I want to see if I can get a good reading on these aliens first. Perhaps another scientific conversation would help. I'll be in contact if something happens. Safe travels, <first>."|895|0
units.english: She moves away from the ship, and you both leisurely walk back to the Free Worlds' warehouse, chatting as you go. "I need to go tell my team that we're moving some of the load to Southbound's new experimental freighter. I'd prefer to tell them what's going on myself - it makes things so much easier - but I think I'll wait a little longer before doing that. I want to see if I can get a good reading on these aliens first. Perhaps another scientific conversation would help. I'll be in contact if something happens. Safe travels, <first>."
units.italian: Si allontana dalla nave, e tornate entrambi con calma al magazzino dei Mondi Liberi, chiacchierando lungo la strada. "Devo andare a dire alla mia squadra che sposteremo parte del carico sul nuovo trasporto sperimentale della Southbound. Preferirei spiegare io che cosa succede, rende tutto molto più semplice, ma credo che aspetterò ancora un po' prima di farlo. Voglio vedere se riesco a farmi un'idea precisa di questi alieni. Magari un'altra conversazione scientifica aiuterebbe. Ti contatto se succede qualcosa. Buon viaggio, <first>."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 6-FW|	You say goodbye, and head to your ship. From the looks of it, it might take some months, if not years, before House Bebliss gets what information they wanted out of this trip.|896|0
units.english: You say goodbye, and head to your ship. From the looks of it, it might take some months, if not years, before House Bebliss gets what information they wanted out of this trip.
units.italian: Vi salutate e ti dirigi alla tua nave. A quanto pare, potrebbero volerci mesi, se non anni, prima che Casa Bebliss ottenga da questo viaggio le informazioni che cercava.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|name|903|0
units.english: The House Always Wins
units.italian: La Casa vince sempre

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|description|904|0
units.english: Head to <destination>, where the members of House Bebliss will return the jump drive you provided them, and give you your payment for assisting them.
units.italian: Recati a <destination>, dove i membri di Casa Bebliss ti restituiranno il motore di salto che gli hai fornito e ti daranno il pagamento per averli assistiti.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|You receive a message from Freya as you land on <origin>. "Hello <first>! I hope this finds you well. The past few months here have been... interesting, to say the least. Working with the Arachi has helped us find answers to the questions we had about the Pug artifacts, which invariably has led to more questions. The Arachi are a bit odd, but it's been fun working with them. I figured they would stay here for at least a year, given how many containers and large crates of supplies they brought in that freighter of theirs, but it looks like they've grown homesick, so we said our goodbyes today. They asked me to contact you and say they'll be waiting in a system called '<system>' to pay you and return the jump drive they borrowed. Have a safe trip there, Captain."|915|0
units.english: You receive a message from Freya as you land on <origin>. "Hello <first>! I hope this finds you well. The past few months here have been... interesting, to say the least. Working with the Arachi has helped us find answers to the questions we had about the Pug artifacts, which invariably has led to more questions. The Arachi are a bit odd, but it's been fun working with them. I figured they would stay here for at least a year, given how many containers and large crates of supplies they brought in that freighter of theirs, but it looks like they've grown homesick, so we said our goodbyes today. They asked me to contact you and say they'll be waiting in a system called '<system>' to pay you and return the jump drive they borrowed. Have a safe trip there, Captain."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Freya mentre atterri su <origin>. "Ciao <first>! Spero che tu stia bene. Questi ultimi mesi qui sono stati... interessanti, a dir poco. Lavorare con gli Arachi ci ha aiutato a trovare risposte alle domande che avevamo sui manufatti dei Pug, il che invariabilmente ha portato ad altre domande. Gli Arachi sono un po' strani, ma è stato divertente lavorare con loro. Immaginavo che sarebbero rimasti qui almeno un anno, visto quanti container e quante casse di provviste hanno portato con quel loro trasporto, ma sembra che abbiano nostalgia di casa, così oggi ci siamo salutati. Mi hanno chiesto di contattarti e di dirti che ti aspetteranno in un sistema chiamato '<system>' per pagarti e restituirti il motore di salto che avevano preso in prestito. Fai buon viaggio, Capitano."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|	When you finish reading the message, you plot a course to <destination>.|916|0
units.english: When you finish reading the message, you plot a course to <destination>.
units.italian: Quando finisci di leggere il messaggio, imposti una rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|Once again, coordinates appear on your screen as you come in to land on <planet>, leading you to the same building where you delivered the jump drive to House Bebliss. Their Arach Spindle is docked there, and the members who were working with Freya come to your ship. "Captain <last>!" One of them greets you as you come down the hatch. "Received the message from Miss Freya, I trust you have? Very fruitful, our conjoined efforts have been."|926|0
units.english: Once again, coordinates appear on your screen as you come in to land on <planet>, leading you to the same building where you delivered the jump drive to House Bebliss. Their Arach Spindle is docked there, and the members who were working with Freya come to your ship. "Captain <last>!" One of them greets you as you come down the hatch. "Received the message from Miss Freya, I trust you have? Very fruitful, our conjoined efforts have been."
units.italian: Ancora una volta compaiono delle coordinate sullo schermo mentre ti avvicini per atterrare su <planet>, e ti portano allo stesso edificio dove hai consegnato il motore di salto a Casa Bebliss. Il loro Fuso Arach è attraccato lì, e i membri che lavoravano con Freya vengono alla tua nave. "Capitano <last>!" ti saluta uno di loro mentre scendi dal portello. "Ricevuto il messaggio della signorina Freya, immagino tu l'abbia? Molto fruttuosi, i nostri sforzi congiunti sono stati."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|	"Unfortunate, it is, that stay there longer we could not," another one interjects. "But away for much longer, we could not be. Need us here, House Bebliss does."|927|0
units.english: "Unfortunate, it is, that stay there longer we could not," another one interjects. "But away for much longer, we could not be. Need us here, House Bebliss does."
units.italian: "Sfortunato, è, che restare là più a lungo non abbiamo potuto," interviene un altro. "Ma via per molto più tempo, non potremmo stare. Bisogno di noi qui, Casa Bebliss ha."

units.id: mission:House Bebliss 7-FW|	They hand you <payment> as thanks for all your help, while the workers remove the jump drive from their Spindle and put it in your ship. The Arachi thank you once more and say goodbye one final time, boarding their Spindle and leaving the planet.|928|0
units.english: They hand you <payment> as thanks for all your help, while the workers remove the jump drive from their Spindle and put it in your ship. The Arachi thank you once more and say goodbye one final time, boarding their Spindle and leaving the planet.
units.italian: Ti consegnano <payment> come ringraziamento per tutto il tuo aiuto, mentre gli operai tolgono il motore di salto dal loro Fuso e lo mettono nella tua nave. Gli Arachi ti ringraziano ancora una volta e si congedano un'ultima volta, salendo sul loro Fuso e lasciando il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|name|935|0
units.english: Pick Up Students
units.italian: Prendere gli studenti

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|description|936|0
units.english: Head to <destination> to pick up <bunks> students and teachers by <date>, and bring them back to their home planet of Second Viridian.
units.italian: Recati a <destination> per prendere <bunks> studenti e insegnanti entro <date> e riportarli sul loro pianeta natale, Second Viridian.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|A few Kimek flag you down by the spaceport entrance. "Greetings, Captain. Work for a tourism company employing dozens of ships across the Coalition we do.
