Interested in employing your services, our captain is. You see, run into some trouble with the deadline, one of our ships has, and pay you handsomely for aiding the company, she would. Waiting inside that Spire, she is," they say, as they point to a ship parked not too far from your own.|952|0
units.english: A few Kimek flag you down by the spaceport entrance. "Greetings, Captain. Work for a tourism company employing dozens of ships across the Coalition we do. Interested in employing your services, our captain is. You see, run into some trouble with the deadline, one of our ships has, and pay you handsomely for aiding the company, she would. Waiting inside that Spire, she is," they say, as they point to a ship parked not too far from your own.
units.italian: Alcuni Kimek ti fermano all'ingresso dello spazioporto. "Salve, Capitano. Lavoro per un'agenzia turistica che impiega decine di navi in tutta la Coalizione, noi facciamo. Interessato a impiegare i tuoi servizi, il nostro capitano è. Vedi, incappato in qualche problema con la scadenza, una delle nostre navi è, e pagarti profumatamente per aver aiutato l'agenzia, lei vorrebbe. Dentro quella Guglia sta aspettando, lei," dicono, indicando una nave parcheggiata non lontano dalla tua.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Alright, I'll see if I can help."|954|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll see if I can help."
units.italian: "Va bene, vedrò se posso aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Can't you just point me the way yourselves?"|956|0
units.english: "Can't you just point me the way yourselves?"
units.italian: "Non potete semplicemente indicarmi la strada da soli?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Sorry, I'm not available at the moment."|957|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not available at the moment."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono disponibile in questo momento."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	One of the Kimek cowers his legs closer to his body for a moment. "Actually, just short of running late to a mission of our own, we are. Crew of another ship we are; merely told to contact you for help, we were. Too busy managing the rest of the fleet, she is."|959|0
units.english: One of the Kimek cowers his legs closer to his body for a moment. "Actually, just short of running late to a mission of our own, we are. Crew of another ship we are; merely told to contact you for help, we were. Too busy managing the rest of the fleet, she is."
units.italian: Uno dei Kimek ritrae le zampe più vicino al corpo per un momento. "In realtà, quasi in ritardo per una nostra missione, noi siamo. Equipaggio di un'altra nave siamo; solo incaricati di contattarti per chiedere aiuto, noi siamo stati. Troppo impegnata a gestire il resto della flotta, lei è."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"A very busy season for us, it has been," another one adds. "Discuss the details, and your compensation, the captain will."|960|0
units.english: "A very busy season for us, it has been," another one adds. "Discuss the details, and your compensation, the captain will."
units.italian: "Una stagione molto intensa per noi, è stata," aggiunge un altro. "Discutere i dettagli, e la tua ricompensa, il capitano lo farà."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Alright, I'll see if I can help."|962|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll see if I can help."
units.italian: "Va bene, vedrò se posso aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Sorry, I'm not available at the moment."|963|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not available at the moment."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono disponibile in questo momento."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	One of them brings you to the Spire, sending a message as you two head there, and the hatch is opened right as you arrive. They thank you for helping, and rush to board their own ship and depart. You go up the Spire's ramp and meet some more Kimek from the company, who greet you and guide you through the ship. Halfway through a corridor, they stop and ask that you wait there. A different Kimek carrying nearly a dozen different devices emerges from a side corridor, and the group begins patting and circling your body with the devices. You ask them what they're doing, but they don't respond. After every single one of the machines has finished its beeps and chirps around you, and the Kimek seem satisfied, they continue on. Surprisingly, they bring you not to the cockpit, but to one of the bunks, where a Kimek is talking with a Saryd man. Once she sees you're there, the Kimek gives a glance to the Saryd, and leaves with the others, leaving you two alone.|966|0
units.english: One of them brings you to the Spire, sending a message as you two head there, and the hatch is opened right as you arrive. They thank you for helping, and rush to board their own ship and depart. You go up the Spire's ramp and meet some more Kimek from the company, who greet you and guide you through the ship. Halfway through a corridor, they stop and ask that you wait there. A different Kimek carrying nearly a dozen different devices emerges from a side corridor, and the group begins patting and circling your body with the devices. You ask them what they're doing, but they don't respond. After every single one of the machines has finished its beeps and chirps around you, and the Kimek seem satisfied, they continue on. Surprisingly, they bring you not to the cockpit, but to one of the bunks, where a Kimek is talking with a Saryd man. Once she sees you're there, the Kimek gives a glance to the Saryd, and leaves with the others, leaving you two alone.
units.italian: Uno di loro ti accompagna alla Guglia, mandando un messaggio mentre vi avvicinate, e il portello si apre proprio quando arrivate. Ti ringraziano per l'aiuto e si precipitano a salire sulla loro nave per partire. Sali la rampa della Guglia e incontri altri Kimek dell'agenzia, che ti salutano e ti guidano attraverso la nave. A metà di un corridoio si fermano e ti chiedono di aspettare lì. Da un corridoio laterale emerge un altro Kimek che porta quasi una dozzina di dispositivi diversi, e il gruppo comincia a tamponarti e a girare intorno al tuo corpo con quegli apparecchi. Chiedi che cosa stiano facendo, ma non rispondono. Dopo che ognuna delle macchine ha finito i suoi bip e i suoi trilli intorno a te, e i Kimek sembrano soddisfatti, proseguono. Sorprendentemente non ti portano in cabina di pilotaggio, ma a una delle cuccette, dove un Kimek sta parlando con un uomo Saryd. Quando vede che sei arrivato, il Kimek lancia uno sguardo al Saryd e se ne va con gli altri, lasciandovi soli.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	Middle-aged, the Saryd has little hair on his head and a dense beard. "Greetings, human friend. <first> <last> your name is, correct?" You nod. "Apologize I do, for the safety measures experienced, you must have. You see, rather sickly lately, I have been, and while usually fine around Kimek or Arach employees and passengers, wish to try my health against a Saryd or human disease, I did not. But, come to listen of my woes, you have not. Called Elirom, and owner of this company, I am. For those wishing to travel in leisure or for work, provide comfortable ships we do," he explains. "Run into some trouble, one of our ships has. Supposed to transport <bunks> students and teachers back to Second Viridian after their school trip was done, but now waiting for repairs for the ship's malfunctioning outfits, they are. Picked up by <date>, the students must be, so as to not miss their tests, but elsewhere busy, our other ships are. Pick them up in our stead, would you? <payment> from our company, you will receive."|969|0
units.english: Middle-aged, the Saryd has little hair on his head and a dense beard. "Greetings, human friend. <first> <last> your name is, correct?" You nod. "Apologize I do, for the safety measures experienced, you must have. You see, rather sickly lately, I have been, and while usually fine around Kimek or Arach employees and passengers, wish to try my health against a Saryd or human disease, I did not. But, come to listen of my woes, you have not. Called Elirom, and owner of this company, I am. For those wishing to travel in leisure or for work, provide comfortable ships we do," he explains. "Run into some trouble, one of our ships has. Supposed to transport <bunks> students and teachers back to Second Viridian after their school trip was done, but now waiting for repairs for the ship's malfunctioning outfits, they are. Picked up by <date>, the students must be, so as to not miss their tests, but elsewhere busy, our other ships are. Pick them up in our stead, would you? <payment> from our company, you will receive."
units.italian: Di mezza età, il Saryd ha pochi capelli sulla testa e una barba folta. "Salve, amico umano. <first> <last> il tuo nome è, giusto?" Fai cenno di sì. "Scusarmi io devo, per le misure di sicurezza che hai dovuto subire. Vedi, piuttosto malaticcio ultimamente, io sono stato, e anche se di solito sto bene con dipendenti e passeggeri Kimek o Arach, mettere alla prova la mia salute contro una malattia Saryd o umana, io non volevo. Ma venire ad ascoltare i miei guai, tu non sei qui per questo. Elirom mi chiamo, e proprietario di questa agenzia, io sono. Per chi desidera viaggiare per svago o per lavoro, navi confortevoli noi forniamo," spiega. "Incappata in qualche problema, una delle nostre navi è. Doveva trasportare <bunks> studenti e insegnanti a Second Viridian al termine della loro gita scolastica, ma ora aspettano riparazioni per le attrezzature malfunzionanti della nave. Presi entro <date>, gli studenti devono essere, per non perdere i loro esami, ma altrove impegnate, le nostre altre navi sono. Andarli a prendere al posto nostro, tu lo faresti? <payment> dalla nostra agenzia, tu riceverai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Sure, where am I picking them up from?"|971|0
units.english: "Sure, where am I picking them up from?"
units.italian: "Certo, dove devo andare a prenderli?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"I'm sorry, but I'm not interested anymore."|972|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm not interested anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono più interessato."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Waiting on <planet> they are. Inform them to expect your ship, I will. Remember, picked up before <date> they must be." He bends his front legs lightly in a bow, thanking you for agreeing to help, and asks for one of the Kimek to come back and escort you out. They repeat the same tedious search process with the devices on your way out, and wish you good luck when they're finally done.|974|0
units.english: "Waiting on <planet> they are. Inform them to expect your ship, I will. Remember, picked up before <date> they must be." He bends his front legs lightly in a bow, thanking you for agreeing to help, and asks for one of the Kimek to come back and escort you out. They repeat the same tedious search process with the devices on your way out, and wish you good luck when they're finally done.
units.italian: "Su <planet> stanno aspettando. Informarli di aspettarsi la tua nave, io lo farò. Ricorda: presi prima di <date> devono essere." Piega leggermente le zampe anteriori in un inchino, ringraziandoti per aver accettato di aiutare, e chiede a uno dei Kimek di tornare a scortarti fuori. Ripetono lo stesso noioso procedimento di ricerca con i dispositivi mentre esci, e ti augurano buona fortuna quando hanno finalmente finito.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	Middle-aged, with little hair on his head and a dense beard, you switftly recognize the Saryd as Elirom, one of the Lunarium leaders you met on Remote Blue. "Hello Captain <last>, good to see you it is. Forgive me for the convoluted security measures, you must, always listening they are..." He rubs one hand over the other while glancing down. "Looking for our members all over <planet>, Heliarch ships are. Received word, I have, that arrive there by <date>, many more Punishers will. If get there they do before evacuated our members, we have, afraid I am that unfeasible to save them, it will become. Still waiting for a ship, <bunks> of them are, and get back there before the Punishers arrive on <date>, our other ships will not. Captain, help us, you must. Compensate you with <payment>, I will."|977|0
units.english: Middle-aged, with little hair on his head and a dense beard, you switftly recognize the Saryd as Elirom, one of the Lunarium leaders you met on Remote Blue. "Hello Captain <last>, good to see you it is. Forgive me for the convoluted security measures, you must, always listening they are..." He rubs one hand over the other while glancing down. "Looking for our members all over <planet>, Heliarch ships are. Received word, I have, that arrive there by <date>, many more Punishers will. If get there they do before evacuated our members, we have, afraid I am that unfeasible to save them, it will become. Still waiting for a ship, <bunks> of them are, and get back there before the Punishers arrive on <date>, our other ships will not. Captain, help us, you must. Compensate you with <payment>, I will."
units.italian: Di mezza età, con pochi capelli sulla testa e una barba folta, riconosci subito il Saryd come Elirom, uno dei leader del Lunarium che hai incontrato su Remote Blue. "Salve Capitano <last>, bello vederti, è. Perdonarmi le misure di sicurezza contorte, tu devi, sempre in ascolto sono..." Si strofina una mano sull'altra abbassando lo sguardo. "Cercare i nostri membri in tutto <planet>, le navi degli Heliarchs lo stanno facendo. Ricevuto parola, io ho, che arrivare là entro <date>, molti altri Punishers lo faranno. Se arrivano prima che evacuato i nostri membri, noi abbiamo, temo che infattibile salvarli, diventerà. Ancora in attesa di una nave, <bunks> di loro sono, e tornare là prima che i Punishers arrivino il <date>, le nostre altre navi non potranno. Capitano, aiutarci, tu devi. Compensarti con <payment>, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Of course, I'll head there right away."|979|0
units.english: "Of course, I'll head there right away."
units.italian: "Certo che sì, ci andrò subito."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"Can't they just lay low until the Punishers have gone away?"|981|0
units.english: "Can't they just lay low until the Punishers have gone away?"
units.italian: "Non possono semplicemente stare nascosti finché i Punishers non se ne sono andati?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	"No, no," he shakes his head. "Find them out, they would. They always do." His eyes wander around, as he takes a step back. He blinks repeatedly for a second, then looks back at you. "Seen what they do to the prisoners they take, I have, Captain. If there they remain, found they will be, and lost <bunks> more, I would have."|982|0
units.english: "No, no," he shakes his head. "Find them out, they would. They always do." His eyes wander around, as he takes a step back. He blinks repeatedly for a second, then looks back at you. "Seen what they do to the prisoners they take, I have, Captain. If there they remain, found they will be, and lost <bunks> more, I would have."
units.italian: "No, no," scuote la testa. "Scoprirli, loro lo farebbero. Lo fanno sempre." Gli occhi gli vagano intorno mentre fa un passo indietro. Sbatte le palpebre più volte per un secondo, poi torna a guardarti. "Visto che cosa fanno ai prigionieri che prendono, io l'ho visto, Capitano. Se lì restano, trovati saranno, e persi <bunks> altri, io ne avrei."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|	He has one of the Kimek come back to escort you out, but before you leave the room, he adds, "Students and their teachers, they are. Picking them up from a school trip, after canceled on them, the original transport did, you are. Bring them back home to Second Viridian for their tests, you will. Asked to do so by the captain of the original transport ship, you were." He urges you to go there as soon as possible to pick them up, and the Kimek take you back out, repeating the same security search in the hallway before opening the hatch for you. They wish you good luck, and close up the hatch again immediately after you've left.|984|0
units.english: He has one of the Kimek come back to escort you out, but before you leave the room, he adds, "Students and their teachers, they are. Picking them up from a school trip, after canceled on them, the original transport did, you are. Bring them back home to Second Viridian for their tests, you will. Asked to do so by the captain of the original transport ship, you were." He urges you to go there as soon as possible to pick them up, and the Kimek take you back out, repeating the same security search in the hallway before opening the hatch for you. They wish you good luck, and close up the hatch again immediately after you've left.
units.italian: Fa tornare uno dei Kimek a scortarti fuori, ma prima che tu lasci la stanza aggiunge: "Studenti e i loro insegnanti, loro sono. Andarli a prendere da una gita scolastica, dopo che ha disdetto su di loro, il trasporto originale ha fatto, tu stai andando. Riportarli a casa a Second Viridian per i loro esami, tu lo farai. Incaricato di farlo dal capitano della nave di trasporto originale, tu sei stato." Ti esorta ad andare lì il prima possibile a prenderli, e i Kimek ti riportano fuori, ripetendo la stessa ricerca di sicurezza nel corridoio prima di aprirti il portello. Ti augurano buona fortuna e richiudono subito il portello dopo che sei uscito.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 1|dialog|989|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort with the <bunks> bunks for the students hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con le <bunks> cuccette per gli studenti non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|name|996|0
units.english: Transport The Students
units.italian: Trasportare gli studenti

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|description|997|0
units.english: Now that you've picked up the <bunks> students and teachers, bring them to their home planet of <destination>.
units.italian: Ora che hai preso i <bunks> studenti e insegnanti, portali sul loro pianeta natale, <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|A line of Kimek, with some Saryds and Arachi in their midst, approach your ship shortly after you've finished landing. These must be the students. They are carrying very little luggage, and board your ship once you open the hatch. Given the young appearance of all of them, you struggle to guess which ones are the teachers. After the last of them comes in, you look outside for a while, confused. Only <bunks> came in, not the 35 that Elirom mentioned.|1008|0
units.english: A line of Kimek, with some Saryds and Arachi in their midst, approach your ship shortly after you've finished landing. These must be the students. They are carrying very little luggage, and board your ship once you open the hatch. Given the young appearance of all of them, you struggle to guess which ones are the teachers. After the last of them comes in, you look outside for a while, confused. Only <bunks> came in, not the 35 that Elirom mentioned.
units.italian: Una fila di Kimek, con alcuni Saryd e Arachi in mezzo, si avvicina alla tua nave poco dopo che hai finito di atterrare. Devono essere gli studenti. Portano pochissimi bagagli e salgono sulla tua nave appena apri il portello. Visto l'aspetto giovane di tutti quanti, fai fatica a indovinare quali siano gli insegnanti. Dopo che è entrato l'ultimo, ti guardi intorno per un po', confuso. Sono entrati solo in <bunks>, non i 35 che Elirom aveva menzionato.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"Weren't there 35 of you?"|1012|0
units.english: "Weren't there 35 of you?"
units.italian: "Non dovevate essere in 35?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	(Say nothing.)|1013|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	Many of them wince at the question, and some of the Kimek start making some rhythmless, low clicking sounds. One of the Saryds comes to close the hatch. "Mistaken, the one who contacted you, must have been," she says. "Here, all of us are."|1015|0
units.english: Many of them wince at the question, and some of the Kimek start making some rhythmless, low clicking sounds. One of the Saryds comes to close the hatch. "Mistaken, the one who contacted you, must have been," she says. "Here, all of us are."
units.italian: Molti di loro sussultano alla domanda, e alcuni dei Kimek cominciano a emettere dei bassi schiocchi senza ritmo. Uno dei Saryd si avvicina per chiudere il portello. "Essersi sbagliato, chi ti ha contattato, deve," dice. "Qui, tutti noi siamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"Weren't there 35 of you?"|1019|0
units.english: "Weren't there 35 of you?"
units.italian: "Non dovevate essere in 35?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	(Say nothing.)|1020|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	Many of them wince at the question, and some of the Kimek start making some rhythmless, low clicking sounds. One of the Saryds comes to close the hatch. "Not anymore..." she says.|1022|0
units.english: Many of them wince at the question, and some of the Kimek start making some rhythmless, low clicking sounds. One of the Saryds comes to close the hatch. "Not anymore..." she says.
units.italian: Molti di loro sussultano alla domanda, e alcuni dei Kimek cominciano a emettere dei bassi schiocchi senza ritmo. Uno dei Saryd si avvicina per chiudere il portello. "Non più..." dice.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	They tell you that they're ready to leave, and ask that you depart for <destination> as soon as possible.|1024|0
units.english: They tell you that they're ready to leave, and ask that you depart for <destination> as soon as possible.
units.italian: Ti dicono che sono pronti a partire e ti chiedono di dirigerli verso <destination> il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|dialog|1029|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the <bunks> students hasn't entered this system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con i <bunks> studenti non è ancora entrata in questo sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|Some of the local Kimek are waiting with transport vehicles for the students. They hand you <payment> once you step off your ship, and one of them appears to tick away at a list with each student that steps off your ship. After the last one leaves, he continues to look at your ship for a few seconds, then to the students, entering the vehicles. He strikes two lines, and thanks you for helping. Back inside your ship, you receive a call from Elirom.|1034|0
units.english: Some of the local Kimek are waiting with transport vehicles for the students. They hand you <payment> once you step off your ship, and one of them appears to tick away at a list with each student that steps off your ship. After the last one leaves, he continues to look at your ship for a few seconds, then to the students, entering the vehicles. He strikes two lines, and thanks you for helping. Back inside your ship, you receive a call from Elirom.
units.italian: Alcuni Kimek del posto aspettano con dei veicoli di trasporto per gli studenti. Ti consegnano <payment> appena scendi dalla nave, e uno di loro sembra spuntare una lista a ogni studente che scende. Dopo che è uscito l'ultimo, continua a guardare la tua nave per qualche secondo, poi gli studenti che salgono sui veicoli. Traccia due righe e ti ringrazia per l'aiuto. Tornato dentro la nave, ricevi una chiamata da Elirom.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"<last>! Thank you for helping, I must," he says. "Difficult it can be, when relying on contractors we are. Prefer to travel in ships of my company, our clients usually do. Glad I am, that no issues with the 35 of them, you had. If any more trouble with our usual transports, I have, ask for your services again I may."|1037|0
units.english: "<last>! Thank you for helping, I must," he says. "Difficult it can be, when relying on contractors we are. Prefer to travel in ships of my company, our clients usually do. Glad I am, that no issues with the 35 of them, you had. If any more trouble with our usual transports, I have, ask for your services again I may."
units.italian: "<last>! Ringraziarti per l'aiuto, io devo," dice. "Difficile può essere, quando ci affidiamo a dei collaboratori esterni. Preferire di viaggiare su navi della mia agenzia, i nostri clienti di solito lo fanno. Lieto io sono, che nessun problema con tutti e 35 loro, tu abbia avuto. Se altri problemi con i nostri soliti trasporti, io avrò, chiedere di nuovo i tuoi servizi, io potrei."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"Sure thing, it's no problem helping with this."|1039|0
units.english: "Sure thing, it's no problem helping with this."
units.italian: "Certamente, non è un problema aiutare in questo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"There were only <bunks>, actually."|1041|0
units.english: "There were only <bunks>, actually."
units.italian: "In realtà erano solo in <bunks>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"Only... oh, I..." he pauses for a few seconds just as his voice cracks a little. "Forgive me, Captain, mistaken, it appears I was. Mixed up the number of passengers with that of another client, I did. Pay more attention next time, I shall." He thanks you again, and ends the call.|1042|0
units.english: "Only... oh, I..." he pauses for a few seconds just as his voice cracks a little. "Forgive me, Captain, mistaken, it appears I was. Mixed up the number of passengers with that of another client, I did. Pay more attention next time, I shall." He thanks you again, and ends the call.
units.italian: "Solo... oh, io..." si interrompe per qualche secondo proprio mentre la voce gli si incrina un po'. "Perdonarmi, Capitano, sbagliato, a quanto pare mi sono. Confuso il numero di passeggeri con quello di un altro cliente, io l'ho fatto. Fare più attenzione la prossima volta, io dovrò." Ti ringrazia di nuovo e chiude la chiamata.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"<last>! A life saver, you are, quite literally," he says. "Handling other evacuations, I still am, so be there to thank you in person, I could not, but know that deeply grateful for your saving those 35, I am. Contact you again I will, when in need of more help rescuing members we are."|1045|0
units.english: "<last>! A life saver, you are, quite literally," he says. "Handling other evacuations, I still am, so be there to thank you in person, I could not, but know that deeply grateful for your saving those 35, I am. Contact you again I will, when in need of more help rescuing members we are."
units.italian: "<last>! Un salvavita, tu sei, letteralmente," dice. "Occuparmi di altre evacuazioni, io sto ancora, quindi essere lì a ringraziarti di persona, io non potevo, ma sappi che profondamente grato per aver salvato quei 35, io sono. Contattarti di nuovo io lo farò, quando bisogno di altro aiuto per salvare i nostri membri noi avremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"Of course, I'd be glad to help again."|1047|0
units.english: "Of course, I'd be glad to help again."
units.italian: "Certo, sarei lieto di aiutare di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"There were only <bunks> waiting for me."|1049|0
units.english: "There were only <bunks> waiting for me."
units.italian: "Ad aspettarmi erano solo in <bunks>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	Half a minute passes in silence. "I see. At any rate, thankful for your rescuing the others, I am," he says as he ends the call.|1050|0
units.english: Half a minute passes in silence. "I see. At any rate, thankful for your rescuing the others, I am," he says as he ends the call.
units.italian: Passa mezzo minuto in silenzio. "Capisco. In ogni caso, grato che tu abbia salvato gli altri, io sono," dice chiudendo la chiamata.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 2|	"Appreciate your willingness to assist us, I do, Captain. Until we meet again." He thanks you once more and ends the call.|1053|0
units.english: "Appreciate your willingness to assist us, I do, Captain. Until we meet again." He thanks you once more and ends the call.
units.italian: "Apprezzare la tua disponibilità ad assisterci, io la apprezzo, Capitano. Finché non ci incontreremo di nuovo." Ti ringrazia ancora una volta e chiude la chiamata.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|name|1058|0
units.english: Pick Up Desert Ranchers
units.italian: Prendere i mandriani del deserto

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|description|1059|0
units.english: Head to <destination> to pick up the <bunks> ranchers by <date> and bring them back to their world, Shifting Sand.
units.italian: Recati a <destination> per prendere i <bunks> mandriani entro <date> e riportarli sul loro mondo, Shifting Sand.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|Walking around the spaceport for a few minutes, you're met by a pair of Saryds. "Captain <last>? Worked with our company before, you have. Helped with transporting a group of students, you had." You nod. "Another troubling situation, we have. Help us again, would you?" They point to a Kimek Spire, presumably the very same you boarded last time, parked at the edge of the local docks.|1076|0
units.english: Walking around the spaceport for a few minutes, you're met by a pair of Saryds. "Captain <last>? Worked with our company before, you have. Helped with transporting a group of students, you had." You nod. "Another troubling situation, we have. Help us again, would you?" They point to a Kimek Spire, presumably the very same you boarded last time, parked at the edge of the local docks.
units.italian: Girando per lo spazioporto per qualche minuto, ti incontrano un paio di Saryd. "Capitano <last>? Lavorato con la nostra agenzia prima, tu hai. Aiutato a trasportare un gruppo di studenti, tu avevi." Fai cenno di sì. "Un'altra situazione problematica, noi abbiamo. Aiutarci di nuovo, tu lo faresti?" Indicano una Guglia Kimek, presumibilmente la stessa su cui sei salito l'ultima volta, parcheggiata ai margini dei moli locali.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"Sure, lead the way."|1078|0
units.english: "Sure, lead the way."
units.italian: "Certo, fai strada."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"I'm not interested in that kind of job at the moment, sorry."|1080|0
units.english: "I'm not interested in that kind of job at the moment, sorry."
units.italian: "Non sono interessato a quel genere di lavoro in questo momento, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"Certain of that, are you? Willing to pay very well for your continued service, the captain is. Change your mind, would <payment>?"|1081|0
units.english: "Certain of that, are you? Willing to pay very well for your continued service, the captain is. Change your mind, would <payment>?"
units.italian: "Ne sei certo? Disposta a pagare molto bene per il tuo servizio continuativo, il capitano è. Cambieresti idea per <payment>?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"On second thought, I'd love a transport job right now."|1083|0
units.english: "On second thought, I'd love a transport job right now."
units.italian: "Ripensandoci, un lavoro di trasporto mi andrebbe proprio adesso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"I'm just not interested in working with you anymore, no."|1084|0
units.english: "I'm just not interested in working with you anymore, no."
units.italian: "Semplicemente non sono più interessato a lavorare con voi, no."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	Once again you're brought to the Spire, but only the Saryds come in with you, unlike the Kimek from last time. You're all escorted through the corridors, and are all searched by the devices, before you're finally brought to Elirom. He greets you, thanking you for coming, "Some more problems, we've had, so in need of a contractor's help once more, the company is."|1087|0
units.english: Once again you're brought to the Spire, but only the Saryds come in with you, unlike the Kimek from last time. You're all escorted through the corridors, and are all searched by the devices, before you're finally brought to Elirom. He greets you, thanking you for coming, "Some more problems, we've had, so in need of a contractor's help once more, the company is."
units.italian: Ancora una volta ti portano alla Guglia, ma questa volta entrano con te solo i Saryd, a differenza dei Kimek dell'ultima volta. Venite tutti scortati attraverso i corridoi e tutti perquisiti dai dispositivi, prima che ti portino finalmente da Elirom. Ti saluta, ringraziandoti di essere venuto: "Altri problemi, noi abbiamo avuto, quindi di nuovo bisogno dell'aiuto di un collaboratore esterno, l'agenzia ha."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"Contract us for transport to <planet>, some Arach ranchers did. Attempting to start a longcow business on the deserts of Shifting Sand, they are, and hoping for a loan from a prestigious bank on <planet>, to start off a new expansion to the ranch they were. <bunks> they are, in total, both ranchers and their employees. Only..." He pauses for a moment, as if considering something. "Difficult, the Arachi can be at times. Once discovered they had, that originally from a rival Arach House, the captain of their original transport was, refuse to return with him, they did. Given us until <date> to find a new transport, they have, before cancel out on us, they do."|1088|0
units.english: "Contract us for transport to <planet>, some Arach ranchers did. Attempting to start a longcow business on the deserts of Shifting Sand, they are, and hoping for a loan from a prestigious bank on <planet>, to start off a new expansion to the ranch they were. <bunks> they are, in total, both ranchers and their employees. Only..." He pauses for a moment, as if considering something. "Difficult, the Arachi can be at times. Once discovered they had, that originally from a rival Arach House, the captain of their original transport was, refuse to return with him, they did. Given us until <date> to find a new transport, they have, before cancel out on us, they do."
units.italian: "Assumerci per un trasporto verso <planet>, alcuni mandriani Arach lo hanno fatto. Cercare di avviare un allevamento di longcow nei deserti di Shifting Sand, essi stanno, e sperare in un prestito da una banca prestigiosa su <planet>, per iniziare una nuova espansione della mandria che avevano. <bunks> loro sono, in totale, sia i mandriani sia i loro dipendenti. Solo che..." Si ferma un momento, come se stesse considerando qualcosa. "Difficili, gli Arachi possono essere a volte. Una volta scoperto che proveniva da una Casa Arach rivale, il capitano del loro trasporto originale, rifiutarsi di tornare con lui, essi lo hanno fatto. Dato a noi fino al <date> per trovare un nuovo trasporto, essi lo hanno, prima di annullare con noi, essi lo faranno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	He says you'll receive <payment> once the ranchers are back on Shifting Sand, and urges you to hurry to <destination> before <date>, so that the Arachi don't cancel the transport. He wishes you good luck, and you're brought back out of the ship. The Saryds that went in with you stay inside, and the Spire departs not long after you've left.|1089|0
units.english: He says you'll receive <payment> once the ranchers are back on Shifting Sand, and urges you to hurry to <destination> before <date>, so that the Arachi don't cancel the transport. He wishes you good luck, and you're brought back out of the ship. The Saryds that went in with you stay inside, and the Spire departs not long after you've left.
units.italian: Dice che riceverai <payment> una volta che i mandriani saranno tornati su Shifting Sand, e ti esorta a sbrigarti ad andare a <destination> entro il <date>, così che gli Arachi non annullino il trasporto. Ti augura buona fortuna, e ti riportano fuori dalla nave. I Saryd che sono entrati con te restano dentro, e la Guglia parte poco dopo che sei uscito.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|Walking around the spaceport for a few minutes, you're met by a pair of Saryds. "Captain <last>? Worked with our company before, you have. Helped with transporting a group of students, you had." You nod. "Another troubling situation, we have. Help us again, would you?" They point to a Kimek Spire, presumably the very same you boarded last time, parked at the edge of the local docks.|1092|0
units.english: Walking around the spaceport for a few minutes, you're met by a pair of Saryds. "Captain <last>? Worked with our company before, you have. Helped with transporting a group of students, you had." You nod. "Another troubling situation, we have. Help us again, would you?" They point to a Kimek Spire, presumably the very same you boarded last time, parked at the edge of the local docks.
units.italian: Girando per lo spazioporto per qualche minuto, ti incontrano un paio di Saryd. "Capitano <last>? Lavorato con la nostra agenzia prima, tu hai. Aiutato a trasportare un gruppo di studenti, tu avevi." Fai cenno di sì. "Un'altra situazione problematica, noi abbiamo. Aiutarci di nuovo, tu lo faresti?" Indicano una Guglia Kimek, presumibilmente la stessa su cui sei salito l'ultima volta, parcheggiata ai margini dei moli locali.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	You follow them to the Spire, and they come in with you, unlike the Kimek from last time. You're all escorted through the corridors, and searched by the security devices, before you're finally brought to Elirom. "Hello Captain, good to see you it is," he greets you. "Word of more Heliarch fleet activity, I have received. Headed to <destination>, to aid on an ongoing search for our members, they are. Arrive there by <date>, they should, so in urgent need of a ship to rescue some <bunks> still on the planet, I am. Pay you <payment>, I will."|1093|0
units.english: You follow them to the Spire, and they come in with you, unlike the Kimek from last time. You're all escorted through the corridors, and searched by the security devices, before you're finally brought to Elirom. "Hello Captain, good to see you it is," he greets you. "Word of more Heliarch fleet activity, I have received. Headed to <destination>, to aid on an ongoing search for our members, they are. Arrive there by <date>, they should, so in urgent need of a ship to rescue some <bunks> still on the planet, I am. Pay you <payment>, I will."
units.italian: Li segui alla Guglia, e anche questa volta entrano con te, a differenza dei Kimek dell'ultima volta. Venite tutti scortati attraverso i corridoi e perquisiti dai dispositivi di sicurezza, prima che ti portino finalmente da Elirom. "Salve Capitano, bello vederti, è," ti saluta. "Notizia di più attività della flotta degli Heliarchs, io ho ricevuto. Diretti a <destination>, per aiutare in una ricerca in corso dei nostri membri, essi sono. Arrivare là entro il <date>, dovrebbero, quindi in urgente bisogno di una nave per salvare alcuni <bunks> ancora sul pianeta, io sono. Pagarti <payment>, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"I'll go there right away."|1095|0
units.english: "I'll go there right away."
units.italian: "Ci andrò subito, stai tranquillo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"How do you keep getting information about these fleets?"|1097|0
units.english: "How do you keep getting information about these fleets?"
units.italian: "Come fate a ricevere continuamente informazioni su queste flotte?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	He collects his thoughts for a while before answering, "Work together to provide us secretive, quick data, Houses Bebliss and Idriss do. From them, the messages come. But, not by them, the information is found. Someone... something maybe, spying on the Heliarchs is. Not one of ours." He pauses again. "Doubted them myself, at first I had. But, never wrong, the information is, almost as if..." He trails off.|1098|0
units.english: He collects his thoughts for a while before answering, "Work together to provide us secretive, quick data, Houses Bebliss and Idriss do. From them, the messages come. But, not by them, the information is found. Someone... something maybe, spying on the Heliarchs is. Not one of ours." He pauses again. "Doubted them myself, at first I had. But, never wrong, the information is, almost as if..." He trails off.
units.italian: Mette insieme i pensieri per un po' prima di rispondere: "Collaborare per fornirci dati segreti e rapidi, Casa Bebliss e Casa Idriss lo fanno. Da loro, i messaggi arrivano. Ma non da loro, le informazioni vengono trovate. Qualcuno... qualcosa forse, che spia gli Heliarchs, c'è. Non uno dei nostri." Si ferma di nuovo. "Dubitato di loro, io stesso all'inizio ho. Ma mai sbagliate, le informazioni sono, quasi come se..." Si interrompe.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|	"Attempting to pass as ranchers, the members are. On a trip to <planet>, but an argument with their original transport, they had. If stopped, you are, tell them that, you should. Remember, <date>. Hopefully still there when you arrive, all <bunks> of them are." He wishes you good luck, and you're brought out of the ship, with the Saryds that found you staying inside. Not long after you've left it, you see the Spire take off and leave the planet.|1100|0
units.english: "Attempting to pass as ranchers, the members are. On a trip to <planet>, but an argument with their original transport, they had. If stopped, you are, tell them that, you should. Remember, <date>. Hopefully still there when you arrive, all <bunks> of them are." He wishes you good luck, and you're brought out of the ship, with the Saryds that found you staying inside. Not long after you've left it, you see the Spire take off and leave the planet.
units.italian: "Cercare di passare per mandriani, i membri lo stanno facendo. In viaggio verso <planet>, ma un litigio con il loro trasporto originale, essi hanno avuto. Se fermato, tu sei, dirglielo, tu dovresti. Ricorda, <date>. Speriamo ancora lì quando arrivi, tutti e <bunks> loro siano." Ti augura buona fortuna, e ti riportano fuori dalla nave, con i Saryd che ti hanno trovato che restano dentro. Poco dopo che l'hai lasciata, vedi la Guglia decollare e lasciare il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 3|dialog|1105|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort with the <bunks> bunks for the ranchers hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con le <bunks> cuccette per i mandriani non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|name|1112|0
units.english: Transport The Ranchers
units.italian: Trasportare i mandriani

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|description|1113|0
units.english: Bring the <bunks> ranchers to their world, <destination>.
units.italian: Porta i <bunks> mandriani sul loro mondo, <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|The ranchers arrive to the hangars shortly after you land, most of them Arachi, with a few Saryds and Kimek in their midst. They come into your ship, all <bunks> of them present.|1124|0
units.english: The ranchers arrive to the hangars shortly after you land, most of them Arachi, with a few Saryds and Kimek in their midst. They come into your ship, all <bunks> of them present.
units.italian: I mandriani arrivano agli hangar poco dopo che sei atterrato, in maggioranza Arachi, con alcuni Saryd e Kimek in mezzo. Entrano nella tua nave, tutti e <bunks> presenti.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"All ready to leave, we are," one Arach tells you as most of the others head to find their bunks.|1127|0
units.english: "All ready to leave, we are," one Arach tells you as most of the others head to find their bunks.
units.italian: "Tutti pronti a partire, noi siamo," ti dice un Arach mentre la maggior parte degli altri va a cercare le cuccette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Got it, we'll leave soon."|1129|0
units.english: "Got it, we'll leave soon."
units.italian: "Ricevuto, partiamo tra poco."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"How did getting that loan go?"|1131|0
units.english: "How did getting that loan go?"
units.italian: "Com'è andata con quel prestito?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"What?" She looks at you with puzzled eyes, until another Arach lightly whacks one of her legs. "Ah, yes, the loan. Well enough. Agreed to grant us the amount needed, they have." She looks back at the other Arach, who stares at her for a moment. "Well, very tired we all are, Captain, so head to my bunk, I will."|1132|0
units.english: "What?" She looks at you with puzzled eyes, until another Arach lightly whacks one of her legs. "Ah, yes, the loan. Well enough. Agreed to grant us the amount needed, they have." She looks back at the other Arach, who stares at her for a moment. "Well, very tired we all are, Captain, so head to my bunk, I will."
units.italian: "Come?" Ti guarda con occhi perplessi, finché un altro Arach le dà un colpetto leggero su una zampa. "Ah, sì, il prestito. Abbastanza bene. Accettato di concederci la somma necessaria, hanno." Guarda di nuovo l'altro Arach, che la fissa per un momento. "Beh, molto stanchi tutti noi siamo, Capitano, quindi andare alla mia cuccetta, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Thought I had, that left behind we would be," one Arach tells you after you've closed the hatch. "Hurry to <planet>, you should. Risk an 'inspection' by the Heliarchs, we cannot."|1135|0
units.english: "Thought I had, that left behind we would be," one Arach tells you after you've closed the hatch. "Hurry to <planet>, you should. Risk an 'inspection' by the Heliarchs, we cannot."
units.italian: "Pensato avevo, che lasciati indietro saremmo stati," ti dice un Arach dopo che hai chiuso il portello. "Sbrigarti verso <planet>, tu dovresti. Rischiare un''ispezione' da parte degli Heliarchs, noi non possiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Got it, we'll leave soon."|1137|0
units.english: "Got it, we'll leave soon."
units.italian: "Ricevuto, partiamo tra poco."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Is everyone here?"|1139|0
units.english: "Is everyone here?"
units.italian: "Ci sono tutti?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Thankfully, yes. Lost nobody this time, we have," she says. "Less brutish on their searches on worlds like <origin>, the Heliarchs are. Managed to avoid them well enough, we did. Or, at least, hope so I do."|1140|0
units.english: "Thankfully, yes. Lost nobody this time, we have," she says. "Less brutish on their searches on worlds like <origin>, the Heliarchs are. Managed to avoid them well enough, we did. Or, at least, hope so I do."
units.italian: "Per fortuna sì. Perso nessuno questa volta, noi abbiamo," dice. "Meno brutali nelle loro ricerche su mondi come <origin>, gli Heliarchs sono. Riusciti a evitarli abbastanza bene, noi siamo. O almeno, sperarlo io lo spero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Well, I'm glad everyone's safe. We'll leave soon."|1142|0
units.english: "Well, I'm glad everyone's safe. We'll leave soon."
units.italian: "Beh, sono contento che siano tutti al sicuro. Partiamo tra poco."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"What do you mean? What's different about worlds like this one?"|1144|0
units.english: "What do you mean? What's different about worlds like this one?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire? Che cosa hanno di diverso mondi come questo?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"What? Obvious is it not? In Saryd territory, we are. Come on now, ready to leave, we are."|1145|0
units.english: "What? Obvious is it not? In Saryd territory, we are. Come on now, ready to leave, we are."
units.italian: "Come? Ovvio non è? In territorio Saryd, noi siamo. Dai, ora, pronti a partire, noi siamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	They all move to their bunks, and you set a course for <destination>.|1147|0
units.english: They all move to their bunks, and you set a course for <destination>.
units.italian: Si dirigono tutti alle loro cuccette, e tu imposti una rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|dialog|1152|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort with the <bunks> ranchers hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con i <bunks> mandriani non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|The Arachi, along with the scattered few Saryds and Kimek, are ready to leave your ship right as you land, thanking you briefly as each one leaves. The Arachi who seemed to be leading the group give you more of a farewell, chatting a bit, until they see a Kimek Spire - that you all guess to be Elirom's ship - approaching. They grunt, and leave with the rest. You head into the Spire and meet Elirom, who hands you <payment> while watching the group leave in transports via one of the cameras on the outside of the ship.|1157|0
units.english: The Arachi, along with the scattered few Saryds and Kimek, are ready to leave your ship right as you land, thanking you briefly as each one leaves. The Arachi who seemed to be leading the group give you more of a farewell, chatting a bit, until they see a Kimek Spire - that you all guess to be Elirom's ship - approaching. They grunt, and leave with the rest. You head into the Spire and meet Elirom, who hands you <payment> while watching the group leave in transports via one of the cameras on the outside of the ship.
units.italian: Gli Arachi, insieme ai pochi Saryd e Kimek sparsi, sono pronti a lasciare la tua nave appena atterri, ringraziandoti brevemente mentre ognuno esce. Gli Arachi che sembravano guidare il gruppo ti dedicano un commiato più lungo, chiacchierando un po', finché non vedono una Guglia Kimek - che immaginate tutti sia la nave di Elirom - avvicinarsi. Emettono un grugnito e se ne vanno con gli altri. Entri nella Guglia e incontri Elirom, che ti consegna <payment> mentre guarda il gruppo allontanarsi sui trasporti attraverso una delle telecamere esterne della nave.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"They didn't seem very happy to see you."|1161|0
units.english: "They didn't seem very happy to see you."
units.italian: "Non sembravano molto contenti di vederti."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"How come you're here? I thought you hired me because you didn't have any ships available."|1163|0
units.english: "How come you're here? I thought you hired me because you didn't have any ships available."
units.italian: "Come mai sei qui? Pensavo mi avessi assunto perché non avevi navi disponibili."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Hmm? Ah, well, return to where met you I had, one of the ships did. Make it in time to pick up the ranchers it could not, though, so very grateful for your service, the company is once again," he explains. "Delegate my own transport job to that ship instead, I did, for wish I did to apologize to the ranchers in person. Afraid I am, that hear my explanations they will not."|1164|0
units.english: "Hmm? Ah, well, return to where met you I had, one of the ships did. Make it in time to pick up the ranchers it could not, though, so very grateful for your service, the company is once again," he explains. "Delegate my own transport job to that ship instead, I did, for wish I did to apologize to the ranchers in person. Afraid I am, that hear my explanations they will not."
units.italian: "Hmm? Ah, beh, tornare dove ti ho incontrato, una delle navi lo ha fatto. Arrivare in tempo per prendere i mandriani, però, non poteva, quindi molto grata del tuo servizio, l'agenzia è ancora una volta," spiega. "Delegare il mio incarico di trasporto a quella nave, io l'ho fatto, invece, perché desideravo scusarmi di persona con i mandriani. Temo che non ascolteranno le mie spiegazioni."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"Seem to be the case, that does." He sighs. "Well, understandable it is, from their perspective. More careful about who I sent to transport them, I should have been."|1167|0
units.english: "Seem to be the case, that does." He sighs. "Well, understandable it is, from their perspective. More careful about who I sent to transport them, I should have been."
units.italian: "Sembra proprio così." Sospira. "Beh, comprensibile è, dal loro punto di vista. Più attento a chi mandavo a trasportarli, io sarei dovuto essere."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"They didn't seem very happy to see you."|1171|0
units.english: "They didn't seem very happy to see you."
units.italian: "Non sembravano molto contenti di vederti."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"How come you're here? I thought you reached out to me because you didn't have any ships available."|1173|0
units.english: "How come you're here? I thought you reached out to me because you didn't have any ships available."
units.italian: "Come mai sei qui? Pensavo ti fossi rivolto a me perché non avevi navi disponibili."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"At the moment, I did not, and available in time to rescue them, none of my ships would be," he explains. "Come here after the first of my ships had returned, I did. Wished I had to apologize to them in person, though it seems that hear any of it, they will not..."|1174|0
units.english: "At the moment, I did not, and available in time to rescue them, none of my ships would be," he explains. "Come here after the first of my ships had returned, I did. Wished I had to apologize to them in person, though it seems that hear any of it, they will not..."
units.italian: "In quel momento non ne avevo, e disponibile in tempo per salvarli, nessuna delle mie navi lo sarebbe stata," spiega. "Venire qui dopo che la prima delle mie navi era tornata, io l'ho fatto. Desideravo scusarmi con loro di persona, anche se sembra che non ascolteranno nulla di tutto ciò..."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	"No, they were not." He sighs. "A Heliarch, I once was. Arbiter. High rank. Thought of as untrustworthy by many of the Redoubt, I still am. Think, some of them do, that responsible for tragedies that came to their families, I was." He continues watching the group dwindle as more transports come, until the last of them disappears into the spaceport village. "That they are wrong, I hope."|1177|0
units.english: "No, they were not." He sighs. "A Heliarch, I once was. Arbiter. High rank. Thought of as untrustworthy by many of the Redoubt, I still am. Think, some of them do, that responsible for tragedies that came to their families, I was." He continues watching the group dwindle as more transports come, until the last of them disappears into the spaceport village. "That they are wrong, I hope."
units.italian: "No, non lo erano." Sospira. "Un Heliarch, io un tempo lo ero. Arbitro. Grado elevato. Considerato inaffidabile da molti del Redoubt, io lo sono ancora. Pensano, alcuni di loro, che responsabile delle tragedie che hanno colpito le loro famiglie, io sia stato." Continua a guardare il gruppo diradarsi man mano che arrivano altri trasporti, finché l'ultimo scompare nel villaggio dello spazioporto. "Che si sbaglino, io lo spero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 4|	He thanks you for helping out again, and says he'll be in contact if he needs any more of your help.|1179|0
units.english: He thanks you for helping out again, and says he'll be in contact if he needs any more of your help.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia per aver aiutato di nuovo e dice che ti contatterà se avrà bisogno di altro aiuto.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|name|1184|0
units.english: Pick Up Immigrants
units.italian: Prendere gli immigrati

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|description|1185|0
units.english: Head to <destination> by <date> to pick up <bunks> immigrants, who are seeking to start a new life on Ablub's Invention.
units.italian: Recati a <destination> entro <date> per prendere <bunks> immigrati, che cercano di iniziare una nuova vita su Ablub's Invention.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|You receive a call seconds after you've touched down on <origin>. It's from Elirom, the Saryd who had you help transport some of his company's clients. "Captain <last>! Your help again, we need," he begins. "Hire us to bring them to their new home on Ablub's Invention, some immigrants from <destination> did. <bunks> in total. Only..." he looks down, his mouth struggling for words. "Fallen ill, the captain of the ship we had arranged for them has. Supposed to leave by <date>, they were, but get to <planet> in time, we cannot. You, however, a jump drive possess. Help us now, only you can, Captain."|1203|0
units.english: You receive a call seconds after you've touched down on <origin>. It's from Elirom, the Saryd who had you help transport some of his company's clients. "Captain <last>! Your help again, we need," he begins. "Hire us to bring them to their new home on Ablub's Invention, some immigrants from <destination> did. <bunks> in total. Only..." he looks down, his mouth struggling for words. "Fallen ill, the captain of the ship we had arranged for them has. Supposed to leave by <date>, they were, but get to <planet> in time, we cannot. You, however, a jump drive possess. Help us now, only you can, Captain."
units.italian: Ricevi una chiamata pochi secondi dopo essere atterrato su <origin>. È di Elirom, il Saryd che ti aveva fatto trasportare alcuni clienti della sua agenzia. "Capitano <last>! Il tuo aiuto di nuovo, ci serve," comincia. "Assumerci per portarli nella loro nuova casa su Ablub's Invention, alcuni immigrati da <destination> lo hanno fatto. <bunks> in totale. Solo che..." abbassa lo sguardo, la bocca che fatica a trovare le parole. "Ammalatosi, il capitano della nave che avevamo organizzato per loro si è. Partire entro <date>, dovevano, ma arrivare su <planet> in tempo, noi non possiamo. Tu, però, un motore di salto possiedi. Aiutarci ora, solo tu puoi, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	"I'd be glad to help. I'll head there as quick as I can."|1205|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. I'll head there as quick as I can."
units.italian: "Sarei lieto di aiutare. Andrò il più in fretta possibile."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	"Can't they just wait a bit longer for you to send another ship?"|1207|0
units.english: "Can't they just wait a bit longer for you to send another ship?"
units.italian: "Non possono semplicemente aspettare un po' di più che mandiate un'altra nave?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	"I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now."|1208|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma sono occupato in questo momento."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	"Please, Captain. Answer all your questions, I will, once safely here they are." He quickly types away at something close to the camera on his end, and you're notified of <payment> in total just having been transferred to your account. "Paid much more for bringing them to safety, you will be. To Ablub's Invention, bring them you must. Sending word for them to wait for you, I am. Help us this one last time, please do, <last>." He looks at you for a moment, then bows lightly before logging off.|1209|0
units.english: "Please, Captain. Answer all your questions, I will, once safely here they are." He quickly types away at something close to the camera on his end, and you're notified of <payment> in total just having been transferred to your account. "Paid much more for bringing them to safety, you will be. To Ablub's Invention, bring them you must. Sending word for them to wait for you, I am. Help us this one last time, please do, <last>." He looks at you for a moment, then bows lightly before logging off.
units.italian: "Ti prego, Capitano. Rispondere a tutte le tue domande, io lo farò, una volta che al sicuro qui saranno." Digita in fretta qualcosa vicino alla telecamera dalla sua parte, e ricevi la notifica che <payment> in totale sono appena stati trasferiti sul tuo conto. "Pagato molto di più per portarli in salvo, tu sarai. Ad Ablub's Invention, portarli tu devi. Mandare parola perché ti aspettino, io sto facendo. Aiutarci quest'ultima volta, per favore, <last>." Ti guarda un momento, poi si inchina leggermente prima di disconnettersi.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	He sighs in relief, then quickly types away at something close to the camera on his end, and you're notified of <payment> in total just having been transferred to your account. "Paid much more you will be, once safe, the immigrants are. Bring them back to Ablub's Invention, you must. Send word for them to expect you, I shall." He bows lightly, then logs off.|1212|0
units.english: He sighs in relief, then quickly types away at something close to the camera on his end, and you're notified of <payment> in total just having been transferred to your account. "Paid much more you will be, once safe, the immigrants are. Bring them back to Ablub's Invention, you must. Send word for them to expect you, I shall." He bows lightly, then logs off.
units.italian: Sospira di sollievo, poi digita in fretta qualcosa vicino alla telecamera dalla sua parte, e ricevi la notifica che <payment> in totale sono appena stati trasferiti sul tuo conto. "Pagato molto di più, tu sarai, una volta al sicuro, gli immigrati saranno. Riportarli ad Ablub's Invention, tu devi. Mandare parola perché ti aspettino, io lo farò." Si inchina leggermente, poi si disconnette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|You receive a call seconds after you've touched down on <origin>. It's from Elirom, and he wastes no time giving you your next mission. "A particularly urgent matter, this is. Looking for our members on <planet>, the Heliarchs are. Found, dozens have already been, and even more Heliarchs by <date> will there arrive. Make it in time, none of our ships can, too far away it is. Possess a jump drive, however, you do. Rescue the <bunks> remaining, you must." He types away at something on his end for a bit, and you see <payment> have been transferred to your account. "Much more I will give you, once safely back on Ablub's Invention you are. If stopped by the Heliarchs you are..." He trails off for a while, and you can hear the increasingly hurried, repeated tapping of hooves on the floor. "If stopped you are, tell them that transporting immigrants to their new homes on Ablub's Invention, you will. Hired by House Idriss, they have been." He urges you to go to <destination> immediately, wishing you good luck, and logging off.|1215|0
units.english: You receive a call seconds after you've touched down on <origin>. It's from Elirom, and he wastes no time giving you your next mission. "A particularly urgent matter, this is. Looking for our members on <planet>, the Heliarchs are. Found, dozens have already been, and even more Heliarchs by <date> will there arrive. Make it in time, none of our ships can, too far away it is. Possess a jump drive, however, you do. Rescue the <bunks> remaining, you must." He types away at something on his end for a bit, and you see <payment> have been transferred to your account. "Much more I will give you, once safely back on Ablub's Invention you are. If stopped by the Heliarchs you are..." He trails off for a while, and you can hear the increasingly hurried, repeated tapping of hooves on the floor. "If stopped you are, tell them that transporting immigrants to their new homes on Ablub's Invention, you will. Hired by House Idriss, they have been." He urges you to go to <destination> immediately, wishing you good luck, and logging off.
units.italian: Ricevi una chiamata pochi secondi dopo essere atterrato su <origin>. È di Elirom, che non perde tempo a darti la prossima missione. "Una faccenda particolarmente urgente, questa è. Cercare i nostri membri su <planet>, gli Heliarchs lo stanno facendo. Trovati, dozzine sono già stati, e ancora più Heliarchs entro <date> arriveranno là. Arrivare in tempo, nessuna delle nostre navi può, troppo lontana è. Possedere un motore di salto, però, tu lo possiedi. Salvare i <bunks> rimasti, tu devi." Digita qualcosa dalla sua parte per un po', e vedi che <payment> sono stati trasferiti sul tuo conto. "Molto di più ti darò, una volta al sicuro ad Ablub's Invention tu sarai. Se fermato dagli Heliarchs tu sei..." Si interrompe per un po', e puoi sentire il tamburellare sempre più frettoloso e ripetuto degli zoccoli sul pavimento. "Se fermato tu sei, di' loro che trasportare immigrati verso le loro nuove case su Ablub's Invention, tu lo stai facendo. Assunti da Casa Idriss, essi sono stati." Ti esorta ad andare subito a <destination>, ti augura buona fortuna e si disconnette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|dialog|1220|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort with the <bunks> bunks for the immigrants hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con le <bunks> cuccette per gli immigrati non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|You are contacted by Elirom upon landing.|1226|0
units.english: You are contacted by Elirom upon landing.
units.italian: Vieni contattato da Elirom all'atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	"Informed I was that manage to make it in time for the transport, you did not, Captain," he speaks in a much sterner tone than what you'd grown accustomed to. "Truly important for us, this job was. Helped us much, you have, but afraid I am that work together any longer, we will not. Goodbye."|1229|0
units.english: "Informed I was that manage to make it in time for the transport, you did not, Captain," he speaks in a much sterner tone than what you'd grown accustomed to. "Truly important for us, this job was. Helped us much, you have, but afraid I am that work together any longer, we will not. Goodbye."
units.italian: "Informato sono stato che riuscito ad arrivare in tempo per il trasporto, tu non sei, Capitano," parla con un tono molto più severo di quello a cui eri abituato. "Davvero importante per noi, questo incarico era. Aiutati molto, tu ci hai, ma temo che lavorare insieme ancora, noi non lo faremo. Addio."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	He signs off before you're able to explain your delay.|1230|0
units.english: He signs off before you're able to explain your delay.
units.italian: Si disconnette prima che tu possa spiegare il tuo ritardo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	"Why there were you not, <last>? Lost to the Heliarchs, all of them now are!" He punches the table, shaking the camera on his end. "Supposed to arrive on time, you were. To rescue them, you were meant to. Abandon them like that, how could you?" He appears to swear in the Saryd tongue.|1233|0
units.english: "Why there were you not, <last>? Lost to the Heliarchs, all of them now are!" He punches the table, shaking the camera on his end. "Supposed to arrive on time, you were. To rescue them, you were meant to. Abandon them like that, how could you?" He appears to swear in the Saryd tongue.
units.italian: "Perché là non eri, <last>? Persi agli Heliarchs, tutti quanti ora sono!" Colpisce il tavolo, facendo tremare la telecamera dalla sua parte. "Arrivare in tempo, tu dovevi. Salvarli, tu dovevi. Abbandonarli così, come hai potuto?" Sembra imprecare nella lingua Saryd.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	He spends a few minutes to calm down, then speaks up again. "Forgive me, Captain. Helped us much, you have, and appreciated your previous heroic actions are, but wrong to rely on you this time, I was."|1234|0
units.english: He spends a few minutes to calm down, then speaks up again. "Forgive me, Captain. Helped us much, you have, and appreciated your previous heroic actions are, but wrong to rely on you this time, I was."
units.italian: Impiega qualche minuto a calmarsi, poi riprende a parlare. "Perdonarmi, Capitano. Aiutati molto, tu ci hai, e apprezzate le tue precedenti azioni eroiche sono, ma sbagliato è stato affidarmi a te questa volta, io ho sbagliato."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 5|	He signs off before you're able to inquire on other ways to save them.|1235|0
units.english: He signs off before you're able to inquire on other ways to save them.
units.italian: Si disconnette prima che tu possa chiedergli altri modi per salvarli.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|name|1238|0
units.english: Transport The Immigrants
units.italian: Trasportare gli immigrati

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|description|1239|0
units.english: Bring the <bunks> immigrants to their new homes on <destination>.
units.italian: Porta i <bunks> immigrati nelle loro nuove case su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|The moment your ship touches down on the hangar you can already see a very large group of Saryds waiting. When you open your hatch, they rush in dozens at a time, and you catch some Kimek and Arachi in the middle, struggling to keep with the galloping mass. Once everyone is inside, you run a passenger count: only <bunks> of the 116 are on board. You look out, and see nobody else coming to your ship. One of the older Saryds approaches you, pressing the button to close the hatch. "Leave we must," he says. Looking back to the Saryd crowd, many of the adults are comforting their children. The sobs of one Saryd girl in particular drown out the others.|1250|0
units.english: The moment your ship touches down on the hangar you can already see a very large group of Saryds waiting. When you open your hatch, they rush in dozens at a time, and you catch some Kimek and Arachi in the middle, struggling to keep with the galloping mass. Once everyone is inside, you run a passenger count: only <bunks> of the 116 are on board. You look out, and see nobody else coming to your ship. One of the older Saryds approaches you, pressing the button to close the hatch. "Leave we must," he says. Looking back to the Saryd crowd, many of the adults are comforting their children. The sobs of one Saryd girl in particular drown out the others.
units.italian: Appena la tua nave si posa sull'hangar vedi già un gruppo molto numeroso di Saryd in attesa. Quando apri il portello si precipitano dentro a dozzine per volta, e intravedi alcuni Kimek e Arachi in mezzo, che faticano a tenere il passo della massa al galoppo. Una volta che sono tutti dentro, fai il conteggio dei passeggeri: solo <bunks> dei 116 sono a bordo. Ti guardi intorno e non vedi nessun altro che arrivi alla nave. Uno dei Saryd più anziani ti si avvicina, premendo il pulsante per chiudere il portello. "Partire noi dobbiamo," dice. Guardando la folla Saryd, molti adulti stanno consolando i loro bambini. I singhiozzi di una ragazza Saryd in particolare coprono quelli degli altri.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"I was told there were 116 of you for me to pick up. We only have <bunks>."|1254|0
units.english: "I was told there were 116 of you for me to pick up. We only have <bunks>."
units.italian: "Mi era stato detto che eravate in 116 da prendere. Ne abbiamo solo <bunks>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Alright, we'll leave in a few minutes."|1255|0
units.english: "Alright, we'll leave in a few minutes."
units.italian: "Va bene, partiamo tra qualche minuto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	He squints, clenching his hands into fists and then relaxing them again. "Only <bunks> you are getting. Take us away from here, now, or fly your ship myself, I will."|1257|0
units.english: He squints, clenching his hands into fists and then relaxing them again. "Only <bunks> you are getting. Take us away from here, now, or fly your ship myself, I will."
units.italian: Strizza gli occhi, stringendo le mani a pugno e poi rilassandole. "Solo <bunks> ne stai prendendo. Portaci via di qui, ora, o a pilotare la tua nave ci penso io."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Understood. We'll leave in a few minutes."|1261|0
units.english: "Understood. We'll leave in a few minutes."
units.italian: "Ho capito. Partiamo tra qualche minuto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"What about the others?"|1263|0
units.english: "What about the others?"
units.italian: "E che cosa ne sarà degli altri?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	He looks back to the wailing girl, his hands slightly trembling as he clenches them into fists. He turns back to you, opening his mouth as if to say something, but no words come out. He heads back to the crowd, headed for the young girl.|1264|0
units.english: He looks back to the wailing girl, his hands slightly trembling as he clenches them into fists. He turns back to you, opening his mouth as if to say something, but no words come out. He heads back to the crowd, headed for the young girl.
units.italian: Guarda di nuovo la ragazza che piange, le mani che tremano leggermente mentre le stringe a pugno. Si volta verso di te, apre la bocca come per dire qualcosa, ma non esce alcuna parola. Torna verso la folla, diretto alla ragazzina.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	You help everyone settle into their bunks, departing for <destination> when you're done.|1266|0
units.english: You help everyone settle into their bunks, departing for <destination> when you're done.
units.italian: Aiuti tutti a sistemarsi nelle cuccette, partendo per <destination> quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|dialog|1271|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort with the <bunks> immigrants hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con i <bunks> immigrati non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|You receive a message from Elirom as you enter the planet's airspace, passing you some coordinates and instructing you to land there instead of the usual ports here. You come to a complex in the middle of a prairie, with a blue-ish metal building at its center. As you come down for a landing, you see Elirom's own ship is landed there.|1278|0
units.english: You receive a message from Elirom as you enter the planet's airspace, passing you some coordinates and instructing you to land there instead of the usual ports here. You come to a complex in the middle of a prairie, with a blue-ish metal building at its center. As you come down for a landing, you see Elirom's own ship is landed there.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Elirom mentre entri nello spazio aereo del pianeta, che ti passa alcune coordinate e ti ordina di atterrare lì invece che ai soliti porti. Arrivi a un complesso in mezzo a una prateria, con un edificio di metallo bluastro al centro. Mentre scendi per atterrare, vedi che anche la nave di Elirom è atterrata lì.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	Just as quickly as they entered it, your passengers rush out of your ship, greeting and hugging some of the people waiting for them. One of them, Elirom, shyly watches from the Spire, not having come down the ramp yet. The older Saryd who was accompanying the crying Saryd girl leaves her side briefly once he sees him, walking at a quick pace toward Elirom. He grabs him by the shoulders and shouts something in the Saryd language, though no translators pick it up. When he lets go of his shoulders, he goes back to accompanying the girl, and Elirom stays put. You go to him, which prompts him to reach in a pocket and grab a bunch of credit chips, handing them to you. <payment>, in total. "Tell you I did, that well paid you would be."|1279|0
units.english: Just as quickly as they entered it, your passengers rush out of your ship, greeting and hugging some of the people waiting for them. One of them, Elirom, shyly watches from the Spire, not having come down the ramp yet. The older Saryd who was accompanying the crying Saryd girl leaves her side briefly once he sees him, walking at a quick pace toward Elirom. He grabs him by the shoulders and shouts something in the Saryd language, though no translators pick it up. When he lets go of his shoulders, he goes back to accompanying the girl, and Elirom stays put. You go to him, which prompts him to reach in a pocket and grab a bunch of credit chips, handing them to you. <payment>, in total. "Tell you I did, that well paid you would be."
units.italian: Con la stessa rapidità con cui erano entrati, i tuoi passeggeri si precipitano fuori dalla nave, salutando e abbracciando alcune delle persone che li aspettano. Uno di loro, Elirom, osserva timidamente dalla Guglia, senza essere ancora sceso dalla rampa. Il Saryd anziano che accompagnava la ragazza in lacrime la lascia per un momento quando lo vede, e si dirige a passo svelto verso Elirom. Lo afferra per le spalle e gli grida qualcosa nella lingua Saryd, che nessun traduttore capta. Quando lo lascia andare, torna ad accompagnare la ragazza, ed Elirom resta fermo dov'è. Vai da lui, cosa che lo induce a infilare la mano in tasca e a prendere una manciata di gettoni di credito, porgendoteli. <payment>, in totale. "Te l'avevo detto, io, che ben pagato tu saresti stato."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"What were all of them so worked up about?"|1283|0
units.english: "What were all of them so worked up about?"
units.italian: "Perché erano tutti così agitati?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"What's really going on with you and your company?"|1284|0
units.english: "What's really going on with you and your company?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sta succedendo davvero tra te e la tua agenzia?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	He looks into your eyes for a few seconds, before taking a long gaze at the skies. "Come. Talk inside the ship, we should." You two head inside, and one of the Kimek crew members closes the hatch. You come to his bunk, where he sits down and begins, "A transport company, I do not own. No company at all, I own. Transporting students, ranchers, immigrants, you were not." He looks at you intensely. "Saving lives, what you have been doing is. Saving them," he points out to the corridor, in the direction of the hatch.|1285|0
units.english: He looks into your eyes for a few seconds, before taking a long gaze at the skies. "Come. Talk inside the ship, we should." You two head inside, and one of the Kimek crew members closes the hatch. You come to his bunk, where he sits down and begins, "A transport company, I do not own. No company at all, I own. Transporting students, ranchers, immigrants, you were not." He looks at you intensely. "Saving lives, what you have been doing is. Saving them," he points out to the corridor, in the direction of the hatch.
units.italian: Ti guarda negli occhi per qualche secondo, poi volge lo sguardo a lungo verso il cielo. "Vieni. Parlare dentro la nave, noi dovremmo."
