Entrate, e uno dei membri Kimek dell'equipaggio chiude il portello. Arrivate alla sua cuccetta, dove si siede e comincia: "Un'agenzia di trasporti, io non la possiedo. Nessuna agenzia, io possiedo. Trasportare studenti, mandriani, immigrati, tu non lo stavi facendo." Ti guarda con intensità. "Salvare vite, quello che tu hai fatto è. Salvarle," indica il corridoio, in direzione del portello.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Saving them? From what?"|1287|0
units.english: "Saving them? From what?"
units.italian: "Salvarle? Da che cosa?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"I just flew them from one planet to another."|1289|0
units.english: "I just flew them from one planet to another."
units.italian: "Le ho solo portate da un pianeta all'altro."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"And in doing so, saved their lives, you have," he responds. "The truth, it was, that arrive to the planets I sent you in time, my other ships would have not, but not in a hurry due to contracts, we were. Searching for them, the Heliarchs were, and on their way, Punisher fleets were. Captured, all those you rescued would have been, if arrived before you, those Punishers had."|1290|0
units.english: "And in doing so, saved their lives, you have," he responds. "The truth, it was, that arrive to the planets I sent you in time, my other ships would have not, but not in a hurry due to contracts, we were. Searching for them, the Heliarchs were, and on their way, Punisher fleets were. Captured, all those you rescued would have been, if arrived before you, those Punishers had."
units.italian: "E così facendo, salvato le loro vite, tu lo hai fatto," risponde. "La verità, era, che arrivare sui pianeti dove ti ho mandato in tempo, le mie altre navi non ci sarebbero riuscite, ma non per fretta di contratti, noi eravamo. Cercare loro, gli Heliarchs lo stavano facendo, e in arrivo, flotte di Punishers erano. Catturati, tutti quelli che hai salvato sarebbero stati, se arrivati prima di te, quei Punishers fossero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Why, the Heliarchs. Our so-called 'protectors.' Paranoid, self-decorated butchers in their rooms deep within the rings..." He looks to the ground, disgust written on his face. "Preying on us for many centuries, they have been. With whatever insanities they invent and worship, their actions they justify."|1293|0
units.english: "Why, the Heliarchs. Our so-called 'protectors.' Paranoid, self-decorated butchers in their rooms deep within the rings..." He looks to the ground, disgust written on his face. "Preying on us for many centuries, they have been. With whatever insanities they invent and worship, their actions they justify."
units.italian: "Perché, gli Heliarchs. I nostri cosiddetti 'protettori'. Macellai paranoici e autoproclamati nelle loro stanze in fondo agli anelli..." Guarda a terra, il disgusto scritto sul viso. "Predarci per molti secoli, essi lo hanno fatto. Con qualunque follia inventino e adorino, le loro azioni giustificano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"The Heliarchs were looking for them? So they... you all are criminals?"|1296|0
units.english: "The Heliarchs were looking for them? So they... you all are criminals?"
units.italian: "Gli Heliarchs vi stavano cercando? Quindi voi... siete tutti criminali?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Who are you?"|1297|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Elirom, I am. Born on Saros. Raised there, fascinated by the Heliarchs since my infancy. When of age I came, into the Academy of Cadets I enlisted. Served the Heliarchy for 67 years, I had, before finally the right thing, I did. For the last 18 of those years, an arbiter, I was." He brings his hands together, as if to warm them up. "The Lunarium Redoubt, I then joined. Belong to that group, they do, the people whom rescue, you did. Or, at least, their parents do... did." He sighs. "Criminals, outlaws... call us whatever names the Heliarchs do, simply trying to save our Coalition from them, we are. Saving people from their mock hunts for terrorists, my job is. Believe me, you may not. Choose to see us, you can, as what deem us, the Heliarchs do. In doing that, though, changing the things they do, the things that seen, I have, the things that..." he trails off. "But dead to them for decades now, I have been."|1298|0
units.english: "Elirom, I am. Born on Saros. Raised there, fascinated by the Heliarchs since my infancy. When of age I came, into the Academy of Cadets I enlisted. Served the Heliarchy for 67 years, I had, before finally the right thing, I did. For the last 18 of those years, an arbiter, I was." He brings his hands together, as if to warm them up. "The Lunarium Redoubt, I then joined. Belong to that group, they do, the people whom rescue, you did. Or, at least, their parents do... did." He sighs. "Criminals, outlaws... call us whatever names the Heliarchs do, simply trying to save our Coalition from them, we are. Saving people from their mock hunts for terrorists, my job is. Believe me, you may not. Choose to see us, you can, as what deem us, the Heliarchs do. In doing that, though, changing the things they do, the things that seen, I have, the things that..." he trails off. "But dead to them for decades now, I have been."
units.italian: "Elirom, io sono. Nato su Saros. Cresciuto là, affascinato dagli Heliarchs fin dalla culla. Quando raggiunta l'età, nell'Accademia dei Cadetti mi arruolai. Servito l'Eliarchia per 67 anni, io ho, prima di fare finalmente la cosa giusta. Per gli ultimi 18 di quegli anni, un arbitro, io ero." Congiunge le mani, come per scaldarle. "Al Lunarium Redoubt, mi unii poi. Appartenere a quel gruppo, loro lo fanno: le persone che hai salvato. O almeno, i loro genitori lo facevano... lo hanno fatto." Sospira. "Criminali, fuorilegge... chiamarci con qualunque nome gli Heliarchs ci chiamino, semplicemente cercare di salvare la nostra Coalizione da loro, noi lo stiamo facendo. Salvare persone dalle loro false battute di caccia ai terroristi, il mio lavoro è. Credermi, tu forse non potrai. Scegliere di vederci, tu puoi, come ciò che ci considerano gli Heliarchs. Facendo questo, però, cambiare le cose che fanno, le cose che ho visto, le cose che..." si interrompe. "Ma morto per loro da decenni ormai, io sono."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"You want me to join your group in fighting the Heliarchs, is that it?"|1300|0
units.english: "You want me to join your group in fighting the Heliarchs, is that it?"
units.italian: "Vuoi che mi unisca al tuo gruppo per combattere gli Heliarchs, è questo?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"Dead? What do you mean?"|1302|0
units.english: "Dead? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Morto? Che cosa intendi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	He thinks for a few minutes, oftentimes opening up his mouth as if deciding to speak, but ultimately going back to reflecting on what to say. "When decided to... desert, I had, work I did on covering up my escape of the facility where stationed, I was. After forcing an... an incident, meant to erase all traces of mine, fled and hid in civilian ships for a while, I had, until found by the Lunarium I was." He smirks lightly. "Thought I had that aware enough of their patterns and methods, I was, enough to locate them. Find me first, they did though. Taken in, I was, and helping them since, I have been."|1303|0
units.english: He thinks for a few minutes, oftentimes opening up his mouth as if deciding to speak, but ultimately going back to reflecting on what to say. "When decided to... desert, I had, work I did on covering up my escape of the facility where stationed, I was. After forcing an... an incident, meant to erase all traces of mine, fled and hid in civilian ships for a while, I had, until found by the Lunarium I was." He smirks lightly. "Thought I had that aware enough of their patterns and methods, I was, enough to locate them. Find me first, they did though. Taken in, I was, and helping them since, I have been."
units.italian: Riflette per qualche minuto, spesso aprendo la bocca come se decidesse di parlare, ma tornando alla fine a rimuginare su cosa dire. "Quando deciso di... disertare, io avevo, il lavoro che feci per coprire la mia fuga dalla struttura dove ero di stanza. Dopo aver forzato un... un incidente, inteso a cancellare ogni mia traccia, fuggii e mi nascosi su navi civili per un po', io lo feci, finché trovato dal Lunarium io non fui." Sorride leggermente. "Convinto ero di essere abbastanza consapevole dei loro schemi e metodi, io, da individuarli. Trovarmi per primo, però, loro lo hanno fatto. Accolto, io sono stato, e da allora li aiuto, io ho."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"What facility did you work at?"|1305|0
units.english: "What facility did you work at?"
units.italian: "In quale struttura lavoravi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"An incident? What did you do?"|1306|0
units.english: "An incident? What did you do?"
units.italian: "Un incidente? Che cosa hai fatto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	His eyes flicker at your question, locked in with yours. He averts his gaze, looking back to the ground. "Get going, I really must. Address those you rescued, I shall. Attempt to comfort and relocate them."|1307|0
units.english: His eyes flicker at your question, locked in with yours. He averts his gaze, looking back to the ground. "Get going, I really must. Address those you rescued, I shall. Attempt to comfort and relocate them."
units.italian: Gli occhi gli vacillano alla tua domanda, agganciati ai tuoi. Distoglie lo sguardo, tornando a fissare il pavimento. "Andare, io devo davvero. Rivolgermi a quelli che hai salvato, io lo farò. Cercare di consolarli e trasferirli."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	He gets up to leave. "Come ask for your help directly again, for a long time I may not, but still in need of help saving our members, we will be. Very grateful, we would be, if help us again when we need it, you would." He extends his arm, and shakes your hand, just before following you back out of the Spire. He quickly trots inside the central building, and you head to your ship and fly to the main spaceport.|1309|0
units.english: He gets up to leave. "Come ask for your help directly again, for a long time I may not, but still in need of help saving our members, we will be. Very grateful, we would be, if help us again when we need it, you would." He extends his arm, and shakes your hand, just before following you back out of the Spire. He quickly trots inside the central building, and you head to your ship and fly to the main spaceport.
units.italian: Si alza per andarsene. "Venire a chiederti aiuto direttamente di nuovo, per molto tempo forse non potrò, ma ancora bisogno di aiuto per salvare i nostri membri, noi avremo. Molto grati, noi saremmo, se aiutarci di nuovo quando ne avremo bisogno, tu lo farai." Allunga il braccio e ti stringe la mano, subito prima di seguirti fuori dalla Guglia. Trotta in fretta dentro l'edificio centrale, e tu ti dirigi alla nave e voli allo spazioporto principale.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"He seemed angry at you."|1313|0
units.english: "He seemed angry at you."
units.italian: "Sembrava arrabbiato con te."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"I could only get <bunks>."|1315|0
units.english: "I could only get <bunks>."
units.italian: "Ho potuto prenderne solo <bunks>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"I know." He sighs. "Made sure I understood that, that old man has."|1316|0
units.english: "I know." He sighs. "Made sure I understood that, that old man has."
units.italian: "Lo so." Sospira. "Assicurarsi che lo capissi, quel vecchio lo ha fatto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	"That he is. A difficult thing to go through, it is. Used to such rough talk, I've grown."|1319|0
units.english: "That he is. A difficult thing to go through, it is. Used to such rough talk, I've grown."
units.italian: "Lo è. Una cosa difficile da affrontare, è. Abituarmi a questi toni rudi, ci ho fatto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Evacuation 6|	He comes closer to you, slouching down and speaking quietly. "Come ask for your help directly again, for a long time I may not, but still in need of help saving our members, we always are. Very grateful, we would be, if help us again when we need it, you would." He pulls back, and extends his arm to shake your hand. He looks at the sky just before he leaves. "Steer clear from the sun you should, <last>." He thanks you again, and leaves to accompany the rescued members into the central building.|1321|0
units.english: He comes closer to you, slouching down and speaking quietly. "Come ask for your help directly again, for a long time I may not, but still in need of help saving our members, we always are. Very grateful, we would be, if help us again when we need it, you would." He pulls back, and extends his arm to shake your hand. He looks at the sky just before he leaves. "Steer clear from the sun you should, <last>." He thanks you again, and leaves to accompany the rescued members into the central building.
units.italian: Si avvicina a te, abbassandosi e parlando piano. "Venire a chiederti aiuto direttamente di nuovo, per molto tempo forse non potrò, ma ancora bisogno di aiuto per salvare i nostri membri, noi ne avremo sempre. Molto grati, noi saremmo, se aiutarci di nuovo quando ne avremo bisogno, tu lo farai." Si ritrae e allunga il braccio per stringerti la mano. Guarda il cielo subito prima di andarsene. "Tenerti lontano dal sole, tu dovresti, <last>." Ti ringrazia di nuovo e se ne va ad accompagnare i membri salvati dentro l'edificio centrale.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|name|1328|0
units.english: Promoting Culture
units.italian: Promuovere la cultura

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|description|1329|0
units.english: Bring Tummug to <destination>, where he'll meet with others to spread a set of promotional posters around the planet.
units.italian: Porta Tummug a <destination>, dove incontrerà altri per diffondere una serie di manifesti promozionali in tutto il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|The spaceport of <origin> looks different than the usual Saryd ports: several large posters with some form of badge or logo are scattered about, some fallen to the ground, others still sticking to the walls. As you pick one up to get a better look, an Arach approaches you. "Captain <last> you are, yes?" You nod. "Tummug, I am called. Caught your eye, I see that our posters have. Part of a group promoting new cultural festivals and movies, I am. A tiresome task at times, repetitive even, but always worth it, in the end, helping spread word of new art pieces is."|1345|0
units.english: The spaceport of <origin> looks different than the usual Saryd ports: several large posters with some form of badge or logo are scattered about, some fallen to the ground, others still sticking to the walls. As you pick one up to get a better look, an Arach approaches you. "Captain <last> you are, yes?" You nod. "Tummug, I am called. Caught your eye, I see that our posters have. Part of a group promoting new cultural festivals and movies, I am. A tiresome task at times, repetitive even, but always worth it, in the end, helping spread word of new art pieces is."
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> sembra diverso dai soliti porti Saryd: diversi grandi manifesti con una specie di emblema o logo sono sparsi in giro, alcuni caduti a terra, altri ancora attaccati alle pareti. Mentre ne raccogli uno per guardarlo meglio, un Arach ti si avvicina. "Capitano <last>, tu sei, giusto?" Fai cenno di sì. "Tummug, mi chiamo. Colpito il tuo interesse, vedo che i nostri manifesti lo hanno. Parte di un gruppo che promuove nuovi festival culturali e film, io sono. Un compito a volte noioso, persino ripetitivo, ma sempre valsa la pena, alla fine, aiutare a diffondere la notizia di nuove opere d'arte lo è."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"What are these ones for?"|1347|0
units.english: "What are these ones for?"
units.italian: "Per che cosa sono questi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"And you want my help, I take it?"|1348|0
units.english: "And you want my help, I take it?"
units.italian: "E vuoi il mio aiuto, immagino?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	You show him the poster you picked up, which has an image of two crescent moon figures 'swallowing' a dark, nine-pointed star. He looks at it for a while, then answers, "Ah, for the 'Twin Eclipse' theatrical show, it is. A recent success from a group of students from Starlit University. Forgive me, so many plays and films I help divulge, that forgetful of their exact imagery, I can get."|1350|0
units.english: You show him the poster you picked up, which has an image of two crescent moon figures 'swallowing' a dark, nine-pointed star. He looks at it for a while, then answers, "Ah, for the 'Twin Eclipse' theatrical show, it is. A recent success from a group of students from Starlit University. Forgive me, so many plays and films I help divulge, that forgetful of their exact imagery, I can get."
units.italian: Gli mostri il manifesto che hai raccolto, su cui c'è l'immagine di due figure a forma di mezzaluna che 'inghiottono' una stella scura a nove punte. Lo guarda per un po', poi risponde: "Ah, per lo spettacolo teatrale 'Eclissi Gemella', è. Un successo recente di un gruppo di studenti dell'Università di Starlit. Perdonarmi, così tante opere e film aiuto a divulgare, che dimentico la loro immagine esatta, io posso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	He asks for the poster and as you hand it to him, he pulls out some manner of spray. Using it on the blank end of the poster and on the nearest wall, he puts it back there. "Done with my work here, I am. Transport to <planet> I need, as waiting for me to help spread some more posters, coworkers of mine are. Take me there, would you? Pay you <payment>, I will."|1352|0
units.english: He asks for the poster and as you hand it to him, he pulls out some manner of spray. Using it on the blank end of the poster and on the nearest wall, he puts it back there. "Done with my work here, I am. Transport to <planet> I need, as waiting for me to help spread some more posters, coworkers of mine are. Take me there, would you? Pay you <payment>, I will."
units.italian: Chiede il manifesto e, mentre glielo porgi, tira fuori una specie di spray. Usandolo sull'estremità vuota del manifesto e sulla parete più vicina, lo rimette lì. "Finito con il mio lavoro qui, io ho. Trasporto verso <planet> mi serve, dato che aspettano me per aiutare a diffondere altri manifesti, i miei colleghi. Portarmi là, tu lo faresti? Pagarti <payment>, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"Sure, let me take you to my ship."|1354|0
units.english: "Sure, let me take you to my ship."
units.italian: "Certo, lascia che ti porti alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"I'm not headed there right now, sorry."|1355|0
units.english: "I'm not headed there right now, sorry."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione adesso, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	You give him the berth for your ship, and he tells you he'll meet you there soon before running off. A few minutes after you've reached the <ship>, you see him approaching, pushing a small crate "filled to the brim with the posters," he explains as you help him load it into your cargo. When you're done, you show him to his bunk, and prepare for the trip.|1357|0
units.english: You give him the berth for your ship, and he tells you he'll meet you there soon before running off. A few minutes after you've reached the <ship>, you see him approaching, pushing a small crate "filled to the brim with the posters," he explains as you help him load it into your cargo. When you're done, you show him to his bunk, and prepare for the trip.
units.italian: Gli dai il numero del posto di attracco della tua nave, e lui ti dice che ti raggiungerà lì presto prima di correre via. Qualche minuto dopo essere arrivato alla <ship>, lo vedi avvicinarsi, spingendo una piccola cassa "piena zeppa di manifesti," spiega mentre lo aiuti a caricarla nel vano di carico. Quando avete finito, gli mostri la cuccetta e ti prepari al viaggio.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|The spaceport of <origin> looks different than the usual Saryd ports: several large posters with some form of badge or logo are scattered about, some fallen to the ground, others still sticking to the walls. Picking one up to get a better look, you recognize the symbol to be that of the Lunarium Redoubt, two moons swallowing a dimming sun. "Up to any unlawful behavior, Captain <last>?" You turn to see an Arach standing there, looking at you. You recognize him as Tummug, one of the Lunarium leaders you met on Remote Blue. "Talk in your ship, could we?" You bring him to the <ship>, and seal the hatch. "Spreading propaganda material against the Heliarchy, I am. The purpose of those posters you found, that is," he explains. "Not the best recruitment strategy, but what I can do without risking too many of our members, it is. Available, are you? In need of transport to <planet>, to continue the work, I am."|1360|0
units.english: The spaceport of <origin> looks different than the usual Saryd ports: several large posters with some form of badge or logo are scattered about, some fallen to the ground, others still sticking to the walls. Picking one up to get a better look, you recognize the symbol to be that of the Lunarium Redoubt, two moons swallowing a dimming sun. "Up to any unlawful behavior, Captain <last>?" You turn to see an Arach standing there, looking at you. You recognize him as Tummug, one of the Lunarium leaders you met on Remote Blue. "Talk in your ship, could we?" You bring him to the <ship>, and seal the hatch. "Spreading propaganda material against the Heliarchy, I am. The purpose of those posters you found, that is," he explains. "Not the best recruitment strategy, but what I can do without risking too many of our members, it is. Available, are you? In need of transport to <planet>, to continue the work, I am."
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> sembra diverso dai soliti porti Saryd: diversi grandi manifesti con una specie di emblema o logo sono sparsi in giro, alcuni caduti a terra, altri ancora attaccati alle pareti. Raccogliendone uno per guardarlo meglio, riconosci il simbolo del Lunarium Redoubt: due lune che inghiottono un sole che si spegne. "Intento a qualche comportamento illegale, Capitano <last>?" Ti volti e vedi un Arach lì in piedi, che ti guarda. Lo riconosci come Tummug, uno dei leader del Lunarium che hai incontrato su Remote Blue. "Parlare nella tua nave, potremmo?" Lo porti alla <ship> e sigilli il portello. "Diffondere materiale di propaganda contro l'Eliarchia, io sto facendo. Lo scopo di quei manifesti che hai trovato, quello è," spiega. "Non la migliore strategia di reclutamento, ma ciò che posso fare senza rischiare troppi dei nostri membri, questo è. Disponibile, tu sei? Bisogno di trasporto verso <planet>, per continuare il lavoro, io ho."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"Of course, we'll leave right away."|1362|0
units.english: "Of course, we'll leave right away."
units.italian: "Certo, partiamo subito."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"Sorry, I'm not going that way right now."|1363|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not going that way right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non vado in quella direzione adesso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"First, get the merchandise, I must," he says as he leaves your ship. He comes back a few minutes later, pushing a small crate "filled to the brim with the posters," he explains as you help him load it into your cargo. When you're done, you show him to his bunk, and prepare for the mission.|1365|0
units.english: "First, get the merchandise, I must," he says as he leaves your ship. He comes back a few minutes later, pushing a small crate "filled to the brim with the posters," he explains as you help him load it into your cargo. When you're done, you show him to his bunk, and prepare for the mission.
units.italian: "Prima, prendere la merce, io devo," dice lasciando la tua nave. Torna qualche minuto dopo, spingendo una piccola cassa "piena zeppa di manifesti," spiega mentre lo aiuti a caricarla nel vano di carico. Quando avete finito, gli mostri la cuccetta e ti prepari alla missione.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|dialog|1370|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Tummug and the posters hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con Tummug e i manifesti non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|As you're still handling landing procedures, Tummug is organizing the posters in several smaller piles. "Make sure everyone has the same amount of posters, I must. Let any of them slack off, I will not," he banters. Your ship touches down on the hangar, and Tummug hands you <payment>. He makes a call, and minute after minute some Saryds start coming to your ship. You open the hatch, and he starts handing out a pile of posters to each one who comes in. The posters aren't all identical, though the imagery is pretty much the same in all of them: a dark, nine-pointed star, crumbling to pieces.|1375|0
units.english: As you're still handling landing procedures, Tummug is organizing the posters in several smaller piles. "Make sure everyone has the same amount of posters, I must. Let any of them slack off, I will not," he banters. Your ship touches down on the hangar, and Tummug hands you <payment>. He makes a call, and minute after minute some Saryds start coming to your ship. You open the hatch, and he starts handing out a pile of posters to each one who comes in. The posters aren't all identical, though the imagery is pretty much the same in all of them: a dark, nine-pointed star, crumbling to pieces.
units.italian: Mentre stai ancora completando le procedure di atterraggio, Tummug sta organizzando i manifesti in diversi mucchietti. "Assicurarmi che tutti abbiano la stessa quantità di manifesti, io devo. Lasciare che qualcuno di loro batta la fiacca, io non lo farò," scherza. La tua nave si posa sull'hangar, e Tummug ti consegna <payment>. Fa una chiamata, e minuto dopo minuto alcuni Saryd cominciano ad arrivare alla tua nave. Apri il portello, e lui comincia a distribuire una pila di manifesti a ognuno che entra. I manifesti non sono tutti identici, anche se l'immagine è più o meno la stessa in tutti: una stella scura a nove punte che si sbriciola.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"So what are these posters for?"|1379|0
units.english: "So what are these posters for?"
units.italian: "E allora per che cosa sono questi manifesti?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"Do you really need that many posters?"|1380|0
units.english: "Do you really need that many posters?"
units.italian: "Ti servono davvero tutti questi manifesti?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	He pauses at your question. "What they are for? Oh, the... 'Crumbling Winter Star' I believe it is called? The play these posters are for?" he asks to one of the Saryds, extending his legs to give them their pile of posters. The Saryd looks at him, then you, and nods. "A big hit on Saros, I hear it was."|1382|0
units.english: He pauses at your question. "What they are for? Oh, the... 'Crumbling Winter Star' I believe it is called? The play these posters are for?" he asks to one of the Saryds, extending his legs to give them their pile of posters. The Saryd looks at him, then you, and nods. "A big hit on Saros, I hear it was."
units.italian: Si ferma alla tua domanda. "Per che cosa sono? Oh, la... 'Stella d'Inverno che Crolla' credo si chiami? L'opera per cui sono questi manifesti?" chiede a uno dei Saryd, allungando le zampe per dargli la sua pila. Il Saryd guarda lui, poi te, e annuisce. "Un grande successo su Saros, a quanto sento dire."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"How exactly are these images going to help?"|1386|0
units.english: "How exactly are these images going to help?"
units.italian: "In che modo esattamente queste immagini dovrebbero aiutare?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"Do you really need that many posters?"|1387|0
units.english: "Do you really need that many posters?"
units.italian: "Ti servono davvero tutti questi manifesti?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"A symbol of Heliarch power, their shining golden sun is. A taboo, dimming or breaking that sun has become. Punishable, even. So, with dimming and breaking that sun, hoping we are that get the Saryds interested in finding out why one would do that, the posters do," he explains.|1389|0
units.english: "A symbol of Heliarch power, their shining golden sun is. A taboo, dimming or breaking that sun has become. Punishable, even. So, with dimming and breaking that sun, hoping we are that get the Saryds interested in finding out why one would do that, the posters do," he explains.
units.italian: "Un simbolo del potere degli Heliarchs, il loro sole dorato splendente è. Un tabù, offuscare o spezzare quel sole è diventato. Persino punibile. Quindi, offuscando e spezzando quel sole, speriamo di suscitare nei Saryd la curiosità di scoprire perché qualcuno lo farebbe, i manifesti lo fanno," spiega.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	"One of the more populous Saryd planets, this is," he responds. "Sure, on the smaller side, the city may be, by Arach or Kimek standards, but still large enough to warrant many posters, it is."|1392|0
units.english: "One of the more populous Saryd planets, this is," he responds. "Sure, on the smaller side, the city may be, by Arach or Kimek standards, but still large enough to warrant many posters, it is."
units.italian: "Uno dei pianeti Saryd più popolosi, questo è," risponde. "Certo, sul lato piccolo, la città può essere, per gli standard Arach o Kimek, ma comunque abbastanza grande da giustificare molti manifesti, è."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 1|	He hands out one of the final two piles to the last Saryd, and grabs the last one for himself. "Now, help them with the posters, I will. If interested in helping us further, meet you in the spaceport, I will. Have some dozen extra bunks available, you must make sure," he says as he leaves your ship.|1394|0
units.english: He hands out one of the final two piles to the last Saryd, and grabs the last one for himself. "Now, help them with the posters, I will. If interested in helping us further, meet you in the spaceport, I will. Have some dozen extra bunks available, you must make sure," he says as he leaves your ship.
units.italian: Consegna una delle ultime due pile all'ultimo Saryd e prende l'ultima per sé. "Ora, aiutarli con i manifesti, io lo farò. Se interessato ad aiutarci ancora, incontrarti allo spazioporto, io lo farò. Avere una dozzina di cuccette extra disponibili, tu devi assicurarti," dice lasciando la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|name|1399|0
units.english: Promoting Culture
units.italian: Promuovere la cultura

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|description|1400|0
units.english: Bring Tummug and his colleagues to <destination>, where they'll spread around some sets of banners around the planet.
units.italian: Porta Tummug e i suoi colleghi a <destination>, dove diffonderanno alcune serie di stendardi in tutto il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|blocked|1403|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|As before, you find the local spaceport decorated with Tummug's various posters, with some all over the walls and a few on the floor already. Either they were taken down or simply failed to stick to the wall properly. Most of the locals just glance at them, then continue on with their business; only a few pockets of people have formed near some of the posters, perhaps discussing the imagery. Some of the spaceport cleaning workers, on the other hand, take them down nonchalantly, though they don't seem to care too much about getting all the posters.|1412|0
units.english: As before, you find the local spaceport decorated with Tummug's various posters, with some all over the walls and a few on the floor already. Either they were taken down or simply failed to stick to the wall properly. Most of the locals just glance at them, then continue on with their business; only a few pockets of people have formed near some of the posters, perhaps discussing the imagery. Some of the spaceport cleaning workers, on the other hand, take them down nonchalantly, though they don't seem to care too much about getting all the posters.
units.italian: Come prima, trovi lo spazioporto locale decorato con i vari manifesti di Tummug, alcuni su tutte le pareti e altri già a terra. O sono stati staccati o semplicemente non sono rimasti attaccati bene. La maggior parte dei locali ci dà solo un'occhiata, poi prosegue per i fatti suoi; solo qualche capannello si è formato vicino ad alcuni manifesti, forse per discutere dell'immagine. Alcuni degli addetti alle pulizie dello spazioporto, invece, li staccano con noncuranza, anche se non sembrano preoccuparsi troppo di prenderli tutti.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	You find Tummug waiting for you in a cafe with some Saryds. "Ready to help us again are you, Captain?" he asks as you sit down.|1415|0
units.english: You find Tummug waiting for you in a cafe with some Saryds. "Ready to help us again are you, Captain?" he asks as you sit down.
units.italian: Trovi Tummug che ti aspetta in un caffè con alcuni Saryd. "Pronto ad aiutarci di nuovo, tu sei, Capitano?" chiede mentre ti siedi.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Where are we going now?"|1417|0
units.english: "Where are we going now?"
units.italian: "Dove andiamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Is everyone here? I made sure to have some bunks free as you said."|1419|0
units.english: "Is everyone here? I made sure to have some bunks free as you said."
units.italian: "Ci sono tutti? Mi sono assicurato di avere delle cuccette libere, come avevi detto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Ah, thank you Captain. Yes, all <bunks> of us, this time you will be transporting," he answers. "Bring along some more help, I wished to, but canceled some of the others have. Some more work here, they must do."|1420|0
units.english: "Ah, thank you Captain. Yes, all <bunks> of us, this time you will be transporting," he answers. "Bring along some more help, I wished to, but canceled some of the others have. Some more work here, they must do."
units.italian: "Ah, grazie Capitano. Sì, tutti in <bunks>, questa volta trasporterai," risponde. "Portare altri aiuti, io volevo, ma hanno dato forfait alcuni degli altri. Altro lavoro qui, devono fare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	He runs one leg over his mandibles in an almost contemplative gesture. "To my home, we will go. <destination>. Setting up one of the famous Arachi soirees, some of the locals are, and tasked with helping them gather attention, we were. Paid <payment> once on <planet> we are, you will be."|1422|0
units.english: He runs one leg over his mandibles in an almost contemplative gesture. "To my home, we will go. <destination>. Setting up one of the famous Arachi soirees, some of the locals are, and tasked with helping them gather attention, we were. Paid <payment> once on <planet> we are, you will be."
units.italian: Passa una zampa sulle mandibole in un gesto quasi pensieroso. "A casa mia, andremo. <destination>. Organizzare una delle famose serate Arachi, alcuni dei locali lo stanno facendo, e incaricati di aiutarli a richiamare l'attenzione, noi siamo stati. Pagato <payment> una volta su <planet> che saremo, tu sarai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	You all leave the cafe, and Tummug and the ten others follow you to your ship. They bring in <cargo>, and settle in their bunks.|1423|0
units.english: You all leave the cafe, and Tummug and the ten others follow you to your ship. They bring in <cargo>, and settle in their bunks.
units.italian: Uscite tutti dal caffè, e Tummug e gli altri dieci ti seguono alla tua nave. Portano a bordo <cargo> e si sistemano nelle cuccette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	You find Tummug waiting for you in a cafe with some Saryds. He gets up once he sees you, and the Saryds follow him outside the establishment. "Talk in your ship, we should," he says once he's close. You all head to the hangars and get inside your ship, with some of the Saryds heading elsewhere to pick up the cargo you'll be carrying. "Run into some trouble, a few of ours have. Leaving for <planet>, we are. Born and raised there, I was, so more familiar with the city's layout, I am. Less likely for some of us to be caught, it should be. Provide them a place to lay low for some time, we will."|1426|0
units.english: You find Tummug waiting for you in a cafe with some Saryds. He gets up once he sees you, and the Saryds follow him outside the establishment. "Talk in your ship, we should," he says once he's close. You all head to the hangars and get inside your ship, with some of the Saryds heading elsewhere to pick up the cargo you'll be carrying. "Run into some trouble, a few of ours have. Leaving for <planet>, we are. Born and raised there, I was, so more familiar with the city's layout, I am. Less likely for some of us to be caught, it should be. Provide them a place to lay low for some time, we will."
units.italian: Trovi Tummug che ti aspetta in un caffè con alcuni Saryd. Si alza appena ti vede, e i Saryd lo seguono fuori dal locale. "Parlare nella tua nave, noi dovremmo," dice quando ti è vicino. Andate tutti agli hangar ed entrate nella tua nave, mentre alcuni dei Saryd vanno altrove a prendere il carico che trasporterai. "Incappati in qualche problema, alcuni dei nostri. In partenza per <planet>, noi siamo. Nato e cresciuto là, io sono, quindi più familiare con la disposizione della città, io sono. Meno probabile che alcuni di noi vengano presi, dovrebbe essere. Offrire loro un posto dove stare nascosti per un po', noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Shouldn't we help the ones who got caught?"|1428|0
units.english: "Shouldn't we help the ones who got caught?"
units.italian: "Non dovremmo aiutare quelli che sono stati presi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Alright, we'll leave once the others come back."|1429|0
units.english: "Alright, we'll leave once the others come back."
units.italian: "Va bene, partiamo appena tornano gli altri."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Caught? Caught they were not," he says. "Run into some trouble, they have, but caught, they have not yet been. Not that I've heard, at least." He pauses as he looks out to the hangars. "Made it to the meeting point, they have not, but news of any arrests or executions, I have not seen. Most likely, hiding out to avoid the patrols that could have seen them, they are."|1431|0
units.english: "Caught? Caught they were not," he says. "Run into some trouble, they have, but caught, they have not yet been. Not that I've heard, at least." He pauses as he looks out to the hangars. "Made it to the meeting point, they have not, but news of any arrests or executions, I have not seen. Most likely, hiding out to avoid the patrols that could have seen them, they are."
units.italian: "Presi? Presi non sono stati," dice. "Incappati in qualche problema, loro lo hanno, ma presi, non lo sono stati ancora. Almeno, non da quanto ho sentito." Fa una pausa guardando verso gli hangar. "Arrivati al punto d'incontro, non lo hanno fatto, ma notizie di arresti o esecuzioni, io non ne ho viste. Molto probabilmente, nascosti per evitare le pattuglie che potrebbero averli visti, loro sono."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	The Saryds return a few minutes later with <cargo>. Once it's safely in your cargo hold, you show Tummug and the others to their bunks.|1433|0
units.english: The Saryds return a few minutes later with <cargo>. Once it's safely in your cargo hold, you show Tummug and the others to their bunks.
units.italian: I Saryd tornano qualche minuto dopo con <cargo>. Una volta che è al sicuro nella stiva, mostri a Tummug e agli altri le loro cuccette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|dialog|1438|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Tummug, his colleagues, and the banners hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con Tummug, i suoi colleghi e gli stendardi non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|As before, Tummug separates the banners into small piles as you're finishing your landing procedures. He hands you <payment> right before the first few Saryds leave with their piles, and a few local Arachi join them in picking up banners to distribute around their local neighborhoods. "Meet you in the spaceport again, we will," Tummug says as he finishes distributing the banners. Looking at his own pile, you see an image split with a sharp line running from top to bottom, with the drawing of an Arach collapsing under a scorching sun on the left side contrasted with one having a happy dinner under the moonlight on the right side. Some message in the Arach language is written out at the bottom, below the two images.|1443|0
units.english: As before, Tummug separates the banners into small piles as you're finishing your landing procedures. He hands you <payment> right before the first few Saryds leave with their piles, and a few local Arachi join them in picking up banners to distribute around their local neighborhoods. "Meet you in the spaceport again, we will," Tummug says as he finishes distributing the banners. Looking at his own pile, you see an image split with a sharp line running from top to bottom, with the drawing of an Arach collapsing under a scorching sun on the left side contrasted with one having a happy dinner under the moonlight on the right side. Some message in the Arach language is written out at the bottom, below the two images.
units.italian: Come prima, Tummug separa gli stendardi in piccole pile mentre stai completando le procedure di atterraggio. Ti consegna <payment> subito prima che i primi Saryd partano con le loro pile, e alcuni Arachi del posto si uniscono a loro nel prendere gli stendardi da distribuire nei loro quartieri. "Incontrarti di nuovo allo spazioporto, noi lo faremo," dice Tummug finendo di distribuire gli stendardi. Guardando la sua pila, vedi un'immagine divisa da una linea netta che corre dall'alto verso il basso, con a sinistra il disegno di un Arach che crolla sotto un sole cocente, in contrasto con uno che cena felice al chiaro di luna sulla destra. In fondo, sotto le due immagini, è scritto un messaggio in lingua Arach.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"What does that say?"|1447|0
units.english: "What does that say?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è scritto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Alright, I'll meet you at the spaceport in a few hours."|1448|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll meet you at the spaceport in a few hours."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci vediamo allo spazioporto tra qualche ora."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"This? 'The Twins' Twin Ships' it is, a... mostly comedic play," he explains. "Nearly identical in looks, the two Arach main characters are, but a rich member of a great House, one of them is, while simply cheap transport to a world with a better job, the other wants. On the same planet, unaware of one another, book passage with the two different Kimek captains, they do. Only, also alike, the two Kimek are, and fly the same model of ship, the Kimek Thistle, they do. Brought to a scorching, stale Saryd factory world, the rich Arach is, while a fancy welcome by the powerful House, the worker gets." He catches himself before going further into the plot. "Well, uh, like I said, mostly a comedy, it is. Not too interesting, I suppose it might be."|1450|0
units.english: "This? 'The Twins' Twin Ships' it is, a... mostly comedic play," he explains. "Nearly identical in looks, the two Arach main characters are, but a rich member of a great House, one of them is, while simply cheap transport to a world with a better job, the other wants. On the same planet, unaware of one another, book passage with the two different Kimek captains, they do. Only, also alike, the two Kimek are, and fly the same model of ship, the Kimek Thistle, they do. Brought to a scorching, stale Saryd factory world, the rich Arach is, while a fancy welcome by the powerful House, the worker gets." He catches himself before going further into the plot. "Well, uh, like I said, mostly a comedy, it is. Not too interesting, I suppose it might be."
units.italian: "Questo? 'Le navi gemelle dei gemelli' è, un'opera... per lo più comica," spiega. "Quasi identici nell'aspetto, i due protagonisti Arach sono, ma membro ricco di una grande Casata, uno di loro è, mentre semplice trasporto economico verso un mondo con un lavoro migliore, l'altro vuole. Sullo stesso pianeta, inconsapevoli l'uno dell'altro, prenotano il passaggio con due capitani Kimek diversi, loro lo fanno. Solo che, uguali anche loro, i due Kimek sono, e pilotano lo stesso modello di nave, il Thistle Kimek, essi lo fanno. Portato su un soffocante e stagnante mondo-fabbrica Saryd, l'Arach ricco viene, mentre una splendida accoglienza dalla potente Casata, il lavoratore riceve." Si ferma prima di addentrarsi oltre nella trama. "Beh, ecco, come dicevo, per lo più una commedia, è. Non troppo interessante, suppongo che possa essere."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"What does that say?"|1454|0
units.english: "What does that say?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è scritto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Alright, I'll meet you at the spaceport in a few hours."|1455|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll meet you at the spaceport in a few hours."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci vediamo allo spazioporto tra qualche ora."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	"Read 'Down with the Tyrant House!' it does." He says. Once he notices you have no idea what that means, he continues, "An Arach nickname for the Heliarchy, it is. First used thousands of years ago it was, when more restrictive, and much less lenient, the Heliarchs were becoming. Prohibited, the expression was, but still known, its meaning is."|1457|0
units.english: "Read 'Down with the Tyrant House!' it does." He says. Once he notices you have no idea what that means, he continues, "An Arach nickname for the Heliarchy, it is. First used thousands of years ago it was, when more restrictive, and much less lenient, the Heliarchs were becoming. Prohibited, the expression was, but still known, its meaning is."
units.italian: "C'è scritto 'Abbasso la Casata Tiranna!'." Dice. Quando si accorge che non hai idea di che cosa significhi, continua: "Un soprannome Arach per l'Eliarchia, è. Usata per la prima volta migliaia di anni fa, quando più restrittivi, e molto meno indulgenti, gli Heliarchs stavano diventando. Proibita, l'espressione era, ma ancora nota, il suo significato è."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 2|	He prepares to leave, and tells you to free up some ten tons of cargo space and keep five bunks available before meeting with him in the spaceport. He then heads down the hatch and disappears into the city.|1459|0
units.english: He prepares to leave, and tells you to free up some ten tons of cargo space and keep five bunks available before meeting with him in the spaceport. He then heads down the hatch and disappears into the city.
units.italian: Si prepara a partire e ti dice di liberare una decina di tonnellate di spazio di carico e tenere cinque cuccette disponibili prima di incontrarlo allo spazioporto. Poi scende dal portello e scompare nella città.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|name|1464|0
units.english: Promoting Culture
units.italian: Promuovere la cultura

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|description|1465|0
units.english: Bring Tummug and his Arachi colleagues to <destination>, with their <cargo>.
units.italian: Porta Tummug e i suoi colleghi Arachi a <destination>, con il loro <cargo>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|blocked|1468|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|The spaceport on <origin> shows fewer of the banners than you expected, with only a few scattered about the walls. One Arach leaves their work building and gasps at the first banner they see, taking it down and throwing it in a bin. They seem stunned for a second, and look around in a hurry, right before scurrying off. Another Arach has a similar reaction to a different banner, but after pondering for a bit, leaves it alone and walks away.|1477|0
units.english: The spaceport on <origin> shows fewer of the banners than you expected, with only a few scattered about the walls. One Arach leaves their work building and gasps at the first banner they see, taking it down and throwing it in a bin. They seem stunned for a second, and look around in a hurry, right before scurrying off. Another Arach has a similar reaction to a different banner, but after pondering for a bit, leaves it alone and walks away.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> mostra meno stendardi di quanto ti aspettassi, solo alcuni sparsi sulle pareti. Un Arach esce dal suo edificio di lavoro e sussulta al primo stendardo che vede, lo stacca e lo getta in un bidone. Resta stordito per un secondo, si guarda intorno in fretta e poi scappa via. Un altro Arach ha una reazione simile davanti a uno stendardo diverso, ma dopo averci riflettuto un po' lo lascia stare e se ne va.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	When you're done gauging the local reception to Tummug's banners, you go look for him. Eventually you arrive at a workshop, where he's talking with four other Arachi as they work on some small robots not too different from those employed in Arach hull repair systems. The only difference appears to be "wings" that the Arachi are testing by controlling them remotely. "Captain <last>!" Tummug exclaims when he notices you. "Apologize, I must, for not waiting for you in the spaceport. Caught up in testing the prototypes, we were."|1478|0
units.english: When you're done gauging the local reception to Tummug's banners, you go look for him. Eventually you arrive at a workshop, where he's talking with four other Arachi as they work on some small robots not too different from those employed in Arach hull repair systems. The only difference appears to be "wings" that the Arachi are testing by controlling them remotely. "Captain <last>!" Tummug exclaims when he notices you. "Apologize, I must, for not waiting for you in the spaceport. Caught up in testing the prototypes, we were."
units.italian: Quando hai finito di valutare l'accoglienza locale degli stendardi di Tummug, vai a cercarlo. Alla fine arrivi a un'officina, dove sta parlando con altri quattro Arachi mentre lavorano su dei piccoli robot non molto diversi da quelli impiegati nei sistemi Arach di riparazione degli scafi. L'unica differenza sembrano essere le "ali" che gli Arachi stanno provando controllandoli a distanza. "Capitano <last>!" esclama Tummug quando ti nota. "Scusarmi, io devo, per non averti aspettato allo spazioporto. Presi dai test dei prototipi, noi eravamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"What were you testing?"|1482|0
units.english: "What were you testing?"
units.italian: "Che cosa stavate provando?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"What are those robots for?"|1483|0
units.english: "What are those robots for?"
units.italian: "A che cosa servono quei robot?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"Remote-controlled drones, they are." He asks one of the Arachi for their controller and begins flying the robot around you. "Testing the precision and response time of commands given to them, we were. Essential for our next venture, they are." He moves the robot away from you and pushes a button on the controller, prompting several small compartments around the machine to open up and a reddish smoke to seep out. "Going to <destination> next, we are. A very populous world, it is, so impossible to cover the whole city in posters, it would be. Use these robots for skywriting our messages, we will." He hands the controller back to the Arach and walks up to you, showing a flyer small enough to fit in your palm, with some short messages in the Kimek language. "Useful for dropping these over the main city, they also will be."|1484|0
units.english: "Remote-controlled drones, they are." He asks one of the Arachi for their controller and begins flying the robot around you. "Testing the precision and response time of commands given to them, we were. Essential for our next venture, they are." He moves the robot away from you and pushes a button on the controller, prompting several small compartments around the machine to open up and a reddish smoke to seep out. "Going to <destination> next, we are. A very populous world, it is, so impossible to cover the whole city in posters, it would be. Use these robots for skywriting our messages, we will." He hands the controller back to the Arach and walks up to you, showing a flyer small enough to fit in your palm, with some short messages in the Kimek language. "Useful for dropping these over the main city, they also will be."
units.italian: "Droni a controllo remoto, sono." Chiede a uno degli Arachi il suo telecomando e comincia a far volare il robot intorno a te. "Provare la precisione e il tempo di risposta dei comandi che ricevono, noi stavamo. Essenziali per la nostra prossima impresa, sono." Allontana il robot da te e preme un pulsante sul telecomando: diversi piccoli sportelli intorno alla macchina si aprono e ne esce un fumo rossastro. "Andare a <destination> adesso, noi dobbiamo. Un mondo molto popoloso, è, quindi impossibile coprire tutta la città di manifesti, sarebbe. Usare questi robot per scrivere i nostri messaggi nel cielo, noi lo faremo." Restituisce il telecomando all'Arach e si avvicina a te, mostrandoti un volantino abbastanza piccolo da stare nel palmo della mano, con alcuni messaggi brevi in lingua Kimek. "Utili per farli cadere sulla città principale, saranno anche."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"Well, I hope the robots work okay. I'll help you bring them to my ship."|1486|0
units.english: "Well, I hope the robots work okay. I'll help you bring them to my ship."
units.italian: "Beh, spero che i robot funzionino bene. Ti aiuto a portarli alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"What's written there?"|1488|0
units.english: "What's written there?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è scritto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	He pulls back the flyer, looking closely at it. "It should be... 'Hottest Summer' and 'an attraction for all people.' A Kimek movie, it is. Not too used to reading Kimek, I am, but designed by some of our Kimek coworkers, these were, so no issues here, there should be." He looks back at the robots. "Only keep the skywriting correct as well, we need."|1489|0
units.english: He pulls back the flyer, looking closely at it. "It should be... 'Hottest Summer' and 'an attraction for all people.' A Kimek movie, it is. Not too used to reading Kimek, I am, but designed by some of our Kimek coworkers, these were, so no issues here, there should be." He looks back at the robots. "Only keep the skywriting correct as well, we need."
units.italian: Ritira il volantino e lo guarda da vicino. "Dovrebbe essere... 'Estate più calda' e 'un'attrazione per tutti'. Un film Kimek, è. Non troppo abituato a leggere il kimek, io sono, ma progettati da alcuni dei nostri colleghi Kimek, questi sono stati, quindi nessun problema qui, dovrebbe esserci." Guarda di nuovo i robot. "Solo mantenere corretta anche la scritta nel cielo, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	He signals to one of the Arachi, and they walk past you to close the doors and windows to the workshop. "Headed for <destination> next, we are. Too populous a world it is, for us to cover all ground with posters or banners. Use the robots, we will." He asks one of the Arachi for their controller and brings the robot closer to you. He presses a button, and it prompts several compartments around the drone to open up, releasing a reddish smoke. "Leave our messages in skywriting, we will," he says as he hands the controller back to the Arachi. He approaches you, showing you a flyer small enough to fit in your palm, with some short messages in the Kimek language. "Use them to drop these around the main spaceport city, we also will."|1492|0
units.english: He signals to one of the Arachi, and they walk past you to close the doors and windows to the workshop. "Headed for <destination> next, we are. Too populous a world it is, for us to cover all ground with posters or banners. Use the robots, we will." He asks one of the Arachi for their controller and brings the robot closer to you. He presses a button, and it prompts several compartments around the drone to open up, releasing a reddish smoke. "Leave our messages in skywriting, we will," he says as he hands the controller back to the Arachi. He approaches you, showing you a flyer small enough to fit in your palm, with some short messages in the Kimek language. "Use them to drop these around the main spaceport city, we also will."
units.italian: Fa cenno a uno degli Arachi, che passa accanto a te per chiudere porte e finestre dell'officina. "Diretti a <destination> adesso, noi siamo. Un mondo troppo popoloso è, perché possiamo coprire tutto il terreno con manifesti o stendardi. Usare i robot, noi lo faremo." Chiede a uno degli Arachi il suo telecomando e avvicina il robot a te. Preme un pulsante, e diversi sportelli intorno al drone si aprono, rilasciando un fumo rossastro. "Lasciare i nostri messaggi scritti nel cielo, noi lo faremo," dice restituendo il telecomando all'Arach. Si avvicina a te e ti mostra un volantino abbastanza piccolo da stare nel palmo, con alcuni messaggi brevi in lingua Kimek. "Usarli per far cadere questi intorno alla principale città dello spazioporto, noi lo faremo anche."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"Isn't that too risky? Wouldn't the Heliarchs find you out with ease?"|1494|0
units.english: "Isn't that too risky? Wouldn't the Heliarchs find you out with ease?"
units.italian: "Non è troppo rischioso? Gli Heliarchs non vi scoprirebbero con facilità?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"What's written there?"|1496|0
units.english: "What's written there?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è scritto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"This one means 'Lordless Suns,' and 'Our Laws for Our People' on this other one," he says, pointing with the tip of one leg to one boldened symbol as he says the first "our." He goes to explain their meaning. "The lords of all Coalition stars, the Heliarchs call themselves. When taken, the Ring of Friendship was, when formed, the Heliarchy was, still far more advanced and experienced in most fields the Saryds were. Turned 'their' ring into the seat of government, they had, and in the naive euphoria victory had granted them, tricked into adopting the Saryd law system, the Kimek and Arachi of the time were. Saryd sentences, Saryd punishments." He looks at you as he drags some legs across the floor, as if scratching the ground. "For only a quarter of a Saryd lifetime, the eldest of the Arachi lived. For all their population, managed to live past a century only a few dozen Kimek have. A third of a lifetime to them, even relatively minor Saryd sentences, the Heliarch sentences, are." He slowly crumples the flyer. "Ruled by laws of long-dead Saryd lords, we still are..."|1497|0
units.english: "This one means 'Lordless Suns,' and 'Our Laws for Our People' on this other one," he says, pointing with the tip of one leg to one boldened symbol as he says the first "our." He goes to explain their meaning. "The lords of all Coalition stars, the Heliarchs call themselves. When taken, the Ring of Friendship was, when formed, the Heliarchy was, still far more advanced and experienced in most fields the Saryds were. Turned 'their' ring into the seat of government, they had, and in the naive euphoria victory had granted them, tricked into adopting the Saryd law system, the Kimek and Arachi of the time were. Saryd sentences, Saryd punishments." He looks at you as he drags some legs across the floor, as if scratching the ground. "For only a quarter of a Saryd lifetime, the eldest of the Arachi lived. For all their population, managed to live past a century only a few dozen Kimek have. A third of a lifetime to them, even relatively minor Saryd sentences, the Heliarch sentences, are." He slowly crumples the flyer. "Ruled by laws of long-dead Saryd lords, we still are..."
units.italian: "Questo significa 'Soli Senza Signore', e 'Le Nostre Leggi per la Nostra Gente' su quest'altro," dice, indicando con la punta di una zampa un simbolo in grassetto mentre dice il primo "nostro". Poi passa a spiegare il loro significato. "I signori di tutte le stelle della Coalizione, gli Heliarchs si definiscono. Quando preso, l'Anello dell'Amicizia fu, quando formatasi, l'Eliarchia era, ancora molto più avanzati ed esperti in quasi tutti i campi i Saryd erano. Trasformato 'il loro' anello nella sede del governo, essi lo avevano, e nell'ingenua euforia che la vittoria aveva concesso loro, indotti ad adottare il sistema legale Saryd, i Kimek e gli Arachi di allora furono. Condanne Saryd, punizioni Saryd." Ti guarda mentre trascina alcune zampe sul pavimento, come se raspasse il terreno. "Per solo un quarto della vita di un Saryd, vissero i più anziani degli Arachi. Su tutta la loro popolazione, riusciti a vivere oltre un secolo solo poche dozzine di Kimek lo hanno fatto. Un terzo di una vita, per loro, anche condanne Saryd relativamente minori, le condanne degli Heliarchs, sono." Accartoccia lentamente il volantino. "Governati dalle leggi di signori Saryd morti da tempo, noi siamo ancora..."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"Spoken with Elirom, I have. Moving fleets around, the Heliarchs are, since distractions for them in other systems, some of our teams have prepared," he explains. "Fewer ships on the planet there are, and quick about it, we will be, so unlikely for them to find us, it is."|1500|0
units.english: "Spoken with Elirom, I have. Moving fleets around, the Heliarchs are, since distractions for them in other systems, some of our teams have prepared," he explains. "Fewer ships on the planet there are, and quick about it, we will be, so unlikely for them to find us, it is."
units.italian: "Parlato con Elirom, io ho. Spostare flotte in giro, gli Heliarchs lo stanno facendo, dato che distrazioni per loro in altri sistemi, alcune delle nostre squadre hanno preparato," spiega. "Meno navi sul pianeta ci sono, e rapidi, noi saremo, quindi improbabile che ci trovino, è."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	Tummug tells the other Arachi to pack up the rest of the robots and flyers, and accompanies you to your ship. In a few minutes the Arachi come dragging carts with crates filled with the drones, flyers, and canisters of the red smoke for the skywriting. The Saryds you brought here follow after them, bringing along more and more carts. Tummug says you'll get <payment> once they get to <planet>, and moves to his bunk, with the other Arachi following suit.|1502|0
units.english: Tummug tells the other Arachi to pack up the rest of the robots and flyers, and accompanies you to your ship. In a few minutes the Arachi come dragging carts with crates filled with the drones, flyers, and canisters of the red smoke for the skywriting. The Saryds you brought here follow after them, bringing along more and more carts. Tummug says you'll get <payment> once they get to <planet>, and moves to his bunk, with the other Arachi following suit.
units.italian: Tummug dice agli altri Arachi di imballare il resto dei robot e dei volantini, e ti accompagna alla tua nave. In pochi minuti gli Arachi arrivano trascinando carrelli con casse piene dei droni, dei volantini e delle bombole di fumo rosso per la scritta nel cielo. I Saryd che hai portato qui li seguono, portando sempre più carrelli. Tummug dice che riceverai <payment> una volta arrivati su <planet>, e si dirige alla sua cuccetta, seguito dagli altri Arachi.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|dialog|1507|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Tummug, his colleagues and the skywriting material hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con Tummug, i suoi colleghi e il materiale per la scritta nel cielo non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|This time Tummug doesn't go on to split the flyers into various piles as you're landing. "Already arranged them in the boxes, we have," he says. He directs you to land in a lone hangar on one of the factories far from the city. Upon landing, several Kimek enter the hangar and start crating off the flyers and skywriting drones back to the factory, presumably to make sure they're all in working order. Tummug hands you <payment>, thanking you for bringing them here.|1512|0
units.english: This time Tummug doesn't go on to split the flyers into various piles as you're landing. "Already arranged them in the boxes, we have," he says. He directs you to land in a lone hangar on one of the factories far from the city. Upon landing, several Kimek enter the hangar and start crating off the flyers and skywriting drones back to the factory, presumably to make sure they're all in working order. Tummug hands you <payment>, thanking you for bringing them here.
units.italian: Questa volta Tummug non si mette a dividere i volantini in pile mentre atterri. "Già sistemati nelle scatole, li abbiamo," dice. Ti indica di atterrare in un hangar isolato di una delle fabbriche lontane dalla città. All'atterraggio diversi Kimek entrano nell'hangar e cominciano a portare via i volantini e i droni da scritta verso la fabbrica, presumibilmente per assicurarsi che siano tutti funzionanti. Tummug ti consegna <payment>, ringraziandoti per averli portati qui.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"Now Captain, fly the drones over the city we will. Only here to keep an eye on any issues they might have, and repair them, we are," he explains. "To better enjoy the show, head back to the main hangars closer to the city, you should. Once finished, we are, meet you in the spaceport I will. Some more cargo space and bunks, we'll need." You head to your ship, and fly it back to the city.|1515|0
units.english: "Now Captain, fly the drones over the city we will. Only here to keep an eye on any issues they might have, and repair them, we are," he explains. "To better enjoy the show, head back to the main hangars closer to the city, you should. Once finished, we are, meet you in the spaceport I will. Some more cargo space and bunks, we'll need." You head to your ship, and fly it back to the city.
units.italian: "Ora Capitano, far volare i droni sopra la città noi lo faremo. Solo qui per tenere d'occhio eventuali problemi che potrebbero avere, e ripararli, noi siamo," spiega. "Per goderti meglio lo spettacolo, tornare ai principali hangar più vicini alla città, tu dovresti. Una volta finito, noi avremo, incontrarti allo spazioporto io lo farò. Altro spazio di carico e cuccette, ci serviranno." Ti dirigi alla nave e la riporti in città.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	"Now <last>, safe here we should be, but even with fewer Heliarch ships now, stay docked here you should not. If traced to here, the signal controlling the drones is, ready to abandon the facility and flee, everyone is," he explains. "Meet you in the spaceport later, I will. Some more cargo space and bunks, we'll need." You head to your ship, and fly it back to the city.|1518|0
units.english: "Now <last>, safe here we should be, but even with fewer Heliarch ships now, stay docked here you should not. If traced to here, the signal controlling the drones is, ready to abandon the facility and flee, everyone is," he explains. "Meet you in the spaceport later, I will. Some more cargo space and bunks, we'll need." You head to your ship, and fly it back to the city.
units.italian: "Ora <last>, al sicuro qui dovremmo essere, ma anche con meno navi degli Heliarchs adesso, restare attraccato qui tu non dovresti. Se tracciato fino a qui, il segnale che controlla i droni viene: pronti ad abbandonare la struttura e fuggire, tutti sono," spiega. "Incontrarti allo spazioporto più tardi, io lo farò. Altro spazio di carico e cuccette, ci serviranno." Ti dirigi alla nave e la riporti in città.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	Almost half an hour goes by with you watching the skies of <planet> before the first signs of the drones show: they're too small for you to see from where you are, but you make out the piles of red smoke swiftly growing into Kimek letters in the sky, appearing in spiraling columns and arcs, with small, spread out dots separating the letters. Crowds clog the streets, Kimek look out the windows and some even gather atop apartment buildings to gaze at the messages. When the drones are done, the messages Tummug had shown you on the flyer are fully formed, and the drones take a short break. When they return, they get to work on another set of messages as the first one begins dissipating. After a few repetitions, and another pause, flyers begin raining down the city streets, the local Kimek picking them up in curiosity and discussing among themselves. The "rain" goes on for several minutes, before the drones start heading to other portions of the city and you lose sight of them.|1520|0
units.english: Almost half an hour goes by with you watching the skies of <planet> before the first signs of the drones show: they're too small for you to see from where you are, but you make out the piles of red smoke swiftly growing into Kimek letters in the sky, appearing in spiraling columns and arcs, with small, spread out dots separating the letters. Crowds clog the streets, Kimek look out the windows and some even gather atop apartment buildings to gaze at the messages. When the drones are done, the messages Tummug had shown you on the flyer are fully formed, and the drones take a short break. When they return, they get to work on another set of messages as the first one begins dissipating. After a few repetitions, and another pause, flyers begin raining down the city streets, the local Kimek picking them up in curiosity and discussing among themselves. The "rain" goes on for several minutes, before the drones start heading to other portions of the city and you lose sight of them.
units.italian: Passa quasi mezz'ora mentre guardi il cielo di <planet> prima che compaiano i primi segni dei droni: sono troppo piccoli perché tu li veda da dove sei, ma distingui le colonne di fumo rosso che crescono rapidamente in lettere Kimek nel cielo, apparendo in spirali e archi, con piccoli punti sparsi a separare le lettere. La folla intasa le strade, i Kimek si affacciano alle finestre e alcuni si radunano persino sui tetti dei palazzi per guardare i messaggi. Quando i droni hanno finito, i messaggi che Tummug ti aveva mostrato sul volantino sono formati del tutto, e i droni si prendono una breve pausa. Quando tornano, si mettono al lavoro su un altro gruppo di messaggi mentre il primo comincia a dissolversi. Dopo alcune ripetizioni, e un'altra pausa, i volantini cominciano a piovere sulle strade della città, e i Kimek del posto li raccolgono incuriositi e ne discutono tra loro. La "pioggia" va avanti per diversi minuti, prima che i droni comincino a dirigersi verso altre zone della città e tu li perda di vista.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 3|	Focusing now on the crowds and their reception, you see the Kimek are split: nearly everywhere they are in heated discussion, with many on one side seemingly approving of the display, while others yell and gesture for the messages to be put out, throwing the flyers to the ground and stomping on them. The Heliarch agents present on the ground do their best to separate the crowds and keep the order, but struggle against the sheer number of Kimek. Not long after the drones disappeared, however, Heliarch warships fly through the atmosphere in a fury, speedily undoing the skywriting as they head in the direction of the factory. Some ships leave more agents on the ground, and with increased personnel the Heliarchs now manage to stop the crowd infighting, and start clearing out the streets.|1521|0
units.english: Focusing now on the crowds and their reception, you see the Kimek are split: nearly everywhere they are in heated discussion, with many on one side seemingly approving of the display, while others yell and gesture for the messages to be put out, throwing the flyers to the ground and stomping on them. The Heliarch agents present on the ground do their best to separate the crowds and keep the order, but struggle against the sheer number of Kimek. Not long after the drones disappeared, however, Heliarch warships fly through the atmosphere in a fury, speedily undoing the skywriting as they head in the direction of the factory. Some ships leave more agents on the ground, and with increased personnel the Heliarchs now manage to stop the crowd infighting, and start clearing out the streets.
units.italian: Concentrandoti ora sulla folla e sulla sua reazione, vedi che i Kimek sono divisi: quasi ovunque sono in accesa discussione, con molti da una parte che sembrano approvare lo spettacolo, mentre altri urlano e gesticolano perché i messaggi vengano spenti, gettano i volantini a terra e li calpestano. Gli agenti degli Heliarchs presenti a terra fanno del loro meglio per separare la folla e mantenere l'ordine, ma faticano contro il numero enorme di Kimek. Non molto dopo la scomparsa dei droni, però, navi da guerra degli Heliarchs attraversano l'atmosfera con furia, disfacendo rapidamente la scritta nel cielo mentre si dirigono verso la fabbrica. Alcune navi lasciano altri agenti a terra, e con più personale gli Heliarchs riescono ora a fermare la rissa tra la folla e cominciano a sgomberare le strade.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|name|1527|0
units.english: Promoting Culture
units.italian: Promuovere la cultura

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|description|1528|0
units.english: Bring Tummug, his colleagues, and their <cargo> to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Tummug, i suoi colleghi e il loro <cargo> a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|blocked|1531|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|Tummug is quick to find you in the spaceport. He approaches you with the Arachi who helped him with the drones, as well as some Saryds and Kimek, all following behind him in a dash. "Delay you long this time I will not, Captain <last>," he says. "Headed to <destination> we are. Already arranged for what we'll need to be brought to your ship, I have."|1540|0
units.english: Tummug is quick to find you in the spaceport. He approaches you with the Arachi who helped him with the drones, as well as some Saryds and Kimek, all following behind him in a dash. "Delay you long this time I will not, Captain <last>," he says. "Headed to <destination> we are. Already arranged for what we'll need to be brought to your ship, I have."
units.italian: Tummug ti trova in fretta allo spazioporto. Ti si avvicina con gli Arachi che lo hanno aiutato con i droni, oltre ad alcuni Saryd e Kimek, tutti che lo seguono di corsa. "Trattenerti a lungo questa volta io non lo farò, Capitano <last>," dice. "Diretti a <destination> noi siamo. Già organizzato perché ciò che ci serve sia portato alla tua nave, io ho."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	He then tugs on your clothing as if asking you to bow down a bit, as he himself stretches up. "Leave at once, we must!" he whispers.|1543|0
units.english: He then tugs on your clothing as if asking you to bow down a bit, as he himself stretches up. "Leave at once, we must!" he whispers.
units.italian: Poi ti tira i vestiti come per chiederti di abbassarti un po', mentre lui stesso si allunga verso l'alto. "Partire subito, noi dobbiamo!" sussurra.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	You do your best to keep up as you run with them back to your ship, where they help some others load boxes and crates of promotional posters into your cargo hold. Strangely enough, you don't see any of the flyers that the drones rained from above earlier, or any sort of video displaying the skywriting on screens around the spaceport. Once the cargo is all in your ship, Tummug comes to say you'll receive <payment> for the job, and rushes inside your ship with the others.|1544|0
units.english: You do your best to keep up as you run with them back to your ship, where they help some others load boxes and crates of promotional posters into your cargo hold. Strangely enough, you don't see any of the flyers that the drones rained from above earlier, or any sort of video displaying the skywriting on screens around the spaceport. Once the cargo is all in your ship, Tummug comes to say you'll receive <payment> for the job, and rushes inside your ship with the others.
units.italian: Fai del tuo meglio per tenere il passo mentre corri con loro verso la tua nave, dove aiutano altri a caricare scatole e casse di manifesti promozionali nella stiva. Stranamente non vedi nessuno dei volantini che i droni hanno fatto piovere dall'alto poco prima, né alcun video che mostri la scritta nel cielo sugli schermi intorno allo spazioporto. Una volta che il carico è tutto sulla nave, Tummug viene a dirti che riceverai <payment> per il lavoro, e si precipita dentro con gli altri.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	He briefly glances around, then says, "A busy day it is, so hurry back to your ship we should. Otherwise, difficult to find, available cargo loaders will be."|1547|0
units.english: He briefly glances around, then says, "A busy day it is, so hurry back to your ship we should. Otherwise, difficult to find, available cargo loaders will be."
