units.italian: Si guarda brevemente intorno, poi dice: "Una giornata intensa è, quindi tornare in fretta alla tua nave noi dovremmo. Altrimenti, difficile da trovare, i caricatori disponibili saranno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	Running back to your ship, you notice a total lack of the flyers that rained down the city earlier, or any replay of the skywriting on any of the screens around the spaceport. Tummug and the Arachi who worked on the drones are all with the group, but their rush to get to your ship leaves you uneasy. You all help some more members get boxes and crates of posters into your ship, and head inside with Tummug and the others once you're done. "Leave now, we must. Too much attention, the drone show seems to have gained us," he tells you. "Pay you <payment> once on <planet> we are, I will. Go." They all head to their bunks, and you move to the cockpit, firing up your engines.|1548|0
units.english: Running back to your ship, you notice a total lack of the flyers that rained down the city earlier, or any replay of the skywriting on any of the screens around the spaceport. Tummug and the Arachi who worked on the drones are all with the group, but their rush to get to your ship leaves you uneasy. You all help some more members get boxes and crates of posters into your ship, and head inside with Tummug and the others once you're done. "Leave now, we must. Too much attention, the drone show seems to have gained us," he tells you. "Pay you <payment> once on <planet> we are, I will. Go." They all head to their bunks, and you move to the cockpit, firing up your engines.
units.italian: Correndo verso la tua nave, noti l'assenza totale dei volantini che poco prima piovevano sulla città, e nessuna replica della scritta nel cielo su nessuno degli schermi intorno allo spazioporto. Tummug e gli Arachi che hanno lavorato ai droni sono tutti con il gruppo, ma la loro fretta di arrivare alla nave ti lascia inquieto. Aiutate tutti altri membri a portare scatole e casse di manifesti dentro la nave, e quando avete finito entri con Tummug e gli altri. "Partire ora, noi dobbiamo. Troppa attenzione, lo spettacolo dei droni sembra averci procurato," ti dice. "Pagarti <payment> una volta su <planet> che saremo, io lo farò. Vai." Si dirigono tutti alle loro cuccette, e tu vai in cabina di pilotaggio, accendendo i motori.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|dialog|1553|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Tummug, his colleagues and the posters hasn't arrived in the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con Tummug, i suoi colleghi e i manifesti non è ancora arrivata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|Tummug gives you the <payment> and starts working on opening up the crates and boxes with the others. By the time you open the hatch, they've only managed to open some of the crates, but it seems like they've called in several Saryds from the hangar to help unload the remaining boxes and move them elsewhere. You approach Tummug, who's still picking through the posters. The posters are emblazoned with images of Saryds, Kimek and Arachi jailed and imprisoned in cages made out of chains. Looking closely, you realize the "chains" are made out of circlets like those used by the Heliarchs. Your eyes go to Tummug, who's looking back at you.|1560|0
units.english: Tummug gives you the <payment> and starts working on opening up the crates and boxes with the others. By the time you open the hatch, they've only managed to open some of the crates, but it seems like they've called in several Saryds from the hangar to help unload the remaining boxes and move them elsewhere. You approach Tummug, who's still picking through the posters. The posters are emblazoned with images of Saryds, Kimek and Arachi jailed and imprisoned in cages made out of chains. Looking closely, you realize the "chains" are made out of circlets like those used by the Heliarchs. Your eyes go to Tummug, who's looking back at you.
units.italian: Tummug ti dà <payment> e comincia ad aprire le casse e le scatole con gli altri. Quando apri il portello, sono riusciti ad aprire solo alcune casse, ma sembra che abbiano chiamato diversi Saryd dall'hangar per aiutare a scaricare le scatole rimanenti e spostarle altrove. Ti avvicini a Tummug, che sta ancora frugando tra i manifesti. I manifesti sono ornati con immagini di Saryd, Kimek e Arachi incarcerati e imprigionati in gabbie fatte di catene. Guardando bene, ti accorgi che le "catene" sono fatte di cerchietti come quelli usati dagli Heliarchs. I tuoi occhi vanno a Tummug, che sta guardando te.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"What exactly are these for?"|1564|0
units.english: "What exactly are these for?"
units.italian: "Per che cosa servono esattamente questi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"I don't think the Heliarchs would be very approving of these."|1566|0
units.english: "I don't think the Heliarchs would be very approving of these."
units.italian: "Non credo che gli Heliarchs li approverebbero molto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Approving of none of our work, they are," he responds. "Enjoy lying to you, I did not, Captain, but risky it would be, to tell you who we were before we secured the boxes and crates from <origin>."|1567|0
units.english: "Approving of none of our work, they are," he responds. "Enjoy lying to you, I did not, Captain, but risky it would be, to tell you who we were before we secured the boxes and crates from <origin>."
units.italian: "Approvare nulla del nostro lavoro, loro lo fanno," risponde. "Piacere di mentirti, io non ne ho avuto, Capitano, ma rischioso sarebbe stato dirti chi eravamo prima di mettere al sicuro le casse e le scatole da <origin>."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"True it is, that spreading around posters, banners and flyers as propaganda, we have. Only, not for some movie or other media they were. Jabs at the Heliarchy, they all have been, means of getting the people thinking, so that maybe recruit them, we can. Help greatly with that, what we secured from <origin> will."|1570|0
units.english: "True it is, that spreading around posters, banners and flyers as propaganda, we have. Only, not for some movie or other media they were. Jabs at the Heliarchy, they all have been, means of getting the people thinking, so that maybe recruit them, we can. Help greatly with that, what we secured from <origin> will."
units.italian: "Vero è, che diffondere in giro manifesti, stendardi e volantini come propaganda, noi lo abbiamo fatto. Solo che, non per qualche film o altro media erano. Stoccate all'Eliarchia, lo sono state tutte: modi per far pensare la gente, così che magari reclutarla, noi possiamo. Aiutare molto in questo, ciò che abbiamo messo al sicuro da <origin> lo farà."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"What did you bring in those crates? Weapons?"|1573|0
units.english: "What did you bring in those crates? Weapons?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete portato in quelle casse? Armi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Who are you?"|1574|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi siete?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Evidence. Proof. Of their crimes unpunished, of treason against one's own. Hold countless billions, the Kimek factory worlds do, and grounds for many of the Heliarchs' senseless arrests, they are. Write off disappearances as work accidents they do, but records, they keep, and tracking the captured 'criminals' they always are. Our target, those records were. There described, the whereabouts or fates of many are."|1576|0
units.english: "Evidence. Proof. Of their crimes unpunished, of treason against one's own. Hold countless billions, the Kimek factory worlds do, and grounds for many of the Heliarchs' senseless arrests, they are. Write off disappearances as work accidents they do, but records, they keep, and tracking the captured 'criminals' they always are. Our target, those records were. There described, the whereabouts or fates of many are."
units.italian: "Prove. Prove dei loro crimini impuniti, di tradimento verso i propri simili. Ospitare innumerevoli miliardi di persone, i mondi-fabbrica Kimek lo fanno, e terreno per molti degli arresti insensati degli Heliarchs, essi sono. Archiviare le sparizioni come incidenti sul lavoro, essi lo fanno, ma registri, li tengono, e tracciare i 'criminali' catturati, lo fanno sempre. Il nostro obiettivo, quei registri erano. Lì descritti, il luogo o il destino di molti sono."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	He remains quiet for a while, focusing his eyes on the images, then on yours as he hands you one of the posters. "Called the Lunarium Redoubt, my group is. Nickname us rebels and outlaws, the Heliarchs kindly do in their broadcasts. Helped us you have, <last>, and help us a lot more, in other ways you can." He pauses, still locking eyes with you. "Think not the Heliarchs as benefactors. Ruin us they will, if stop them we cannot."|1578|0
units.english: He remains quiet for a while, focusing his eyes on the images, then on yours as he hands you one of the posters. "Called the Lunarium Redoubt, my group is. Nickname us rebels and outlaws, the Heliarchs kindly do in their broadcasts. Helped us you have, <last>, and help us a lot more, in other ways you can." He pauses, still locking eyes with you. "Think not the Heliarchs as benefactors. Ruin us they will, if stop them we cannot."
units.italian: Resta in silenzio per un po', fissando gli occhi sulle immagini, poi sui tuoi mentre ti consegna uno dei manifesti. "Chiamato il Lunarium Redoubt, il mio gruppo è. Soprannominarci ribelli e fuorilegge, gli Heliarchs lo fanno gentilmente nelle loro trasmissioni. Aiutati, tu ci hai, <last>, e aiutarci molto di più, in altri modi tu potrai." Si ferma, ancora con gli occhi nei tuoi. "Non considerare gli Heliarchs come benefattori. Rovinarci, essi lo faranno, se fermarli noi non possiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Self explanatory, I imagine?" he says before he picks up the last few of them from the box. "Spread these around the planets, we of course will, but more valuable, the information in the unopened boxes and crates is."|1581|0
units.english: "Self explanatory, I imagine?" he says before he picks up the last few of them from the box. "Spread these around the planets, we of course will, but more valuable, the information in the unopened boxes and crates is."
units.italian: "Si spiegano da soli, immagino?" dice prima di prendere gli ultimi dalla scatola. "Diffondere questi per i pianeti, noi naturalmente lo faremo, ma più preziose, le informazioni nelle casse e nelle scatole non aperte sono."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"What information?"|1583|0
units.english: "What information?"
units.italian: "Quali informazioni?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Is that why you were in such a rush to leave before?"|1585|0
units.english: "Is that why you were in such a rush to leave before?"
units.italian: "È per questo che prima avevate tanta fretta di partire?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Hoped we had, that suffice as a distraction the skywriting and rain of flyers would, so that safe for the others to break in and steal the data it was," he explains, sighing. "Mistaken, we were. Set their patrols off all around, our previous propaganda efforts apparently did. Go into hiding for a while, they'll need to."|1586|0
units.english: "Hoped we had, that suffice as a distraction the skywriting and rain of flyers would, so that safe for the others to break in and steal the data it was," he explains, sighing. "Mistaken, we were. Set their patrols off all around, our previous propaganda efforts apparently did. Go into hiding for a while, they'll need to."
units.italian: "Sperato avevamo, che bastare come diversivo la scritta nel cielo e la pioggia di volantini sarebbero, così che al sicuro per gli altri entrare e rubare i dati sarebbe stato," spiega, sospirando. "Sbagliati, noi eravamo. Fatto scattare le loro pattuglie ovunque, i nostri precedenti sforzi di propaganda a quanto pare lo hanno. Nascondersi per un po', dovranno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	"Documents, recorded data of the fates or whereabouts of many who 'disappeared,' we stole. A common thing it is, on Kimek factory worlds, for Heliarchs to write them off as work accidents. Investigate the data thoroughly we will, and maybe uncover the coordinates of their prison - or morgue - we finally can."|1589|0
units.english: "Documents, recorded data of the fates or whereabouts of many who 'disappeared,' we stole. A common thing it is, on Kimek factory worlds, for Heliarchs to write them off as work accidents. Investigate the data thoroughly we will, and maybe uncover the coordinates of their prison - or morgue - we finally can."
units.italian: "Documenti, dati registrati sul destino o sul luogo in cui si trovano molti che sono 'spariti', noi abbiamo rubato. Una cosa comune è, sui mondi-fabbrica Kimek, che gli Heliarchs li archivino come incidenti sul lavoro. Esaminare i dati a fondo noi lo faremo, e magari scoprire le coordinate della loro prigione, o obitorio, finalmente noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Propaganda 4|	He thanks you for helping, and leaves your ship with the remaining posters. You go to check the spaceport and portions of the city later, but find neither Tummug, his colleagues, or any of the posters.|1591|0
units.english: He thanks you for helping, and leaves your ship with the remaining posters. You go to check the spaceport and portions of the city later, but find neither Tummug, his colleagues, or any of the posters.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia per l'aiuto e lascia la tua nave con i manifesti rimanenti. Più tardi vai a controllare lo spazioporto e alcune zone della città, ma non trovi né Tummug, né i suoi colleghi, né alcuno dei manifesti.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|name|1598|0
units.english: Bootcamp
units.italian: Addestramento

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|description|1599|0
units.english: Bring <bunks> Lunarium members, along with their <cargo> to <destination>, where they will purchase some ships and use them to fight pirates to train their combat tactics.
units.italian: Porta <bunks> membri del Lunarium, insieme al loro <cargo>, a <destination>, dove acquisteranno alcune navi e le useranno per combattere i pirati e addestrare le loro tattiche di combattimento.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|After wandering the spaceport for a while, you notice a crowd of dozens of individuals heading to the hangars, specifically in what looks like the direction of your ship. A roughly equal number of Kimek and Arachi, with some Saryds as well, they stand in front of the <ship>, looking around as if searching for its captain. You approach them, and one of the Kimek, whose thorax and abdomen are slimmer than the usual for her species, meets you to speak for their group.|1621|0
units.english: After wandering the spaceport for a while, you notice a crowd of dozens of individuals heading to the hangars, specifically in what looks like the direction of your ship. A roughly equal number of Kimek and Arachi, with some Saryds as well, they stand in front of the <ship>, looking around as if searching for its captain. You approach them, and one of the Kimek, whose thorax and abdomen are slimmer than the usual for her species, meets you to speak for their group.
units.italian: Dopo aver girato un po' per lo spazioporto, noti una folla di decine di individui diretta agli hangar, più precisamente in quella che sembra la direzione della tua nave. Kimek e Arachi in numero più o meno uguale, con anche alcuni Saryd, si fermano davanti alla <ship> e si guardano intorno come se cercassero il suo capitano. Ti avvicini, e uno dei Kimek, il cui torace e addome sono più snelli del solito per la sua specie, ti viene incontro per parlare a nome del gruppo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"There you are, Captain <last>," she greets you. "Pyakri, my name is, and looking for your transport services, my friends and I are. Talk in your ship, could we? Wish to discuss the details there, I do."|1624|0
units.english: "There you are, Captain <last>," she greets you. "Pyakri, my name is, and looking for your transport services, my friends and I are. Talk in your ship, could we? Wish to discuss the details there, I do."
units.italian: "Eccoti, Capitano <last>," ti saluta. "Pyakri, il mio nome è, e cercare i tuoi servizi di trasporto, io e i miei amici stiamo. Parlare nella tua nave, potremmo? Discutere i dettagli lì, io desidero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Sure, let me get the hatch."|1626|0
units.english: "Sure, let me get the hatch."
units.italian: "Certo, fammi aprire il portello."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"You'll have to clear out, I'm not taking any passengers now."|1627|0
units.english: "You'll have to clear out, I'm not taking any passengers now."
units.italian: "Dovete andarvene, non prendo passeggeri adesso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	You bring her aboard, and she continues when you close the hatch. "Thank you Captain. Now, assisted some of my colleagues, you already have, yes?" She waits for you to answer, but seeing your puzzled look, resumes her explanation. "The Lunarium Redoubt? Assisted us before, you have, even if aware of all the details beforehand you were not. Suppose I do that mostly heard of us as criminals or the like, you must have. Petty in their propaganda, the Heliarchs are. Recommend you as trustworthy, some people did whom helped you have, so possible it is, to go ahead with a special endeavor that planning, I have been."|1629|0
units.english: You bring her aboard, and she continues when you close the hatch. "Thank you Captain. Now, assisted some of my colleagues, you already have, yes?" She waits for you to answer, but seeing your puzzled look, resumes her explanation. "The Lunarium Redoubt? Assisted us before, you have, even if aware of all the details beforehand you were not. Suppose I do that mostly heard of us as criminals or the like, you must have. Petty in their propaganda, the Heliarchs are. Recommend you as trustworthy, some people did whom helped you have, so possible it is, to go ahead with a special endeavor that planning, I have been."
units.italian: La porti a bordo, e lei continua quando chiudi il portello. "Grazie Capitano. Ora, aiutato alcuni miei colleghi, tu li hai già, sì?" Aspetta che tu risponda, ma visto il tuo sguardo perplesso, riprende la spiegazione. "Il Lunarium Redoubt? Aiutato noi prima, tu lo hai, anche se consapevole di tutti i dettagli in anticipo tu non eri. Suppongo che per lo più sentito parlare di noi come criminali o simili, tu devi avere. Meschini nella loro propaganda, gli Heliarchs sono. Raccomandarti come affidabile, alcune persone lo hanno fatto che ti hanno aiutato, quindi possibile è, andare avanti con una impresa speciale che pianificare, io sto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"What's this 'endeavor' you need help with?"|1631|0
units.english: "What's this 'endeavor' you need help with?"
units.italian: "In che cosa consiste questa 'impresa' per cui ti serve aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Your friends only told me what I was really doing after I was done. I don't want to help you any further."|1633|0
units.english: "Your friends only told me what I was really doing after I was done. I don't want to help you any further."
units.italian: "I tuoi amici mi hanno detto che cosa stavo facendo davvero solo dopo che avevo finito. Non voglio aiutarvi ancora."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Why? Interested in helping the Heliarchs instead, are you? Worked with them, some of our members have. An arbiter, Elirom, one of them, was. One of the highest ranks, that is, second only to the consuls themselves," she responds, getting closer to you. "Change for the better, the Coalition soon will. Difficult it will be, to take down the Heliarchy. Very strong it is, so greatly appreciated any help would be. Of course, once free from them we are, rewarded appropriately shall be those, help us who do in our time of need."|1634|0
units.english: "Why? Interested in helping the Heliarchs instead, are you? Worked with them, some of our members have. An arbiter, Elirom, one of them, was. One of the highest ranks, that is, second only to the consuls themselves," she responds, getting closer to you. "Change for the better, the Coalition soon will. Difficult it will be, to take down the Heliarchy. Very strong it is, so greatly appreciated any help would be. Of course, once free from them we are, rewarded appropriately shall be those, help us who do in our time of need."
units.italian: "Perché? Interessato ad aiutare gli Heliarchs invece, tu sei? Lavorato con loro, alcuni dei nostri membri lo hanno. Un arbitro, Elirom, uno di loro, era. Uno dei gradi più alti, cioè, secondo solo ai consoli stessi," risponde, avvicinandosi a te. "Cambiare in meglio, la Coalizione presto lo farà. Difficile sarà, abbattere l'Eliarchia. Molto forte è, quindi molto apprezzato qualsiasi aiuto sarebbe. Naturalmente, una volta liberi da loro che saremo, ricompensati adeguatamente saranno coloro che ci aiutano nel nostro momento del bisogno."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"And what would I have to do to help you?"|1636|0
units.english: "And what would I have to do to help you?"
units.italian: "E che cosa dovrei fare per aiutarvi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Why do you want to take down the Heliarchs? Seems to me the Coalition is doing very well under them."|1638|0
units.english: "Why do you want to take down the Heliarchs? Seems to me the Coalition is doing very well under them."
units.italian: "Perché volete abbattere gli Heliarchs? Mi sembra che la Coalizione se la passi molto bene sotto di loro."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Whether you and your friends win or lose, I want no part in it. I'm not helping you."|1639|0
units.english: "Whether you and your friends win or lose, I want no part in it. I'm not helping you."
units.italian: "Che tu e i tuoi amici vincate o perdiate, non voglio farne parte. Non vi aiuto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Of course, only exposed to Heliarchy propaganda, you are. An achievement of the current Heliarchs, what prosperity we have is not, and furthering that prosperity, they most certainly are not!" She quickly slows down her breathing after the exclamation, calming down. "Grown paranoid, they have. Seen a Quarg in millennia, nobody in the Coalition has, but think they do, that to fight the Quarg their purpose is. Making enemies, taking prisoners of their own people, they have been. Public arrests with no warning or cause, disappearances in the night..." She backs away slightly, her mandibles clicking in a low murmur. "Leave I will, if interested you are not, but in need of help we are, Captain."|1641|0
units.english: "Of course, only exposed to Heliarchy propaganda, you are. An achievement of the current Heliarchs, what prosperity we have is not, and furthering that prosperity, they most certainly are not!" She quickly slows down her breathing after the exclamation, calming down. "Grown paranoid, they have. Seen a Quarg in millennia, nobody in the Coalition has, but think they do, that to fight the Quarg their purpose is. Making enemies, taking prisoners of their own people, they have been. Public arrests with no warning or cause, disappearances in the night..." She backs away slightly, her mandibles clicking in a low murmur. "Leave I will, if interested you are not, but in need of help we are, Captain."
units.italian: "Certo, esposto solo alla propaganda dell'Eliarchia, tu sei. Un risultato degli Heliarchs attuali, la prosperità che abbiamo non è, e portare avanti quella prosperità, loro certamente non lo stanno facendo!" Rallenta in fretta il respiro dopo l'esclamazione, calmandosi. "Diventati paranoici, loro sono. Visto un Quarg in millenni, nessuno nella Coalizione lo ha, ma credere che esistano, e che combattere i Quarg sia il loro scopo, loro lo fanno. Creare nemici, prendere prigionieri tra la propria gente, essi lo stanno facendo. Arresti pubblici senza preavviso né motivo, sparizioni nella notte..." Indietreggia leggermente, le mandibole che schioccano in un mormorio basso. "Andarmene io lo farò, se interessato tu non sei, ma bisogno di aiuto noi abbiamo, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Help with what, exactly?"|1643|0
units.english: "Help with what, exactly?"
units.italian: "Aiuto per che cosa, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"I'm sorry, but helping your group any further sounds too risky to me."|1644|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but helping your group any further sounds too risky to me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma aiutare ancora il vostro gruppo mi sembra troppo rischioso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Difficult it is, to fight Heliarch ships, but fight them all the same we will need to, eventually," she explains. "Not very... experienced in warfare, most of our members are, as avoiding any ship battles we have been. Seeing as a jump drive you have, think we did that bring some of our regional fleet leaders to human space, you could. Train there against human pirates, we can."|1647|0
units.english: "Difficult it is, to fight Heliarch ships, but fight them all the same we will need to, eventually," she explains. "Not very... experienced in warfare, most of our members are, as avoiding any ship battles we have been. Seeing as a jump drive you have, think we did that bring some of our regional fleet leaders to human space, you could. Train there against human pirates, we can."
units.italian: "Difficile è, combattere le navi degli Heliarchs, ma combatterle comunque noi dovremo, prima o poi," spiega. "Non molto... esperti in guerra, la maggior parte dei nostri membri lo è, dato che evitare qualsiasi battaglia tra navi noi abbiamo sempre fatto. Visto che un motore di salto tu hai, pensato abbiamo che portare alcuni dei nostri capi delle flotte regionali nello spazio umano, tu potresti. Addestrarci lì contro i pirati umani, noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Alright. I'll help you. How many people are you bringing along?"|1649|0
units.english: "Alright. I'll help you. How many people are you bringing along?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Vi aiuterò. Quante persone portate?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"I'm sorry, but helping your group any further sounds too risky to me."|1650|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but helping your group any further sounds too risky to me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma aiutare ancora il vostro gruppo mi sembra troppo rischioso."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	She perks up with your answer. "<bunks> in total, our group is. Wish to cause a commotion in human space, we do not, so bringing along <cargo> to sustain ourselves for a while, we are. Avoid leaving the ships at all, we will."|1652|0
units.english: She perks up with your answer. "<bunks> in total, our group is. Wish to cause a commotion in human space, we do not, so bringing along <cargo> to sustain ourselves for a while, we are. Avoid leaving the ships at all, we will."
units.italian: Si rianima alla tua risposta. "<bunks> in totale, il nostro gruppo è. Voler creare scompiglio nello spazio umano, noi non vogliamo, quindi portare con noi <cargo> per sostentarci per un po', stiamo facendo. Evitare di lasciare le navi del tutto, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	You recognize her as Pyakri, a Lunarium military leader who you met on Remote Blue, and bring her aboard your ship to talk. "Looking for you I have been, Captain <last>. Need your help I do, for a training endeavor of sorts."|1655|0
units.english: You recognize her as Pyakri, a Lunarium military leader who you met on Remote Blue, and bring her aboard your ship to talk. "Looking for you I have been, Captain <last>. Need your help I do, for a training endeavor of sorts."
units.italian: La riconosci come Pyakri, una leader militare del Lunarium che hai incontrato su Remote Blue, e la porti a bordo della tua nave per parlare. "Cercarti io ti ho cercato, Capitano <last>. Bisogno del tuo aiuto io ho, per una specie di addestramento."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"What do you need help with?"|1657|0
units.english: "What do you need help with?"
units.italian: "Con che cosa ti serve aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"I'm not very good at training others, are you sure you need my help?"|1659|0
units.english: "I'm not very good at training others, are you sure you need my help?"
units.italian: "Non sono molto bravo ad addestrare gli altri, sei sicura che ti serva il mio aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	Her mandibles click together rapidly, sounding almost like a chime in its rhythm. "Doing the training you will not be. For the most part, at least," she explains. "Waiting just outside, many of our regional fleet leaders are. Your jump drive, and some of your knowledge, what we need is." She chirps again.|1660|0
units.english: Her mandibles click together rapidly, sounding almost like a chime in its rhythm. "Doing the training you will not be. For the most part, at least," she explains. "Waiting just outside, many of our regional fleet leaders are. Your jump drive, and some of your knowledge, what we need is." She chirps again.
units.italian: Le sue mandibole si chiudono a scatto rapidamente, con un ritmo che suona quasi come un carillon. "Fare l'addestramento tu non lo farai. Per la maggior parte, almeno," spiega. "Aspettare appena fuori, molti dei capi delle nostre flotte regionali stanno. Il tuo motore di salto, e parte della tua conoscenza, ciò di cui abbiamo bisogno è." Cinguetta di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	"Very... lacking, most of our members are, in ship to ship combat expertise. Wish to test some tactics, the leaders do, so that better explain it to members under them they can. Of course, dangerous to challenge the Heliarchs for that, it is, so thought of training against human pirates, we did. Bring us to human space for that, you would. <bunks> in total we are, and bring along <cargo> to sustain ourselves without needing to leave the ships and cause a commotion, we will."|1662|0
units.english: "Very... lacking, most of our members are, in ship to ship combat expertise. Wish to test some tactics, the leaders do, so that better explain it to members under them they can. Of course, dangerous to challenge the Heliarchs for that, it is, so thought of training against human pirates, we did. Bring us to human space for that, you would. <bunks> in total we are, and bring along <cargo> to sustain ourselves without needing to leave the ships and cause a commotion, we will."
units.italian: "Molto... carenti, la maggior parte dei nostri membri sono, in esperienza di combattimento nave contro nave. Provare alcune tattiche, i capi vogliono, così che spiegarle meglio ai membri sotto di loro possano. Naturalmente, pericoloso sfidare gli Heliarchs per questo, è, quindi pensato di addestrarci contro i pirati umani, noi abbiamo. Portarci nello spazio umano per questo, tu lo faresti. <bunks> in totale noi siamo, e portare con noi <cargo> per sostentarci senza dover lasciare le navi e creare scompiglio, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|	She asks you to open the hatch, and she has a few more members from the crowd come in. They ask for your map, and then for the nearest hub of pirate activity. You point to Greenrock in Shaula, the biggest pirate world in southern human space, telling them it's one of the most dangerous ones. They then ask if there are any major shipyards in the South, and you point them to Southbound Shipyards, on <planet>, and the Tarazed Corporation, on Wayfarer. After some debate, they decide that <planet>'s proximity to the Coalition makes it a better pick in case they need to return quickly, and settle on that as the destination. "Bringing along enough credits to purchase a few warships, I hope we are," Pyakri comments. They have their <cargo> brought to your ship, and you show them to their bunks.|1664|0
units.english: She asks you to open the hatch, and she has a few more members from the crowd come in. They ask for your map, and then for the nearest hub of pirate activity. You point to Greenrock in Shaula, the biggest pirate world in southern human space, telling them it's one of the most dangerous ones. They then ask if there are any major shipyards in the South, and you point them to Southbound Shipyards, on <planet>, and the Tarazed Corporation, on Wayfarer. After some debate, they decide that <planet>'s proximity to the Coalition makes it a better pick in case they need to return quickly, and settle on that as the destination. "Bringing along enough credits to purchase a few warships, I hope we are," Pyakri comments. They have their <cargo> brought to your ship, and you show them to their bunks.
units.italian: Ti chiede di aprire il portello, e fa entrare altri membri dalla folla. Chiedono la tua mappa, e poi il centro più vicino di attività piratesca. Indichi Greenrock in Shaula, il più grande mondo pirata dello spazio umano meridionale, dicendo che è uno dei più pericolosi. Chiedono poi se ci sono cantieri navali importanti nel Sud, e indichi i Cantieri Southbound, su <planet>, e la Tarazed Corporation, su Wayfarer. Dopo qualche discussione, decidono che la vicinanza di <planet> alla Coalizione lo rende una scelta migliore nel caso debbano tornare rapidamente, e scelgono quella come destinazione. "Portare con noi abbastanza crediti per comprare alcune navi da guerra, spero che stiamo facendo," commenta Pyakri. Fanno portare il loro <cargo> alla tua nave, e tu mostri loro le cuccette.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 1|dialog|1669|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but your escort bringing Pyakri and the other Lunarium members and their supplies hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for them.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta che porta Pyakri e gli altri membri del Lunarium con le loro provviste non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|name|1676|0
units.english: Combat Test
units.italian: Prova di fuoco

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|description|1677|0
units.english: Escort Pyakri's fleet to <waypoints>, and help them fight a pirate fleet there to get started with their training. Make sure all of the Lunarium ships survive. Return to <origin> once you're finished.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta di Pyakri fino a <waypoints> e aiutala a combattere lì una flotta di pirati per dare inizio al loro addestramento. Assicurati che tutte le navi del Lunarium sopravvivano. Torna a <origin> quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|Once you've landed, Pyakri and some other Lunarium members come to your cockpit, where you show them a monitor with the list of ships for sale at the local shipyard. You answer their questions about the ships' abilities, strengths, and failings to the best of your knowledge. You also show them the outfits available on <origin>, in case they want to change any of the ship loadouts. After discussing with the others for a few minutes, and going back to check the pages of some ships, Pyakri asks you to help her purchase 1 Bastion, 3 Argosies and 4 Clippers.|1687|0
units.english: Once you've landed, Pyakri and some other Lunarium members come to your cockpit, where you show them a monitor with the list of ships for sale at the local shipyard. You answer their questions about the ships' abilities, strengths, and failings to the best of your knowledge. You also show them the outfits available on <origin>, in case they want to change any of the ship loadouts. After discussing with the others for a few minutes, and going back to check the pages of some ships, Pyakri asks you to help her purchase 1 Bastion, 3 Argosies and 4 Clippers.
units.italian: Una volta atterrato, Pyakri e altri membri del Lunarium vengono nella tua cabina di pilotaggio, dove mostri loro un monitor con l'elenco delle navi in vendita nel cantiere locale. Rispondi alle loro domande sulle capacità, i punti di forza e i difetti delle navi, al meglio delle tue conoscenze. Mostri anche le attrezzature disponibili su <origin>, nel caso vogliano cambiare la configurazione delle navi. Dopo aver discusso con gli altri per qualche minuto, e aver ripercorso le schede di alcune navi, Pyakri ti chiede di aiutarla ad acquistare 1 Bastion, 3 Argosy e 4 Clipper.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Are you sure you don't want more Bastions? They're pretty tough, you'd all be safer in them."|1689|0
units.english: "Are you sure you don't want more Bastions? They're pretty tough, you'd all be safer in them."
units.italian: "Sei sicura di non volere più Bastion? Sono piuttosto resistenti, sareste tutti più al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"So how are you going to actually enter the ships? I thought you wanted to remain secret from humans."|1690|0
units.english: "So how are you going to actually enter the ships? I thought you wanted to remain secret from humans."
units.italian: "E come farete davvero a salire sulle navi? Pensavo voleste restare nascosti agli umani."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Much more durable than what we have available, Heliarch ships are. Aware of the danger, everyone is, and to better understand ways to survive in more fragile ships, practice with them we must."|1692|0
units.english: "Much more durable than what we have available, Heliarch ships are. Aware of the danger, everyone is, and to better understand ways to survive in more fragile ships, practice with them we must."
units.italian: "Molto più resistenti di quelle che abbiamo a disposizione, le navi degli Heliarchs sono. Consapevoli del pericolo, tutti lo sono, e per capire meglio come sopravvivere su navi più fragili, esercitarci con queste noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Be outside for long, we cannot, so to have the ships brought closer to here, we will need. Wait for nightfall first, though, we should, as easier to sneak quickly into the purchased ships it would be."|1695|0
units.english: "Be outside for long, we cannot, so to have the ships brought closer to here, we will need. Wait for nightfall first, though, we should, as easier to sneak quickly into the purchased ships it would be."
units.italian: "Fuori a lungo, noi non possiamo restare, quindi far avvicinare le navi qui, ci servirà. Aspettare prima il calare della notte, però, noi dovremmo, dato che più facile sarebbe infilarci in fretta nelle navi acquistate."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	You help her finish the transaction, giving the basic rundown of Southbound's shipyard interface, and ask for the ships to be brought to the hangars beside the <ship>. "A great help you were, Captain. Vital, this will be, if to pass as a human fleet, we are. Be careful in communicating with clients in the area, I must be." Your face showing some confusion, she explains her plans further. "After gotten the gist of fighting human pirates with you, we have, work as bounty hunters, we will. Make enough to pay you back for your services, I intend to. Even if similar to taking jobs in the Coalition space, human bounties are, need to communicate minimally with the clients, we may still."|1697|0
units.english: You help her finish the transaction, giving the basic rundown of Southbound's shipyard interface, and ask for the ships to be brought to the hangars beside the <ship>. "A great help you were, Captain. Vital, this will be, if to pass as a human fleet, we are. Be careful in communicating with clients in the area, I must be." Your face showing some confusion, she explains her plans further. "After gotten the gist of fighting human pirates with you, we have, work as bounty hunters, we will. Make enough to pay you back for your services, I intend to. Even if similar to taking jobs in the Coalition space, human bounties are, need to communicate minimally with the clients, we may still."
units.italian: La aiuti a concludere la transazione, spiegando a grandi linee l'interfaccia del cantiere Southbound, e chiedi che le navi vengano portate agli hangar accanto alla <ship>. "Un grande aiuto sei stato, Capitano. Vitale, questo sarà, se passare per una flotta umana noi vogliamo. Fare attenzione nel comunicare con i clienti della zona, io devo." Il tuo viso mostra un po' di confusione, così spiega meglio i suoi piani. "Dopo aver capito l'essenziale del combattere i pirati umani con te, lavorare come cacciatori di taglie, noi lo faremo. Guadagnare abbastanza per rimborsarti dei tuoi servizi, io intendo. Anche se simili ai lavori nello spazio della Coalizione, le taglie umane sono: dover comunicare il minimo con i clienti, potremmo comunque."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Well, I'm sure you'll get the hang of it."|1699|0
units.english: "Well, I'm sure you'll get the hang of it."
units.italian: "Beh, sono sicuro che ci prenderete la mano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Are you sure that's a good idea? Since you want to avoid humans noticing you."|1701|0
units.english: "Are you sure that's a good idea? Since you want to avoid humans noticing you."
units.italian: "Sei sicura che sia una buona idea? Visto che volete evitare che gli umani vi notino."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"What? Oh, worried about the translators, are you? Yes, sound robotic at times, they can, but impede us not, that will. Readied the translating software to work on text messages, we have. Neither seen nor heard, we will be," she touts.|1702|0
units.english: "What? Oh, worried about the translators, are you? Yes, sound robotic at times, they can, but impede us not, that will. Readied the translating software to work on text messages, we have. Neither seen nor heard, we will be," she touts.
units.italian: "Come? Oh, preoccupato per i traduttori, tu sei? Sì, suonare robotici a volte, essi possono, ma impedirci nulla, questo non lo farà. Preparato il software di traduzione per funzionare sui messaggi scritti, noi lo abbiamo. Né visti né sentiti, noi saremo," si vanta.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"I'm more worried that the... speech pattern will give you away."|1704|0
units.english: "I'm more worried that the... speech pattern will give you away."
units.italian: "Mi preoccupa di più che il... modo di parlare vi tradisca."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Well, if you think you'll be alright, sure."|1705|0
units.english: "Well, if you think you'll be alright, sure."
units.italian: "Beh, se pensi che andrà bene, certo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	"Pattern?" She looks at you, confused, and so you explain the quirk of the Coalition's translator boxes. You ask her to simply type something into your monitor, with the aid of the same translating software, and point to her the jumbled words when it translates to your language. "And always like this, our translators have been?" she asks in disbelief. You nod, and in either some act of shame, or anger, she cowers her legs closer to her body, while tapping the ground with them erratically. "Work perfectly for translating from the human language, they do, and problems between the Coalition languages, there are not... Reported before, this issue was not. Not to the Heliarchs, not to us! An embarrassment, that is..." She sighs, spreading her legs back to normal. "Once in power, we are, talk to Oobat about fixing them, I will. For now, hope I will that need to communicate with humans much, we will not."|1707|0
units.english: "Pattern?" She looks at you, confused, and so you explain the quirk of the Coalition's translator boxes. You ask her to simply type something into your monitor, with the aid of the same translating software, and point to her the jumbled words when it translates to your language. "And always like this, our translators have been?" she asks in disbelief. You nod, and in either some act of shame, or anger, she cowers her legs closer to her body, while tapping the ground with them erratically. "Work perfectly for translating from the human language, they do, and problems between the Coalition languages, there are not... Reported before, this issue was not. Not to the Heliarchs, not to us! An embarrassment, that is..." She sighs, spreading her legs back to normal. "Once in power, we are, talk to Oobat about fixing them, I will. For now, hope I will that need to communicate with humans much, we will not."
units.italian: "Modo di parlare?" Ti guarda confusa, così le spieghi la stranezza delle scatole di traduzione della Coalizione. Le chiedi di digitare semplicemente qualcosa sul tuo monitor, con l'aiuto dello stesso software di traduzione, e le indichi le parole mescolate quando traduce nella tua lingua. "E sempre così, i nostri traduttori sono stati?" chiede incredula. Fai cenno di sì, e in un gesto di vergogna o di rabbia, ritrae le zampe più vicino al corpo, battendole a terra in modo irregolare. "Funzionare perfettamente per tradurre dalla lingua umana, essi lo fanno, e problemi tra le lingue della Coalizione, non ce ne sono... Segnalato prima, questo problema non era. Non agli Heliarchs, non a noi! Una figuraccia, questa è..." Sospira, distendendo le zampe come prima. "Una volta al potere che saremo, parlare con Oobat di aggiustarli, io lo farò. Per ora, sperare io spero che bisogno di comunicare molto con gli umani, noi non ne avremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	Once all the purchased ships are parked near your own, you give her another rundown, this time of the job board. You help her learn the layout of bounty hunting jobs, and give her some tips on locating ships with bounties on them. Hours after nightfall, you see the hangars become much less lively, with only the night shift workers moving about. You open the hatch and make sure the coast is clear before moving with the Lunarium members to the Bastion, parked closest to your own ship. The members assigned to that ship enter the hatch, Pyakri included, and you repeat the process with the others, heading to the Argosies in front of you. After the last of them, you move in quick trips to each of the Clippers, finally looping back to your ship once you're done. With everyone now in their own ship, you ask some workers to help move the supplies right by the hatches. Once the workers have moved away, the Lunarium crew open up to bring the cargo inside, and you head to the Bastion to meet with Pyakri.|1709|0
units.english: Once all the purchased ships are parked near your own, you give her another rundown, this time of the job board. You help her learn the layout of bounty hunting jobs, and give her some tips on locating ships with bounties on them. Hours after nightfall, you see the hangars become much less lively, with only the night shift workers moving about. You open the hatch and make sure the coast is clear before moving with the Lunarium members to the Bastion, parked closest to your own ship. The members assigned to that ship enter the hatch, Pyakri included, and you repeat the process with the others, heading to the Argosies in front of you. After the last of them, you move in quick trips to each of the Clippers, finally looping back to your ship once you're done. With everyone now in their own ship, you ask some workers to help move the supplies right by the hatches. Once the workers have moved away, the Lunarium crew open up to bring the cargo inside, and you head to the Bastion to meet with Pyakri.
units.italian: Una volta che tutte le navi acquistate sono parcheggiate vicino alla tua, le fai un altro riepilogo, questa volta della bacheca degli incarichi. La aiuti a imparare la disposizione dei lavori di caccia alle taglie, e le dai qualche consiglio su come individuare le navi con taglie sulla testa. Ore dopo il calare della notte, vedi che gli hangar diventano molto meno animati, con solo gli operai del turno di notte in movimento. Apri il portello e ti assicuri che la via sia libera prima di muoverti con i membri del Lunarium verso il Bastion, parcheggiato più vicino alla tua nave. I membri assegnati a quella nave entrano dal portello, Pyakri compresa, e ripeti il procedimento con gli altri, dirigendoti agli Argosy davanti a te. Dopo l'ultimo di quelli, ti muovi in rapide corse verso ognuno dei Clipper, tornando infine alla tua nave quando hai finito. Con tutti ora nelle rispettive navi, chiedi ad alcuni operai di aiutare a spostare le provviste proprio accanto ai portelli. Una volta che gli operai si sono allontanati, l'equipaggio del Lunarium si apre per portare il carico dentro, e tu ti dirigi al Bastion per incontrare Pyakri.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|	You find the ship's interior already undergoing modifications, with many of the Arachi using various legs to hold wires in place as they replace the human control pads and keys to versions they are more accustomed to. Pyakri is inside the cockpit, testing many of the controls as she looks at a manual on one screen, already translated to the Kimek language. "Ah, hello again Captain. Worked well, the plan has, and seen we were not. At least hope that, I do." She opens up a map, pointing to a star you recognize as <waypoints>. "Taken our first job, we have. Since far more experienced in fighting human pirates, you are, ask for your help in this first fight, I must. Informed me the job offer has, that in this system the bounties are. Head there quickly to face them, we should, before time to flee, they have. Follow your ship there, we will." You go from ship to ship, reminding each of the captains to be careful in the coming fight, and then enter your own. With the purpose of this training being to grow the Lunarium's combat experience and tactics, things certainly wouldn't work well if some of them died right in their first fight, so you should try and keep them all alive.|1710|0
units.english: You find the ship's interior already undergoing modifications, with many of the Arachi using various legs to hold wires in place as they replace the human control pads and keys to versions they are more accustomed to. Pyakri is inside the cockpit, testing many of the controls as she looks at a manual on one screen, already translated to the Kimek language. "Ah, hello again Captain. Worked well, the plan has, and seen we were not. At least hope that, I do." She opens up a map, pointing to a star you recognize as <waypoints>. "Taken our first job, we have. Since far more experienced in fighting human pirates, you are, ask for your help in this first fight, I must. Informed me the job offer has, that in this system the bounties are. Head there quickly to face them, we should, before time to flee, they have. Follow your ship there, we will." You go from ship to ship, reminding each of the captains to be careful in the coming fight, and then enter your own. With the purpose of this training being to grow the Lunarium's combat experience and tactics, things certainly wouldn't work well if some of them died right in their first fight, so you should try and keep them all alive.
units.italian: Trovi l'interno della nave già sottoposto a modifiche, con molti degli Arachi che usano le varie zampe per tenere i fili in posizione mentre sostituiscono i pannelli di controllo e i tasti umani con versioni a cui sono più abituati. Pyakri è in cabina di pilotaggio e prova molti comandi guardando un manuale su uno schermo, già tradotto in lingua Kimek. "Ah, di nuovo salve Capitano. Funzionato bene, il piano ha, e visti noi non siamo stati. Almeno sperarlo, io lo spero." Apre una mappa e indica una stella che riconosci come <waypoints>. "Preso il nostro primo incarico, noi lo abbiamo. Dato che molto più esperto nel combattere i pirati umani, tu sei, chiederti aiuto in questo primo scontro, io devo. Informato dell'incarico, mi ha, che in questo sistema sono le taglie. Dirigerci là in fretta per affrontarle, noi dovremmo, prima che tempo per fuggire, esse abbiano. Seguire la tua nave fin là, noi lo faremo." Vai di nave in nave, ricordando a ogni capitano di fare attenzione nello scontro imminente, e poi entri nella tua. Dato che lo scopo di questo addestramento è crescere l'esperienza di combattimento e le tattiche del Lunarium, le cose non andrebbero certo bene se alcuni di loro morissero al primo scontro, quindi dovresti cercare di tenerli tutti vivi.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|dialog|1716|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you're not done with the mission yet. Either some of the Lunarium's ships haven't entered the system yet, or some of the pirate ships in <waypoints> haven't been defeated. Return once everything is in order.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai ancora finito la missione. O alcune delle navi del Lunarium non sono ancora entrate nel sistema, oppure alcune delle navi pirata in <waypoints> non sono state sconfitte. Torna quando tutto sarà a posto.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 2|Pyakri contacts you right as you land, by a text message in your monitor. "A great help you were, Captain! More... battle-hardened, if call them that you could, the crew with me are, so have much trouble with their morale, I did not, but still have me worried, the pirates did. Used to human ships, we are not, so fly them well enough to combat such fleets, we cannot. Not yet. Now that guided us through this first fight, you have, work on our own for a while - taking smaller, simpler bounties - we will. Contact you again, I shall, once done with our training, we are."|1741|0
units.english: Pyakri contacts you right as you land, by a text message in your monitor. "A great help you were, Captain! More... battle-hardened, if call them that you could, the crew with me are, so have much trouble with their morale, I did not, but still have me worried, the pirates did. Used to human ships, we are not, so fly them well enough to combat such fleets, we cannot. Not yet. Now that guided us through this first fight, you have, work on our own for a while - taking smaller, simpler bounties - we will. Contact you again, I shall, once done with our training, we are."
units.italian: Pyakri ti contatta appena atterri, con un messaggio scritto sul monitor. "Un grande aiuto sei stato, Capitano! Più... temprati dalla battaglia, se così si può dire, gli equipaggi con me sono, quindi non ho avuto grossi problemi con il loro morale, ma comunque preoccuparmi, i pirati lo hanno fatto. Abituati alle navi umane, noi non siamo, quindi pilotarle abbastanza bene per combattere tali flotte, noi non sappiamo. Non ancora. Ora che guidati noi attraverso questo primo scontro, tu lo hai, lavorare da soli per un po', prendendo taglie più piccole e semplici, noi lo faremo. Contattarti di nuovo, io lo farò, una volta finito il nostro addestramento, noi avremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 3|name|1769|0
units.english: Pick Up Pyakri
units.italian: Prendere Pyakri

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 3|description|1770|0
units.english: Pyakri and the other 53 Lunarium members are done with their training in human space. Head to <planet>, where they are waiting to be picked up and brought back to the Coalition.
units.italian: Pyakri e gli altri 53 membri del Lunarium hanno finito il loro addestramento nello spazio umano. Recati su <planet>, dove aspettano di essere presi e riportati nella Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 3|Your monitor shifts into a messaging interface as you're landing, and some text quickly pours in. "Captain, hello. Pyakri, it is. In the last few months, fought many human pirates, and managed to practice and hone fleet movements, we have. Return to the others in the Coalition, we now must, so need your help again, we will. Waiting on <planet>, we will be." The message ends and your monitor returns to normal. You set a marker on <destination> to head there later and pick up the Lunarium members.|1781|0
units.english: Your monitor shifts into a messaging interface as you're landing, and some text quickly pours in. "Captain, hello. Pyakri, it is. In the last few months, fought many human pirates, and managed to practice and hone fleet movements, we have. Return to the others in the Coalition, we now must, so need your help again, we will. Waiting on <planet>, we will be." The message ends and your monitor returns to normal. You set a marker on <destination> to head there later and pick up the Lunarium members.
units.italian: Il tuo monitor si trasforma in un'interfaccia di messaggistica mentre atterri, e del testo arriva in fretta. "Capitano, salve. Pyakri, sono io. Negli ultimi mesi, combattuto molti pirati umani, e riusciti a esercitarci e affinare i movimenti di flotta, noi lo abbiamo. Tornare dagli altri nella Coalizione, ora noi dobbiamo, quindi bisogno del tuo aiuto di nuovo, noi avremo. Aspettare su <planet>, noi lo faremo." Il messaggio finisce e il monitor torna alla normalità. Metti un segnaposto su <destination> per andare là più tardi a prendere i membri del Lunarium.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|name|1791|0
units.english: Homecoming
units.italian: Ritorno a casa

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|description|1792|0
units.english: Bring the <bunks> Lunarium members back to the Coalition, to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta i <bunks> membri del Lunarium nella Coalizione, a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|blocked|1795|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|Pyakri's fleet lands on the pads around the <ship>, and they message you saying they will wait for nightfall to board your ship. In the meantime, they focus on removing objects and tools and undoing adaptations to the ships that could give away their presence. Once the sun sets you notice them opening their hatches, so you open your own and help them quickly and quietly sneak into your ship. Perhaps because they'd grown used to human space, or maybe they simply did not care since they were going home for good, they proved a lot less cautious this time around, though you still don't imagine anyone saw them.|1805|0
units.english: Pyakri's fleet lands on the pads around the <ship>, and they message you saying they will wait for nightfall to board your ship. In the meantime, they focus on removing objects and tools and undoing adaptations to the ships that could give away their presence. Once the sun sets you notice them opening their hatches, so you open your own and help them quickly and quietly sneak into your ship. Perhaps because they'd grown used to human space, or maybe they simply did not care since they were going home for good, they proved a lot less cautious this time around, though you still don't imagine anyone saw them.
units.italian: La flotta di Pyakri atterra sulle piazzole intorno alla <ship>, e ti mandano un messaggio dicendo che aspetteranno il calare della notte per salire sulla tua nave. Nel frattempo si dedicano a rimuovere oggetti e attrezzi e a disfare le modifiche alle navi che potrebbero tradire la loro presenza. Quando il sole tramonta li vedi aprire i portelli, così apri il tuo e li aiuti a infilarsi in fretta e in silenzio nella tua nave. Forse perché si erano abituati allo spazio umano, o forse semplicemente perché non se ne curavano, dato che tornavano a casa per sempre, questa volta si sono dimostrati molto meno prudenti, anche se continui a non immaginare che qualcuno li abbia visti.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	Once everyone is in your ship, Pyakri approaches you and hands you some credit chips worth <payment> in total. "Try splitting the fleet into smaller ones for a while, we did, so taken some simpler, less rewarding bounties, we also have," she explains. "But, hopefully made enough to pay you for your services, we have."|1806|0
units.english: Once everyone is in your ship, Pyakri approaches you and hands you some credit chips worth <payment> in total. "Try splitting the fleet into smaller ones for a while, we did, so taken some simpler, less rewarding bounties, we also have," she explains. "But, hopefully made enough to pay you for your services, we have."
units.italian: Una volta che tutti sono nella tua nave, Pyakri ti si avvicina e ti consegna dei gettoni di credito per un valore totale di <payment>. "Provare a dividere la flotta in gruppi più piccoli per un po', noi lo abbiamo fatto, quindi preso anche alcune taglie più semplici e meno remunerative, noi abbiamo," spiega. "Ma, speriamo, guadagnato abbastanza per pagarti i tuoi servizi, noi abbiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	"Did you manage to fight the pirates well enough?"|1808|0
units.english: "Did you manage to fight the pirates well enough?"
units.italian: "Siete riusciti a combattere i pirati abbastanza bene?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	"Honestly I'm surprised you didn't lose anyone. Some of the ships you bought aren't exactly made for fighting."|1810|0
units.english: "Honestly I'm surprised you didn't lose anyone. Some of the ships you bought aren't exactly made for fighting."
units.italian: "Sinceramente sono sorpreso che non abbiate perso nessuno. Alcune delle navi che avete comprato non sono esattamente fatte per combattere."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	She clicks her mandibles quickly. "Neither are ours. Coalition ships, I mean. Of weaker materials, our civilian vessels are made, with less intricate shield matrices, less space for weaponry. With that knowledge, intentionally choose ships on the more fragile side for this training, I did. Focused on fighting heavier human ships, we were, to simulate that difference in durability and firepower," she explains. "Of course, with Heliarch ships, much greater the gap is, but a useful experience it has been regardless."|1811|0
units.english: She clicks her mandibles quickly. "Neither are ours. Coalition ships, I mean. Of weaker materials, our civilian vessels are made, with less intricate shield matrices, less space for weaponry. With that knowledge, intentionally choose ships on the more fragile side for this training, I did. Focused on fighting heavier human ships, we were, to simulate that difference in durability and firepower," she explains. "Of course, with Heliarch ships, much greater the gap is, but a useful experience it has been regardless."
units.italian: Schiocca le mandibole in fretta. "Neanche le nostre. Le navi della Coalizione, intendo. Di materiali più deboli, le nostre navi civili sono fatte, con matrici di scudi meno intricate, meno spazio per le armi. Con quella consapevolezza, scegliere di proposito navi sul lato più fragile per questo addestramento, io l'ho fatto. Concentrarci sul combattere navi umane più pesanti, noi lo abbiamo fatto, per simulare quella differenza di resistenza e potenza di fuoco," spiega. "Naturalmente, con le navi degli Heliarchs, molto più grande il divario è, ma un'esperienza utile è stata comunque."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	"Lie I will not, difficult the first few months were. Very used to the Coalition, to our equipment, we were, so forget we did many times that no hull repair capabilities of their own, the ships had." She passes her two front legs over her head a few times, as if brushing it in shame. "Lucky we were, that no casualties we had. At least, a good way to improvise mid-battle rescues, it all was." she finishes, perking up her head.|1814|0
units.english: "Lie I will not, difficult the first few months were. Very used to the Coalition, to our equipment, we were, so forget we did many times that no hull repair capabilities of their own, the ships had." She passes her two front legs over her head a few times, as if brushing it in shame. "Lucky we were, that no casualties we had. At least, a good way to improvise mid-battle rescues, it all was." she finishes, perking up her head.
units.italian: "Mentire io non lo farò, difficili i primi mesi sono stati. Molto abituati alla Coalizione, alle nostre attrezzature, noi eravamo, quindi dimenticare noi lo abbiamo fatto molte volte che nessuna capacità di riparazione dello scafo propria, le navi avevano." Passa le due zampe anteriori sulla testa più volte, come se la spazzasse per la vergogna. "Fortunati noi siamo stati, che nessuna perdita abbiamo avuto. Almeno, un buon modo per improvvisare soccorsi in battaglia, è stato tutto," conclude, sollevando la testa.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	You once again help them contact the local shipyard and arrange for the selling of their fleet. After the process is done and the workers have finished taking away the ships, Pyakri tells you that they're ready to head back to the Coalition, to <destination>, from where they'll head back to their respective bases and share their newfound experience with Lunarium recruits. You help Pyakri and the rest to their bunks, and set a course for <planet>.|1816|0
units.english: You once again help them contact the local shipyard and arrange for the selling of their fleet. After the process is done and the workers have finished taking away the ships, Pyakri tells you that they're ready to head back to the Coalition, to <destination>, from where they'll head back to their respective bases and share their newfound experience with Lunarium recruits. You help Pyakri and the rest to their bunks, and set a course for <planet>.
units.italian: Aiuti di nuovo a contattare il cantiere locale e a organizzare la vendita della loro flotta. Una volta concluso il procedimento e dopo che gli operai hanno portato via le navi, Pyakri ti dice che sono pronti a tornare nella Coalizione, a <destination>, da dove torneranno alle rispettive basi e condivideranno la nuova esperienza con le reclute del Lunarium. Aiuti Pyakri e gli altri a raggiungere le cuccette, e imposti una rotta per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|dialog|1821|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but your escort bringing Pyakri and the other Lunarium members hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for them.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta che porta Pyakri e gli altri membri del Lunarium non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|Shortly after you land, several groups come to meet some of the Lunarium members and escort them to their ships. They depart right away, while any remaining members leave straight for the city. "Gotten word of our return yet, the others have not, so wait here for more ships to bring them to the planet they normally operate from, they will," Pyakri explains.|1826|0
units.english: Shortly after you land, several groups come to meet some of the Lunarium members and escort them to their ships. They depart right away, while any remaining members leave straight for the city. "Gotten word of our return yet, the others have not, so wait here for more ships to bring them to the planet they normally operate from, they will," Pyakri explains.
units.italian: Poco dopo che sei atterrato, diversi gruppi vengono a incontrare alcuni dei membri del Lunarium e li scortano alle loro navi. Partono subito, mentre i membri rimasti si dirigono direttamente verso la città. "Ricevuto notizia del nostro ritorno, gli altri non lo hanno ancora, quindi aspettare qui altre navi che li portino al pianeta da cui operano normalmente, essi lo faranno," spiega Pyakri.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	"A great help you were, Captain. Train normally against each other as in drills, we cannot, as risk the Heliarchs finding us, it would. Not very useful either, since fighting ships weak like our own, we will not be." She looks out to the others, preparing to head into the city herself. "Aware I am that joined up with us, you have not, Captain. Your choice, it is, whether help us further you do, help the Heliarchs, or just leave and never return. Just, ask you I do, that think well about it before deciding, you must." With that, she says goodbye, and follows the others into the city.|1829|0
units.english: "A great help you were, Captain. Train normally against each other as in drills, we cannot, as risk the Heliarchs finding us, it would. Not very useful either, since fighting ships weak like our own, we will not be." She looks out to the others, preparing to head into the city herself. "Aware I am that joined up with us, you have not, Captain. Your choice, it is, whether help us further you do, help the Heliarchs, or just leave and never return. Just, ask you I do, that think well about it before deciding, you must." With that, she says goodbye, and follows the others into the city.
units.italian: "Un grande aiuto sei stato, Capitano. Addestrarci normalmente gli uni contro gli altri come nelle esercitazioni, noi non possiamo, perché rischiare che gli Heliarchs ci trovino, lo farebbe. Nemmeno molto utile, dato che combattere navi deboli come le nostre, noi non lo faremo." Guarda verso gli altri, preparandosi a entrare in città anche lei. "Consapevole io sono che unito a noi, tu non lo sei, Capitano. Una tua scelta è, se aiutarci ancora tu lo farai, aiutare gli Heliarchs, o semplicemente andartene e non tornare mai più. Solo, chiederti io lo faccio, che pensarci bene prima di decidere, tu devi." Detto questo, ti saluta e segue gli altri in città.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Combat Training 4|	"Lucky we are that joined us, you have, Captain <last>. Wanted for years to try some tactics in real combat, I had, but of course, do it here without risking our whole operation, we could not. Hope I do that boost the confidence of our lower ranks, the recent experience we gained will." She asks you to be careful in your travels, and says goodbye, following the others into the city.|1832|0
units.english: "Lucky we are that joined us, you have, Captain <last>. Wanted for years to try some tactics in real combat, I had, but of course, do it here without risking our whole operation, we could not. Hope I do that boost the confidence of our lower ranks, the recent experience we gained will." She asks you to be careful in your travels, and says goodbye, following the others into the city.
units.italian: "Fortunati noi siamo che unito a noi, tu lo sei, Capitano <last>. Voluto per anni provare alcune tattiche in combattimento reale, io lo avevo, ma naturalmente, farlo qui senza rischiare tutta la nostra operazione, noi non potevamo. Sperare io spero che aumenti la fiducia dei nostri ranghi inferiori, l'esperienza che abbiamo appena acquisito lo farà." Ti chiede di fare attenzione nei tuoi viaggi, e ti saluta, seguendo gli altri in città.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Questions|name|1839|0
units.english: Lunarium Meeting
units.italian: Riunione del Lunarium

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Questions|description|1840|0
units.english: Now that you've further helped the Lunarium, head to <destination>, where you were invited to meet with their leaders, who have a special task in mind for you.
units.italian: Ora che hai aiutato ancora il Lunarium, recati a <destination>, dove sei stato invitato a incontrare i loro leader, che hanno in mente un compito speciale per te.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Questions|As you prepare to land on <origin>, your monitor starts producing a low hum, stops, then starts again. This keeps up for nearly a minute until a message pops up. "Captain <last>, come to trust you our comrades have, thanks to your consistent help to our cause. Interested we are in your continuous support, so that free the Coalition, together we can. Come to <destination> you must. Meet with you, our leaders will, so that discuss an important task with them, you may. Have an available bunk in your ship, you should."|1869|0
units.english: As you prepare to land on <origin>, your monitor starts producing a low hum, stops, then starts again. This keeps up for nearly a minute until a message pops up. "Captain <last>, come to trust you our comrades have, thanks to your consistent help to our cause. Interested we are in your continuous support, so that free the Coalition, together we can. Come to <destination> you must. Meet with you, our leaders will, so that discuss an important task with them, you may. Have an available bunk in your ship, you should."
units.italian: Mentre ti prepari ad atterrare su <origin>, il monitor comincia a produrre un ronzio basso, si ferma, poi riprende. Va avanti così per quasi un minuto, finché non compare un messaggio. "Capitano <last>, arrivati a fidarsi di te i nostri compagni sono, grazie al tuo costante aiuto alla nostra causa. Interessati noi siamo al tuo continuo sostegno, così che liberare la Coalizione, insieme noi possiamo. Venire a <destination> tu devi. Incontrarti, i nostri leader lo faranno, così che discutere con loro un compito importante, tu potrai. Avere una cuccetta disponibile nella tua nave, tu dovresti."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Questions|	The message cuts off shortly after you finish reading it. Your monitor is back to normal, and no humming sound can be heard. You mark <planet> on your map.|1870|0
units.english: The message cuts off shortly after you finish reading it. Your monitor is back to normal, and no humming sound can be heard. You mark <planet> on your map.
units.italian: Il messaggio si interrompe poco dopo che hai finito di leggerlo. Il monitor è tornato alla normalità, e non si sente più alcun ronzio. Segni <planet> sulla mappa.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Questions|dialog|1873|0
units.english: You are currently assisting the Heliarchy. Cancel or finish any missions you have for them if you want to join the Lunarium.
units.italian: Stai attualmente assistendo l'Eliarchia. Annulla o completa le missioni che hai per loro se vuoi unirti al Lunarium.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|name|1876|0
units.english: The Interview
units.italian: L'intervista

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|description|1877|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> with Oobat, an Arach diplomat from the Lunarium, to try and speak with the Quarg about their thoughts on the current Coalition.
units.italian: Viaggia fino a <destination> con Oobat, una diplomatica Arach del Lunarium, per cercare di parlare con i Quarg e sapere che cosa pensano della Coalizione attuale.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|blocked|1880|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|Here on <origin>, the Lunarium leaders are waiting for you. Would you like to meet with them and officially join the Lunarium? Given their cause against the Heliarchs, this would no doubt set you on a path to conflict with the Heliarchy.|1889|0
units.english: Here on <origin>, the Lunarium leaders are waiting for you. Would you like to meet with them and officially join the Lunarium? Given their cause against the Heliarchs, this would no doubt set you on a path to conflict with the Heliarchy.
units.italian: Qui su <origin> i leader del Lunarium ti stanno aspettando. Vuoi incontrarli e unirti ufficialmente al Lunarium? Data la loro causa contro gli Heliarchs, questo ti metterebbe senza dubbio su un cammino di conflitto con l'Eliarchia.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	(Yes.)|1891|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	(Not yet.)|1892|0
units.english: (Not yet.)
units.italian: (Non ancora.)

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	(No. I don't want to support the Lunarium at all.)|1894|0
units.english: (No. I don't want to support the Lunarium at all.)
units.italian: (No. Non voglio sostenere il Lunarium in alcun modo.)

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	You leave your ship to find a pair of Kimek waiting for you. "Follow us to the meeting point, you will," one of them says, and you oblige, trying to keep a low profile as you go with them across the city. You reach a district near the center of town, with modest blocks and few skyscrapers, and head into what seems to be a Kimek restaurant. You continue following the two Kimek past busy tables and Kimek patrons who all have eyes on you as you head to the back.|1896|0
units.english: You leave your ship to find a pair of Kimek waiting for you. "Follow us to the meeting point, you will," one of them says, and you oblige, trying to keep a low profile as you go with them across the city. You reach a district near the center of town, with modest blocks and few skyscrapers, and head into what seems to be a Kimek restaurant. You continue following the two Kimek past busy tables and Kimek patrons who all have eyes on you as you head to the back.
units.italian: Scendi dalla nave e trovi due Kimek che ti aspettano. "Seguirci fino al punto d'incontro, tu dovrai," dice uno di loro, e tu acconsenti, cercando di passare inosservato mentre li segui per la città. Arrivi a un quartiere vicino al centro, con palazzi modesti e pochi grattacieli, ed entri in quello che sembra un ristorante Kimek. Continui a seguire i due Kimek oltre i tavoli affollati e i clienti Kimek che hanno tutti gli occhi su di te mentre vai verso il fondo.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	Taking an elevator, you move down a few levels. You arrive at some doors that open to an Arach delegation, with half a dozen bulky Arachi surrounding a young, fine-dressed lady in a blue "dress" with white lines wrapping around it. "Oh, finally arrived, have they?" she says as you step off the elevator, coming to meet you. "<first> <last>, is it? So intrigued by our most recent recruit, I was, that decide I did to come to this meeting for once. Lady Lobmab Bebliss, I am, head of our great house, and benefactor to the Lunarium." She steps one leg forward towards you, as if in some archaic Arach gesture. Unsure on how to respond, you do your best extravagant bow, which seems to satisfy her as she pulls her leg back closer to her body. "Confess I must, however, that most inconvenient it is, to come so far away while maintaining a low profile. Difficult to just disappear, it is, when the head of the greatest Arach House, you are. Hope I do that worth it, your contributions are."|1897|0
units.english: Taking an elevator, you move down a few levels. You arrive at some doors that open to an Arach delegation, with half a dozen bulky Arachi surrounding a young, fine-dressed lady in a blue "dress" with white lines wrapping around it. "Oh, finally arrived, have they?" she says as you step off the elevator, coming to meet you. "<first> <last>, is it?
