So intrigued by our most recent recruit, I was, that decide I did to come to this meeting for once. Lady Lobmab Bebliss, I am, head of our great house, and benefactor to the Lunarium." She steps one leg forward towards you, as if in some archaic Arach gesture. Unsure on how to respond, you do your best extravagant bow, which seems to satisfy her as she pulls her leg back closer to her body. "Confess I must, however, that most inconvenient it is, to come so far away while maintaining a low profile. Difficult to just disappear, it is, when the head of the greatest Arach House, you are. Hope I do that worth it, your contributions are."
units.italian: Prendi un ascensore e scendi di alcuni piani. Arrivi a delle porte che si aprono su una delegazione Arach, con una mezza dozzina di Arachi massicci intorno a una giovane signora vestita con eleganza in un "abito" blu con linee bianche che lo avvolgono. "Oh, finalmente sono arrivati?" dice mentre scendi dall'ascensore, venendoti incontro. "<first> <last>, giusto? Così incuriosita dal nostro più recente recluta, io ero, che decidere io ho deciso di venire a questa riunione, per una volta. Lady Lobmab Bebliss, io sono, capo della nostra grande casata, e benefattrice del Lunarium." Fa un passo avanti con una zampa verso di te, come in un qualche arcaico gesto Arach. Incerto su come rispondere, fai del tuo meglio con un inchino stravagante, che sembra soddisfarla mentre ritrae la zampa più vicino al corpo. "Confessare io devo, però, che molto scomodo è, venire così lontano mantenendo un profilo basso. Difficile sparire e basta, è, quando il capo della più grande Casata Arach, tu sei. Sperare io spero che ne valga la pena, i tuoi contributi lo siano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"I'll do what I can to help."|1899|0
units.english: "I'll do what I can to help."
units.italian: "Farò quello che posso per aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"It sounds like you've contributed much to the Lunarium cause. How have you helped the resistance?"|1901|0
units.english: "It sounds like you've contributed much to the Lunarium cause. How have you helped the resistance?"
units.italian: "Sembra che tu abbia contribuito molto alla causa del Lunarium. In che modo hai aiutato la resistenza?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Yes, well observed. Kept the Lunarium Redoubt safe from prying Heliarch eyes and ears, my house has. Under me, assured it is that found by them, no dealings of ours - no dealings involving you - are," she says in a smug tone.|1902|0
units.english: "Yes, well observed. Kept the Lunarium Redoubt safe from prying Heliarch eyes and ears, my house has. Under me, assured it is that found by them, no dealings of ours - no dealings involving you - are," she says in a smug tone.
units.italian: "Sì, ben osservato. Tenere il Lunarium Redoubt al sicuro da occhi e orecchie indiscreti degli Heliarchs, la mia casata lo ha fatto. Sotto di me, assicurato è che trovati da loro, nessuno dei nostri affari - nessun affare che coinvolga te - sia," dice con tono compiaciuto.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	The Kimek who accompanied you here ask that you continue on. Lobmab and her bodyguards lead the way through busy cubicles and hallways, where dozens of Kimek work at computers and screens, as if monitoring the whole city. At the end of what seems to be the main passage of the complex, you pass through a doorway to find the Lunarium leaders seated around a table. You're shown to a seat, and as Lobmab comes in at the end, one of the bodyguards announces, "Lady Lobmab Bebliss, head of our great House."|1904|0
units.english: The Kimek who accompanied you here ask that you continue on. Lobmab and her bodyguards lead the way through busy cubicles and hallways, where dozens of Kimek work at computers and screens, as if monitoring the whole city. At the end of what seems to be the main passage of the complex, you pass through a doorway to find the Lunarium leaders seated around a table. You're shown to a seat, and as Lobmab comes in at the end, one of the bodyguards announces, "Lady Lobmab Bebliss, head of our great House."
units.italian: I Kimek che ti hanno accompagnato qui ti chiedono di proseguire. Lobmab e le sue guardie del corpo aprono la strada attraverso cubicoli e corridoi affollati, dove dozzine di Kimek lavorano a computer e schermi, come se stessero monitorando l'intera città. Alla fine di quello che sembra il passaggio principale del complesso, attraversi una porta e trovi i leader del Lunarium seduti intorno a un tavolo. Ti indicano un posto, e quando Lobmab entra per ultima, una delle guardie del corpo annuncia: "Lady Lobmab Bebliss, capo della nostra grande Casata."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	Some of the others at the table look to one another, and one of the Kimek who accompanied you all the way from your ship sighs quietly before coming to Lobmab. "Most welcome you are, Lady Lobmab," he says, as he begins pointing to the leaders one by one, starting from your left with a Kimek. "Your host, Chiree is, the head of our local forces and organizer of many of our operations. Fought the Heliarchs since a young age, she has." He continues pointing to them in a clockwise pattern, now to the left of Chiree. "Likewise, been helping us for decades now, Tummug has, in spreading word of our group, and bringing to the people the truth about the Heliarchy. Another prominent Arach, and vital to the task soon to be discussed, Oobat is. A studious linguist, and aspiring diplomat, she is. Already worked together, I believe you and Pyakri have? One of our most senior militia officers, she is." He takes a pause, looking at Lobmab, almost as if waiting for some approval regarding his introductions of the others. She simply nods, and he moves on. "And... Elirom. A prominent Saryd Heliarch Arbiter who defected over a century ago. Been advising us since, he has." He waits for her to say something, before looking back at the table again and pointing to you. "Oh, of course. <first> <last>, the human, helped us greatly who has, and joining us today, who is."|1905|0
units.english: Some of the others at the table look to one another, and one of the Kimek who accompanied you all the way from your ship sighs quietly before coming to Lobmab. "Most welcome you are, Lady Lobmab," he says, as he begins pointing to the leaders one by one, starting from your left with a Kimek. "Your host, Chiree is, the head of our local forces and organizer of many of our operations. Fought the Heliarchs since a young age, she has." He continues pointing to them in a clockwise pattern, now to the left of Chiree. "Likewise, been helping us for decades now, Tummug has, in spreading word of our group, and bringing to the people the truth about the Heliarchy. Another prominent Arach, and vital to the task soon to be discussed, Oobat is. A studious linguist, and aspiring diplomat, she is. Already worked together, I believe you and Pyakri have? One of our most senior militia officers, she is." He takes a pause, looking at Lobmab, almost as if waiting for some approval regarding his introductions of the others. She simply nods, and he moves on. "And... Elirom. A prominent Saryd Heliarch Arbiter who defected over a century ago. Been advising us since, he has." He waits for her to say something, before looking back at the table again and pointing to you. "Oh, of course. <first> <last>, the human, helped us greatly who has, and joining us today, who is."
units.italian: Alcuni degli altri al tavolo si guardano tra loro, e uno dei Kimek che ti ha accompagnato fin dalla nave sospira piano prima di avvicinarsi a Lobmab. "La più benvenuta, Lady Lobmab," dice, cominciando a indicare i leader uno per uno, partendo alla tua sinistra con un Kimek. "La tua ospite, Chiree è, a capo delle nostre forze locali e organizzatrice di molte delle nostre operazioni. Combattuto gli Heliarchs fin da giovane, lei lo ha." Continua a indicarli in senso orario, ora alla sinistra di Chiree. "Allo stesso modo, aiutarci da decenni ormai, Tummug lo ha fatto, nel diffondere la notizia del nostro gruppo e nel portare alla gente la verità sull'Eliarchia. Un'altra Arach di rilievo, e vitale per il compito di cui parleremo presto, Oobat è. Una linguista studiosa e aspirante diplomatica, lei è. Già lavorato insieme, credo, tu e Pyakri lo avete fatto? Uno dei nostri ufficiali di milizia più anziani, lei è." Fa una pausa, guardando Lobmab, quasi come se aspettasse un qualche assenso sulle sue presentazioni degli altri. Lei si limita a fare un cenno, e lui prosegue. "E... Elirom. Un importante Arbitro degli Heliarchs, Saryd, che ha disertato oltre un secolo fa. Consigliarci da allora, lui lo ha fatto." Aspetta che lei dica qualcosa, poi torna a guardare il tavolo e indica te. "Oh, certo. <first> <last>, l'umano, che ci ha aiutato moltissimo, e che oggi si unisce a noi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	Satisfied with the introductions, Lobmab takes her seat, much to the Kimek's relief. "Very grateful we are, that made the time for this meeting you have, Lady Lobmab," Chiree says. "A special task for Captain <last>, we have, and wish to have all leaders present to discuss it, we did. But, first, welcome our newest member, we must," she says, looking at you. "Any questions for us have you, Captain?"|1906|0
units.english: Satisfied with the introductions, Lobmab takes her seat, much to the Kimek's relief. "Very grateful we are, that made the time for this meeting you have, Lady Lobmab," Chiree says. "A special task for Captain <last>, we have, and wish to have all leaders present to discuss it, we did. But, first, welcome our newest member, we must," she says, looking at you. "Any questions for us have you, Captain?"
units.italian: Soddisfatta delle presentazioni, Lobmab prende posto, con grande sollievo del Kimek. "Molto grati noi siamo, che trovato il tempo per questa riunione tu abbia, Lady Lobmab," dice Chiree. "Un compito speciale per il Capitano <last>, noi abbiamo, e desideravamo avere tutti i leader presenti per discuterne, noi volevamo. Ma, prima, accogliere il nostro nuovo membro, noi dobbiamo," dice, guardando te. "Domande da farci, ne hai, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"What are you all going to do if you do manage to take down the Heliarchs?"|1909|0
units.english: "What are you all going to do if you do manage to take down the Heliarchs?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farete tutti quanti se riuscirete davvero ad abbattere gli Heliarchs?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"You'll need to fight the Heliarchs at some point. Are you capable of doing that?"|1912|0
units.english: "You'll need to fight the Heliarchs at some point. Are you capable of doing that?"
units.italian: "A un certo punto dovrete combattere gli Heliarchs. Ne siete capaci?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Am I the only outsider helping you?"|1916|0
units.english: "Am I the only outsider helping you?"
units.italian: "Sono l'unico esterno che vi aiuta?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"How do you pay for all this?"|1920|0
units.english: "How do you pay for all this?"
units.italian: "Come pagate tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"I'm fine for now. What about this task you need me for?"|1924|0
units.english: "I'm fine for now. What about this task you need me for?"
units.italian: "Per ora mi va bene così. E il compito per cui vi servo?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Rebuild, first we will need to," Chiree responds. "Fight tooth and nail to remain in power, they will, so a great deal of damage to the Coalition, we expect."|1928|0
units.english: "Rebuild, first we will need to," Chiree responds. "Fight tooth and nail to remain in power, they will, so a great deal of damage to the Coalition, we expect."
units.italian: "Ricostruire, prima noi dovremo," risponde Chiree. "Combattere con le unghie e con i denti per restare al potere, essi lo faranno, quindi molti danni alla Coalizione, noi ci aspettiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Once back in order, everything is, focus on reassuring the populace we should. A change for the better, it will be, and help in making sure everyone realizes that, House Bebliss will," Lobmab jumps in. "Earn back what they took from us, we will."|1929|0
units.english: "Once back in order, everything is, focus on reassuring the populace we should. A change for the better, it will be, and help in making sure everyone realizes that, House Bebliss will," Lobmab jumps in. "Earn back what they took from us, we will."
units.italian: "Una volta che tutto è tornato in ordine, concentrarci sul rassicurare la popolazione noi dovremmo. Un cambiamento in meglio, sarà, e aiutare ad assicurarsi che tutti se ne rendano conto, Casa Bebliss lo farà," interviene Lobmab. "Recuperare ciò che ci hanno tolto, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	Once the head of House Bebliss is done, Chiree continues. "Pointless, our fight will have been, if corrupted in those rings again, our successors thousands of years from now become. Set up transparency measures and means to ensure that absolute power, the consuls do not have, we will."|1930|0
units.english: Once the head of House Bebliss is done, Chiree continues. "Pointless, our fight will have been, if corrupted in those rings again, our successors thousands of years from now become. Set up transparency measures and means to ensure that absolute power, the consuls do not have, we will."
units.italian: Quando la capo di Casa Bebliss ha finito, Chiree continua. "Inutile, la nostra lotta sarà stata, se nei loro anelli tornano corrotti, i nostri successori tra migliaia di anni. Stabilire misure di trasparenza e mezzi per assicurare che il potere assoluto, i consoli non lo abbiano, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Try and fool you, I will not. At a tremendous disadvantage, to say the least, we are," Pyakri answers. "Weaker, our ships are, and far less powerful weapons, we boast. Mostly human designs. Due to being simpler, easier to produce in what factories we have, they are. Also lack experience, the troops do..."|1935|0
units.english: "Try and fool you, I will not. At a tremendous disadvantage, to say the least, we are," Pyakri answers. "Weaker, our ships are, and far less powerful weapons, we boast. Mostly human designs. Due to being simpler, easier to produce in what factories we have, they are. Also lack experience, the troops do..."
units.italian: "Prenderti in giro, io non lo farò. In uno svantaggio tremendo, a dir poco, noi siamo," risponde Pyakri. "Più deboli, le nostre navi sono, e armi molto meno potenti, noi vantiamo. Per lo più progetti umani. Perché più semplici, più facili da produrre nelle fabbriche che abbiamo, essi sono. Anche mancare di esperienza, le truppe lo fanno..."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	The mood around the table quickly dims as she goes on listing the ways the Lunarium is lacking in comparison to your opponents. Elirom stands up, putting both hands on the table to draw attention. "Smarter than us, they are not. Assure you of that, I can. Wanting in many areas we are, yes, but only because hoard our best materials, they do. Already preparing some deadlier weapons, we are. Finished, the blueprints have been. Only lacking the right materials, we are. When secured those, we have, move on to reforming our arsenal we can, and maybe get some better ships produced, too."|1936|0
units.english: The mood around the table quickly dims as she goes on listing the ways the Lunarium is lacking in comparison to your opponents. Elirom stands up, putting both hands on the table to draw attention. "Smarter than us, they are not. Assure you of that, I can. Wanting in many areas we are, yes, but only because hoard our best materials, they do. Already preparing some deadlier weapons, we are. Finished, the blueprints have been. Only lacking the right materials, we are. When secured those, we have, move on to reforming our arsenal we can, and maybe get some better ships produced, too."
units.italian: L'atmosfera intorno al tavolo si spegne in fretta mentre lei continua a elencare i modi in cui il Lunarium è carente rispetto agli avversari. Elirom si alza, appoggiando entrambe le mani sul tavolo per attirare l'attenzione. "Più intelligenti di noi, loro non lo sono. Assicurartelo, io posso. Carenti in molti settori noi siamo, sì, ma solo perché accumulano i loro materiali migliori, loro lo fanno. Già preparare alcune armi più letali, noi stiamo. Finiti, i progetti sono. Solo i materiali giusti ci mancano. Quando procurare quelli che li avremo, passare a riformare il nostro arsenale noi potremo, e magari far produrre anche qualche nave migliore."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"And suppose I do that, intend to tell me where to attack for such materials, you do?" Pyakri asks as she stands up herself. "Caught by 'the unforeseen' will my men again be? By an Arach battalion you forgot to mention, again?"|1937|0
units.english: "And suppose I do that, intend to tell me where to attack for such materials, you do?" Pyakri asks as she stands up herself. "Caught by 'the unforeseen' will my men again be? By an Arach battalion you forgot to mention, again?"
units.italian: "E supponendo che lo faccia, hai intenzione di dirmi dove attaccare per procurarti quei materiali?" chiede Pyakri alzandosi a sua volta. "Colti di nuovo dall'imprevisto, i miei uomini? Da un battaglione Arach che hai dimenticato di menzionare, ancora una volta?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	Caught off-guard by the question, apparently, Elirom looks at her for a few seconds, then resigns himself to sit back down.|1938|0
units.english: Caught off-guard by the question, apparently, Elirom looks at her for a few seconds, then resigns himself to sit back down.
units.italian: Colto alla sprovvista dalla domanda, a quanto pare, Elirom la guarda per qualche secondo, poi si rassegna a rimettersi a sedere.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	For a few seconds, they simply exchange looks at your question, until Lobmab speaks up. "Transmissions and messages from some source, Bebliss has received for centuries now. Told us they have of Heliarch activity, fleet movements, training drills, propaganda plans. Always exactly right in their predictions, the messages were. Also pointed us to equipment caches - caches with outfits previously found nowhere in the Coalition - they have. Human weaponry, blueprints, factory parts..."|1943|0
units.english: For a few seconds, they simply exchange looks at your question, until Lobmab speaks up. "Transmissions and messages from some source, Bebliss has received for centuries now. Told us they have of Heliarch activity, fleet movements, training drills, propaganda plans. Always exactly right in their predictions, the messages were. Also pointed us to equipment caches - caches with outfits previously found nowhere in the Coalition - they have. Human weaponry, blueprints, factory parts..."
units.italian: Per qualche secondo si scambiano solo sguardi alla tua domanda, finché Lobmab prende la parola. "Trasmissioni e messaggi da qualche fonte, Bebliss ha ricevuto per secoli ormai. Informato noi hanno di attività degli Heliarchs, movimenti di flotte, esercitazioni, piani di propaganda. Sempre esatte nelle loro previsioni, le informazioni erano. Ci hanno anche indicato depositi di attrezzature - depositi con equipaggiamenti che prima non si trovavano da nessuna parte nella Coalizione. Armi umane, progetti, pezzi di fabbrica..."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Aware of the identity of whoever does it, we are not," Elirom says. "An arbiter I was, and though a great deal I knew, still kept from me, some critical information was. Possible, it is, that from one of the consuls, the information comes. Though, difficult to steal a jump drive to bring in the weapons, it would be, even for a consul." He pauses, a dead stare in his eyes as he bites lightly on a finger. "Also received word of... experiments, we have from the messages. Some manner of procedure to take over bodies... stop whatever it is being done in the rings, we must."|1944|0
units.english: "Aware of the identity of whoever does it, we are not," Elirom says. "An arbiter I was, and though a great deal I knew, still kept from me, some critical information was. Possible, it is, that from one of the consuls, the information comes. Though, difficult to steal a jump drive to bring in the weapons, it would be, even for a consul." He pauses, a dead stare in his eyes as he bites lightly on a finger. "Also received word of... experiments, we have from the messages. Some manner of procedure to take over bodies... stop whatever it is being done in the rings, we must."
units.italian: "Consapevoli dell'identità di chi lo fa, noi non siamo," dice Elirom. "Un arbitro io ero, e anche se molto sapevo, ancora tenute nascoste da me, alcune informazioni critiche erano. Possibile è, che da uno dei consoli, le informazioni arrivino. Anche se, difficile rubare un motore di salto per portare le armi, sarebbe, persino per un console." Fa una pausa, lo sguardo fisso e vuoto mentre si morde leggermente un dito. "Ricevuto anche notizia di... esperimenti, noi abbiamo dai messaggi. Una qualche procedura per prendere il controllo dei corpi... fermare qualunque cosa si stia facendo negli anelli, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	The rest of the table look to Lobmab at the same time, prompting her explanation. "Amassed great fortune over our history, House Bebliss has. As part of our gracious help to the Lunarium, providing nearly everything in financial terms we have been."|1949|0
units.english: The rest of the table look to Lobmab at the same time, prompting her explanation. "Amassed great fortune over our history, House Bebliss has. As part of our gracious help to the Lunarium, providing nearly everything in financial terms we have been."
units.italian: Il resto del tavolo guarda Lobmab nello stesso momento, sollecitandola a spiegare. "Accumulato una grande fortuna nel corso della nostra storia, Casa Bebliss lo ha fatto. Come parte del nostro generoso aiuto al Lunarium, fornire quasi tutto in termini finanziari, noi lo abbiamo fatto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	She stops, with the others still looking at her, as if expecting something more. She remains silent, so Chiree looks back at you, continuing, "Also taken some loans from House Plumtab in our stead, Houses Bebliss and Idriss have. Not terribly passionate for our cause, Plumtab's bankers are, but share our interest in booting the Heliarchs, they do, even if meet or talk with us, they never do."|1950|0
units.english: She stops, with the others still looking at her, as if expecting something more. She remains silent, so Chiree looks back at you, continuing, "Also taken some loans from House Plumtab in our stead, Houses Bebliss and Idriss have. Not terribly passionate for our cause, Plumtab's bankers are, but share our interest in booting the Heliarchs, they do, even if meet or talk with us, they never do."
units.italian: Si ferma, con gli altri che continuano a guardarla come se si aspettassero qualcos'altro. Resta in silenzio, così Chiree torna a guardare te e continua: "Preso anche alcuni prestiti dalla Casa Plumtab al nostro posto, Casa Bebliss e Casa Idriss lo hanno fatto. Non terribilmente appassionati alla nostra causa, i banchieri di Plumtab sono, ma condividono il nostro interesse a cacciare gli Heliarchs, essi lo fanno, anche se incontrarci o parlarci, non lo fanno mai."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	Tummug goes around the table, handing copies of some documents to the other leaders before answering. "One of the centerpoints of Heliarch propaganda, the fear of the Quarg is. Served to justify their budget, and their obsession with hoarding the military, for millennia it has. Thought up a way to mitigate the effect that has on the populace, Oobat has."|1958|0
units.english: Tummug goes around the table, handing copies of some documents to the other leaders before answering. "One of the centerpoints of Heliarch propaganda, the fear of the Quarg is. Served to justify their budget, and their obsession with hoarding the military, for millennia it has. Thought up a way to mitigate the effect that has on the populace, Oobat has."
units.italian: Tummug fa il giro del tavolo, consegnando copie di alcuni documenti agli altri leader prima di rispondere. "Uno dei punti centrali della propaganda degli Heliarchs, la paura dei Quarg è. Servita a giustificare il loro bilancio e la loro ossessione di accumulare l'esercito, per millenni lo ha. Escogitato un modo per attenuare l'effetto che questo ha sulla popolazione, Oobat lo ha."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	With this cue, Oobat goes further into the plan. "Not seen in Coalition space in over six thousand years, a Quarg ship has been. Most likely moved on from our war, they have, unlike the Heliarchs. If proof of the Quarg's lack of interest in waging war against us, we had, spread it to the people, we could. Given the Captain's resourcefulness, and possession of a jump drive, think we did that the best way to acquire that proof, meeting up with the Quarg is." She grabs one of the documents, pointing to it. "For you all to review these questions, I would like. Careful we should be, with regard to their wording. Once done, we are, board Captain <last>'s ship, I will. Meet with the Quarg in human space, we must," she says the last part looking at you. "Met with the Quarg before, have you, Captain?"|1959|0
units.english: With this cue, Oobat goes further into the plan. "Not seen in Coalition space in over six thousand years, a Quarg ship has been. Most likely moved on from our war, they have, unlike the Heliarchs. If proof of the Quarg's lack of interest in waging war against us, we had, spread it to the people, we could. Given the Captain's resourcefulness, and possession of a jump drive, think we did that the best way to acquire that proof, meeting up with the Quarg is." She grabs one of the documents, pointing to it. "For you all to review these questions, I would like. Careful we should be, with regard to their wording. Once done, we are, board Captain <last>'s ship, I will. Meet with the Quarg in human space, we must," she says the last part looking at you. "Met with the Quarg before, have you, Captain?"
units.italian: Con questo segnale, Oobat entra più nel dettaglio del piano. "Non viste nello spazio della Coalizione da oltre seimila anni, una nave dei Quarg non lo è stata. Molto probabilmente andati oltre la nostra guerra, loro lo sono, a differenza degli Heliarchs. Se prova del disinteresse dei Quarg a farci guerra, noi avessimo, diffonderla tra la gente, noi potremmo. Data l'intraprendenza del Capitano, e il possesso di un motore di salto, pensato abbiamo che il modo migliore per ottenere quella prova, incontrarsi con i Quarg sia." Prende uno dei documenti e lo indica. "Che li rivediate tutti voi, queste domande, io vorrei. Attenti noi dovremmo essere, quanto alla loro formulazione. Una volta fatto, noi avremo, salire sulla nave del Capitano <last>, io lo farò. Incontrarci con i Quarg nello spazio umano, noi dobbiamo," dice quest'ultima parte guardando te. "Incontrato i Quarg prima, tu li hai, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"No, sorry. I never had the time to visit one of their worlds or rings."|1963|0
units.english: "No, sorry. I never had the time to visit one of their worlds or rings."
units.italian: "No, mi dispiace. Non ho mai avuto il tempo di visitare uno dei loro mondi o dei loro anelli."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"I've only seen them in pictures and videos."|1964|0
units.english: "I've only seen them in pictures and videos."
units.italian: "Li ho visti solo in immagini e video."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Ah, a shame that is. Well, I suppose a first time for the both of us, this trip will be."|1965|0
units.english: "Ah, a shame that is. Well, I suppose a first time for the both of us, this trip will be."
units.italian: "Ah, un peccato è. Beh, suppongo che una prima volta per entrambi, questo viaggio sarà."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|label|1967|0
units.english: met quarg
units.italian: met quarg

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Yes. They can be a bit odd, but they've always treated me well."|1969|0
units.english: "Yes. They can be a bit odd, but they've always treated me well."
units.italian: "Sì. Possono essere un po' strani, ma mi hanno sempre trattato bene."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Yes, sadly. They're obnoxious and condescending."|1970|0
units.english: "Yes, sadly. They're obnoxious and condescending."
units.italian: "Sì, purtroppo. Sono insopportabili e altezzosi."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Good to hear, that is. Hope I do that willing to extend that treatment to me, they are."|1972|0
units.english: "Good to hear, that is. Hope I do that willing to extend that treatment to me, they are."
units.italian: "Bello sentirlo, questo è. Sperare io spero che disposti a estendere quel trattamento a me, loro siano."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|label|1974|0
units.english: quarg bad
units.italian: quarg bad

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	The table puts the documents away in unison, looking at you after your answer. "I see... well, at least cooperate for the interview, we can hope they will."|1975|0
units.english: The table puts the documents away in unison, looking at you after your answer. "I see... well, at least cooperate for the interview, we can hope they will."
units.italian: Il tavolo mette via i documenti all'unisono, guardandoti dopo la tua risposta. "Capisco... beh, almeno sperare che collaborino per l'intervista, noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	The Lunarium leaders spend an hour or so going over the questions proposed for the interview, deciding to ditch some, and add a few new ones. All the while, Elirom asks in a worried manner if Oobat is sure of this idea. "Forgive me if sounding like a Heliarch, I am, but dangerous to leave, it is. Know we do not, the Quarg reaction to seeing someone from the Coalition in their territory."|1977|0
units.english: The Lunarium leaders spend an hour or so going over the questions proposed for the interview, deciding to ditch some, and add a few new ones. All the while, Elirom asks in a worried manner if Oobat is sure of this idea. "Forgive me if sounding like a Heliarch, I am, but dangerous to leave, it is. Know we do not, the Quarg reaction to seeing someone from the Coalition in their territory."
units.italian: I leader del Lunarium passano circa un'ora a rivedere le domande proposte per l'intervista, decidendo di scartarne alcune e di aggiungerne altre. Per tutto il tempo, Elirom chiede in modo preoccupato se Oobat sia sicura di questa idea. "Perdonarmi se sembro un Heliarch, io devo, ma pericoloso uscire, è. Non sappiamo, noi, la reazione dei Quarg nel vedere qualcuno della Coalizione nel loro territorio."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|	"Understand that, I do, but fine I will be. Unlike the Quarg it is, to attack unprovoked," she answers. "And if bad comes to worst, trust I do in Captain <last>'s abilities to ensure our escape." The leaders go over the interview questions a while longer, until they've reached a consensus as to its completeness. They wish you and Oobat good luck, and you both are escorted back out of the complex to your ship. There, Oobat asks you for the best place for such an interview in human space, and you point to <destination>, where the Quarg are constructing their ringworld. "Then head there, we must. In your care I will be, Captain." You show her to her bunk, and plot a course to <planet>.|1978|0
units.english: "Understand that, I do, but fine I will be. Unlike the Quarg it is, to attack unprovoked," she answers. "And if bad comes to worst, trust I do in Captain <last>'s abilities to ensure our escape." The leaders go over the interview questions a while longer, until they've reached a consensus as to its completeness. They wish you and Oobat good luck, and you both are escorted back out of the complex to your ship. There, Oobat asks you for the best place for such an interview in human space, and you point to <destination>, where the Quarg are constructing their ringworld. "Then head there, we must. In your care I will be, Captain." You show her to her bunk, and plot a course to <planet>.
units.italian: "Capirlo, io lo capisco, ma bene io starò. Diverso dai Quarg, è, attaccare senza provocazione," risponde. "E se si arriva al peggio, fidarmi io mi fido delle capacità del Capitano <last> di assicurare la nostra fuga." I leader rivedono le domande dell'intervista ancora un po', finché non raggiungono un consenso sulla loro completezza. Augurano buona fortuna a te e a Oobat, e venite entrambi riaccompagnati fuori dal complesso fino alla nave. Lì Oobat ti chiede qual è il posto migliore per un'intervista del genere nello spazio umano, e tu indichi <destination>, dove i Quarg stanno costruendo il loro mondo ad anello. "Allora andare là, noi dobbiamo. Nelle tue mani io sarò, Capitano." Le mostri la cuccetta e imposti una rotta per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Quarg Interview|dialog|1985|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but your escort bringing Oobat hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta con Oobat non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|name|1992|0
units.english: Report Back
units.italian: Riferire

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|description|1993|0
units.english: Now that you and Oobat have interviewed the Quarg, head back to <destination> to inform the Lunarium leaders of how it went.
units.italian: Ora che tu e Oobat avete intervistato i Quarg, torna a <destination> per informare i leader del Lunarium di come è andata.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|Once you've docked in <origin>, you go check on Oobat, who's readying some form of camera while rehearsing the questions for the interview. "Just a moment Captain, ready in a minute I will be," she says. You head out of your ship and flag down the first Quarg you see.|2002|0
units.english: Once you've docked in <origin>, you go check on Oobat, who's readying some form of camera while rehearsing the questions for the interview. "Just a moment Captain, ready in a minute I will be," she says. You head out of your ship and flag down the first Quarg you see.
units.italian: Una volta attraccato su <origin>, vai a controllare Oobat, che sta preparando una specie di telecamera mentre ripassa le domande per l'intervista. "Solo un momento Capitano, pronta tra un minuto, io sarò," dice. Esci dalla nave e fermi il primo Quarg che vedi.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"How may I assist you, human?" it says.|2003|0
units.english: "How may I assist you, human?" it says.
units.italian: "Come posso esserti utile, umano?" dice.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"I've brought an Arach from the Coalition. She wants to interview the Quarg."|2005|0
units.english: "I've brought an Arach from the Coalition. She wants to interview the Quarg."
units.italian: "Ho portato un'Arach della Coalizione. Vuole intervistare i Quarg."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"I'm with a group from the Coalition, the Lunarium, who are fighting the Heliarchs. They want to talk to you, and have sent a diplomat with me."|2006|0
units.english: "I'm with a group from the Coalition, the Lunarium, who are fighting the Heliarchs. They want to talk to you, and have sent a diplomat with me."
units.italian: "Sono con un gruppo della Coalizione, il Lunarium, che combatte gli Heliarchs. Vogliono parlare con voi, e hanno mandato una diplomatica con me."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	It stays silent, glancing over at your ship. "I see," it says. "Wait here. I will bring one who can speak on the matter." It moves away in a quickstep, briefly talking to some other Quarg along the way, who come to your ship and wait. Oobat comes out of your ship as you wait, causing a minor scene as some of the humans visiting the station panic at the sight of a giant spider. Others come closer, intrigued by the unknown alien, or perhaps thinking her to be some form of prop. Oobat doesn't pay them much mind though, instead focusing on the Quarg near the two of you, and watching the others in the distance.|2007|0
units.english: It stays silent, glancing over at your ship. "I see," it says. "Wait here. I will bring one who can speak on the matter." It moves away in a quickstep, briefly talking to some other Quarg along the way, who come to your ship and wait. Oobat comes out of your ship as you wait, causing a minor scene as some of the humans visiting the station panic at the sight of a giant spider. Others come closer, intrigued by the unknown alien, or perhaps thinking her to be some form of prop. Oobat doesn't pay them much mind though, instead focusing on the Quarg near the two of you, and watching the others in the distance.
units.italian: Resta in silenzio, lanciando un'occhiata alla tua nave. "Capisco," dice. "Aspetta qui. Porterò uno che può parlare della questione." Si allontana a passo rapido, parlando brevemente con altri Quarg lungo la strada, che vengono alla tua nave e aspettano. Oobat esce dalla nave mentre aspettate, causando un piccolo putiferio: alcuni degli umani in visita alla stazione vanno nel panico alla vista di un ragno gigante. Altri si avvicinano, incuriositi dall'aliena sconosciuta, o magari convinti che sia una specie di scenografia. Oobat non ci fa troppo caso, però: si concentra sui Quarg vicino a voi due e osserva gli altri in lontananza.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	The Quarg around you dissuade the gawking humans from getting closer, and after a few more minutes a Quarg in faded, light gray robes comes to meet you. "Hello, human. And..."|2008|0
units.english: The Quarg around you dissuade the gawking humans from getting closer, and after a few more minutes a Quarg in faded, light gray robes comes to meet you. "Hello, human. And..."
units.italian: I Quarg intorno a voi dissuadono gli umani incuriositi dall'avvicinarsi, e dopo qualche altro minuto un Quarg in vesti chiare di un grigio slavato viene a incontrarvi. "Salve, umano. E..."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Oobat, my name is," she says. "A member of the Lunarium Redoubt, a group in the Coalition created to fight the Heliarchs, I am. Assisted us much, Captain <last> has, and bring me here now they did, for wish to ask you some questions about your views on the Coalition, my group does."|2009|0
units.english: "Oobat, my name is," she says. "A member of the Lunarium Redoubt, a group in the Coalition created to fight the Heliarchs, I am. Assisted us much, Captain <last> has, and bring me here now they did, for wish to ask you some questions about your views on the Coalition, my group does."
units.italian: "Oobat, il mio nome è," dice. "Un membro del Lunarium Redoubt, un gruppo nella Coalizione creato per combattere gli Heliarchs, io sono. Aiutato molto noi, il Capitano <last> lo ha, e portarmi qui ora lui lo ha, perché desidera farvi alcune domande sulle vostre opinioni sulla Coalizione, il mio gruppo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	The Quarg gazes at you two for a few seconds, before squatting down to your level. "Very well. What questions do you have?"|2010|0
units.english: The Quarg gazes at you two for a few seconds, before squatting down to your level. "Very well. What questions do you have?"
units.italian: Il Quarg vi fissa per qualche secondo, poi si accoscia al vostro livello. "Molto bene. Quali domande avete?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	She hands you the camera, turning it on and asking that you keep it as still as you can once you're positioned to get a good angle. She then connects her translator to it remotely, so that the audio picks up the Quarg's translated responses. "Well, begin then we shall. Regarding the very reason for the Coalition's formation, intending to fight us again, are you?"|2011|0
units.english: She hands you the camera, turning it on and asking that you keep it as still as you can once you're positioned to get a good angle. She then connects her translator to it remotely, so that the audio picks up the Quarg's translated responses. "Well, begin then we shall. Regarding the very reason for the Coalition's formation, intending to fight us again, are you?"
units.italian: Lei ti consegna la telecamera, la accende e ti chiede di tenerla il più ferma possibile una volta posizionato per ottenere una buona angolazione. Poi vi collega a distanza il suo traduttore, così che l'audio capti le risposte tradotte del Quarg. "Bene, cominciamo allora. Riguardo alla ragione stessa della formazione della Coalizione: intendete combatterci di nuovo, voi?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	It thinks for a moment, then answers, "No. We never intended to fight. It was the Saryds, Kimek and Arachi of old who fought us. We are not a warring people."|2012|0
units.english: It thinks for a moment, then answers, "No. We never intended to fight. It was the Saryds, Kimek and Arachi of old who fought us. We are not a warring people."
units.italian: Riflette un momento, poi risponde: "No. Non abbiamo mai avuto intenzione di combattere. Furono i Saryd, i Kimek e gli Arachi del passato a combatterci. Noi non siamo un popolo guerriero."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	Seemingly satisfied with the answer, Oobat moves on to the next. She questions the Quarg for about ten minutes on their activities outside the Coalition and their relation with the humans and other species. She even has you move the camera around for a bit to show the local human-Quarg interactions, as the Quarg compares dealing with humanity to dealing with the Coalition species. Oobat moves from question to question as if in a checklist, until she arrives at the last one. "About finished, we are. Thankful for your answers I am. Just one last thing, to appease the people back home. Interested in returning to take back the rings, are you?"|2013|0
units.english: Seemingly satisfied with the answer, Oobat moves on to the next. She questions the Quarg for about ten minutes on their activities outside the Coalition and their relation with the humans and other species. She even has you move the camera around for a bit to show the local human-Quarg interactions, as the Quarg compares dealing with humanity to dealing with the Coalition species. Oobat moves from question to question as if in a checklist, until she arrives at the last one. "About finished, we are. Thankful for your answers I am. Just one last thing, to appease the people back home. Interested in returning to take back the rings, are you?"
units.italian: Sembrando soddisfatta della risposta, Oobat passa alla successiva. Interroga il Quarg per circa dieci minuti sulle loro attività fuori dalla Coalizione e sul loro rapporto con gli umani e le altre specie. Ti fa persino muovere un po' la telecamera per mostrare le interazioni locali tra umani e Quarg, mentre il Quarg paragona il trattare con l'umanità al trattare con le specie della Coalizione. Oobat passa da una domanda all'altra come se seguisse una lista, finché non arriva all'ultima. "Quasi finiti, noi siamo. Grata per le vostre risposte, io sono. Solo un'ultima cosa, per placare la gente a casa. Interessati a tornare a riprendervi gli anelli, voi siete?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Of course," it says without hesitation. "The rings are our homes. My home." Clearly not expecting that answer, Oobat looks at you in confusion.|2014|0
units.english: "Of course," it says without hesitation. "The rings are our homes. My home." Clearly not expecting that answer, Oobat looks at you in confusion.
units.italian: "Certamente," dice senza esitare. "Gli anelli sono le nostre case. La mia casa." Chiaramente non aspettandosi quella risposta, Oobat ti guarda confusa.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"It's been thousands of years. You're still lingering on those rings?"|2016|0
units.english: "It's been thousands of years. You're still lingering on those rings?"
units.italian: "Sono passati migliaia di anni. State ancora a rimuginare su quegli anelli?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"If you want them back, why haven't you returned by now?"|2017|0
units.english: "If you want them back, why haven't you returned by now?"
units.italian: "Se li volete indietro, perché non siete tornati finora?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Lingering on... 'those' rings? Our rings. Our homes," it replies. "Do you so easily forget yours?" The Quarg crosses one arm, grabbing its shoulder, lowering its head as its back curves. Patches of skin start turning pitch black, and it brings its other arm to its head as if in pain.|2019|0
units.english: "Lingering on... 'those' rings? Our rings. Our homes," it replies. "Do you so easily forget yours?" The Quarg crosses one arm, grabbing its shoulder, lowering its head as its back curves. Patches of skin start turning pitch black, and it brings its other arm to its head as if in pain.
units.italian: "Rimuginare su... 'quei' anelli? I nostri anelli. Le nostre case," risponde. "Dimenticate così facilmente le vostre?" Il Quarg incrocia un braccio, afferrandosi la spalla, abbassando la testa mentre la schiena si curva. Chiazze di pelle cominciano a diventare nere come la pece, e porta l'altro braccio alla testa come se provasse dolore.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Because that would have forced a fight. The three... these Heliarchs, would not listen. They never listened," it answers, crossing one arm and grabbing its shoulder, lowering its head as its back curves. Patches of skin start turning pitch black, and it brings its other arm to its head as if in pain.|2022|0
units.english: "Because that would have forced a fight. The three... these Heliarchs, would not listen. They never listened," it answers, crossing one arm and grabbing its shoulder, lowering its head as its back curves. Patches of skin start turning pitch black, and it brings its other arm to its head as if in pain.
units.italian: "Perché questo avrebbe imposto uno scontro. I tre... questi Heliarchs, non avrebbero ascoltato. Non hanno mai ascoltato," risponde, incrociando un braccio e afferrandosi la spalla, abbassando la testa mentre la schiena si curva. Chiazze di pelle cominciano a diventare nere come la pece, e porta l'altro braccio alla testa come se provasse dolore.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	By now the atmosphere's changed, with no humans in sight around you. Dozens more Quarg begin to form circles around your ship, eyes fixated on Oobat. The ones closest to you watch the one who was being interviewed carefully, like waiting for some sign, as its whole body shifts color. Oobat is still looking at you, confusion and worry written on her face.|2024|0
units.english: By now the atmosphere's changed, with no humans in sight around you. Dozens more Quarg begin to form circles around your ship, eyes fixated on Oobat. The ones closest to you watch the one who was being interviewed carefully, like waiting for some sign, as its whole body shifts color. Oobat is still looking at you, confusion and worry written on her face.
units.italian: Ormai l'atmosfera è cambiata, e non c'è più nessun umano in vista intorno a voi. Dozzine di altri Quarg cominciano a formare cerchi intorno alla tua nave, gli occhi fissi su Oobat. Quelli più vicini a voi osservano con attenzione quello che veniva intervistato, come in attesa di qualche segno, mentre tutto il suo corpo cambia colore. Oobat ti sta ancora guardando, confusione e preoccupazione scritte sul viso.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"I think that does it for the interview."|2026|0
units.english: "I think that does it for the interview."
units.italian: "Direi che per l'intervista è tutto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"We should leave. Now."|2027|0
units.english: "We should leave. Now."
units.italian: "Dovremmo andarcene. Ora."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	She nods, and gives a quick "thank you" to the Quarg again, turning to go back inside your ship. The Quarg stops her though, reaching out one arm quickly to grab one of her legs. Slowly, its skin turns back to the grayish blue from before, as it calms down. "Should you succeed, please, permit my return home." The Quarg around you disperse, and the one who was interviewed stands up again and moves back to other sections of the station.|2028|0
units.english: She nods, and gives a quick "thank you" to the Quarg again, turning to go back inside your ship. The Quarg stops her though, reaching out one arm quickly to grab one of her legs. Slowly, its skin turns back to the grayish blue from before, as it calms down. "Should you succeed, please, permit my return home." The Quarg around you disperse, and the one who was interviewed stands up again and moves back to other sections of the station.
units.italian: Fa un cenno e rivolge di nuovo un rapido "grazie" al Quarg, voltandosi per tornare dentro la tua nave. Il Quarg però la ferma, allungando rapidamente un braccio per afferrarle una zampa. Lentamente, la sua pelle torna al grigio-blu di prima, mentre si calma. "Doveste riuscirci, vi prego, concedetemi di tornare a casa." I Quarg intorno a voi si disperdono, e quello che è stato intervistato si alza di nuovo e si allontana verso altre sezioni della stazione.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	You board your ship with Oobat, and hand her back the camera. "Mostly well, it went," she says, looking through the sped up footage and pausing at certain moments where the Quarg is responding. "Not what we expected from that last question, it was, however. Disappointed, I imagine Elirom will be." She tells you she'll be working on some basic edits to the footage, and says you may return to <planet>.|2029|0
units.english: You board your ship with Oobat, and hand her back the camera. "Mostly well, it went," she says, looking through the sped up footage and pausing at certain moments where the Quarg is responding. "Not what we expected from that last question, it was, however. Disappointed, I imagine Elirom will be." She tells you she'll be working on some basic edits to the footage, and says you may return to <planet>.
units.italian: Sali sulla nave con Oobat e le restituisci la telecamera. "Per lo più bene, è andata," dice, scorrendo il filmato accelerato e fermandosi in certi momenti in cui il Quarg risponde. "Non quello che ci aspettavamo da quell'ultima domanda, è stato, però. Deluso, immagino che Elirom sarà." Ti dice che lavorerà a qualche montaggio di base del filmato, e che puoi tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|dialog|2034|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but your escort bringing Oobat hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta con Oobat non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|When you and Oobat reach the Lunarium's complex, you're welcomed back by Chiree, Elirom and Tummug. "Tell you I did that come back safely, they would," Tummug says to Elirom. "So, good enough to use in our efforts, was it?"|2041|0
units.english: When you and Oobat reach the Lunarium's complex, you're welcomed back by Chiree, Elirom and Tummug. "Tell you I did that come back safely, they would," Tummug says to Elirom. "So, good enough to use in our efforts, was it?"
units.italian: Quando tu e Oobat raggiungete il complesso del Lunarium, vi accolgono Chiree, Elirom e Tummug. "Te l'avevo detto che sarebbero tornati sani e salvi," dice Tummug a Elirom. "Allora, abbastanza buono da usare nei nostri sforzi, è stato?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	Oobat shows them the recording, satisfaction clear on their faces as they listen to the Quarg. The mood darkens when the last question appears, however. Once it ends, Elirom stands up and heads to the nearest wall, slamming an arm onto it. Chiree sighs, and turns to Tummug, "Worth using still, is the footage?"|2042|0
units.english: Oobat shows them the recording, satisfaction clear on their faces as they listen to the Quarg. The mood darkens when the last question appears, however. Once it ends, Elirom stands up and heads to the nearest wall, slamming an arm onto it. Chiree sighs, and turns to Tummug, "Worth using still, is the footage?"
units.italian: Oobat mostra loro la registrazione, la soddisfazione chiara sui loro volti mentre ascoltano il Quarg. L'umore si incupisce quando però compare l'ultima domanda. Quando finisce, Elirom si alza e va verso la parete più vicina, colpendola con un braccio. Chiree sospira e si volta verso Tummug: "Ancora da usare, il filmato?"

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Up until that one? Yes, of course. Need to edit it for a cleaner, quicker video, we do, but a great piece it will be," he says. "That last part though, go as we expected, it did not."|2043|0
units.english: "Up until that one? Yes, of course. Need to edit it for a cleaner, quicker video, we do, but a great piece it will be," he says. "That last part though, go as we expected, it did not."
units.italian: "Fino a quella? Sì, certo. Bisogno di montarlo per un video più pulito e rapido, noi abbiamo, ma un pezzo eccezionale sarà," dice. "Quell'ultima parte però, andare come ci aspettavamo, non è andata."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Only prove the Heliarchs right, that last question would," Elirom chimes in. "Matter not, it does, if a thousand times the footage disproves their narrative. If even one thing, pick and spin as proof of their side they can, fruitless, the effort will be." He pauses, then hits the wall again, with less force. "Play it again, could you?" Oobat obliges, and plays the recording once again. Elirom has it paused a few times over the course of the video, breaking out a device to write down some notes. Once he's finished, he has the last portion repeated a few times still, seeming particularly interested in the Quarg's changing pigment. "Onyx black..." he ponders out loud, "what was, again, the emotion of that color?" Snapping out of the trance only after a few more repetitions, he hands Oobat the notes. "Right they were about the Quarg wanting to take the rings back... A shame it is, that use that point against them we cannot. Though, maybe, if interested in the rings they still are after so long..."|2044|0
units.english: "Only prove the Heliarchs right, that last question would," Elirom chimes in. "Matter not, it does, if a thousand times the footage disproves their narrative. If even one thing, pick and spin as proof of their side they can, fruitless, the effort will be." He pauses, then hits the wall again, with less force. "Play it again, could you?" Oobat obliges, and plays the recording once again. Elirom has it paused a few times over the course of the video, breaking out a device to write down some notes. Once he's finished, he has the last portion repeated a few times still, seeming particularly interested in the Quarg's changing pigment. "Onyx black..." he ponders out loud, "what was, again, the emotion of that color?" Snapping out of the trance only after a few more repetitions, he hands Oobat the notes. "Right they were about the Quarg wanting to take the rings back... A shame it is, that use that point against them we cannot. Though, maybe, if interested in the rings they still are after so long..."
units.italian: "Solo dare ragione agli Heliarchs, quell'ultima domanda farebbe," interviene Elirom. "Non importare, non importa, se mille volte il filmato smentisce la loro narrazione. Se anche una sola cosa, scegliere e rigirare come prova a sostegno della loro parte possono, inutile, lo sforzo sarà." Fa una pausa, poi colpisce di nuovo la parete, con meno forza. "Riprodurlo, potresti?" Oobat acconsente e riproduce di nuovo la registrazione. Elirom la mette in pausa alcune volte nel corso del video, tirando fuori un dispositivo per prendere appunti. Quando ha finito, fa ripetere ancora qualche volta l'ultima parte, sembrando particolarmente interessato al mutare del pigmento del Quarg. "Nero onice..." riflette ad alta voce, "qual era, ancora, l'emozione di quel colore?" Uscendo dalla trance solo dopo altre ripetizioni, consegna gli appunti a Oobat. "Avevano ragione sul fatto che i Quarg vogliono riprendersi gli anelli... Un peccato è, che usare quel punto contro di loro noi non possiamo. Anche se, forse, se interessati agli anelli sono ancora dopo tanto tempo..."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	He exits without saying anything else, leaving everyone else confused with his abrupt departure. "Much to take in at once, it must be, for him in particular. A Heliarch he once was, after all," Tummug says. "Get to work on perfecting the footage, and readying it for release to the public, we should."|2045|0
units.english: He exits without saying anything else, leaving everyone else confused with his abrupt departure. "Much to take in at once, it must be, for him in particular. A Heliarch he once was, after all," Tummug says. "Get to work on perfecting the footage, and readying it for release to the public, we should."
units.italian: Esce senza dire altro, lasciando tutti gli altri confusi dalla sua partenza brusca. "Molto da assimilare tutto insieme, deve essere, per lui in particolare. Un Heliarch, lui un tempo era, dopotutto," dice Tummug. "Mettersi al lavoro per perfezionare il filmato, e prepararlo per la diffusione al pubblico, noi dovremmo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	Oobat agrees, and the two prepare to leave with the footage. "A unique experience the trip was, Captain. Hope I do that work together again, we soon will."|2046|0
units.english: Oobat agrees, and the two prepare to leave with the footage. "A unique experience the trip was, Captain. Hope I do that work together again, we soon will."
units.italian: Oobat è d'accordo, e i due si preparano a partire con il filmato. "Un'esperienza unica, il viaggio è stata, Capitano. Sperare io spero che lavorare di nuovo insieme, noi presto lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Same here. It was different from my usual jobs, working a camera and all."|2048|0
units.english: "Same here. It was different from my usual jobs, working a camera and all."
units.italian: "Anche io. È stato diverso dai miei soliti lavori, con la telecamera e tutto il resto."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	"Anytime. Just, let's find some more normal people to interview, next time."|2049|0
units.english: "Anytime. Just, let's find some more normal people to interview, next time."
units.italian: "Quando vuoi. Solo, la prossima volta troviamo gente un po' più normale da intervistare."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	She chuckles, and nods before leaving the room, following Tummug out of the Lunarium complex.|2050|0
units.english: She chuckles, and nods before leaving the room, following Tummug out of the Lunarium complex.
units.italian: Ridacchia e fa un cenno prima di lasciare la stanza, seguendo Tummug fuori dal complesso del Lunarium.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	Chiree approaches you and hands you a small box. You pick it up, and upon cursory examination, notice it's one of the Coalition's translation devices. "One of us you now are, so capable of understanding what we say without others aiding you, you should be," she says. "Still readying ourselves for major assaults on the Heliarchs, we are. A difficult fight against them, we will have, all the way. Hoping, I am, that with your help we can count, when the time comes."|2053|0
units.english: Chiree approaches you and hands you a small box. You pick it up, and upon cursory examination, notice it's one of the Coalition's translation devices. "One of us you now are, so capable of understanding what we say without others aiding you, you should be," she says. "Still readying ourselves for major assaults on the Heliarchs, we are. A difficult fight against them, we will have, all the way. Hoping, I am, that with your help we can count, when the time comes."
units.italian: Chiree ti si avvicina e ti consegna una piccola scatola. La prendi e, a un esame rapido, noti che è uno dei dispositivi di traduzione della Coalizione. "Uno di noi ora tu sei, quindi capace di capire quello che diciamo senza che altri ti aiutino, tu dovresti essere," dice. "Ancora prepararci per grandi assalti agli Heliarchs, noi stiamo. Una battaglia difficile contro di loro, noi avremo, fino alla fine. Sperare, io sto sperando, che con il tuo aiuto contare, quando verrà il momento, noi potremo."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	You look to Chiree, and see her brushing her frontmost left leg with the tip of her right one, as if cleaning away something. Once she's done, you see various bolts and a metal texture revealed. "Lose two of my legs to a Heliarch attack, I did. Grown used to the prosthetics, I have, but faded from my memory, that day has not." She stares at you. "Aware, we are, that helped the Heliarchs before, you have. Ask about specifics, I did not, for wish to know, I do not. Harmless work, it may have been. Or, helped them mutilate others like me, you may have." She approaches you, handing you a small box: one of the Coalition's translation devices. "One of us, you now are. Hear of any more aid to the Heliarchs from your side, I will not."|2056|0
units.english: You look to Chiree, and see her brushing her frontmost left leg with the tip of her right one, as if cleaning away something. Once she's done, you see various bolts and a metal texture revealed. "Lose two of my legs to a Heliarch attack, I did. Grown used to the prosthetics, I have, but faded from my memory, that day has not." She stares at you. "Aware, we are, that helped the Heliarchs before, you have. Ask about specifics, I did not, for wish to know, I do not. Harmless work, it may have been. Or, helped them mutilate others like me, you may have." She approaches you, handing you a small box: one of the Coalition's translation devices. "One of us, you now are. Hear of any more aid to the Heliarchs from your side, I will not."
units.italian: Guardi Chiree e la vedi sfregare la zampa anteriore sinistra con la punta di quella destra, come se pulisse qualcosa. Quando ha finito, vedi bulloni e una trama metallica. "Perso due delle mie zampe in un attacco degli Heliarchs, io le ho. Abituata alle protesi, io sono, ma svanito dalla mia memoria, quel giorno non è." Ti fissa. "Consapevoli, noi siamo, che aiutato gli Heliarchs prima, tu lo hai. Chiedere dettagli, io non l'ho fatto, perché desiderio di sapere, io non ne ho. Lavoro innocuo, può essere stato. O, aiutato loro a mutilare altri come me, tu potresti averlo fatto." Si avvicina a te e ti consegna una piccola scatola: uno dei dispositivi di traduzione della Coalizione. "Uno di noi, ora tu sei. Sentire di altro aiuto agli Heliarchs dalla tua parte, io non lo farò."

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	You say your goodbyes, and you're escorted out of the complex and back to your ship. The Kimek who brought you there enter the ship with you briefly, and inform you that they've sent word across their major bases in the Coalition about your joining up. You're told that you'll find some new outfits available in their secretive outfitters. "In separate portions of the cities, sometimes in other cities entirely, our shops are, but safe from Heliarch patrols, they so far have proven." They give you a short list of the planets where you'll find their outfitters, and coordinates and instructions as to how to get to and access each of them.|2058|0
units.english: You say your goodbyes, and you're escorted out of the complex and back to your ship. The Kimek who brought you there enter the ship with you briefly, and inform you that they've sent word across their major bases in the Coalition about your joining up. You're told that you'll find some new outfits available in their secretive outfitters. "In separate portions of the cities, sometimes in other cities entirely, our shops are, but safe from Heliarch patrols, they so far have proven." They give you a short list of the planets where you'll find their outfitters, and coordinates and instructions as to how to get to and access each of them.
units.italian: Vi salutate, e vieni scortato fuori dal complesso e riportato alla tua nave. I Kimek che ti hanno portato lì entrano brevemente nella nave con te e ti informano che hanno mandato parola alle loro basi principali nella Coalizione del tuo ingresso nel gruppo. Ti dicono che troverai alcune nuove attrezzature nei loro fornitori segreti. "In parti separate delle città, a volte in città del tutto diverse, i nostri negozi sono, ma al sicuro dalle pattuglie degli Heliarchs, finora si sono dimostrati." Ti danno un breve elenco dei pianeti dove troverai i loro fornitori, con coordinate e istruzioni su come raggiungerli e accedervi.

units.id: mission:Lunarium: Join|	When they leave, you start tinkering with the translation device, figuring out how to configure it to translate each of the languages. After testing it using local transmissions and broadcasts for half an hour or so, you're decently fast with it, to the point where you can change what language it translates to or from a few times in a second.|2059|0
units.english: When they leave, you start tinkering with the translation device, figuring out how to configure it to translate each of the languages. After testing it using local transmissions and broadcasts for half an hour or so, you're decently fast with it, to the point where you can change what language it translates to or from a few times in a second.
units.italian: Quando se ne vanno, cominci a smanettare con il dispositivo di traduzione, cercando di capire come configurarlo per tradurre ciascuna delle lingue. Dopo averlo provato usando trasmissioni e comunicazioni locali per una mezz'ora circa, ci prendi una discreta dimestichezza, al punto da poter cambiare la lingua da cui o verso cui traduce un paio di volte al secondo.
